function toOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalOrderDto {
  const data = asRecord(row.data);
  const createdAt = timestamp(row.createdAt);
  const safeData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of customerVisibleOrderFields) {
    if (key in data) safeData[key] = data[key];
  }
  const items = Array.isArray(safeData.items)
    ? safeData.items.filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))
      .map((item) => ({
        id: typeof item.id === 'string' ? item.id : '',
        productName: typeof item.productName === 'string' ? item.productName : '',
        productUrl: typeof item.productUrl === 'string' ? item.productUrl : '',
        quantity: typeof item.quantity === 'number' ? item.quantity : 0,
        productPrice: typeof item.productPrice === 'number' ? item.productPrice : 0,
        weight: typeof item.weight === 'number' ? item.weight : 0,
        cbm: typeof item.cbm === 'number' ? item.cbm : 0,
        length: typeof item.length === 'number' ? item.length : 0,
        width: typeof item.width === 'number' ? item.width : 0,
        height: typeof item.height === 'number' ? item.height : 0,
        trackingNumber: typeof item.trackingNumber === 'string' ? item.trackingNumber : '',
      }))
    : [];

  return {
    ...safeData,
    id: String(row.orderId),
    orderNumber: String(row.orderNumber),
    trackingNumber: String(row.trackingNumber ?? row.orderNumber),
    status: String(data.status ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    orderStatus: String(data.orderStatus ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    createdAt: typeof data.createdAt === 'number' ? data.createdAt : createdAt,
    updatedAt: typeof data.updatedAt === 'number' ? data.updatedAt : createdAt,
    items,

/**
 * site-content.schemas.ts
 * مخططات التحقق لوحدة محتوى الموقع — قراءات إدارية ومخرجات كتابة صارمة.
 * Validation schemas for the site content module: admin list queries and strict write payloads.
 */
import { z } from 'zod';

/** قائمة إدارية مرقّمة؛ `search` و`status` اختياريان ويُهما عند الفراغ. */
export const siteContentListSchema = z.object({
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).default(50),
  offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0),
  search: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(120)
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : undefined))
    .optional(),
  status: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(40)
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : undefined))
    .optional(),
});

/** رد الدعم — النص مطلوب ومحدود؛ اسم المرسل يُفرض خادميًا لا من العميل. */
export const ticketReplySchema = z
  .object({
    message: z.string().trim().min(1).max(4000),
  })
  .strict();

export const announcementPrioritySchema = z.enum(['normal', 'high', 'urgent']);
export const announcementAudienceSchema = z.enum(['all', 'customer', 'courier', 'supplier']);

const announcementBase = {
  title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(300),
  content: z.string().trim().min(1).max(8000),
  targetAudience: announcementAudienceSchema,
  priority: announcementPrioritySchema,
  isActive: z.boolean(),
};

/** إنشاء إعلان: كل الحقول مطلوبة لأن الإعلان يُقرأ لاحقًا من نفس الشكل. */
export const createAnnouncementSchema = z.object(announcementBase).strict();

/** تعديل إعلان: تُقبل الحقول الجزئية فقط؛ `isActive` وحدها تكفي لتبديل الإظهار. */
export const updateAnnouncementSchema = z.object(announcementBase).partial().strict().refine(
  (value) => Object.keys(value).length > 0,
  { message: 'At least one announcement field must be provided.' },
);

/** حالة طلب التوظيف — نص قصير مقيد بالقيم المستعملة فعليًا في الواجهة. */
export const jobApplicationStatusSchema = z.object({ status: z.string().trim().min(2).max(40) }).strict();

function toOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): PortalOrderDto {
  const data = asRecord(row.data);
  const createdAt = timestamp(row.createdAt);
  const safeData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of customerVisibleOrderFields) {
    if (key in data) safeData[key] = data[key];
  }
  const items = Array.isArray(safeData.items)
    ? safeData.items.filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))
      .map((item) => ({
        id: typeof item.id === 'string' ? item.id : '',
        productName: typeof item.productName === 'string' ? item.productName : '',
        productUrl: typeof item.productUrl === 'string' ? item.productUrl : '',
        quantity: typeof item.quantity === 'number' ? item.quantity : 0,
        productPrice: typeof item.productPrice === 'number' ? item.productPrice : 0,
        weight: typeof item.weight === 'number' ? item.weight : 0,
        cbm: typeof item.cbm === 'number' ? item.cbm : 0,
        length: typeof item.length === 'number' ? item.length : 0,
        width: typeof item.width === 'number' ? item.width : 0,
        height: typeof item.height === 'number' ? item.height : 0,
        trackingNumber: typeof item.trackingNumber === 'string' ? item.trackingNumber : '',
      }))
    : [];

  return {
    ...safeData,
    id: String(row.orderId),
    orderNumber: String(row.orderNumber),
    trackingNumber: String(row.trackingNumber ?? row.orderNumber),
    status: String(data.status ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    orderStatus: String(data.orderStatus ?? row.orderStatus ?? 'pending'),
    createdAt: typeof data.createdAt === 'number' ? data.createdAt : createdAt,
    updatedAt: typeof data.updatedAt === 'number' ? data.updatedAt : createdAt,
    items,
  };
}

BEGIN

  END IF;
END

This is a genuine bug introduced by the flat rewrite. `getNotification`, `createNotification` readback, and `markAsRead` use `${notificationSelect} WHERE ...` which is correct. Only `listNotifications` is broken (it duplicates the FROM).

Better: restructure into two constants: `SELECT_COLUMNS` and `FROM_CLAUSE`, then:
- base select = `${SELECT_COLUMNS} ${FROM_CLAUSE}`
- list = `${SELECT_COLUMNS}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total ${FROM_CLAUSE} ${where} ORDER BY ... LIMIT ...`

67	async function page(
68	  pool: Pool,
69	  table: string,
70	  columns: string,
71	  order: string,
72	  input: PageQuery,
73	  searchColumns: string[],
74	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
75	  const values: unknown[] = [];
76	  const filters: string[] = [];
77	  if (input.search) {
78	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
79	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
80	  }
81	  if (input.customerId) {
82	    values.push(input.customerId);
83	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
84	  }
85	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
86	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
87	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
88	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
89	    values,
90	  );
91	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
92	}

## Defect map: why the "حساب مالي" list renders empty

**Root cause (field-name mismatch, no HTTP error):** `alx_api` returns account rows with `subAccountId`, `accountNameAr`, `currencyNo` (`F:\system\swiftship-tracker\swiftshift2\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.repository.ts:21`, schema `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.schemas.ts:191-213`). Only `mapAccountRow` (`src\services\financeApi.ts:82-112`) renames them to the legacy `accSubId / accNameAr / curNo`. Every subscriber path below bypasses that mapper and filters on the legacy names.

- **D1 — Orders data hook drops 100% of accounts.** `src\features\orders\hooks\useOrderData.ts:239-259`: the accounts subscription filters `Boolean(account.accSubId || account.acc_sub_id)` (line 245). The API field is `subAccountId`, so the array is always `[]`. This single defect empties surfaces (1) create-order payment (`src\components\orders\CreateOrderModal.tsx:316-321` → `src\features\orders\components\create-order-modal\CreateOrderStep4.tsx:409`) and (2) COD/payment dialog (`src\components\orders\PaymentModal.tsx:124-133`). Fix: read `account.subAccountId ?? account.accSubId ?? account.acc_sub_id` (or run rows through `mapAccountRow`).
- **D2 — `EditOrderModal` gets no `financialAccounts` prop at all.** Parent renders it without the prop (`src\features\orders\pages\subcomponents\OrdersPageDialogs.tsx:294-312`), while `EditOrderModal.tsx:73,152` defaults it to `[]`, so `cashAccountsList/bankAccountsList` (`:167-172`) are empty. Fix: pass `financialAccounts={financialAccounts}`.
- **D3 — Auto entries still read legacy Supabase, never the API.** `src\components\OrderStatusManagementTab.tsx:7` imports `db/collection/onSnapshot` from `data/legacy/legacy-compat` and loads accounts at `:144-146` (`collection(db,'accounts')`). This explains "no request to `/api/v1/finance/accounts`": the dropdown (`:1097`, `:1152`) is fed from Supabase only. Fix: replace with `financialAccountService.getAllAccounts()` / API subscription and map `entityType === 'system'` rows.
- **D4 — Finance-accounting gateway does not normalize legacy names.** `src\components\financeAccounting\FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:35-40` maps only `id`/`accountName`; rows keep `subAccountId`/`accountNameAr`. Consumers then filter on `accSubId`/`isPosting`: `src\components\financeAccounting\useFinanceAccountingSelectors.ts:280,300-307`, `src\components\finance\forms\VoucherEntryForm.tsx:259,263` (`a.isPosting` is never set on these rows → empty cash/bank lists), `GeneralEntryForm.tsx:498`, `CompoundEntryForm.tsx:500`, `CustodyAdvancesTab.tsx:43-44`. Fix: apply `mapAccountRow` + derive `isPosting` in `normalizeRows`.
- **D5 — Silent catches mask permission/403 failures.** `src\services\financialAccountService.ts:588-594` returns `[]` on error; `src\features\financeEntries\pages\FinanceEntriesPage.tsx:84` `.catch(() => ({ data: [] }))` swallows a 403 from `route('view_financial_accounts', …)` (`alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.routes.ts:105`), leaving the entries/vouchers picker empty with no visible error.
- **D6 — Page-size truncation.** `src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:23` and `FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:67-70` fetch `limit: 100` only, no paging.

Field names the UI expects: `id, name, accNameAr, accountCode, currency, curNo, accSubId ('111'/'112'), isPosting, isActive, entityType, entityId, entityName` — API gives `accountId, accountNameAr, currencyNo, subAccountId` and no `isPosting`.

docs\old\financial_entries_rearchitecture_plan.md:148:تستبدل واجهة `financialAccountService.recordJournalEntry` و`recordTransaction` تدريجيًا بخدمة `financialEntryService` موحدة. ستوفر الخدمة واجهات مثل `createEntry`, `updateDraftEntry`, `postTemporaryEntry`, `reverseEntry`, `voidEntry`, `getEntryDetail` و`getAccountMovement`. تستدعي جميعها إجراء RPC واحدًا في PostgreSQL لكل عملية حرجة، بدل تنفيذ `batch` من المتصفح عبر جداول متعددة.

45	/**
46	 * يبحث عن حساب بكوده المحاسبي — يستعمل للمراجع التاريخية المكتوبة بصيغة قديمة.
47	 * Looks an account up by its code; used for historical references written in the legacy id format.
48	 */
49	async function findAccountByCode(accountCode: string): Promise<FinancialAccount | null> {
50	  const code = String(accountCode || '').trim();
51	  if (!code) return null;
52	  const rows = await readAllFinanceRows(ACCOUNTS_PATH, { search: code, includeInactive: true });
53	  const matched = rows.find((row) => String(row?.accountCode ?? '') === code);
54	  return matched ? mapAccountRow(matched) : null;
55	}

160	  /**
161	   * Get account by account ID directly
162	   */
163	  async getAccountById(accountId: string): Promise<FinancialAccount | null> {
164	    const id = String(accountId || '').trim();
165	    if (!id) return null;
166	    try {
167	      const direct = await readFinanceRecord(`${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
168	      if (direct) return mapAccountRow(direct);
169	
170	      // جسر قراءة للمراجع التاريخية فقط: «acc_1130_0001» → «1130-0001».
171	      // Read bridge for historical references written in the legacy underscore format.
172	      const legacyCode = id.replace(/^acc_/, '').replace(/_/g, '-');
173	      if (legacyCode && legacyCode !== id) {
174	        const byCode = await findAccountByCode(legacyCode);
175	        if (byCode) return byCode;
176	      }
177	
178	      // خريطة ترحيل المعرفات — account_id_migration_map through the API.
179	      const mapping = await readFinanceRecord(
180	        `/api/v1/finance/account-id-map?oldAccountId=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
181	      );
182	      const mappedAccountId = String((mapping as { newAccountId?: string } | null)?.newAccountId ?? '').trim();
183	      if (mappedAccountId) {
184	        const mappedAccount = await readFinanceRecord(`${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(mappedAccountId)}`);
185	        if (mappedAccount) return mapAccountRow(mappedAccount);
186	      }
187	
188	      // Fallback: search by entityId if not found by primary account id
189	      return this.getAccountByEntityId(id);
190	    } catch (error) {
191	      console.error(
192	        "[FinancialAccountService] Error fetching account by ID:",
193	        error,
194	      );
195	      return null;
196	    }
197	  }

199	  /**
200	   * Complete unified double-entry journal voucher posting system.
201	   * Creates a master entry in the `main_entry` collection,
202	   * leg entries in `account_trans`, updates both balances,
203	   * and updates corresponding parent entities, entirely atomically.
204	   */
205	  async recordJournalEntry(
206	    entry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id">,
207	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },//مهم:يجب تغييرها من ثابته الى جلب من قاعده البيانات
208	  ): Promise<string> {
209	    if (providedRates) {
210	      console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] تم تجاهل أسعار التحويل الممررة؛ يعتمد المسار الذري على مراجع سعر صرف مثبتة من قاعدة البيانات فقط.');
211	    }
212	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(entry.debitAccountId);
213	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(entry.creditAccountId);
214	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
215	      throw new Error('One or more financial accounts not found in ledger register.');
216	    }
217	    if (!accountingHierarchyService.isPostingAccount(debitAccount) || !accountingHierarchyService.isPostingAccount(creditAccount)) {
218	      throw new Error('Journal entries may only use active financial posting accounts.');
219	    }
220	
221	    const result = await financialEntryService.createFromLegacyVoucher({
222	      entryNumber: entry.entryNumber,
223	      createdAt: entry.createdAt || Date.now(),
224	      description: entry.description,
225	      attachments: entry.attachments,
226	      notes: entry.notes,
227	      amount: entry.amount,
228	      currency: entry.currency,
229	      amountDebitCurrency: entry.amountDebitCurrency,
230	      amountCreditCurrency: entry.amountCreditCurrency,
231	      module: entry.module,
232	      refNumber: entry.refNumber,
233	      orderId: entry.orderId,
234	      shipmentId: entry.shipmentId,
235	      automationKey: entry.automationKey,
236	      autoRuleId: entry.autoRuleId,
237	      isAutomatic: entry.isAutomatic,
238	      createdByUid: entry.createdByUid,
239	      paymentMethod: (entry as any).paymentMethod,
240	      // تمرير postingStatus من القيد — forward postingStatus from main entry for autoPost support
241	      postingStatus: entry.postingStatus || 'posted',
242	    }, {
243	      id: debitAccount.id!, curNo: debitAccount.curNo, currency: debitAccount.currency,
244	      entityType: debitAccount.entityType, entityId: debitAccount.entityId,
245	    }, {
246	      id: creditAccount.id!, curNo: creditAccount.curNo, currency: creditAccount.currency,
247	      entityType: creditAccount.entityType, entityId: creditAccount.entityId,
248	    });
249	
250	    activityLogService.log(
251	      "financial_transaction" as any,
252	      debitAccount.entityName + " / " + creditAccount.entityName,
253	      {
254	        type: "Double-Entry-Unified",
255	        amount: entry.amount,
256	        currency: entry.currency,
257	        refNumber: entry.refNumber,
258	        entryNumber: entry.entryNumber,
259	      },
260	    );
261	
262	    return result.id;
263	  }

265	  /**
266	   * Record a true double-entry transaction (Debit one account, Credit another)
267	   */
268	  async recordDoubleEntryTransaction(
269	    debitAccountId: string,
270	    creditAccountId: string,
271	    transactionData: Omit<AccountTransaction, "id" | "type" | "currency">,
272	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },
273	  ): Promise<void> {
274	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(debitAccountId);
275	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(creditAccountId);
276	
277	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
278	      throw new Error(
279	        "Debit or Credit account does not exist in chart registry.",
280	      );
281	    }
282	
283	    const now = transactionData.createdAt || Date.now();
284	    const entryNumber =
285	      transactionData.refNumber ||
286	      `JV-${now}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
287	
288	    const journalEntry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id"> = {
289	      entryNumber,
290	      createdAt: now,
291	      description: transactionData.description || "",
292	      attachments: (transactionData as any).attachments || [],
293	      notes:
294	        (transactionData as any).notes || transactionData.description || "",
295	
296	      debitAccountId,
297	      debitAccountName: debitAccount.entityName,
298	      debitAccountCode: debitAccount.accountCode,
299	
300	      creditAccountId,
301	      creditAccountName: creditAccount.entityName,
302	      creditAccountCode: creditAccount.accountCode,
303	
304	      amount: transactionData.amountOriginal,
305	      currency: transactionData.currencyOriginal,
306	      amountDebitCurrency: 0, // Computed dynamically in recordJournalEntry
307	      amountCreditCurrency: 0, // Computed dynamically in recordJournalEntry
308	
309	      module: transactionData.module || "adjustment",
310	      refNumber: transactionData.refNumber || "",
311	      createdByUid: transactionData.createdByUid || "system",
312	      createdByName: transactionData.createdByName || "Finance System Admin",
313	    };
314	
315	    await this.recordJournalEntry(journalEntry, providedRates);
316	  }

318	  /**
319	   * Centralized, unified and strict recordTransaction method.
320	   * Enforces that every transaction defines a source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account,
321	   * checks that the transaction amounts are fully balanced,
322	   * and registers the unified transaction accordingly.
323	   */
324	  async recordTransaction(
325	    transaction: Transaction,
326	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },
327	  ): Promise<void> {
328	    // 1. Enforce strict requirement: Must explicitly define source (Credit) and destination (Debit)
329	    if (!transaction.debitAccount?.id || !transaction.creditAccount?.id) {
330	      throw new Error(
331	        "Transaction submission rejected: A source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account are explicitly required.",
332	      );
333	    }
334	
335	    // 2. Prevent any transaction submission where totalDebit !== totalCredit
336	    // On the single value amount double entry form, the debit and credit totals are inherently equal to this amount.
337	    const debitTotal = transaction.amount;
338	    const creditTotal = transaction.amount;
339	    if (debitTotal !== creditTotal) {
340	      throw new Error(
341	        "Transaction submission rejected: Sum of Debits must equal Sum of Credits (totalDebit == totalCredit). debitTotal=" + debitTotal + "creditTotal=" + creditTotal,
342	      );
343	    } else if (debitTotal <= 0) {
344	      throw new Error(
345	        "Transaction submission rejected: Debit Amount must be greater than zero.",
346	      );
347	    } else if (creditTotal <= 0) {
348	      throw new Error(
349	        "Transaction submission rejected: Credit Amount must be greater than zero.",
350	      );
351	    }
352	
353	
354	
355	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(transaction.debitAccount.id);
356	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(
357	      transaction.creditAccount.id,
358	    );
359	
360	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
361	      throw new Error(
362	        "Transaction submission rejected: Specified accounts do not exist.",
363	      );
364	    }
365	
366	    const journalEntry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id"> = {
367	      entryNumber:
368	        (transaction as any).entryNumber ||
369	        transaction.automationKey ||
370	        `JV-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replaceAll('-', '')}-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
371	      createdAt: transaction.date || Date.now(),
372	      description: transaction.description || "",
373	      attachments: transaction.attachments || [],
374	      notes: transaction.notes || transaction.description || "",
375	
376	      debitAccountId: transaction.debitAccount.id,
377	      debitAccountName: debitAccount.entityName,
378	      debitAccountCode: debitAccount.accountCode,
379	
380	      creditAccountId: transaction.creditAccount.id,
381	      creditAccountName: creditAccount.entityName,
382	      creditAccountCode: creditAccount.accountCode,
383	
384	      amount: transaction.amount,
385	      currency: transaction.currency || debitAccount.currency || "YER",
386	      amountDebitCurrency: 0,
387	      amountCreditCurrency: 0,
388	
389	      module: transaction.module || "adjustment",
390	      refNumber: transaction.refNumber || "",
391	      orderId: transaction.orderId,
392	      orderNumber: transaction.orderNumber,
393	      shipmentId: transaction.shipmentId,
394	      automationKey: transaction.automationKey,
395	      autoRuleId: transaction.autoRuleId,
396	      statusId: transaction.statusId,
397	      isAutomatic: transaction.isAutomatic,
398	      amountSources: transaction.amountSources,
399	      amountBreakdown: transaction.amountBreakdown,
400	      // تمرير postingStatus إذا مُرِّر من القيد التلقائي — forward postingStatus if provided (for autoPost support)
401	      postingStatus: (transaction as any).postingStatus || 'posted',
402	      createdByUid: transaction.createdByUid || "system",
403	      createdByName: transaction.createdByName || "Audit Engine",
404	    };
405	
406	    await this.recordJournalEntry(journalEntry, providedRates);
407	  }

492	  /**
493	   * Fetches current exchange rates from the `cur_price` table in Supabase via currencyService.
494	   * الأسعار ديناميكية كاملاً من جداول currency + cur_price — لا أسعار ثابتة.
495	   */
496	  async getExchangeRates(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
497	    try {
498	      const activeCurrencies = await currencyService.getActiveCurrencies();
499	      if (!activeCurrencies.length) {
500	        throw new Error('لا توجد عملات نشطة يمكن التحقق من أسعارها.');
501	      }
502	      const rates: Record<string, number> = {};
503	      for (const currency of activeCurrencies) {
504	        const code = String(currency.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
505	        const price = currency.isDefault ? 1 : Number(currency.currentPrice);
506	        if (!code || !Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) {
507	          throw new Error(`لا يوجد سعر صرف موثق للعملة ${code || '[unknown]'}.`);
508	        }
509	        rates[code] = price;
510	      }
511	      return rates;
512	    } catch (e) {
513	      console.error('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر تحميل أسعار الصرف الموثقة؛ أُوقف إنشاء القيد بدل استخدام سعر احتياطي.', e);
514	      throw e;
515	    }
516	  }

518	  /**
519	   * Validates if a currency is active (isActive = true).
520	   * Throws an error if the currency is disabled to prevent voucher/transaction creation.
521	   */
522	  async validateCurrencyActive(currencyCode: string): Promise<boolean> {
523	    if (!currencyCode) return true;
524	    const activeCurrencies = await currencyService.getActiveCurrencies();
525	    const isAvailable = activeCurrencies.some(
526	      (c) => c.code.toUpperCase() === currencyCode.toUpperCase()
527	    );
528	    if (!isAvailable) {
529	      throw new Error(`العملة (${currencyCode}) معطلة حالياً في النظام ولا يمكن إنشاء قيد بها.`);
530	    }
531	    return true;
532	  }

534	  /**
535	   * Universal Currency Converter
536	   * تحويل مبلغ من عملة إلى أخرى باستخدام خريطة أسعار الصرف.
537	   *
538	   * المنطق:
539	   *   rates[X] = كم وحدة من العملة الأساس تساوي 1 وحدة من X
540	   *   العملة الأساس (isDefault=true) لها rate=1
541	   *   تحويل A → B = amount * rates[A] / rates[B]
542	   *
543	   * لا يوجد افتراض بأن YER هي العملة الأساس — العملة الأساس هي التي rate=1
544	   */
545	    convertToTargetCurrency(
546	    amount: number,
547	    fromCurrency: string,
548	    targetCurrency: string,
549	    exchangeRates: Record<string, number | undefined>,
550	  ): number {
551	    return convertToTargetCurrencyValue(amount, fromCurrency, targetCurrency, exchangeRates);
552	  }

623	  /**
624	   * Compute a ledger summary for a given account (total debit, credit, net balance)
625	   * by summing all account_trans for that account.
626	   * Useful for reconciliation and audit reports.
627	   * الملخص يعتمد أسطر القيود المرحّلة فقط (posting_status='posted') كما يعيدها API.
628	   */
629	  async getLedgerSummary(
630	    accountId: string,
631	  ): Promise<{ debit: number; credit: number; net: number; count: number }> {
632	    try {
633	      const movements = await readAllFinanceRows(
634	        `${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/movements`,
635	      );
636	      let debit = 0;
637	      let credit = 0;
638	      for (const movement of movements) {
639	        const amount = Number(movement?.amount ?? 0);
640	        if (movement?.transType === 'Debit') debit += amount;
641	        else credit += amount;
642	      }
643	      return { debit, credit, net: debit - credit, count: movements.length };
644	    } catch (error) {
645	      console.error(
646	        "[FinancialAccountService] Error computing ledger summary:",
647	        error,
648	      );
649	      return { debit: 0, credit: 0, net: 0, count: 0 };
650	    }
651	  }

653	  /**
654	   * يطلب من قاعدة البيانات إعادة احتساب رصيد الحساب من account_trans فقط.
655	   * لا يسمح هذا المسار للواجهة بإعادة بناء الرصيد من جداول ملغاة.
656	   * Asks the database to rebuild the balance from posted ledger lines only.
657	   */
658	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
659	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
660	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
661	    try {
662	      const accountPath = `${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}`;
663	      const account = await readFinanceRecord(accountPath);
664	      if (!account) {
665	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);
666	        return 0;
667	      }
668	      await recalculateAccountBalances([accountId]);
669	      const refreshedAccount = await readFinanceRecord(accountPath);
670	      return Number(mapAccountRow(refreshedAccount)?.balance ?? 0);
671	    } catch (error) {
672	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
673	      return 0;
674	    }
675	  }
676	
677	  /**
678	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
679	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
680	   */
681	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
682	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
683	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
684	    }
685	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
686	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
687	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
688	    }, delayMs);
689	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
690	  }
691	
692	  /**

695	   * The database function processes every account in one call and reports how many were recalculated.
696	   */
697	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{ processed: number; errors: number }> {
698	    try {

700	      return { processed: summary.recalculatedCount, errors: summary.success ? 0 : 1 };
701	    } catch (error) {
702	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error recalculating balances:", error);
703	      return { processed: 0, errors: 1 };
704	    }
705	  }

747	  /**
748	   * Safe seed or retrieve automatic voucher rules from the settings document
749	   * يقرأ قواعد القيود التلقائية من وثيقة الإعدادات ويبذر الناقص منها.
750	   */
751	  async ensureAutomaticVoucherRules(): Promise<any[]> {
752	    const normalizedDefaultRules = buildDefaultAutomaticVoucherRules();
753	
754	    try {
755	      const record = await readSettingsRecord('automatic_voucher_rules');
756	      const storedRules = (record?.settings as { data?: unknown } | undefined)?.data;
757	      const currentRules: any[] = Array.isArray(storedRules) ? storedRules : [];
758	
759	      const existingRulesIds = new Set(currentRules.map((rule) => rule?.id));
760	      const missingRules = normalizedDefaultRules.filter((rule: any) => !existingRulesIds.has(rule.id));
761	      if (record && missingRules.length === 0) return currentRules;
762	
763	      const mergedRules = [...currentRules, ...missingRules];
764	      try {
765	        await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/settings/automatic_voucher_rules', {
766	          settings: { data: mergedRules },
767	        });
768	      } catch (writeError) {
769	        // الحفظ يحتاج edit_general_settings؛ القارئ بلا صلاحية يستعمل القواعد المدموجة محلياً.
770	        // Seeding needs edit_general_settings; a read-only user still gets the merged rules locally.
771	        console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر حفظ قواعد القيود التلقائية في الإعدادات:', writeError);
772	      }
773	
774	      return mergedRules;
775	    } catch (e) {
776	      console.error(
777	        "[FinancialAccountService] Failed to seed automatic voucher rules:",
778	        e,
779	      );
780	      return normalizedDefaultRules;
781	    }
782	  }

794	  /**
795	   * Completely purges a financial entity (customer, courier, or user) and all its financial footprint.
796	   * Steps:
797	   * 1. Finds the associated account in `accounts` table.
798	   * 2. If account exists, finds all `account_trans` legs linked to this account.
799	   * 3. For each transaction leg:
800	   *    - Collects the opposite account ID (if it's a double-entry with another account).
801	   *    - Deletes both legs of the double entry.
802	   *    - Deletes the associated master `main_entry` document.
803	   * 4. Deletes the `accounts` document.
804	   * 5. Deletes the core entity document (from `customers`, `couriers`, or `users`).
805	   * 6. Recalculates and synces balances for all opposite accounts affected by the deletions.
806	   */
807	  async purgeEntityAndFinancialFootprint(
808	    entityType: PurgeableEntityType,
809	    entityId: string
810	  ): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
811	    return purgeEntityAndFinancialFootprint(this, entityType, entityId);
812	  }

125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.

127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}

152	  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? '') === key);

159	  const res = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ result?: { success?: boolean; recalculatedCount?: number } }>>(
160	    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/recalculate',
161	    accountIds && accountIds.length > 0 ? { accountIds } : {},
162	  );
163	  const result = res?.data?.result ?? {};
164	  return {
165	    success: result.success !== false,
166	    recalculatedCount: Number(result.recalculatedCount ?? accountIds?.length ?? 0),

79	function isEntityRecord(value: unknown): value is EntityRecord {
80	  return isRecord(value) && typeof value.id === 'string';
81	}
82	
83	function isCustomerRecord(value: unknown): value is CustomerRecord {
84	  return isEntityRecord(value);
85	}
86	
87	function isEmployeeRecord(value: unknown): value is EmployeeRecord {
88	  return isEntityRecord(value);

96	  return isEntityRecord(value);

99	function parseOrderRecord(value: unknown): OrderRecord | null {
100	  if (!isEntityRecord(value)) return null;
101	  const orderStatusId = value.orderStatusId;
102	  const amountRemaining = value.amountRemaining;
103	  const createdAt = value.createdAt;
104	  return {
105	    ...value,
106	    id: value.id,
107	    orderStatus: readText(value.orderStatus) ?? undefined,
108	    status: readText(value.status) ?? undefined,
109	    orderNumber: readText(value.orderNumber) ?? undefined,
110	    customerId: readText(value.customerId) ?? undefined,
111	    orderStatusId:
112	      typeof orderStatusId === 'string' || typeof orderStatusId === 'number'
113	        ? orderStatusId
114	        : undefined,
115	    orderSourceName: readText(value.orderSourceName) ?? undefined,
116	    orderSourceType: readText(value.orderSourceType) ?? undefined,
117	    customerName: readText(value.customerName) ?? undefined,
118	    customerPhone: readText(value.customerPhone) ?? undefined,
119	    amountPaid:
120	      typeof value.amountPaid === 'string' || typeof value.amountPaid === 'number'
121	        ? value.amountPaid
122	        : undefined,
123	    amountRemaining:
124	      typeof amountRemaining === 'string'
125	        ? amountRemaining
126	        : typeof amountRemaining === 'number'
127	          ? String(amountRemaining)
128	          : amountRemaining === null
129	            ? null
130	            : undefined,
131	    currency: readText(value.currency) ?? undefined,
132	    exchangeRateUSD:
133	      typeof value.exchangeRateUSD === 'number' ? value.exchangeRateUSD : undefined,
134	    exchangeRateSAR:
135	      typeof value.exchangeRateSAR === 'number' ? value.exchangeRateSAR : undefined,
136	    createdAt:
137	      typeof createdAt === 'string' || typeof createdAt === 'number' ? createdAt : undefined,
138	  };
139	}

141	function parseShipmentRecord(value: unknown): ShipmentRecord | null {
142	  if (!isEntityRecord(value)) return null;
143	  return {
144	    ...value,
145	    id: value.id,
146	    status: readText(value.status) ?? undefined,
147	    shipmentStatus: readText(value.shipmentStatus) ?? undefined,
148	    shippingCompany: readText(value.shippingCompany) ?? undefined,
149	    courier_id: readText(value.courier_id) ?? undefined,
150	    orderId: readText(value.orderId) ?? undefined,
151	    createdAt: readNumber(value.createdAt),
152	  };
153	}
154	
155	function isRuleRecord(value: unknown): value is AutoVoucherRule {
156	  return isRecord(value);
157	}
158	
159	function isRuleRecordArray(value: unknown): value is AutoVoucherRule[] {
160	  return Array.isArray(value) && value.every(isRuleRecord);
161	}
162	
163	function readText(value: unknown): string | null {
164	  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
165	}
166	
167	function readNumber(value: unknown): number {
168	  if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
169	  if (typeof value === 'string') return Number(value);
170	  return Number(value === null ? null : undefined);
171	}

274	      if (record && isRuleRecordArray(record.data)) {
275	        setAutoVoucherRules(record.data);
276	      }
277	    });
278

283	            ...record,
284	            id: record.id,
285	            name: readText(record.name) || 'بدون اسم',

291	          'FIRESTORE ERROR ON shipping_companies SNAPSHOT LISTENER IN ORDERS.tsx:',
292	          error,
293	        );
294	      },
295	    );
296	
297	    const unsubProducts = api.collections.products.subscribe(
298	      ({ records }) => {

301	            ...record,

Now look at `ordersApiDataGateway.collections.accounts` and `financeApiDataGateway.subscribeCollection('accounts')`.

Key issue: the filter at useOrderData.ts:243-246 requires `account.accSubId || account.acc_sub_id` — the API DTO may not return accSubId, so everything is filtered out. Also `isActive !== false`.

Also `isEntityRecord` requires `typeof value.id === 'string'` — if the gateway returns accountId only without id mapping, records get dropped.

1	import { ApiClient, ApiClientError } from '../../../data/http/api-client';
2	import type { OrdersFeatureApi, OrdersCollectionRepository, OrdersWritePayload } from '../api';
3	import type { OrderFeatureRecord, ShipmentFeatureRecord } from '../types';
4	
5	type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
6	type ApiRow = Record<string, unknown> & { id?: string };
7	type ApiCollectionConfig = { readPath: string; writePath?: string; idKey: string };
8	
9	const client = new ApiClient({
10	  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
11	  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
12	  maxReadRetries: 0,
13	});
14	
15	const unsupported = (operation: string): never => {
16	  throw new Error(`ORDERS_API_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED:${operation}`);
17	};
18	const normalize = <T extends ApiRow>(row: T, idKey: string): T & { id: string } => ({ ...row, id: String(row[idKey] ?? row.id ?? '') });
19	const extractRows = <T extends ApiRow>(data: T[] | { items?: T[] } | undefined): T[] => Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : [];
20	
21	function makeApiCollection<T extends ApiRow>(config: ApiCollectionConfig): OrdersCollectionRepository<T> {
22	  const list = async (): Promise<readonly T[]> => {
23	    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T[] | { items?: T[] }>>(config.readPath, { limit: 100, offset: 0 });
24	    return extractRows(response.data).map((row) => normalize(row, config.idKey) as T);
25	  };
26	  const pathFor = (id: string) => `${config.writePath ?? config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
27	  return {
28	    subscribe(onData: (snapshot: { records: readonly T[] }) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
29	      let disposed = false;
30	      const refresh = async () => {
31	        try { const records = await list(); if (!disposed) onData({ records }); }
32	        catch (error) { if (!disposed) onError?.(error); }
33	      };
34	      void refresh();
35	      const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000);
36	      return () => { disposed = true; clearInterval(timer); };
37	    },
38	    list,
39	    async get(id) {
40	      const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T>>(`${config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
41	      return normalize(response.data, config.idKey) as T;
42	    },
43	    async create(id, payload) {
44	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`create:${config.readPath}`);
45	      const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(config.writePath, { ...payload, [config.idKey]: id });
46	      return { id: String(response.data[config.idKey] ?? response.data.id ?? id) };
47	    },
48	    async set(id, payload) {
49	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`set:${config.readPath}`);
50	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
51	    },
52	    async update(id, payload) {
53	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`update:${config.readPath}`);
54	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
55	    },
56	    async delete(id) {
57	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`delete:${config.readPath}`);
58	      await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id));
59	    },
60	  };
61	}

#### Thinking

Confirmed! The API returns `subAccountId` (not `accSubId`) and `accountNameAr` (not `accNameAr`). Wait, mapAccountRow handles `accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId` and `accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr`. Good — the mapAccountRow is fine. But `useOrderData` and `useFinanceAccountingData`/`FinanceApiDataGateway.normalizeRows` do NOT use mapAccountRow — they do their own shallow normalization.

FinanceApiDataGateway.normalizeRows for accounts: sets `id: row.accountId ?? row.id`, `accountName: row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn` — does NOT map `accSubId` ← `subAccountId`, `accNameAr` ← `accountNameAr`, `curNo` ← `currencyNo`, `entityName`. So downstream selectors that filter on `accSubId`/`curNo`/`type` will break.

useOrderData.ts:243-246: filters `Boolean(account.accSubId || account.acc_sub_id)` — the API returns `subAccountId`, so this is always falsy → financialAccounts becomes EMPTY. That is the primary defect for orders (create-order payment section, COD/payment dialog).

Also `name` uses accNameAr/accountName → API returns accountNameAr, so name falls back to id.

#### Thinking

Defect confirmed: EditOrderModal (line 294-312) does NOT receive `financialAccounts` prop → defaults to `[]` (EditOrderModal.tsx:152) → cashAccountsList/bankAccountsList empty.

Now check who else uses CreateOrderModal — maybe OrdersPage renders it directly too? Line 1426 is the only place. Also check whether some other page passes financialAccounts to EditOrderModal. Grep `financialAccounts=` in src.

From the earlier grep: FinanceAccounting.tsx:558, 619; OrdersPageDialogs 277, 382 (PaymentModal); so EditOrderModal never gets it. Good.

Also check CreateOrderModal props interface: `financialAccounts?: FinancialAccountOption[]` — with the filter on `accSubId === '111' || id.startsWith('111')`. But note the account codes are '1110-0002' which starts with '111' — so id.startsWith('111') works IF id is the accountId = account code (accountId format is '1110-0002'? test data shows accountId '2120-0004' = accountCode). OK so that filter can work via id prefix, even if accSubId missing. But the upstream useOrderData filter `Boolean(account.accSubId || account.acc_sub_id)` kills everything before it reaches. API returns `subAccountId` → dropped. That's the master defect for orders surfaces 1 & 2.

Now, FinanceAccounting surface: financialAccounts from useFinanceAccountingData → FinanceApiDataGateway.subscribeCollection('accounts'). normalizeRows only maps id/accountName; so `entityName`, `accSubId`, `curNo`, `accountType` missing. Then FinanceAccounting.tsx:102 filterPostingAccounts — isPostingAccount requires id && isActive !== false && isHierarchyNode !== true — those pass. Then in useFinanceAccountingSelectors line 280-295 filteredAccountsList uses acc.entityType (present as entityType in API — yes, accountColumns has entity_type AS "entityType"). OK.

Now where does the FinanceAccounting "حساب مالي" dropdown live? ManualJournalAdjustmentModal / AccountPickerModal / FinancialAccountsTab. Let's check AccountPickerModal & the components that pass accounts to pickers, and check useFinanceAccountingSelectors filterPostingAccounts second arg requireClassified? Line 280: `filterPostingAccounts(financialAccounts)` without requireClassified → fine.

## Defect map: why the "حساب مالي" list renders empty

**Root cause (field-name mismatch, no HTTP error):** `alx_api` returns account rows with `subAccountId`, `accountNameAr`, `currencyNo` (`F:\system\swiftship-tracker\swiftshift2\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.repository.ts:21`, schema `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.schemas.ts:191-213`). Only `mapAccountRow` (`src\services\financeApi.ts:82-112`) renames them to the legacy `accSubId / accNameAr / curNo`. Every subscriber path below bypasses that mapper and filters on the legacy names.

- **D1 — Orders data hook drops 100% of accounts.** `src\features\orders\hooks\useOrderData.ts:239-259`: the accounts subscription filters `Boolean(account.accSubId || account.acc_sub_id)` (line 245). The API field is `subAccountId`, so the array is always `[]`. This single defect empties surfaces (1) create-order payment (`src\components\orders\CreateOrderModal.tsx:316-321` → `src\features\orders\components\create-order-modal\CreateOrderStep4.tsx:409`) and (2) COD/payment dialog (`src\components\orders\PaymentModal.tsx:124-133`). Fix: read `account.subAccountId ?? account.accSubId ?? account.acc_sub_id` (or run rows through `mapAccountRow`).
- **D2 — `EditOrderModal` gets no `financialAccounts` prop at all.** Parent renders it without the prop (`src\features\orders\pages\subcomponents\OrdersPageDialogs.tsx:294-312`), while `EditOrderModal.tsx:73,152` defaults it to `[]`, so `cashAccountsList/bankAccountsList` (`:167-172`) are empty. Fix: pass `financialAccounts={financialAccounts}`.
- **D3 — Auto entries still read legacy Supabase, never the API.** `src\components\OrderStatusManagementTab.tsx:7` imports `db/collection/onSnapshot` from `data/legacy/legacy-compat` and loads accounts at `:144-146` (`collection(db,'accounts')`). This explains "no request to `/api/v1/finance/accounts`": the dropdown (`:1097`, `:1152`) is fed from Supabase only. Fix: replace with `financialAccountService.getAllAccounts()` / API subscription and map `entityType === 'system'` rows.
- **D4 — Finance-accounting gateway does not normalize legacy names.** `src\components\financeAccounting\FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:35-40` maps only `id`/`accountName`; rows keep `subAccountId`/`accountNameAr`. Consumers then filter on `accSubId`/`isPosting`: `src\components\financeAccounting\useFinanceAccountingSelectors.ts:280,300-307`, `src\components\finance\forms\VoucherEntryForm.tsx:259,263` (`a.isPosting` is never set on these rows → empty cash/bank lists), `GeneralEntryForm.tsx:498`, `CompoundEntryForm.tsx:500`, `CustodyAdvancesTab.tsx:43-44`. Fix: apply `mapAccountRow` + derive `isPosting` in `normalizeRows`.
- **D5 — Silent catches mask permission/403 failures.** `src\services\financialAccountService.ts:588-594` returns `[]` on error; `src\features\financeEntries\pages\FinanceEntriesPage.tsx:84` `.catch(() => ({ data: [] }))` swallows a 403 from `route('view_financial_accounts', …)` (`alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.routes.ts:105`), leaving the entries/vouchers picker empty with no visible error.
- **D6 — Page-size truncation.** `src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:23` and `FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:67-70` fetch `limit: 100` only, no paging.

Field names the UI expects: `id, name, accNameAr, accountCode, currency, curNo, accSubId ('111'/'112'), isPosting, isActive, entityType, entityId, entityName` — API gives `accountId, accountNameAr, currencyNo, subAccountId` and no `isPosting`.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  target_ids text[]; target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[]; requested_count integer; actual_count integer;
  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0; deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_notifications integer := 0; deleted_whatsapp_logs integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;
  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);
  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]), COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts FROM public.account_trans WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);
  DELETE FROM public.notifications WHERE data->>'orderId' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'order_id' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'orderNumber' = ANY(target_numbers); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_notifications = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_logs WHERE data->>'orderId' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'order_id' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'orderNumber' = ANY(target_numbers); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_whatsapp_logs = ROW_COUNT;
  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids); END IF;
  DELETE FROM public.account_trans WHERE account_trans_id = ANY(account_trans_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.orders_history WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR order_number = ANY(target_numbers) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;
  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true); DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT; PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);
  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts); END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('orderIds', target_ids, 'orders', deleted_orders, 'shipments', deleted_shipments, 'products', deleted_order_items, 'mainEntries', deleted_main_entries, 'accountTrans', deleted_account_trans, 'notifications', deleted_notifications, 'whatsappLogs', deleted_whatsapp_logs, 'ordersHi

#### Thinking

Now I understand the orders POST 400: the gateway sends the *entire* order record (`input.order`), which includes keys not in `createOrderInputSchema`... but the schema isn't `.strict()`, so unknown keys are stripped, not rejected. So why 400?

Possible 400 reasons: 
- `client.post` sends `{...input.order, items, shipments}`. If `input.order.status` is an empty string → `z.string().min(1)` fails → 400. Or `currency` field... `optionalText` max 500 fine. `orderCurrencyPrice: money` → if the frontend sends a string "100" → fails (no coerce) → 400! Or `quantity: z.number().int().positive()` — if item quantity is 0 → fails. Or `productUrl: z.string().url()` — if the frontend sends a non-URL product URL (like "abc") → fails → 400. Very likely: items carry productUrl strings that aren't valid URLs, or unitPrice negative.
- Also Idempotency-Key present, so fine.

export interface CreateNotificationInput {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  type?: 'system' | 'order' | 'shipment' | 'finance' | 'alert' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
  category?: 'order' | 'finance' | 'system' | 'shipment' | 'alert';
  isPublic?: boolean;
  associatedUserIds?: readonly string[];
}

export const notificationsApiDataGateway = {
  /** قائمة الإشعارات المرئية للمستخدم المصادق عليه + العدد الكلي من الـ meta. */
  async listNotifications(query: NotificationListQuery = {}): Promise<{ items: ApiNotification[]; total: number }> {
    const path = query.scope === 'all' ? '/api/v1/notifications/all' : '/api/v1/notifications';
    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
      `${path}${toQueryString({
        limit: query.limit ?? 200,
        offset: query.offset ?? 0,
        isRead: query.isRead,
        category: query.category,
        search: query.search,
      })}`,
    );
    const items = asArray<unknown>(response.data).map(asNotification);
    return { items, total: Number(response.meta?.total ?? items.length) };
  },

  /** عدد الإشعارات غير المقروءة من العدّاد الخادمي، لا من طول الصفحة. */
  async getUnreadCount(scope: 'mine' | 'all' = 'mine'): Promise<number> {
    const { total } = await this.listNotifications({ limit: 1, offset: 0, isRead: false, scope });
    return total;
  },

  /** إنشاء إشعار داخلي — كل الحقول أعمدة رئيسية ولا حقل payload. */
  async createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<ApiNotification> {
    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/notifications', input);
    return asNotification(response.data);
  },

  /** تعليم إشعار كمقروء لهذا المستخدم (حالة القراءة لكل مستلم في الجدول العلائقي). */
  async markAsRead(notificationId: string): Promise<ApiNotification> {
    const response = await appApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
      `/api/v1/notifications/${encodeURIComponent(notificationId)}/read`,
      {},
    );
    return asNotification(response.data);
  },

  /** تعليم كل إشعارات المستخدم الحالي كمقروءة؛ يُرجع عدد السطور المحدّثة. */
  async markAllAsRead(): Promise<number> {
    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ updatedCount?: number }>>(
      '/api/v1/notifications/read-all',
      {},
    );
    return Number(response.data?.updatedCount ?? 0);
  },

  /** سجل أحداث الإرسال الخارجي (WhatsApp/Email/SMS) من جدول الـ Outbox. */
  async listDeliveryLogs(query: { limit?: number; offset?: number; status?: string; channel?: string } = {}): Promise<{ items: ApiDeliveryLog[]; total: number }> {
    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
      `/api/v1/notifications/delivery-logs${toQueryString({
        limit: query.limit ?? 150,
        offset: query.offset ?? 0,
        status: query.status,
        channel: query.channel,
      })}`,
    );

-- Migration: 0010_notifications_outbox.sql
-- Description: إنشاء جدول Outbox للإشعارات الخارجية (WhatsApp / Email / SMS) ومنح صلاحيات الـ runtime.
-- Creation of the external notification outbox (transactional outbox pattern) plus runtime grants.
-- Date: 2026-10-05 — revised 2026-10-14
--
-- ملاحظة تصحيحية: هذا الملف كان يُنشئ جدولا وهميا لـ public notifications بأعمدة
-- (body / notification_type / channel / metadata) غير موجودة في قاعدة البيانات الحقيقية،
-- وكان يستخدم حقل jsonb جامع. الإشعارات الداخلية تعيش في public.notifications (جدول قديم)
-- ويسطّحها الترحيل 0025_flatten_notifications.sql، ولا أعمدة jsonb بعد هذا الترحيل.
-- Corrective note: this file previously created a fictional notifications table with columns
-- that do not exist in the real database and a catch-all jsonb field. In-app notifications live in
-- public.notifications and are flattened by 0025; no jsonb payload columns remain.

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. جدول Outbox للإشعارات الخارجية (Transactional Outbox Pattern)
-- Outbox table for external notifications
-- كل الحقول أعمدة رئيسية — لا يوجد حقل payload جامع — every field is a first-class column.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alx_api_private.notification_outbox (
  -- المعرف الفريد لحدث الـ Outbox
  outbox_id             TEXT        NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,

  -- مفتاح الـ Idempotency لمنع تكرار الإرسال
  idempotency_key       TEXT        NOT NULL UNIQUE,

  -- القناة الخارجية: whatsapp | email | sms
  channel               TEXT        NOT NULL
                          CHECK (channel IN ('whatsapp', 'email', 'sms')),

  -- المستلم: رقم الهاتف أو البريد الإلكتروني
  recipient             TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- اسم المستلم القابل للقراءة (اختياري)
  recipient_name        TEXT,

  -- معرف قالب الرسالة (اختياري)
  template_id           TEXT,

  -- نص الرسالة
  message               TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- الإشعار الداخلي المرتبط إن وُجد (مرجع اختياري غير مقيد بإنشاء الجدول)
  notification_id       TEXT,

  -- حالة الإرسال: queued | processing | sent | failed | cancelled
  status                TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
                          CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'sent', 'failed', 'cancelled')),

  -- عدد محاولات الإرسال
  attempt_count         INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                          CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),

  -- أقصى عدد محاولات مسموحة
  max_attempts          INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 3
                          CHECK (max_attempts > 0),

  -- وقت آخر محاولة
  last_attempted_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,

7	
8	-- 1) Assets schema completion / استكمال أعمدة الأصول
9	ALTER TABLE public.assets
10	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category text,
11	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cost numeric DEFAULT 0,

20	-- 2) DELETE grants for the finance admin surface and already-shipped product routes.
21	--    Without these, the API delete endpoints fail with 42501 at runtime.
22	GRANT DELETE ON
23	  public.assets,
24	  public.account,
25	  public.acc_main,
26	  public.acc_sub,
27	  public.acc_sub_group,
28	  public.accounts,
29	  public.default_accounts,

31	  public.auto_entries,

34	  public.returned_products
35	TO alx_api_runtime;
36	
37	-- 3) Entity financial footprint purge / تطهير الأثر المالي للجهة
38	--    Deletes the entity's ledger footprint (accounts, movement legs, the entries those
39	--    legs form, related custody advances) and finally the entity row itself.
40	--    Guards: customers with orders and couriers with unsettled custody advances are refused.
41	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_entity_financial_footprint(
42	  p_entity_type text,
43	  p_entity_id text,
44	  p_actor text
45	) RETURNS jsonb
46	LANGUAGE plpgsql
47	SECURITY DEFINER
48	SET search_path = pg_catalog
49	AS $purge$
50	DECLARE
51	  v_accounts text[];
52	  v_entries  text[];
53	  v_open_orders integer;
54	  v_open_custodies integer;
55	  v_n_accounts integer;
56	  v_n_entries integer;
57	  v_n_legs integer;
58	  v_n_custodies integer;
59	  v_entity_table text;
60	  v_entity_pk text;
61	BEGIN
62	  IF p_entity_type NOT IN ('customers','couriers','employees','users','sources','shipping_companies') THEN
63	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_ENTITY_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: %', p_entity_type;
64	  END IF;
65	  IF p_entity_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_entity_id) = '' THEN
66	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_ENTITY_ID_REQUIRED';
67	  END IF;
68	
69	  -- Whitelisted table / primary-key map (verified against the live schema).
70	  v_entity_table := p_entity_type;
71	  v_entity_pk := CASE p_entity_type
72	    WHEN 'customers' THEN 'customer_id'
73	    WHEN 'couriers' THEN 'courier_id'
74	    WHEN 'employees' THEN 'employee_id'
75	    WHEN 'users' THEN 'user_id'
76	    WHEN 'sources' THEN 'source_id'
77	    WHEN 'shipping_companies' THEN 'shipping_company_id'
78	  END;
79	
80	  -- Guard: customers cannot be purged while orders reference them.
81	  IF p_entity_type = 'customers' THEN
82	    SELECT count(*) INTO v_open_orders FROM public.orders WHERE customer_id = p_entity_id;
83	    IF v_open_orders > 0 THEN
84	      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_BLOCKED_CUSTOMER_HAS_ORDERS: %', v_open_orders;
85	    END IF;
86	  END IF;
87	
88	  -- Guard: couriers cannot be purged with outstanding custody advances.
89	  IF p_entity_type = 'couriers' THEN
90	    SELECT count(*) INTO v_open_custodies
91	    FROM public.custody_advances
92	    WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id
93	      AND (status IS DISTINCT FROM 'settled')
94	      AND COALESCE(amount_outstanding, 0) > 0;
95	    IF v_open_custodies > 0 THEN
96	      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_BLOCKED_COURIER_HAS_OPEN_CUSTODY: %', v_open_custodies;
97	    END IF;
98	  END IF;
99	
100	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_id), '{}'::text[]) INTO v_accounts
101	  FROM public.accounts WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id;
102	
103	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT main_entry_id), '{}'::text[]) INTO v_entries
104	  FROM public.account_trans
105	  WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id
106	     OR (array_length(v_accounts, 1) IS NOT NULL AND account_id = ANY (v_accounts))
107	     OR custody_id IN (SELECT custody_advance_id FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id);
108	
109	  v_n_accounts := (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id);
110	  v_n_entries  := COALESCE(array_length(v_entries, 1), 0);
111	  v_n_legs     := (SELECT count(*) FROM public.account_trans
112	                   WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id
113	                      OR (array_length(v_accounts, 1) IS NOT NULL AND account_id = ANY (v_accounts))
114	                      OR custody_id IN (SELECT custody_advance_id FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id));
115	
116	  DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE array_length(v_entries, 1) IS NOT NULL AND main_entry_id = ANY (v_entries);
117

{
  "content": "-- 0036_fix_order_deletion.sql\n-- إصلاح حذف الطلبات: كان الدالة تحذف الشحنات قبل سجلّاتها، فيفشل الحذف بـ 23503\n-- (orders_history.shipment_id → shipments بـ NO ACTION).\n-- Order-deletion fix: the RPC deleted shipments before their history rows, so every real\n-- deletion aborted with 23503 (orders_history.shipment_id → shipments is ON DELETE NO ACTION).\n-- Also removes the dead jsonb predicates: no notification or whatsapp log row carries an order\n-- reference (verified on the live database: 0 of 201 notifications, 0 of 19 logs), so reading\n-- data->>'orderId' deleted nothing while blocking the 0034 jsonb cleanup.\n-- Date: 2026-10-15\n\nBEGIN;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n-- منع انتحال search_path عند تنفيذ الدالة بصلاحيات المالك — fixed search_path, no hijack.\nSET search_path = pg_catalog\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  target_ids text[]; target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[];\n  requested_count integer; actual_count integer;\n  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0;\n  deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids\n    FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned\n   WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;\n  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);\n  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers\n    FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids\n    FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids\n    FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]),\n         COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[])\n    INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts\n    FROM public.account_trans\n   WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);\n\n  -- 1) أرجل القيود ثم القيود نفسها — payment legs first, then the entries they belong to.\n  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN\n    DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);\n  END IF;\n  DELETE FROM public.account_trans\n    WHERE account_trans_id = ANY(account_trans_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;\n  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;\n\n  -- 2) السجل التاريخي قبل آباء مفاتيحه الأجنبية (shipments ثم orders).\n  --    History rows reference shipments and orders, so they go first; orders_history_change cascades.\n  DELETE FROM public.orders_history\n    WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR order_number = ANY(target_numbers) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;\n\n  -- 3) الشحنات ومنتجات الطلب — only now are shipments and order items removable.\n  DELETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;\n  DELETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;\n\n  -- 4) الطلب نفسه مع كبت مؤرِّق الحذف — the order itself, with the audit trigger suppressed.\n  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true);\n  DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT;\n  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);\n\n  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts);\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'orderIds', target_ids,\n    'orders', deleted_orders,\n    'shipments', deleted_shipments,\n    'products', deleted_order_items,\n    'mainEntries', deleted_main_entries,\n    'accountTrans', deleted_account_trans,\n    'notifications', 0,\n    'whatsappLogs', 0,\n    'ordersHistory', deleted_orders_history,\n    'activityLogsDeleted', 0);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- إعادة منح التنفيذ لصلاحية التشغيل بعد الاستبدال — re-grant EXECUTE after the replacement.\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(text[]) FROM PUBLIC;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(text[]) TO alx_api_runtime;\n\nCOMMIT;\n",
  "file_path": "F:\\system\\swiftship-tracker\\swiftshift2\\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\\alx_api\\src\\db\\migrations\\0036_fix_order_deletion.sql"
}

/** عمود maintenance_logs قد يرجع نصًا مخزّنًا قديمًا — نصّفه ونقبل السجلات الصالحة فقط. */
function toMaintenanceLogs(value: unknown): MaintenanceLog[] {
  let rows: unknown = value;
  if (typeof rows === 'string') {
    try {
      rows = JSON.parse(rows);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [];
  return rows
    .filter((entry): entry is Record<string, unknown> => Boolean(entry) && typeof entry === 'object')
    .map((entry) => ({
      logId: toText(entry.logId ?? entry.log_id),
      cost: toNumber(entry.cost),
      currency: toText(entry.currency),
      type: (toText(entry.type) || 'Repair') as MaintenanceType,
      notes: toText(entry.notes),
      doneBy: toText(entry.doneBy ?? entry.done_by),
      date: toText(entry.date),
      createdAt: toNumber(entry.createdAt ?? entry.created_at),
    }));
}

function mapAssetRow(row: any): FinancialAsset | null {
  const id = toText(row?.assetId ?? row?.id).trim();
  if (!id) return null;
  return {
    id,
    assetCode: toText(row.assetCode ?? row.asset_code),
    nameAr: toText(row.nameAr ?? row.name_ar),
    nameEn: toText(row.nameEn ?? row.name_en),
    category: (toText(row.category) || 'Other') as AssetCategory,
    type: (toText(row.type) || 'Fixed') as AssetType,
    cost: toNumber(row.cost),
    currency: toText(row.currency),
    purchaseDate: toText(row.purchaseDate ?? row.purchase_date),
    assignedCourierId: row.assignedCourierId ?? row.assigned_courier_id ?? null,
    assignedCourierName: row.assignedCourierName ?? row.assigned_courier_name ?? null,
    status: (toText(row.status) || 'Active') as AssetStatus,
    notes: toText(row.notes),
    maintenanceLogs: toMaintenanceLogs(row.maintenanceLogs ?? row.maintenance_logs),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false && row.is_active !== false,
    financialAccountId: toText(row.accountId ?? row.account_id) || undefined,
    financialAccountCode: toText(row.accountCode ?? row.account_code) || undefined,
    createdAt: row.createdAt ?? row.created_at,
  };
}

  async remove(assetId: string): Promise<void> {

   * Appends to the asset's current logs (read-modify-write) so no prior entry is lost.
   */
  async appendMaintenanceLog(asset: FinancialAsset, log: MaintenanceLog): Promise<FinancialAsset> {
    const response = await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<any>>(
      `${ASSETS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(asset.id)}`,
      { maintenanceLogs: [...(asset.maintenanceLogs ?? []), log] },
    );
    return unwrapAsset(response?.data);
  },
};

#### Thinking

Design decision: keep the API contract `maintenanceLogs` array on the asset DTO, but store it relationally in `asset_maintenance_log` (server-side). Read-modify-write from the client sends the whole array; the repository replaces the child rows (delete + insert). That's simple, transactional, and jsonb-free. The DTO stays an array (not a jsonb column), which is fine: it's a relational child collection.

Implementation in finance.repository.ts:
- assetColumns: drop `maintenance_logs AS "maintenanceLogs"`.
- add `assetMaintenanceColumns` + `attachMaintenanceLogs(pool, rows)`.
- createAsset: insert flat, then replaceLogs if input.maintenanceLogs provided; return with logs.
- updateAsset: update flat; if maintenanceLogs defined → replace child rows; re-read row + logs.
- deleteAsset: unchanged (child cascades).
- assetRecordColumns: remove maintenanceLogs key.
- AssetRecordFields contract: keep 'maintenanceLogs' (array type) — it's in the union list at line 156.

Log row shape: maintenance_log_id, asset_id, seq, type, cost, currency, notes, done_by, performed_at (date from log.date), created_at, created_by.

Client sends log objects {logId,cost,currency,type,notes,doneBy,date,createdAt}. Map seq by array index; keep logId as maintenance_log_id when it looks like an id (non-empty ≤128) else generate.

/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */
export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<any>>(path);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isNotFoundError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * يحوّل صف الحساب القادم من alx_api إلى الشكل الذي تعرفه واجهات النظام.
 * Maps an accounts row (accountId/accountNameAr/subAccountId/currencyNo) to the legacy FinancialAccount shape.
 */
export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {
  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();
  if (!accountId) return null;
  return {
    ...row,
    id: accountId,
    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),
    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),
    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),
    entityType: row.entityType,
    entityId: String(row.entityId ?? ''),
    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn ?? ''),
    currency: String(row.currency ?? ''),
    curNo: row.curNo ?? row.currencyNo ?? undefined,
    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),
    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),
    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
    type: row.type,
    parentCode: row.parentCode ?? undefined,
    accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId ?? undefined,
    groupId: row.groupId ?? undefined,
    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),
    accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr ?? undefined,
    accNameEn: row.accNameEn ?? row.accountNameEn ?? undefined,
    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),
    notes: row.notes ?? undefined,
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
  } as FinancialAccount;
}

61	async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
62	  collectionName: string
63	): Promise<T[]> {
64	  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
65	  if (!path)
66	    throw new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`);
67	  const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiPage<T>>>(path, {
68	    limit: 100,
69	    offset: 0,
70	  });
71	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data)
72	    ? response.data
73	    : (response.data.items ?? []);
74	  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];
75	}

67	async function page(
68	  pool: Pool,
69	  table: string,
70	  columns: string,
71	  order: string,
72	  input: PageQuery,
73	  searchColumns: string[],
74	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
75	  const values: unknown[] = [];
76	  const filters: string[] = [];
77	  if (input.search) {
78	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
79	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
80	  }
81	  if (input.customerId) {
82	    values.push(input.customerId);
83	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
84	  }
85	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
86	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
87	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
88	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
89	    values,
90	  );
91	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
92	}

Root cause of the create-order 400 found:
1. Frontend sends explicit `null` for optional string fields (`customerId`, `deliveryCourierId`, `shippingCourierId`, `courierId`, ...) → zod `optionalText` rejects null.
2. `items[].productUrl` must be a valid URL — the UI sends protocol-less URLs ("ar.shein.com/...").
3. Also `shipments[].shippingCompany` isn't in shipmentInputSchema (unknown keys are stripped by zod by default, fine).

Fix approach (server-side, honest, no weakening of real constraints):
- Accept `null` for optional text fields → normalize null → undefined. Add a shared `nullableText`-ish optional helper: `const optionalText = z.union([z.string().trim().max(500), z.null()]).transform(v => v ?? undefined).optional()`. Careful with exactOptionalPropertyTypes: transform producing undefined for an optional property is OK at the type level? The input type has `?: string | undefined` — fine.
- productUrl: accept protocol-less strings but validate they look like a host path — or normalize by prefixing `https://`. Cleanest: keep a URL check but allow a bare domain: transform: if the value has no scheme and matches /^[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/i → prefix 'https://'. Hmm, is that "weakening"? The DB column is text; the frontend legitimately stores bare hosts. I'd rather accept both and validate only max length, and let the service normalize. Actually the safest honest approach: `productUrl: z.string().trim().max(2000)` — it's a text field, not a URL-typed column; strictness here isn't protecting anything meaningful (SSRF/validation is done at fetch time). But dropping URL validation might be seen as weakening validation. Better: keep URL semantics by normalizing missing scheme.

11	export function presentColumnEntries(
12	  input: object,
13	  columnMap: Record<string, string>,
14	): Array<[string, unknown]> {
15	  const entries: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];
16	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {

23	/**
24	 * Run a callback on a dedicated pooled connection inside a transaction where
25	 * request.jwt.claims is set to the acting user, so legacy SECURITY DEFINER RPCs
26	 * that resolve auth.uid() keep working when invoked through the API runtime role.
27	 * تنفيذ داخل معاملة على اتصال مخصص مع ضبط request.jwt.claims بمعرّف المستخدم المنفّذ
28	 * لتبقى دوال RPC الآمنة (auth.uid) تعمل عند استدعائها عبر حساب تشغيل alx_api.
29	 */
30	export async function withActorClaims<T>(
31	  connect: () => Promise<ActorClaimClient>,
32	  actorId: string,
33	  run: (client: ActorClaimClient) => Promise<T>,
34	): Promise<T> {
35	  const client = await connect();
36	  try {
37	    await client.query('BEGIN');
38	    await client.query("SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', $1, TRUE)", [JSON.stringify({ sub: actorId })]);
39	    const result = await run(client);
40	    await client.query('COMMIT');
41	    return result;
42	  } catch (error) {
43	    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
44	    throw error;
45	  } finally {
46	    client.release();
47	  }
48	}
49	
50	export interface ActorClaimClient {
51	  query: (sql: string, params?: unknown[]) => Promise<{ rows: unknown[] }>;
52	  release: () => void;
53	}

For optional: `const optionalAmount = amount.nullish().transform(v => v ?? undefined)`. Careful: z.coerce on null → Number(null)=0! With `.nullish()` the union check happens before coercion? 91	async function page(
92	  pool: Pool,
93	  table: string,
94	  columns: string,
95	  order: string,
96	  input: PageQuery,
97	  searchColumns: string[],
98	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
99	  const values: unknown[] = [];
100	  const filters: string[] = [];
101	  if (input.search) {
102	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
103	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
104	  }
105	  if (input.customerId) {
106	    values.push(input.customerId);
107	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
108	  }
109	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
110	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
111	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
112	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
113	    values,
114	  );
