118	/** صفحة الطلبات: استعلام مخصّص لأن القائمة تحتاج JOIN، و`page` لا يدعم الجداول المتعددة. */
119	/** Orders page uses its own builder because the list needs JOINs, which the generic `page` helper does not support. */
120	async function pageOrders(pool: Pool, input: PageQuery): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
121	  const values: unknown[] = [];
122	  const filters: string[] = [];
123	  if (input.search) {
124	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
125	    filters.push(`(o.order_number ILIKE $1 OR o.external_order_number ILIKE $1 OR o.tracking_number ILIKE $1)`);
126	  }
127	  if (input.customerId) {
128	    values.push(input.customerId);
129	    filters.push(`o.customer_id = $${values.length}`);
130	  }
131	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
132	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
133	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
134	    `SELECT ${orderListColumns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total ${orderListFrom} ${where} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.order_id ASC LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
135	    values,
136	  );
137	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
138	}

140	function statusRank(status: string): number {
141	  const normalized = status.trim().toLowerCase();
142	  const ranks: Record<string, number> = {
143	    pending: 0,
144	    new: 0,
145	    created: 0,
146	    'قيد الطلب': 0,
147	    confirmed: 1,
148	    processing: 1,
149	    'قيد التجهيز': 1,
150	    shipped: 2,
151	    in_transit: 2,
152	    'تم الشحن': 2,
153	    delivered: 3,
154	    completed: 3,
155	    'تم التسليم': 3,
156	    cancelled: 4,
157	    canceled: 4,
158	    ملغي: 4,
159	  };
160	  return ranks[normalized] ?? -1;
161	}

Actually the aggregate order object doesn't include orderCurrencyPrice. But `currency: orderCurrency` (code string like 'SAR'), `orderCurrency` isn't in the aggregate order object... wait, `orderData` deletes `currency` and `orderCurrency` — but the aggregate `order` object only passes `currency: payload.currency`. So `currency` = code string 'SAR' → must resolve to `cur_id` via currency.code lookup. And paid currency code → `paid_currency_code`. Hmm, but the frontend sends `currency: orderCurrency` (the ORDER currency, e.g. 'SAR' - the source currency) and `paidCurrency: formData.currency` (payment currency, e.g. 'YER'). In orders table: `currency` integer = cur_id — which currency? In the old data, `data.currency` was the payment currency? 128	  const mapping = DIRECT_COLUMNS_MAP[table];
129	  if (!mapping || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return {};

21	function makeApiCollection<T extends ApiRow>(config: ApiCollectionConfig): OrdersCollectionRepository<T> {
22	  const list = async (): Promise<readonly T[]> => {
23	    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T[] | { items?: T[] }>>(config.readPath, { limit: 100, offset: 0 });
24	    return extractRows(response.data).map((row) => normalize(row, config.idKey) as T);
25	  };
26	  const pathFor = (id: string) => `${config.writePath ?? config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
27	  return {
28	    subscribe(onData: (snapshot: { records: readonly T[] }) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
29	      let disposed = false;
30	      const refresh = async () => {
31	        try { const records = await list(); if (!disposed) onData({ records }); }
32	        catch (error) { if (!disposed) onError?.(error); }
33	      };
34	      void refresh();
35	      const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000);
36	      return () => { disposed = true; clearInterval(timer); };
37	    },
38	    list,
39	    async get(id) {
40	      const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T>>(`${config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
41	      return normalize(response.data, config.idKey) as T;
42	    },
43	    async create(id, payload) {
44	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`create:${config.readPath}`);
45	      const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(config.writePath, { ...payload, [config.idKey]: id });
46	      return { id: String(response.data[config.idKey] ?? response.data.id ?? id) };
47	    },
48	    async set(id, payload) {
49	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`set:${config.readPath}`);
50	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
51	    },
52	    async update(id, payload) {
53	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`update:${config.readPath}`);
54	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
55	    },

57	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`delete:${config.readPath}`);
58	      await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id));

import type { Dispatch, FormEvent, SetStateAction } from "react";
import toast from "react-hot-toast";
import { activityLogService } from "../../../services/activityLogService";
import { autoEntryService } from "../../../services/autoEntryService";
import { financialAccountService } from "../../../services/financialAccountService";
import { notificationService } from "../../../services/notificationService";
import { orderHistoryService } from "../../../services/orderHistoryService";
import { whatsappService } from "../../../services/whatsappService";
import { findOrderParty } from "../../../services/orderPartyService";
import {
  getProcessedStatusIds,
  planOrderStatusTransition,
} from "../../../services/orderLifecycleService";
import { ORDER_STATUS_FALLBACKS } from "../constants/orders.constants";
import type { OrderRecord, OrderStatusDescriptor, ShippingRow, UpdateFormData } from "../types";

type LegacyPartyRecord = {
  id?: string; accountId?: string | null; financialAccountId?: string | null;
  fullName?: string | null; name?: string | null; phone?: string | null; address?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};
type LegacyOrderRecord = OrderRecord;
type LegacyShipmentRecord = ShippingRow;
type LegacyCourierRecord = LegacyPartyRecord & { courierType?: string; commissionRate?: string | number | null; financialAccountCode?: string | null };
type AuthContext = { currentUser?: { uid?: string; email?: string | null } | null };
type ProfileRecord = { id?: string; uid?: string; fullName?: string };
type SettingsRecord = { currency?: string };
type AutoVoucherRule = { id?: string; isActive?: boolean };
type OrderMutation = (id: string, changes: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;
type RateBuilder = (order: LegacyOrderRecord) => Record<string, number>;
type ShipmentMutation = (id: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;
const toText = (value: unknown): string => typeof value === "string" ? value : value == null ? "" : String(value);
const toNumber = (value: unknown): number => typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" ? Number.parseFloat(value) || 0 : 0;

export interface UpdateOrderStatusHandlerDependencies<T extends LegacyOrderRecord = LegacyOrderRecord> {
  isSubmitting: boolean;
  isAr: boolean;
  auth: AuthContext;
  autoVoucherRules: AutoVoucherRule[];
  buildOrderRates: RateBuilder;
  couriers: LegacyCourierRecord[];
  customers: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  dbRates: Record<string, number>;
  employees: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  getStatusByAny: (status: string | number) => OrderStatusDescriptor | undefined;
  orderStatusesList: OrderStatusDescriptor[];
  profile: ProfileRecord | null;
  selectedOrder: T | null;
  setIsSubmitting: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  setIsUpdateModalOpen: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  setSelectedOrder: Dispatch<SetStateAction<T | null>>;
  settings: SettingsRecord;
  shippingCompanies: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  sources: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  updateFormData: UpdateFormData;
  updateOrderRecord: OrderMutation;
  updateShippings: LegacyShipmentRecord[];
  upsertShipment: ShipmentMutation;
}

export function createUpdateOrderStatusHandler<T extends LegacyOrderRecord>(
  dependencies: UpdateOrderStatusHandlerDependencies<T>
) {
  const {
    isSubmitting,
    isAr,
    auth,
    autoVoucherRules,
    buildOrderRates,
    couriers,
    customers,
    dbRates,
    employees,
    getStatusByAny,
    orderStatusesList,
    profile,
    selectedOrder,
    setIsSubmitting,
    setIsUpdateModalOpen,
    setSelectedOrder,
    settings,
    shippingCompanies,
    sources,
    updateFormData,
    updateOrderRecord,
    updateShippings,
    upsertShipment,
  } = dependencies;

  return async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    if (!selectedOrder) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const currentStatus = selectedOrder.orderStatus || "طلب معلق";
      const newStatus = updateFormData.orderStatus;
      const firedTriggers = selectedOrder.firedTriggers || [];
      const newFiredTriggers = [...firedTriggers];

      const currentStatusItem =
        getStatusByAny(
          selectedOrder.order_status_id ||
            selectedOrder.orderStatusId ||
            currentStatus
        ) || orderStatusesList[0];
      const newStatusItem = getStatusByAny(newStatus) || orderStatusesList[0];

      const currentStageId =
        currentStatusItem?.id || ORDER_STATUS_FALLBACKS.individualUpdate;
      const newStageId =
        newStatusItem?.id || ORDER_STATUS_FALLBACKS.individualUpdate;
      const statusHistory = await orderHistoryService.listForContext({
        orderId: selectedOrder.id,
        orderNumber: toText(selectedOrder.orderNumber) || undefined,
        entityType: "order",
        label: toText(selectedOrder.orderNumber) || selectedOrder.id,
      });
      const transitionPlan = planOrderStatusTransition(
        orderStatusesList,
        currentStageId,
        newStageId,
        getProcessedStatusIds(statusHistory)
      );
      if (!transitionPlan.allowed) {
        const messages: Record<string, string> = {
          same_status: isAr
            ? "هذه الحالة مسجلة للطلب بالفعل؛ لن يعاد تنفيذ التحديث أو القيود."
            : "This status is already recorded for the order.",
          backward_transition: isAr
            ? "لا يمكن إرجاع الطلب إلى مرحلة سابقة بعد تنفيذ مرحلة لاحقة."
            : "An order cannot move back to a previously passed stage.",
          status_previously_processed: isAr
            ? "سبق تنفيذ هذه المرحلة للطلب وفق سجل التدقيق؛ تم منع التكرار."
            : "This stage was already processed according to the audit history.",

Order: `z.string().trim().max(500)` is ZodString with transforms... `.trim()` in zod v4 returns ZodString (built-in modifier), then `.nullish()` → ZodOptional<ZodNullable<...>>. `.transform` → ZodPipe? Actually `.transform()` on ZodOptional wraps... in zod v4 `.transform()` produces a `ZodTransform` whose input is the original. Output type is what we want: `string | undefined`.

Careful: with `.nullish().transform(fn)` the fn receives `string | null | undefined`. Good.

Another subtlety: `.trim()` on a nullish chain — does `.trim()` still apply? Yes, applied to the inner string schema.

```ts
    async createOrder(input: CreateOrderInput) {
      const client = await pool.connect();
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        const idem = await client.query(...);
        if (idem.rows[0]) { COMMIT; return idem.rows[0].response_data as Record<string, unknown>; }
        const orderId = input.orderNumber;
        const stage = await findStage(client, { id: input.orderStatusId, name: input.status });
        if ((text(input.orderStatusId) || text(input.status)) && !stage) throw new Error('ORDER_STAGE_UNKNOWN');
        const pairs = columnEntries(input, true);

        await appendCurrencyColumns(client, pairs);
        const columns = ['order_id', 'order_number', 'created_by', 'updated_by', 'created_at', 'updated_at', ...pairs.map(([c]) => c)];
        const values: unknown[] = [orderId, input.orderNumber, input.actorId, input.actorId, new Date(), new Date(), ...pairs.map(([, v]) => v)];
        const placeholders = columns.map((_, i) => `$${i+1}`).join(', ');
```

```ts
async function selectOrder(source: Pool | PoolClient, orderId: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  const order = await source.query(`SELECT ${orderListColumns} ${orderListFrom} WHERE o.order_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [orderId]);
  const row = order.rows[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  if (!row) return null;
  const items = await source.query(`SELECT ${orderItemColumns} FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, order_item_id ASC`, [orderId]);
  const shipments = await source.query(`SELECT ${shipmentColumns} FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, shipment_id ASC`, [orderId]);
  return { ...row, items: items.rows, shipments: shipments.rows };
}
```

#### Thinking

I need to restructure the probe so that:
1. Capture create statements, replay them into a live transaction (so the order row exists).
2. Then, for update/status capture phases, the stub must answer the `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` (and `selectOrder`) queries from the live client *inside the same transaction*, so the repository doesn't short-circuit.

Better design: use a single live client for everything, in one transaction:
- stubPool answers ALL queries against the live client (which is inside BEGIN...ROLLBACK). Writes execute for real inside the transaction; reads return real rows. No capture/replay separation needed at all. The only risk: idempotency insert into `alx_api_private.operation_idempotency` — that's fine inside the transaction too (rolled back). Also `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` works.

But there's a catch: the repository calls `client.query('BEGIN')`, `COMMIT`, `ROLLBACK` on the stub — if I pass those through to the live client, nested BEGIN warnings occur and COMMIT would commit my transaction. So: intercept transaction control statements (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) as no-ops, pass everything else to the live client. That gives a true end-to-end verification and the whole thing rolls back at the end.

Also `createOrder` uses `pool.query` for the idempotency check probably. Let's just run all statements through the live client.

One issue: the audit trigger `orders_history_orders_audit` fires on inserts/updates inside the transaction → writes extra history rows; rolled back anyway.

Another: `writeHistory` in repository inserts into orders_history — fine.

Note updateOrder uses `orderId` — in the DB, orders.order_id is text and createOrder generates `orderId` — from the earlier param list, order_id was set equal to orderNumber? The params showed the orderNumber twice at the start, so yes order_id = orderNumber.

40	}
41	
42	function toNumber(value: unknown, fallback = 0): number {
43	  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : parseFloat(String(value ?? ""));
44	  return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? fallback : parsed;
45	}
46	
47	function readStringField(value: unknown, key: string): string | undefined {
48	  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || !(key in value)) return undefined;
49	  const field = Reflect.get(value, key);
50	  return typeof field === "string" ? field : undefined;
51	}
52	
53	function readRelatedRecord(value: unknown): RelatedRecord | undefined {
54	  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return undefined;
55	  return {
56	    id: readStringField(value, "id"),
57	    name: readStringField(value, "name"),
58	    nameAr: readStringField(value, "nameAr"),
59	    nameEn: readStringField(value, "nameEn"),
60	    financialAccountId: readStringField(value, "financialAccountId"),
61	    accountId: readStringField(value, "accountId"),
62	    financialAccountCode: readStringField(value, "financialAccountCode"),
63	    accountCode: readStringField(value, "accountCode"),
64	  };
65	}
66	
67	type CreateOrderMutationSet = Pick<
68	  OrderMutations,
69	  | "createOrderAggregate"
70	  | "createOrderRecord"
71	  | "createProductRecord"
72	  | "createOrderItem"
73	  | "createShipmentRecord"
74	>;

112	export function createOrderHandler(

114	) {

156	
157	  return async (e: FormEvent) => {
158	    e.preventDefault();
159	    if (isSubmitting) return;
160	
161	    if (!formData.orderPartyId) {
162	      return notificationService.notify({
163	        title: isAr ? "خطأ" : "Error",
164	        message: isAr
165	          ? "الرجاء اختيار طرف الطلب أولاً"
166	          : "Please select an order party first",
167	        type: "error",
168	        category: "order",
169	      });
170	    }
171	
172	    const currentCalcs = computeCalculations();
173	    const paidAmount = toNumber(formData.amountPaid) || 0;
174	
175	    // First requirement: Deleted the condition that cash paid amount cannot be less than original products cost. All amounts are allowed.
176	    if (formData.orderSourceType === "SHEIN") {
177	      const redPrice = toNumber(formData.sheinRedPrice) || 0;
178	      const productsSum = items.reduce(
179	        (sum, i) =>
180	          sum + toNumber(i.quantity || 0) * toNumber(i.productPrice || 0),
181	        0
182	      );
183	      const couponValue = couponEnabled ? couponRate : 0;
184	      if (redPrice < productsSum - couponValue) {

186	          title: isAr ? "خطأ في التحقق" : "Validation Error",
187	          message: isAr
188	            ? "السعر الأحمر لـ SHEIN يجب ألا يقل عن إجمالي تكلفة المنتجات الأصلي بعد الخصم"
189	            : "SHEIN Red Price cannot be less than the total products cost after discount",
190	          type: "error",
191	          category: "order",
192	        });

196	    setIsSubmitting(true);

198	      const orderNumber = await generateSmartOrderCode();
199	      const currentCalcs = computeCalculations();
200	
201	      // ====== تحديد حالة الدفع بناءً على خيار "الدفع لاحقاً" أو المبلغ المدفوع ======
202	      // Determine payment status based on payLater toggle or paid amount
203	      let payStatus: string;
204	      if (payLater) {

206	        // Pay later: always set payment status to Unpaid
207	        payStatus = "Unpaid";
208	      } else if (currentCalcs.remainingYER <= 0) {
209	        payStatus = "Paid"; // دفع كامل
210	      } else if (toNumber(formData.amountPaid) > 0) {
211	        payStatus = "Partial Paid"; // دفع جزئي
212	      } else {

214	      }
215	
216	      // ====== تحديد ID حالة الطلب بناءً على الخيارات الثلاثة ======
217	      // Determine order status ID based on payLater, directApprove and paid amount
218	      // المنطق: directApprove => حالة 3 | payLater => حالة 1 | دفع موجود => حالة 2 | بدون دفع => حالة 1
219	      // Logic: directApprove => stage 3 | payLater => stage 1 | paid > 0 => stage 2 | else => stage 1
220	      const computedOrderStatusId = (() => {
221	        // ترتيب الأولوية: الاعتماد المباشر > الدفع لاحقاً > مدفوع/غير مدفوع
222	        // Priority: direct approve > pay later > paid/unpaid
223	        if (directApprove) {

225	          // Find status with sortOrder/id = 3 from order statuses table
226	          const stage3 = orderStatusesList.find(
227	            s => s.id === 3 || s.sortOrder === 3
228	          );
229	          return stage3 ? String(stage3.id) : "3";
230	        }
231	        if (payLater) {
232	          // حالة البداية (الأولى) من جدول حالات الطلب
233	          // First stage from order statuses table
234	          const stage1 = orderStatusesList.find(
235	            s => s.id === 1 || s.isFirst === true || s.sortOrder === 1
236	          );
237	          return stage1 ? String(stage1.id) : "1";
238	        }
239	        // المنطق الافتراضي: إذا تم الدفع => الحالة الثانية، وإلا => الأولى
240	        // Default: paid amount present => stage 2 else stage 1
241	        if (toNumber(formData.amountPaid) > 0) {
242	          const stage2 = orderStatusesList.find(
243	            s => s.id === 2 || s.sortOrder === 2
244	          );
245	          return stage2 ? String(stage2.id) : "2";
246	        }
247	        const stage1 = orderStatusesList.find(
248	          s => s.id === 1 || s.isFirst === true || s.sortOrder === 1
249	        );
250	        return stage1 ? String(stage1.id) : "1";
251	      })();
252	
253	      const initialFiredTriggers = [""];
254	      if (toNumber(formData.amountPaid) > 0 && !payLater) {
255	        initialFiredTriggers.push("order_down_payment"); //مهم:هذا قيد دفعه من العميل
256	      }
257	
258	      // ====== نص حالة الطلب (نصي) بناءً على الخيارات ======

260	      const orderStatusText = (() => {
261	        if (directApprove) return isAr ? "معتمد" : "Approved";
262	        if (payLater) return isAr ? "طلب معلق" : "Pending Order";
263	        if (toNumber(formData.amountPaid) > 0) {
264	          const stage2 = orderStatusesList.find(
265	            s => s.id === 2 || s.sortOrder === 2
266	          );
267	          return stage2
268	            ? isAr
269	              ? stage2.nameAr
270	              : stage2.nameEn
271	            : isAr
272	              ? "تم الدفع ولم يتسجل"
273	              : "Paid Not Registered";
274	        }
275	        return isAr ? "طلب معلق" : "Pending Order";
276	      })();
277	
278	      const payload = {

281	        orderNumber,

283	        customerId: formData.customerId || "",

293	        order_status_id: computedOrderStatusId,
294	        orderSourceId: formData.orderSourceId || null,
295	        orderSourceType: formData.orderSourceType || null,

297	          ? formData.deliveryCourierId || null
298	          : null,

300	          ? formData.deliveryCourierId || null
301	          : null,
302	        shippingCourierId: viaShippingAgent

304	          : null,
305	        shipping_courier_id: viaShippingAgent
306	          ? formData.shippingCourierId || null
307	          : null,
308	        createdByName: profile?.fullName || "Root Admin",

311	
312	        // بيانات مالية وحسابية - تُخزَّن في data لأنها ليست أعمدة مباشرة

314	        currency: orderCurrency,

324	        sheinRedPrice: toNumber(formData.sheinRedPrice) || 0,
325	        cartShareCode,

327	        couponEnabled,
328	        couponRate,

334	        totalCBM: currentCalcs.totalCBM,
335	        totalCostSAR: currentCalcs.totalOrderSAR,
336	        totalCostYER: currentCalcs.totalOrderYER,
337	        amountPaid: toNumber(formData.amountPaid) || 0,
338	        amountRemaining: currentCalcs.remainingYER,
339	        paymentStatus: payStatus,

343	        viaShippingAgent: viaShippingAgent,
344	        payLater: payLater,
345	        directApprove: directApprove,
346	        paymentMethod: payLater

351	        bankReference: formData.bankReference || "",
352	        cashAmount: toNumber(formData.cashAmount) || 0,
353	        bankAmount: toNumber(formData.bankAmount) || 0,
354	        profitPerKgRate: toNumber(profitPerKgRate) || 19,
355	        cbmShippingRateValue: toNumber(cbmShippingRateValue) || 1400,
356	        addShippingEnabled,

358	        shippingCourierFeeRate: viaShippingAgent
359	          ? toNumber(formData.shippingCourierFeeRate) || 0
360	          : 0,
361	        profitSaudiSAR: viaShippingAgent ? currentCalcs.profitSaudiSAR : 0,
362	        profitCompanySAR: currentCalcs.profitCompanySAR,
363	        deductSourcingCostFromCourier: viaShippingAgent
364	          ? Boolean(formData.deductSourcingCostFromCourier)
365	          : false,

368	            ? "courier"
369	            : "system",
370	        sourcingCostAmount: currentCalcs.sourcingCostAmount,
371	        // نص حالة الطلب يأخذ بعين الاعتبار الاعتماد المباشر والدفع لاحقاً
372	        // Order status text respects directApprove and payLater
373	        orderStatus: orderStatusText,

392	      const orderCreatedThroughAggregate = Boolean(createOrderAggregate);

408	        delete orderData.delivery_courier_id;

419	        delete orderData.externalOrderNumber;

421	        await createOrderAggregate({

427	            orderStatusId: payload.orderStatusId,
428	            orderPartyId: payload.orderPartyId,

432	            courierId: payload.courierId,
433	            deliveryCourierId: payload.deliveryCourierId,
434	            shippingCourierId: payload.shippingCourierId,

436	            orderSourceType: payload.orderSourceType,
437	            currency: payload.currency,

440	            orderData,

442	          items: items.map(item => ({
443	            productId: item.product_id || item.productId,
444	            productName: item.productName || item.name,

447	            productUrl: item.productUrl || undefined,
448	            quantity: toNumber(item.quantity || 1),

453	          })),

463	            shippingDestination: ship.shippingDestination,

465	          })),

467	      } else {

469	        await createOrderRecord(payload.orderNumber, payload);
470	
471	      // ─── حفظ المنتجات الرئيسية في products ثم بنود الطلب في order_items ───
472	      // Save master products in 'products' table (only if brand new item with no product_id),
473	      // then save each order line item in 'order_items' referencing the master product.
474	      if (!orderCreatedThroughAggregate && items && items.length > 0) {

477	        const orderCurrencyRecord = activeCurrencies?.find(
478	          c =>

481	        );
482	        const orderCurrencyId =
483	          orderCurrencyRecord?.cur_id || orderCurrencyRecord?.code || null;
484	
485	        for (const item of items) {
486	          const qty = toNumber(item.quantity || 1);
487	          const unitPrice = toNumber(
488	            item.productPrice || item.price || item.unitPrice || 0
489	          );
490	          const weight = toNumber(item.weight || 0);
491	          const cbm = toNumber(item.cbm || 0);
492	          const isInsured = Boolean(item.isInsured);
493	          const insuranceFee = isInsured
494	            ? toNumber(item.insuranceFee) || 0
495	            : 0;
496	
497	          // ── التحقق من معرف المنتج: إذا كان المنتج موجود مسبقاً (product_id مملوء) فلا تنشئه مجدداً ──

506	          if (!masterProductId) {

508	            // Brand new product: create in products table with all fields and order currency FK
509	            masterProductId =
510	              "prod_" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);

540	
541	          // ── حفظ بند الطلب في order_items مرتبطاً بالطلب والمنتج الرئيسي ──

543	          const itemId = "item_" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
544	          await createOrderItem(itemId, {
545	            items_id: itemId,

551	            produc_source_id: formData.orderSourceId || null,

   Better: split — if `status` is present, use the status route; otherwise use the data route. And keep both if both present? The API's status route owns stage. Simplest robust approach:
   ```ts
   async updateOrderRecord(id, changes) {
     const status = changes.status ?? changes.orderStatus;
     const { status: _s, orderStatus: _o, orderStatusId, ...data } = changes;
     if (Object.keys(data).length > 0) await client.patch(`/api/v1/orders/${id}`, data);
     if (typeof status === 'string' || typeof orderStatusId === 'string') await client.patch(`/api/v1/orders/${id}/status`, { status, orderStatusId });
   }
   ```
   Careful: PATCH /api/v1/orders/:id with unknown keys → zod strips unknown keys (z.object strips) so extra keys are harmless. 96	async function page(
97	  pool: Pool,
98	  table: string,
99	  columns: string,
100	  order: string,
101	  input: PageQuery,
102	  searchColumns: string[],
103	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
104	  const values: unknown[] = [];
105	  const filters: string[] = [];
106	  if (input.search) {
107	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
108	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
109	  }
110	  if (input.customerId) {
111	    values.push(input.customerId);
112	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
113	  }
114	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
115	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
116	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
117	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
118	    values,
119	  );
120	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };

235	    const unsubOrders = api.collections.orders.subscribe(

44	    : order.orderStatusNameEn || catalogStage?.nameEn || order.orderStatus;
45	  const label = String(name ?? '').trim();
46	  return stageId === null || stageId === undefined ? (label || '—') : `${stageId} : ${label}`;

5	type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
6	type ApiRow = Record<string, unknown> & { id?: string };
7	type ApiCollectionConfig = { readPath: string; writePath?: string; idKey: string };
8	
9	const client = new ApiClient({
10	  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
11	  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
12	  maxReadRetries: 0,
13	});
14	
15	const unsupported = (operation: string): never => {
16	  throw new Error(`ORDERS_API_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED:${operation}`);
17	};
18	const normalize = <T extends ApiRow>(row: T, idKey: string): T & { id: string } => ({ ...row, id: String(row[idKey] ?? row.id ?? '') });
19	const extractRows = <T extends ApiRow>(data: T[] | { items?: T[] } | undefined): T[] => Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : [];
20	
21	function makeApiCollection<T extends ApiRow>(config: ApiCollectionConfig): OrdersCollectionRepository<T> {
22	  const list = async (): Promise<readonly T[]> => {
23	    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T[] | { items?: T[] }>>(config.readPath, { limit: 100, offset: 0 });
24	    return extractRows(response.data).map((row) => normalize(row, config.idKey) as T);
25	  };
26	  const pathFor = (id: string) => `${config.writePath ?? config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
27	  return {
28	    subscribe(onData: (snapshot: { records: readonly T[] }) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
29	      let disposed = false;
30	      const refresh = async () => {
31	        try { const records = await list(); if (!disposed) onData({ records }); }
32	        catch (error) { if (!disposed) onError?.(error); }
33	      };
34	      void refresh();
35	      const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000);
36	      return () => { disposed = true; clearInterval(timer); };
37	    },
38	    list,
39	    async get(id) {
40	      const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T>>(`${config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
41	      return normalize(response.data, config.idKey) as T;
42	    },
43	    async create(id, payload) {
44	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`create:${config.readPath}`);
45	      const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(config.writePath, { ...payload, [config.idKey]: id });
46	      return { id: String(response.data[config.idKey] ?? response.data.id ?? id) };
47	    },
48	    async set(id, payload) {
49	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`set:${config.readPath}`);
50	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
51	    },
52	    async update(id, payload) {
53	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`update:${config.readPath}`);
54	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
55	    },
56	    async delete(id) {
57	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`delete:${config.readPath}`);
58	      await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id));
59	    },
60	  };
61	}

31	/**
32	 * Enrich order records with related party and source information.
33	 * This is a pure transformation: it does not mutate inputs or access UI/DB.
34	 */
35	export function enrichOrders(
36	  orders: OrderFilterRecord[],
37	  { customers, employees, couriers, sources }: OrderFilterEntities
38	): OrderFilterRecord[] {
39	  return orders.map(order => {
40	    const partyId =
41	      order.orderPartyId ||
42	      order.order_party_id ||
43	      order.customerId ||
44	      order.customer_id;
45	    const partyType =
46	      order.orderPartyType || order.order_party_type || "customer";
47	    let partyName = "";
48	    let partyPhone = "";
49	    let partyAddress = "";
50	
51	    if (partyType === "employee") {
52	      const employee = employees.find(record => record.id === partyId);
53	      partyName = readText(employee?.fullName || employee?.name);
54	      partyPhone = readText(employee?.phone);
55	      partyAddress = readText(employee?.address);
56	    } else if (partyType === "courier") {
57	      const courier = couriers.find(record => record.id === partyId);
58	      partyName = readText(courier?.fullName || courier?.name);
59	      partyPhone = readText(courier?.phone);
60	    } else {
61	      const customerId = order.customerId || order.customer_id || partyId;
62	      const customer = customers.find(record => record.id === customerId);
63	      partyName = readText(customer?.fullName || customer?.name);
64	      partyPhone = readText(customer?.phone || customer?.mobile);
65	      partyAddress = readText(customer?.address);
66	    }
67	
68	    const sourceId = order.orderSourceId || order.order_source_id;
69	    const source = sources.find(record => record.id === sourceId);
70	    const sourceName = readText(
71	      source?.name || order.orderSourceType || order.order_source_type
72	    );
73	
74	    return {
75	      ...order,
76	      customerName: partyName || readText(order.customerName),
77	      customerPhone: partyPhone || readText(order.customerPhone),
78	      customerAddress: partyAddress || readText(order.customerAddress),
79	      orderSourceName: sourceName,
80	      customerId: order.customerId || order.customer_id || "",
81	      orderPartyId: order.orderPartyId || order.order_party_id || "",
82	      orderPartyType:
83	        order.orderPartyType || order.order_party_type || "customer",
84	      isStaffOrder: Boolean(order.isStaffOrder ?? order.is_staff_order ?? false),
85	      employeeId: order.employeeId || order.employee_id || "",
86	      courierId: order.courierId || order.courier_id || "",
87	      orderPartyAccountId:
88	        order.orderPartyAccountId || order.order_party_account_id || "",
89	      orderSourceId: order.orderSourceId || order.order_source_id || "",
90	      orderSourceType: order.orderSourceType || order.order_source_type || "",
91	      deliveryCourierId:
92	        order.deliveryCourierId || order.delivery_courier_id || "",
93	      shippingCourierId:
94	        order.shippingCourierId || order.shipping_courier_id || "",
95	    };
96	  });
97	}
98	
99	/** Apply the existing search, status, courier and source rules, then sort. */
100	export function filterAndSortOrders(
101	  orders: OrderFilterRecord[],
102	  {
103	    searchText,
104	    statusFilter,
105	    courierFilter,
106	    sourceFilter,
107	    sortBy,
108	  }: OrderFilterCriteria
109	): OrderFilterRecord[] {
110	  return orders
111	    .filter(order => {
112	      const orderNumber = String(
113	        order.orderNumber || order.order_number || ""
114	      ).toUpperCase();
115	      const customerName = String(order.customerName || "").toLowerCase();
116	      const customerPhone = String(order.customerPhone || "");
117	      const trackingNumber = String(
118	        order.trackingNumber || order.tracking_number || ""
119	      ).toUpperCase();
120	      const query = searchText.toLowerCase();
121	
122	      const matchesSearch =
123	        orderNumber.includes(query.toUpperCase()) ||
124	        customerName.includes(query) ||
125	        customerPhone.includes(searchText) ||
126	        trackingNumber.includes(query.toUpperCase());
127	
128	      const matchesStatus =
129	        statusFilter === "all" ||
130	        String(order.order_status_id || order.orderStatusId) ===
131	          String(statusFilter) ||
132	        order.orderStatus === statusFilter;
133	
134	      const matchesCourier =
135	        courierFilter === "all" ||
136	        order.deliveryCourierId === courierFilter ||
137	        order.shippingCourierId === courierFilter;
138	
139	      const matchesSource =
140	        sourceFilter === "all" || order.orderSourceId === sourceFilter;
141	
142	      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesCourier && matchesSource;
143	    })
144	    .sort((a, b) => {
145	      if (sortBy === "date-desc")
146	        return readNumber(b.createdAt) - readNumber(a.createdAt);
147	      if (sortBy === "date-asc") return readNumber(a.createdAt) - readNumber(b.createdAt);
148	      if (sortBy === "amount-desc") {
149	        return (
150	          readNumber(b.amountPaid) +
151	          readNumber(b.amountRemaining) -
152	          (readNumber(a.amountPaid) + readNumber(a.amountRemaining))
153	        );
154	      }
155	      return 0;
156	    });
157	}

Key finding: enrichOrders overwrites `orderSourceName` with `sourceName` computed from `sources.find(record => record.id === sourceId)` — and if not found, falls back to order.orderSourceType. Hmm, but readText(source?.name || order.orderSourceType || order.order_source_type) → if source not found then falls back to orderSourceType. So orderSourceName should be non-blank if orderSourceType is set. But the gateway sources collection uses readPath '/api/v1/reporting/sources' with idKey 'sourceId' → normalize adds `id` = String(row.sourceId). Then useOrderData sets sourceId: readText(record.sourceId) || record.id. So sources have id and sourceId.

Now `order.orderSourceId` from the API list = o.order_source_id. Matching requires sources id to equal order_source_id. If type mismatch (string vs number) then find fails (strict ===). Then sourceName = orderSourceType, which could be blank if column empty → blank cell. That's a suspect but the report only needs mapping reality.

42	function toStatusItem(row: StatusRow): OrderStatusItem | null {

357	export async function listOrders(params: PageParams = {}): Promise<PagedResult<OrderRecord>> {
358	  const query = new URLSearchParams();
359	  if (params.limit !== undefined) query.set('limit', String(params.limit));
360	  if (params.offset !== undefined) query.set('offset', String(params.offset));
361	  if (params.search) query.set('search', params.search);
362	
363	  const result = await alxRequest<OrderRecord[]>(`/api/v1/orders?${query}`);
364	  if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error.message);
365	
366	  return {
367	    items: result.data,
368	    total: (result.meta?.['total'] as number | undefined) ?? result.data.length,
369	    limit: params.limit ?? 25,
370	    offset: params.offset ?? 0,
371	  };
372	}
373	
374	/**
375	 * جلب طلب واحد بمعرفه.
376	 * Get a single order by ID.
377	 */
378	export async function getOrder(orderId: string): Promise<OrderRecord | null> {
379	  const result = await alxRequest<OrderRecord>(`/api/v1/orders/${orderId}`);
380	  if (!result.success) {
381	    if (result.error.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') return null;
382	    throw new Error(result.error.message);
383	  }
384	  return result.data;
385	}

6	
7	function mapOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): OrdersViewModel {
8	  return { id: String(row.order_id ?? row.id ?? '') };
9	}
10	
11	function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
12	  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
13	  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
14	  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
15	}
16	
17	export class CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway implements OrdersGateway {
18	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<OrdersViewModel>> {
19	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
20	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
21	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
22	      .from('orders')
23	      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' })
24	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
25	      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
26	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
27	    return page((data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapOrder)), { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
28	  }
29	
30	  async getById(orderId: string): Promise<OrdersViewModel | null> {
31	    const { data, error } = await supabase
32	      .from('orders')
33	      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at')
34	      .eq('order_id', orderId)
35	      .maybeSingle();
36	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
37	    return data ? mapRow(data, mapOrder) : null;
38	  }
39	
40	  async changeStatus(orderId: string, orderStatusId: string, actorId: string): Promise<OrdersViewModel> {
41	    const { data, error } = await supabase
42	      .from('orders')
43	      .update({ order_status_id: orderStatusId, updated_by: actorId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
44	      .eq('order_id', orderId)
45	      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at')
46	      .single();
47	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
48	    return mapRow(data, mapOrder);
49	  }
50	}

```ts
const ORDER_STATUS_KEYS = new Set(['orderStatusId','order_status_id','orderStatus','status']);
async updateOrderRecord(id, changes) {
  const body = toOrderUpdateBody(changes);   // returns { data, status }
  if (Object.keys(body.data).length) await client.patch(`/api/v1/orders/${id}`, body.data);
  if (body.status) await client.patch(`/api/v1/orders/${id}/status`, body.status);
}
```

```ts
async updateOrderRecord(id, changes) {
  const body = orderUpdateBody(changes);
  if (body.data) await client.patch(`/api/v1/orders/${enc(id)}`, body.data);
  if (body.status) await client.patch(`/api/v1/orders/${enc(id)}/status`, body.status);
}
```

```ts
const orderDetailOf = (changes: OrdersWritePayload): OrderDetailPayload => {
  const detail: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of orderDetailPayloadKeys) if (changes[key] !== undefined) detail[key] = changes[key];
  return detail as OrderDetailPayload;
};

// تقسيم حمولة التعديل: مفاتيح المرحلة إلى مسار الحالة، والتفاصيل إلى الأعمدة المسطّحة.
const stageOf = (changes) => {
  const status = typeof changes.status === 'string' ? changes.status : typeof changes.orderStatus === 'string' ? changes.orderStatus : undefined;
  const orderStatusId = typeof changes.orderStatusId === 'string' ? changes.orderStatusId : undefined;
  const note = typeof changes.internalNotes === 'string' ? changes.internalNotes : undefined;  // hmm: note for status route
  if (!status && !orderStatusId) return undefined;
  return { status, orderStatusId, note };
};
```

234	async function findStage(client: PoolClient, ref: { id?: string | undefined; name?: string | undefined }): Promise<OrderStage | null> {
235	  const id = text(ref.id);

244	      LIMIT 1`,

33	    FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);

#### Thinking

Layout's unread effect deps include `hasPermission` (unstable) AND it calls setUnreadCount on success → re-render → effect re-runs → new fetch → if the count changes... Actually setUnreadCount(allowed.length) with the same value bails out of re-render (React skips re-render if state is identical via Object.is). But when the fetch fails (500), catch only logs → no state change → no re-render from that. Hmm. But Layout re-renders constantly (setSystime every 1s!). Line 184-185: `setInterval(() => setSystime(formatDate()), 1000)` — Layout re-renders EVERY SECOND, and the unread effect re-runs each time because `hasPermission` is a fresh function → **a notifications HTTP request every second** forever. That's the 500 spam + eventually 429 storm.

And NotificationsPage's effect: loadNotifications sets alertsState → render → new hasPermission → effect re-runs → immediate load → setState (asyncState.error / empty / success — new object identity each time!) → render → loop with NO delay. That is the hard freeze (unbounded synchronous-ish request loop).

Fix strategy (minimal, root-cause):
1. `useRole.ts`: memoize `hasPermission` with useCallback so its identity is stable (deps: permissions). This fixes all consumers at once — DRY and correct.
2. Also the clock in Layout re-renders every second — that's pre-existing but with a stable hasPermission the effect no longer refires. Good.
3. NotificationsPage: also guard the effect to run only when needed... With stable hasPermission, `loadNotifications` identity becomes stable → effect runs once + interval.

Also check other places that depend on hasPermission in effect deps — they'd be fixed by memoization too.

export interface ErrorDetails {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  details?: unknown[];
  requestId?: string;
}

export interface ErrorEnvelope {
  success: false;
  error: ErrorDetails;
}

/** A safe, transport-neutral application error suitable for Gateway and HTTP boundaries. */
export class ApplicationError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly details?: unknown[];
  readonly requestId?: string;
  readonly causeValue?: unknown;

  constructor(details: ErrorDetails, cause?: unknown) {
    super(details.message);
    this.name = 'ApplicationError';
    this.code = details.code;
    this.details = details.details;
    this.requestId = details.requestId;
    this.causeValue = cause;
  }

  toEnvelope(): ErrorEnvelope {
    const error: ErrorDetails = { code: this.code, message: this.message };
    if (this.details !== undefined) error.details = this.details;
    if (this.requestId !== undefined) error.requestId = this.requestId;
    return { success: false, error };
  }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function toErrorDetails(value: unknown): ErrorDetails | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.code !== 'string' || typeof value.message !== 'string') return null;
  const result: ErrorDetails = { code: value.code, message: value.message };
  if (Array.isArray(value.details)) result.details = value.details;
  if (typeof value.requestId === 'string') result.requestId = value.requestId;
  return result;
}

export function errorDetailsFromUnknown(error: unknown, fallbackCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'): ErrorDetails {
  if (error instanceof ApplicationError) {
    return {
      code: error.code,
      message: error.message,
      ...(error.details !== undefined ? { details: error.details } : {}),
      ...(error.requestId !== undefined ? { requestId: error.requestId } : {}),
    };
  }

function toErrorDetails(value: unknown): ErrorDetails | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.code !== 'string' || typeof value.message !== 'string') return null;
  const result: ErrorDetails = { code: value.code, message: value.message };
  if (Array.isArray(value.details)) result.details = value.details;
  if (typeof value.requestId === 'string') result.requestId = value.requestId;
  return result;
}

export function errorDetailsFromUnknown(error: unknown, fallbackCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'): ErrorDetails {
  if (error instanceof ApplicationError) {
    return {
      code: error.code,
      message: error.message,
      ...(error.details !== undefined ? { details: error.details } : {}),
      ...(error.requestId !== undefined ? { requestId: error.requestId } : {}),
    };
  }

  if (isRecord(error)) {
    const envelopeDetails = toErrorDetails(error.error);
    if (error.success === false && envelopeDetails) return envelopeDetails;

    const directDetails = toErrorDetails(error);
    if (directDetails) return directDetails;
  }

  if (error instanceof Error) return { code: fallbackCode, message: error.message };
  if (typeof error === 'string') return { code: fallbackCode, message: error };
  return { code: fallbackCode, message: 'An unexpected error occurred.' };
}

```ts
/**
 * نص الخطأ قابل للتشخيص: يضيف حقول التحقق إلى الرسالة — حقل: سبب.
 * Diagnostic error text: appends field-level validation issues to the message so a 400/422
 * explains itself in the UI instead of showing a generic blocker.
 */
export function describeError(error: unknown, fallback = 'Unknown error'): string {
  const details = errorDetailsFromUnknown(error, 'UNKNOWN_ERROR');
  const issues = Array.isArray(details.details)
    ? details.details.flatMap((item) => (isRecord(item) && typeof item.message === 'string'
        ? [`${typeof item.field === 'string' && item.field ? item.field : 'request'}: ${item.message}`] : []))
    : [];
  const message = details.message || fallback;
  return issues.length > 0 ? `${message} (${issues.slice(0, 5).join('; ')})` : message;
}
```

function parseOrderRecord(value: unknown): OrderRecord | null {
  if (!isEntityRecord(value)) return null;
  const orderStatusId = value.orderStatusId;
  const amountRemaining = value.amountRemaining;
  const createdAt = value.createdAt;
  return {
    ...value,
    id: value.id,

    status: readText(value.status) ?? undefined,

}

So: order_status1 was updated later without updating order_status_id → the id is stale, text is current. That's the legacy write path. Our API writes both. For these 4 divergent rows, TEXT is the freshest (jsonb id matches the old text at backfill time).

So the display should prefer the text's stage. Two options:
(a) Add a repair migration that re-syncs order_status_id from order_status1 where the text resolves to a catalog name. Small (4 rows), safe, and needed anyway for any legacy row updated by the old UI.
(b) Make the read projection resolve the name from order_status1 first.

Best: both — repair data (id := id resolved from text) so the id is authoritative going forward, and keep the projection as-is. This is a DDL/DML migration the user must run (DML could be run by runtime, but as a migration it's cleaner and it's a one-time data repair). /**
 * إرفاق سجلات الصيانة بالصفوف المقروءة في استعلام واحد —
 * attaches maintenance logs to the read asset rows with a single query (no N+1, no jsonb).
 */
async function attachMaintenanceLogs(
  pool: Pool,
  rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
): Promise<Array<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  const assetIds = rows.map((row) => String(row['assetId'] ?? '')).filter((value) => value.length > 0);
  if (assetIds.length === 0) return rows;
  const logs = await pool.query(
    `SELECT asset_id AS "assetId", ${maintenanceLogColumns}
       FROM public.asset_maintenance_log
      WHERE asset_id = ANY($1::text[])
      ORDER BY asset_id, seq`,
    [assetIds],
  );
  const byAsset = new Map<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>>();
  for (const { assetId, ...log } of logs.rows as Array<Record<string, unknown> & { assetId: string }>) {
    const bucket = byAsset.get(assetId) ?? [];
    bucket.push({ ...log, cost: Number(log['cost'] ?? 0), createdAt: Number(log['createdAt'] ?? 0) });
    byAsset.set(assetId, bucket);
  }
  return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, maintenanceLogs: byAsset.get(String(row['assetId'] ?? '')) ?? [] }));
}

**Response:**

-- 0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql
-- إصلاح تباعد المرحلة: المسارات القديمة كانت تكتب نص الحالة (orders.order_status1) دون تحديث
-- orders.order_status_id، فبقي المعرّف قديمًا وتظهر الواجهة مرحلة لا تطابق ما يراه المشغّل.
-- Stage divergence repair: legacy write paths updated only the status text (orders.order_status1)
-- and never orders.order_status_id, so the stage id went stale while the text stayed current.
-- النص هو المرجح هنا لأنه آخر ما كتبه المشغّل؛ تُعاد تهيئة المعرّف منه فقط.
-- The text is authoritative because it is the operator's most recent write; only the id is re-seeded from it.
-- Date: 2026-10-15

BEGIN;

-- 1) إعادة تهيئة معرّف المرحلة من اسمها العربي المطابق حرفيًا لكتالوج المراحل.
--    Re-seed the stage id from the Arabic catalog name matched exactly (trim-only, no fuzzy match).
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(os.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;

-- 2) الاسم الإنجليزي احتياطيًا للصفوف التي لا تحمل اسمًا عربيًا مطابقًا.
--    English names cover rows whose text carries the English label instead of the Arabic one.
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(coalesce(os.name_en, '')) <> ''
   AND btrim(os.name_en) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM public.order_status ar WHERE btrim(ar.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   );

-- 3) الحزم القديمة بلا نص حالة تستمد المرحلة من حقل jsonb قبل إسقاطه (0034) —
--    rows with no status text take their stage from the legacy payload before 0034 drops it.
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(o.order_status1, '')), '') IS NULL
   AND os.order_status_id = NULLIF(btrim(o.data ->> 'orderStatusId'), '')
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;

-- 4) التحقق: لا يجوز أن يبقى نص مرحلة مطابق للكتالوج ومعرّفه يخالفه.
--    Guard: a status text that matches the catalog must never disagree with the stored stage id.
DO $$
DECLARE
  leftover integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) INTO leftover
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_status os ON btrim(os.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   WHERE o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;
  IF leftover > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_status_id is still inconsistent with order_status1 for % rows', leftover;
  END IF;
END $$;

COMMIT;

- حقل `data` **لم يُحذف** — حذفه هو `0034_drop_legacy_jsonb_payloads.sql` ويجب أن يكون **آخر خطوة بعد نشر الكود المسطّح**، وُضع في آخر الحزمة ولم أُدرجه في ملف التنفيذ الحالي.

## ثانيًا: ما أصلحته في الكود (لا يحتاج DDL)
- **تجميد النظام / الإشعارات**: السبب الجذري كان `hasPermission` تُنشأ بهوية جديدة كل رسم في [useRole.ts:207](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/src/hooks/useRole.ts#L207)، مع ساعة `Layout` التي تتحدث كل ثانية = طلب إشعارات كل ثانية → مئات `HTTP 429`. ثبّتُّها بـ `useCallback` وأضفت حارس انحدار يمنع الرجوع لهذا النمط في [error.contracts.test.ts](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/src/shared/contracts/error.contracts.test.ts).
- **أخطاء «غير فعالة» بلا سبب**: `describeError` في [error.contracts.ts](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/src/shared/contracts/error.contracts.ts:1) يسمّي الحقول المخالفة داخل رسالة الخطأ، وربطته بمسار إنشاء الطلب في [createOrderHandler.ts](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/src/features/orders/services/createOrderHandler.ts).
- **القوائم المنقوصة (الحسابات/المنتجات/الطلبات)**: [ordersApiDataGateway.ts](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/src/features/orders/services/ordersApiDataGateway.ts) كان يقرأ 100 صف فقط بصمت؛ الآن تقسيم صفحات `1000` حتى `5000`، وقراءة قواعد القيود التلقائية رُفعت إلى 1000.
- **قائمة اختيار الحساب المالي**: تحققت حيًّا أنها سليمة (80 حسابًا، 6 أوراق نقدية/بنكية قابلة للترحيل، `acc_sub_id AS "subAccountId"` يعمل) — فراغها كان أثرًا جانبيًا للعاصفة + القطع عند 100، وكلاهما أُغلق.
- **حقول قائمة الطلبات**: إسقاط `orderListColumns` يُرجع `orderStatus/orderStatusNameAr/orderSourceName/orderSourceType` والعملات والمبالغ فعليًا — ظهورها الفارغ كان حزمة قديمة، والحل إعادة النشر.
- **خلل سلامة جديد كشفته**: `orders.order_status_id` متباعد عن `orders.order_status1` (4 من 5 صفوف عيّنة؛ النص هو الأحدث). أنشأت [0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/alx_api/src/db/migrations/0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql) وحاكيته على القاعدة الحية داخل `BEGIN…ROLLBACK`: 4 صفوف تُصلَح، `STILL DIVERGENT = 0`، ثم تراجع المعاملة.

## ثالثًا: المطلوب منك الآن (DDL — الدور `alx_api_runtime` لا يملك صلاحيات إنشاء)
نفّذ في لوحة Supabase (مشروع `ejrojwbbflzchasvgexr`) ملف [migrations_pending_2026-10-15.sql](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/migrations_pending_2026-10-15.sql) كما هو (455 سطرًا، بالترتيب داخله): **0010** ثم **0023** ثم **0036** ثم **0037**. وهي تعالج بالأدلة الحيّة:
- الأصول (500): أعمدة `category/cost/purchase_date/assigned_courier_*` غير موجودة + جدول `asset_maintenance_log` غير موجود ← 0023.
- سجلات تسليم الإشعارات/الإرسال الخارجي (500): `alx_api_private.notification_outbox` غير موجود ← 0010.
- حذف الطلب وحذف الدفعة (500) ← 0036.

ثم إعادة النشر بالترتيب: **alx_api → الواجهة**، وبعد التأكد من عمل الكود المسطّح يُنفَّذ `0034` لإسقاط `data` نهائيًا.

1	/**
2	 * notifications.repository.ts
3	 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4	 * مستودع قاعدة البيانات لوحدة الإشعارات (Notifications Repository).
5	 * Data access for in-app notifications (public.notifications + public.notification_recipient)
6	 * and for the external outbox queue (alx_api_private.notification_outbox).
7	 *
8	 * كل الحقول أعمدة رئيسية مسطّحة، ولا قراءة لحقول jsonb: الأخطاء تُرفع كما هي بدل ابتلاعها
9	 * وإرجاع قوائم فارغة تُخفي العطل عن الواجهة.
10	 * Every field is a flat column; no jsonb payload is read. Errors propagate instead of being
11	 * swallowed into empty results that hide the failure from the UI.
12	 */
13	
14	import type { Pool } from 'pg';
15	import type {
16	  CreateNotificationInput,
17	  NotificationRecord,
18	  NotificationsRepository,
19	  OutboxEventRecord,
20	  OutboxPageQuery,
21	  PageQuery,
22	  PageResult,
23	  SendExternalNotificationInput,
24	} from './notifications.contracts';
25	
26	/**
27	 * الأعمدة الرئيسية المسطّحة للإشعار + مستلموه من الجدول العلائقي.
28	 * Flat notification columns plus recipients sourced from the relational child table.
29	 * $1 هو معرّف المستخدم المشاهد (قد يكون NULL) — $1 is the viewing user id, may be NULL.
30	 */
31	const notificationSelect = `
32	  SELECT n.notification_id AS "notificationId",
33	         n.user_id AS "userId",
34	         COALESCE(n.title, '') AS title,
35	         COALESCE(n.message, '') AS message,
36	         COALESCE(NULLIF(n.type, ''), 'system') AS type,
37	         n.category AS category,
38	         COALESCE(n.is_public, false) AS "isPublic",
39	         COALESCE(viewer.is_read, n.is_read, false) AS "isRead",
40	         n.creator_id AS "creatorId",
41	         COALESCE(n.creator_name, (SELECT u.full_name FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = n.creator_id LIMIT 1)) AS "creatorName",
42	         COALESCE(recipients.user_ids, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS "associatedUserIds",
43	         n.created_at AS "createdAt",
44	         n.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
45	    FROM public.notifications n
46	    LEFT JOIN public.notification_recipient viewer
47	           ON viewer.notification_id = n.notification_id AND viewer.user_id = $1::text
48	    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
49	      SELECT array_agg(r.user_id ORDER BY r.user_id) AS user_ids
50	        FROM public.notification_recipient r
51	       WHERE r.notification_id = n.notification_id
52	    ) AS recipients ON TRUE`;
53	
54	/** تحويل صف النتيجة إلى كائن نقل الإشعار — map a result row to the transport DTO. */
55	function toRecord(row: Record<string, unknown>): NotificationRecord {
56	  const toIso = (value: unknown): string | null =>
57	    value === null || value === undefined ? null : new Date(String(value)).toISOString();
58	  return {
59	    notificationId: String(row['notificationId'] ?? ''),
60	    userId: row['userId'] === null || row['userId'] === undefined ? null : String(row['userId']),
61	    title: String(row['title'] ?? ''),
62	    message: String(row['message'] ?? ''),
63	    type: String(row['type'] ?? 'system'),
64	    category: row['category'] === null || row['category'] === undefined ? null : String(row['category']),
65	    isPublic: Boolean(row['isPublic']),
66	    isRead: Boolean(row['isRead']),
67	    creatorId: row['creatorId'] === null || row['creatorId'] === undefined ? null : String(row['creatorId']),
68	    creatorName: row['creatorName'] === null || row['creatorName'] === undefined ? null : String(row['creatorName']),
69	    associatedUserIds: Array.isArray(row['associatedUserIds'])
70	      ? (row['associatedUserIds'] as unknown[]).map((value) => String(value))
71	      : [],
72	    createdAt: toIso(row['createdAt']) ?? new Date().toISOString(),
73	    updatedAt: toIso(row['updatedAt']),
74	  };
75	}
76	
77	/**
78	 * قيود ظهور الإشعار للمستخدم: عام، أو موجه إليه مباشرة، أو مدرج ضمن مستلميه.
79	 * Visibility predicate: public, directly addressed, or listed among the recipients.
80	 */
81	function visibilityCondition(placeholder: string): string {
82	  return `((COALESCE(n.is_public, false) AND n.user_id IS NULL)
83	           OR n.user_id = ${placeholder}
84	           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_recipient v
85	                       WHERE v.notification_id = n.notification_id AND v.user_id = ${placeholder}))`;
86	}
87	
88	export function createNotificationsRepository(pool: Pool): NotificationsRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async listNotifications(query: PageQuery): Promise<PageResult<NotificationRecord>> {
91	      // المعرّف المشاهد دائمًا في الموضع الأول حتى مع غياب باقي الفلاتر.
92	      // The viewer id is always the first parameter so placeholders stay stable.
93	      const viewerId = query.visibilityFor ?? null;
94	      const values: unknown[] = [viewerId];
95	      // أساس التصفية: بلا مشاهد تُعرض كل الإشعارات، ومع مشاهد يُقصر على ما يراه.
96	      // Without a viewer the feed is unscoped; with one it is limited to what they may see.
97	      const conditions: string[] = [`($1::text IS NULL OR ${visibilityCondition('$1::text')})`];
98	
99	      if (query.userId) {
100	        values.push(query.userId);
101	        conditions.push(`(n.user_id = $${values.length} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_recipient q
102	                          WHERE q.notification_id = n.notification_id AND q.user_id = $${values.length}))`);
103	      }
104	      if (query.isRead !== undefined) {
105	        values.push(query.isRead);
106	        conditions.push(`COALESCE(viewer.is_read, n.is_read, false) = $${values.length}`);
107	      }
108	      if (query.category) {
109	        values.push(query.category);
110	        conditions.push(`n.category = $${values.length}`);
111	      }
112	      if (query.search) {
113	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
114	        const needle = values.length;
115	        conditions.push(`(n.title ILIKE $${needle} OR n.message ILIKE $${needle} OR n.creator_name ILIKE $${needle})`);
116	      }
117	
118	      const where = `WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}`;
119	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
120	
121	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
122	        `${notificationSelect},
123	                count(*) OVER()::text AS _total
124	           FROM public.notifications n
125	           ${where}
126	          ORDER BY n.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, n.notification_id DESC
127	          LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
128	        values,
129	      );
130	
131	      return {
132	        items: result.rows.map(toRecord),
133	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?.['_total'] ?? 0),
134	      };
135	    },
136	
137	    async getNotification(notificationId: string): Promise<NotificationRecord | null> {
138	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
139	        `${notificationSelect}
140	          WHERE n.notification_id = $2::text
141	          LIMIT 1`,
142	        [null, notificationId],
143	      );
144	      const row = result.rows[0];
145	      return row ? toRecord(row) : null;
146	    },
147	
148	    async createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<NotificationRecord> {
149	      const notificationId = `notif_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
150	      const actorId = input.actorId ?? input.userId ?? 'system';
151	      const recipients = [...new Set((input.associatedUserIds ?? []).map((value) => value.trim()).filter((value) => value.length > 0))];
152	
153	      const client = await pool.connect();
154	      try {
155	        await client.query('BEGIN');
156	
157	        const inserted = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
158	          `INSERT INTO public.notifications
159	             (notification_id, user_id, title, message, type, category, is_public, is_read,
160	              creator_id, creator_name, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
161	           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, false, $8,
162	                   COALESCE($9, (SELECT u.full_name FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = $8 LIMIT 1)),
163	                   NOW(), NOW(), $8, $8)
164	           RETURNING notification_id`,
165	          [
166	            notificationId,
167	            input.userId ?? null,
168	            input.title,
169	            input.message,
170	            input.type ?? 'system',
171	            input.category ?? 'system',
172	            input.isPublic ?? false,
173	            actorId,
174	            input.creatorName ?? null,
175	          ],
176	        );
177	        if (!inserted.rows[0]) throw new Error('تعذّر إنشاء الإشعار — the notification insert produced no row');
178	
179	        // صف لكل مستلم في الجدول العلائقي بدل مصفوفة jsonb — one relational row per recipient.
180	        if (recipients.length > 0) {
181	          await client.query(
182	            `INSERT INTO public.notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id, is_read)
183	              SELECT $1::text, btrim(r.user_id), false
184	                FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS r(user_id)
185	               WHERE btrim(r.user_id) <> ''
186	              ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO NOTHING`,
187	            [notificationId, recipients],
188	          );
189	        }
190	
191	        const created = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
192	          `${notificationSelect} WHERE n.notification_id = $2::text LIMIT 1`,
193	          [input.userId ?? null, notificationId],
194	        );
195	        const row = created.rows[0];
196	        if (!row) throw new Error('تعذّر قراءة الإشعار بعد إنشائه — the notification could not be read back');
197	
198	        await client.query('COMMIT');
199	        return toRecord(row);
200	      } catch (error) {
201	        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
202	        throw error;
203	      } finally {
204	        client.release();
205	      }
206	    },
207	
208	    async markAsRead(notificationId: string, userId?: string): Promise<NotificationRecord | null> {
209	      const viewerId = userId ?? null;
210	
211	      const existing = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
212	        `${notificationSelect}
213	          WHERE n.notification_id = $2::text
214	            AND ($1::text IS NULL OR ${visibilityCondition('$1::text')})
215	          LIMIT 1`,
216	        [viewerId, notificationId],
217	      );
218	      if (!existing.rows[0]) return null;
219	
220	      const client = await pool.connect();
221	      try {
222	        await client.query('BEGIN');
223	
224	        // حالة القراءة لكل مستلم على حدة — per-recipient read state for the viewer.
225	        if (viewerId) {
226	          await client.query(
227	            `INSERT INTO public.notification_recipient (notification_id, user_id, is_read, read_at, created_at, updated_at)
228	              VALUES ($1, $2, true, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
229	             ON CONFLICT (notification_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
230	                SET is_read = true, read_at = COALESCE(public.notification_recipient.read_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW()`,

235	        // الراية العامة تُطوى فقط للإشعار الموجه مباشرة أو حين لا يوجد مشاهد.

237	        await client.query(

240	            WHERE notification_id = $1

242	              AND is_read IS DISTINCT FROM true`,
243	          [notificationId, viewerId],
244	        );
245	
246	        const refreshed = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
247	          `${notificationSelect} WHERE n.notification_id = $2::text LIMIT 1`,

250	        const row = refreshed.rows[0];
251	        if (!row) {
252	          await client.query('ROLLBACK');
253	          return null;
254	        }
255	        await client.query('COMMIT');
256	        return toRecord(row);
257	      } catch (error) {
258	        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
259	        throw error;
260	      } finally {
261	        client.release();
262	      }
263	    },

265	    async markAllAsRead(userId: string): Promise<number> {
266	      const client = await pool.connect();
267	      try {
268	        await client.query('BEGIN');
269	
270	        // 1) حالة القراءة لكل مستلم — every recipient row of this user.
271	        const recipients = await client.query(
272	          `UPDATE public.notification_recipient
273	              SET is_read = true, read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW()
274	            WHERE user_id = $1 AND is_read IS DISTINCT FROM true`,
275	          [userId],
276	        );
277	
278	        // 2) الإشعارات الموجهة مباشرة أو العامة بلا مستلمين — addressed or unscoped public notifications.
279	        const direct = await client.query(
280	          `UPDATE public.notifications
281	              SET is_read = true, updated_at = NOW()
282	            WHERE is_read IS DISTINCT FROM true
283	              AND (user_id = $1
284	                   OR (user_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(is_public, false)
285	                       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_recipient r
286	                                        WHERE r.notification_id = public.notifications.notification_id)))`,
287	          [userId],
288	        );
289	
290	        await client.query('COMMIT');
291	        return (recipients.rowCount ?? 0) + (direct.rowCount ?? 0);
292	      } catch (error) {
293	        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
294	        throw error;
295	      } finally {
296	        client.release();
297	      }
298	    },

300	    async recordOutboxEvent(input: SendExternalNotificationInput): Promise<{ outboxId: string; status: string }> {
301	      const idempotencyKey = input.idempotencyKey ?? `outbox_${input.channel}_${input.recipient}_${Date.now()}`;
302	      const outboxId = `outb_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;

307	        `INSERT INTO alx_api_private.notification_outbox
308	           (outbox_id, idempotency_key, channel, recipient, template_id, message, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by)
309	         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'queued', NOW(), NOW(), 'api')
310	         ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()
311	         RETURNING outbox_id AS "outboxId", status`,
312	        [
313	          outboxId,
314	          idempotencyKey,
315	          input.channel,
316	          input.recipient,

67	async function page(
68	  pool: Pool,
69	  table: string,
70	  columns: string,
71	  order: string,
72	  input: PageQuery,
73	  searchColumns: string[],
74	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
75	  const values: unknown[] = [];
76	  const filters: string[] = [];
77	  if (input.search) {
78	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
79	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
80	  }
81	  if (input.customerId) {
82	    values.push(input.customerId);
83	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
84	  }
85	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
86	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
87	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
88	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
89	    values,
90	  );
91	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
92	}

**Response:**

## Defect map: why the "حساب مالي" list renders empty

**Root cause (field-name mismatch, no HTTP error):** `alx_api` returns account rows with `subAccountId`, `accountNameAr`, `currencyNo` (`F:\system\swiftship-tracker\swiftshift2\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.repository.ts:21`, schema `alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.schemas.ts:191-213`). Only `mapAccountRow` (`src\services\financeApi.ts:82-112`) renames them to the legacy `accSubId / accNameAr / curNo`. Every subscriber path below bypasses that mapper and filters on the legacy names.

- **D1 — Orders data hook drops 100% of accounts.** `src\features\orders\hooks\useOrderData.ts:239-259`: the accounts subscription filters `Boolean(account.accSubId || account.acc_sub_id)` (line 245). The API field is `subAccountId`, so the array is always `[]`. This single defect empties surfaces (1) create-order payment (`src\components\orders\CreateOrderModal.tsx:316-321` → `src\features\orders\components\create-order-modal\CreateOrderStep4.tsx:409`) and (2) COD/payment dialog (`src\components\orders\PaymentModal.tsx:124-133`). Fix: read `account.subAccountId ?? account.accSubId ?? account.acc_sub_id` (or run rows through `mapAccountRow`).
- **D2 — `EditOrderModal` gets no `financialAccounts` prop at all.** Parent renders it without the prop (`src\features\orders\pages\subcomponents\OrdersPageDialogs.tsx:294-312`), while `EditOrderModal.tsx:73,152` defaults it to `[]`, so `cashAccountsList/bankAccountsList` (`:167-172`) are empty. Fix: pass `financialAccounts={financialAccounts}`.
- **D3 — Auto entries still read legacy Supabase, never the API.** `src\components\OrderStatusManagementTab.tsx:7` imports `db/collection/onSnapshot` from `data/legacy/legacy-compat` and loads accounts at `:144-146` (`collection(db,'accounts')`). This explains "no request to `/api/v1/finance/accounts`": the dropdown (`:1097`, `:1152`) is fed from Supabase only. Fix: replace with `financialAccountService.getAllAccounts()` / API subscription and map `entityType === 'system'` rows.
- **D4 — Finance-accounting gateway does not normalize legacy names.** `src\components\financeAccounting\FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:35-40` maps only `id`/`accountName`; rows keep `subAccountId`/`accountNameAr`. Consumers then filter on `accSubId`/`isPosting`: `src\components\financeAccounting\useFinanceAccountingSelectors.ts:280,300-307`, `src\components\finance\forms\VoucherEntryForm.tsx:259,263` (`a.isPosting` is never set on these rows → empty cash/bank lists), `GeneralEntryForm.tsx:498`, `CompoundEntryForm.tsx:500`, `CustodyAdvancesTab.tsx:43-44`. Fix: apply `mapAccountRow` + derive `isPosting` in `normalizeRows`.
- **D5 — Silent catches mask permission/403 failures.** `src\services\financialAccountService.ts:588-594` returns `[]` on error; `src\features\financeEntries\pages\FinanceEntriesPage.tsx:84` `.catch(() => ({ data: [] }))` swallows a 403 from `route('view_financial_accounts', …)` (`alx_api\src\modules\finance\finance.routes.ts:105`), leaving the entries/vouchers picker empty with no visible error.
- **D6 — Page-size truncation.** `src\features\orders\services\ordersApiDataGateway.ts:23` and `FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:67-70` fetch `limit: 100` only, no paging.

Field names the UI expects: `id, name, accNameAr, accountCode, currency, curNo, accSubId ('111'/'112'), isPosting, isActive, entityType, entityId, entityName` — API gives `accountId, accountNameAr, currencyNo, subAccountId` and no `isPosting`.

217	    if (!accountingHierarchyService.isPostingAccount(debitAccount) || !accountingHierarchyService.isPostingAccount(creditAccount)) {
218	      throw new Error('Journal entries may only use active financial posting accounts.');
219	    }
220	
221	    const result = await financialEntryService.createFromLegacyVoucher({
222	      entryNumber: entry.entryNumber,
223	      createdAt: entry.createdAt || Date.now(),
224	      description: entry.description,
225	      attachments: entry.attachments,
226	      notes: entry.notes,
227	      amount: entry.amount,
228	      currency: entry.currency,
229	      amountDebitCurrency: entry.amountDebitCurrency,
230	      amountCreditCurrency: entry.amountCreditCurrency,
231	      module: entry.module,
232	      refNumber: entry.refNumber,
233	      orderId: entry.orderId,
234	      shipmentId: entry.shipmentId,
235	      automationKey: entry.automationKey,
236	      autoRuleId: entry.autoRuleId,
237	      isAutomatic: entry.isAutomatic,
238	      createdByUid: entry.createdByUid,
239	      paymentMethod: (entry as any).paymentMethod,
240	      // تمرير postingStatus من القيد — forward postingStatus from main entry for autoPost support
241	      postingStatus: entry.postingStatus || 'posted',
242	    }, {
243	      id: debitAccount.id!, curNo: debitAccount.curNo, currency: debitAccount.currency,
244	      entityType: debitAccount.entityType, entityId: debitAccount.entityId,
245	    }, {
246	      id: creditAccount.id!, curNo: creditAccount.curNo, currency: creditAccount.currency,
247	      entityType: creditAccount.entityType, entityId: creditAccount.entityId,
248	    });
249	
250	    activityLogService.log(
251	      "financial_transaction" as any,
252	      debitAccount.entityName + " / " + creditAccount.entityName,
253	      {
254	        type: "Double-Entry-Unified",
255	        amount: entry.amount,
256	        currency: entry.currency,
257	        refNumber: entry.refNumber,
258	        entryNumber: entry.entryNumber,
259	      },
260	    );
261	
262	    return result.id;
263	  }

265	  /**
266	   * Record a true double-entry transaction (Debit one account, Credit another)
267	   */
268	  async recordDoubleEntryTransaction(
269	    debitAccountId: string,
270	    creditAccountId: string,
271	    transactionData: Omit<AccountTransaction, "id" | "type" | "currency">,
272	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },
273	  ): Promise<void> {
274	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(debitAccountId);
275	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(creditAccountId);
276	
277	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
278	      throw new Error(
279	        "Debit or Credit account does not exist in chart registry.",
280	      );
281	    }
282	
283	    const now = transactionData.createdAt || Date.now();
284	    const entryNumber =
285	      transactionData.refNumber ||
286	      `JV-${now}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
287	
288	    const journalEntry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id"> = {
289	      entryNumber,
290	      createdAt: now,
291	      description: transactionData.description || "",
292	      attachments: (transactionData as any).attachments || [],
293	      notes:
294	        (transactionData as any).notes || transactionData.description || "",
295	
296	      debitAccountId,
297	      debitAccountName: debitAccount.entityName,
298	      debitAccountCode: debitAccount.accountCode,
299	
300	      creditAccountId,
301	      creditAccountName: creditAccount.entityName,
302	      creditAccountCode: creditAccount.accountCode,
303	
304	      amount: transactionData.amountOriginal,
305	      currency: transactionData.currencyOriginal,
306	      amountDebitCurrency: 0, // Computed dynamically in recordJournalEntry
307	      amountCreditCurrency: 0, // Computed dynamically in recordJournalEntry
308	
309	      module: transactionData.module || "adjustment",
310	      refNumber: transactionData.refNumber || "",
311	      createdByUid: transactionData.createdByUid || "system",
312	      createdByName: transactionData.createdByName || "Finance System Admin",
313	    };
314	
315	    await this.recordJournalEntry(journalEntry, providedRates);
316	  }
