318	  /**
319	   * Centralized, unified and strict recordTransaction method.
320	   * Enforces that every transaction defines a source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account,
321	   * checks that the transaction amounts are fully balanced,
322	   * and registers the unified transaction accordingly.
323	   */
324	  async recordTransaction(
325	    transaction: Transaction,
326	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },
327	  ): Promise<void> {
328	    // 1. Enforce strict requirement: Must explicitly define source (Credit) and destination (Debit)
329	    if (!transaction.debitAccount?.id || !transaction.creditAccount?.id) {
330	      throw new Error(
331	        "Transaction submission rejected: A source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account are explicitly required.",
332	      );
333	    }
334	
335	    // 2. Prevent any transaction submission where totalDebit !== totalCredit
336	    // On the single value amount double entry form, the debit and credit totals are inherently equal to this amount.
337	    const debitTotal = transaction.amount;
338	    const creditTotal = transaction.amount;
339	    if (debitTotal !== creditTotal) {
340	      throw new Error(
341	        "Transaction submission rejected: Sum of Debits must equal Sum of Credits (totalDebit == totalCredit). debitTotal=" + debitTotal + "creditTotal=" + creditTotal,
342	      );
343	    } else if (debitTotal <= 0) {
344	      throw new Error(
345	        "Transaction submission rejected: Debit Amount must be greater than zero.",
346	      );
347	    } else if (creditTotal <= 0) {
348	      throw new Error(
349	        "Transaction submission rejected: Credit Amount must be greater than zero.",
350	      );
351	    }
352	
353	
354	
355	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(transaction.debitAccount.id);
356	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(
357	      transaction.creditAccount.id,
358	    );
359	
360	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
361	      throw new Error(
362	        "Transaction submission rejected: Specified accounts do not exist.",
363	      );
364	    }
365	
366	    const journalEntry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id"> = {
367	      entryNumber:
368	        (transaction as any).entryNumber ||
369	        transaction.automationKey ||
370	        `JV-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replaceAll('-', '')}-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
371	      createdAt: transaction.date || Date.now(),
372	      description: transaction.description || "",
373	      attachments: transaction.attachments || [],
374	      notes: transaction.notes || transaction.description || "",
375	
376	      debitAccountId: transaction.debitAccount.id,
377	      debitAccountName: debitAccount.entityName,
378	      debitAccountCode: debitAccount.accountCode,
379	
380	      creditAccountId: transaction.creditAccount.id,
381	      creditAccountName: creditAccount.entityName,
382	      creditAccountCode: creditAccount.accountCode,
383	
384	      amount: transaction.amount,
385	      currency: transaction.currency || debitAccount.currency || "YER",
386	      amountDebitCurrency: 0,
387	      amountCreditCurrency: 0,
388	
389	      module: transaction.module || "adjustment",
390	      refNumber: transaction.refNumber || "",
391	      orderId: transaction.orderId,
392	      orderNumber: transaction.orderNumber,
393	      shipmentId: transaction.shipmentId,
394	      automationKey: transaction.automationKey,
395	      autoRuleId: transaction.autoRuleId,
396	      statusId: transaction.statusId,
397	      isAutomatic: transaction.isAutomatic,
398	      amountSources: transaction.amountSources,
399	      amountBreakdown: transaction.amountBreakdown,
400	      // تمرير postingStatus إذا مُرِّر من القيد التلقائي — forward postingStatus if provided (for autoPost support)
401	      postingStatus: (transaction as any).postingStatus || 'posted',
402	      createdByUid: transaction.createdByUid || "system",
403	      createdByName: transaction.createdByName || "Audit Engine",
404	    };
405	
406	    await this.recordJournalEntry(journalEntry, providedRates);
407	  }

492	  /**
493	   * Fetches current exchange rates from the `cur_price` table in Supabase via currencyService.
494	   * الأسعار ديناميكية كاملاً من جداول currency + cur_price — لا أسعار ثابتة.
495	   */
496	  async getExchangeRates(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
497	    try {
498	      const activeCurrencies = await currencyService.getActiveCurrencies();
499	      if (!activeCurrencies.length) {
500	        throw new Error('لا توجد عملات نشطة يمكن التحقق من أسعارها.');
501	      }
502	      const rates: Record<string, number> = {};
503	      for (const currency of activeCurrencies) {
504	        const code = String(currency.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
505	        const price = currency.isDefault ? 1 : Number(currency.currentPrice);
506	        if (!code || !Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) {
507	          throw new Error(`لا يوجد سعر صرف موثق للعملة ${code || '[unknown]'}.`);
508	        }
509	        rates[code] = price;
510	      }
511	      return rates;
512	    } catch (e) {
513	      console.error('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر تحميل أسعار الصرف الموثقة؛ أُوقف إنشاء القيد بدل استخدام سعر احتياطي.', e);
514	      throw e;
515	    }
516	  }

518	  /**
519	   * Validates if a currency is active (isActive = true).
520	   * Throws an error if the currency is disabled to prevent voucher/transaction creation.
521	   */
522	  async validateCurrencyActive(currencyCode: string): Promise<boolean> {
523	    if (!currencyCode) return true;
524	    const activeCurrencies = await currencyService.getActiveCurrencies();
525	    const isAvailable = activeCurrencies.some(
526	      (c) => c.code.toUpperCase() === currencyCode.toUpperCase()
527	    );
528	    if (!isAvailable) {
529	      throw new Error(`العملة (${currencyCode}) معطلة حالياً في النظام ولا يمكن إنشاء قيد بها.`);
530	    }
531	    return true;
532	  }
533	
534	  /**
535	   * Universal Currency Converter
536	   * تحويل مبلغ من عملة إلى أخرى باستخدام خريطة أسعار الصرف.
537	   *
538	   * المنطق:
539	   *   rates[X] = كم وحدة من العملة الأساس تساوي 1 وحدة من X
540	   *   العملة الأساس (isDefault=true) لها rate=1
541	   *   تحويل A → B = amount * rates[A] / rates[B]
542	   *
543	   * لا يوجد افتراض بأن YER هي العملة الأساس — العملة الأساس هي التي rate=1
544	   */
545	    convertToTargetCurrency(
546	    amount: number,
547	    fromCurrency: string,
548	    targetCurrency: string,
549	    exchangeRates: Record<string, number | undefined>,
550	  ): number {
551	    return convertToTargetCurrencyValue(amount, fromCurrency, targetCurrency, exchangeRates);
552	  }
553	
554	  /**
555	   * Convert amount to default currency (YER by default or system currency)
556	   */
557	  convertToDefaultCurrency(
558	    amount: number,
559	    fromCurrency: string,
560	    defaultCurrency: string,
561	    exchangeRates: {
562	      USD?: number;
563	      SAR?: number;
564	      [key: string]: number | undefined;
565	    },
566	  ): number {
567	    return this.convertToTargetCurrency(
568	      amount,
569	      fromCurrency,
570	      defaultCurrency,
571	      exchangeRates as any,
572	    );
573	  }

623	  /**
624	   * Compute a ledger summary for a given account (total debit, credit, net balance)
625	   * by summing all account_trans for that account.
626	   * Useful for reconciliation and audit reports.
627	   * الملخص يعتمد أسطر القيود المرحّلة فقط (posting_status='posted') كما يعيدها API.
628	   */
629	  async getLedgerSummary(
630	    accountId: string,
631	  ): Promise<{ debit: number; credit: number; net: number; count: number }> {
632	    try {
633	      const movements = await readAllFinanceRows(
634	        `${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/movements`,
635	      );
636	      let debit = 0;
637	      let credit = 0;
638	      for (const movement of movements) {
639	        const amount = Number(movement?.amount ?? 0);
640	        if (movement?.transType === 'Debit') debit += amount;
641	        else credit += amount;
642	      }
643	      return { debit, credit, net: debit - credit, count: movements.length };
644	    } catch (error) {
645	      console.error(
646	        "[FinancialAccountService] Error computing ledger summary:",
647	        error,
648	      );
649	      return { debit: 0, credit: 0, net: 0, count: 0 };
650	    }
651	  }
652	
653	  /**
654	   * يطلب من قاعدة البيانات إعادة احتساب رصيد الحساب من account_trans فقط.
655	   * لا يسمح هذا المسار للواجهة بإعادة بناء الرصيد من جداول ملغاة.
656	   * Asks the database to rebuild the balance from posted ledger lines only.
657	   */
658	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
659	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
660	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
661	    try {
662	      const accountPath = `${ACCOUNTS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}`;
663	      const account = await readFinanceRecord(accountPath);
664	      if (!account) {
665	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);
666	        return 0;
667	      }
668	      await recalculateAccountBalances([accountId]);
669	      const refreshedAccount = await readFinanceRecord(accountPath);
670	      return Number(mapAccountRow(refreshedAccount)?.balance ?? 0);
671	    } catch (error) {
672	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
673	      return 0;
674	    }
675	  }
676	
677	  /**
678	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
679	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
680	   */
681	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
682	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
683	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
684	    }
685	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
686	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
687	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
688	    }, delayMs);
689	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
690	  }
691	
692	  /**
693	   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.
694	   * تعمل دالة قاعدة البيانات على كل الحسابات دفعة واحدة وتعيد عدد ما احتُسب.
695	   * The database function processes every account in one call and reports how many were recalculated.
696	   */
697	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{ processed: number; errors: number }> {
698	    try {
699	      const summary = await recalculateAccountBalances();
700	      return { processed: summary.recalculatedCount, errors: summary.success ? 0 : 1 };
701	    } catch (error) {
702	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error recalculating balances:", error);
703	      return { processed: 0, errors: 1 };
704	    }
705	  }

707	  /**
708	   * Ensures essential system accounts exist and returns their IDs.
709	   *
710	   * Each system account uses the EXACT code from the chart of accounts:
711	   *   sys_profit_account  → 4000-0001  (Revenue — Company Profit)
712	   *   sys_delivery_cost   → 5000-2788  (Expense — Delivery Costs)
713	   *   sys_sourcing_cost   → 5100-4483  (Expense — Import/Sourcing Costs)
714	   *   sys_local_shipping  → 5100-7119  (Expense — Local Shipping)
715	   *   sys_packaging_fees  → 5100-7355  (Expense — Packaging Fees)
716	   *   sys_shipping_costs  → 5300-7118  (Expense — International Shipping)
717	   *   sys_cash_account    → 1111-0     (Asset — General Cash Box)
718	   */
719	
720	  async ensureSystemAccounts(
721	    _currency: string = 'YER',
722	  ): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
723	    const sysAccounts = [
724	      { id: "sys_profit_account" },
725	      { id: "sys_delivery_cost" },
726	      { id: "sys_sourcing_cost" },
727	      { id: "sys_orders_cost" },
728	      { id: "sys_local_shipping" },
729	      { id: "sys_packaging_fees" },
730	      { id: "sys_shipping_costs" },
731	      { id: "sys_cash_account" },
732	    ];
733	
734	    const sysIds: Record<string, string> = {};
735	
736	    for (const acc of sysAccounts) {
737	      const configuredDefault = await accountingHierarchyService.getDefaultAccount(acc.id);
738	      if (configuredDefault) {
739	        sysIds[acc.id] = configuredDefault.accountId;
740	        continue;
741	      }
742	      throw new Error(`الحساب الافتراضي «${acc.id}» غير مربوط أو معطّل في جدول default_accounts.`);
743	    }
744	    return sysIds;
745	  }
746	
747	  /**
748	   * Safe seed or retrieve automatic voucher rules from the settings document
749	   * يقرأ قواعد القيود التلقائية من وثيقة الإعدادات ويبذر الناقص منها.
750	   */
751	  async ensureAutomaticVoucherRules(): Promise<any[]> {
752	    const normalizedDefaultRules = buildDefaultAutomaticVoucherRules();
753	
754	    try {
755	      const record = await readSettingsRecord('automatic_voucher_rules');
756	      const storedRules = (record?.settings as { data?: unknown } | undefined)?.data;
757	      const currentRules: any[] = Array.isArray(storedRules) ? storedRules : [];
758	
759	      const existingRulesIds = new Set(currentRules.map((rule) => rule?.id));
760	      const missingRules = normalizedDefaultRules.filter((rule: any) => !existingRulesIds.has(rule.id));
761	      if (record && missingRules.length === 0) return currentRules;
762	
763	      const mergedRules = [...currentRules, ...missingRules];
764	      try {
765	        await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/settings/automatic_voucher_rules', {
766	          settings: { data: mergedRules },
767	        });
768	      } catch (writeError) {
769	        // الحفظ يحتاج edit_general_settings؛ القارئ بلا صلاحية يستعمل القواعد المدموجة محلياً.
770	        // Seeding needs edit_general_settings; a read-only user still gets the merged rules locally.
771	        console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر حفظ قواعد القيود التلقائية في الإعدادات:', writeError);
772	      }
773	
774	      return mergedRules;
775	    } catch (e) {
776	      console.error(
777	        "[FinancialAccountService] Failed to seed automatic voucher rules:",
778	        e,
779	      );
780	      return normalizedDefaultRules;
781	    }
782	  }
783	  /**
784	   * Safe execution of dynamic automatic voucher postings based on rule configuration
785	   */
786	  async triggerAutomaticVoucher(
787	    ruleId: string,
788	    order: any,
789	    entities: AutomaticVoucherEntities,
790	  ): Promise<boolean> {
791	    return executeAutomaticVoucher(this, ruleId, order, entities);

798	   * 2. If account exists, finds all `account_trans` legs linked to this account.
799	   * 3. For each transaction leg:
800	   *    - Collects the opposite account ID (if it's a double-entry with another account).
801	   *    - Deletes both legs of the double entry.

803	   * 4. Deletes the `accounts` document.

805	   * 6. Recalculates and synces balances for all opposite accounts affected by the deletions.

810	  ): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {

4	 * Shared finance HTTP gateway: one ApiClient instance, one envelope unwrap, and the account-row mapper
5	 * used by every finance service so the legacy shape is produced in exactly one place (DRY).

7	import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../data/http/app-api-client';
8	import type { GatewayQuery } from '../data/contracts/common.gateway';

11	/** عميل المالية هو عميل التطبيق المشترك نفسه — لا إعداد اتصال مكرر. */
12	export const financeApiClient = appApiClient;

14	export type { ApiEnvelope };

16	/** معاملات قراءة المالية الموسعة (تشمل مرشحات لا تعرفها GatewayQuery العامة). */

27	/** بعض المسارات تُعيد مصفوفة في data وأخرى كائناً فيه items — موحّد للقراءتين. */
28	export const asRows = (payload: unknown): any[] =>
29	  Array.isArray(payload)
30	    ? (payload as any[])
31	    : Array.isArray((payload as any)?.items)
32	      ? (payload as any).items
33	      : [];

35	export const isNotFoundError = (error: unknown): boolean =>
36	  (error as { code?: string })?.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND';

38	/** يقرأ صفحة واحدة ويفكّ غلاف الاستجابة. */
39	export async function readFinancePage(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<{ rows: any[]; total: number }> {
40	  const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(path, query);
41	  return { rows: asRows(res?.data), total: Number(res?.meta?.total ?? asRows(res?.data).length) };
42	}
43	
44	export async function readFinanceRows(path: string, query?: FinanceQuery): Promise<any[]> {
45	  return (await readFinancePage(path, query)).rows;
46	}

48	const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
49	const DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS = 20_000;
50	
51	/** يقرأ كل الصفحات المتاحة حتى الحد الأقصى حمايةً من الحلقات غير المنتهية. */
52	export async function readAllFinanceRows(
53	  path: string,
54	  query: FinanceQuery = {},
55	  pageSize = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
56	  maxRows = DEFAULT_MAX_ROWS,
57	): Promise<any[]> {
58	  const rows: any[] = [];
59	  for (let offset = 0; offset < maxRows; offset += pageSize) {
60	    const page = await readFinancePage(path, { ...query, limit: pageSize, offset });
61	    rows.push(...page.rows);
62	    if (page.rows.length < pageSize || rows.length >= page.total) break;
63	  }
64	  return rows;
65	}

82	export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {
83	  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();
84	  if (!accountId) return null;
85	  return {
86	    ...row,
87	    id: accountId,
88	    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),
89	    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),
90	    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),
91	    entityType: row.entityType,

93	    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn ?? ''),
94	    currency: String(row.currency ?? ''),
95	    curNo: row.curNo ?? row.currencyNo ?? undefined,
96	    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),
97	    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),
98	    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),
99	    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
100	    type: row.type,
101	    parentCode: row.parentCode ?? undefined,
102	    accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId ?? undefined,
103	    groupId: row.groupId ?? undefined,
104	    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),
105	    accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr ?? undefined,
106	    accNameEn: row.accNameEn ?? row.accountNameEn ?? undefined,
107	    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),
108	    notes: row.notes ?? undefined,
109	    createdAt: row.createdAt,
110	    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
111	  } as FinancialAccount;
112	}

114	/** مسارات تعديل الكيانات التي تحمل مرجع حسابها المالي. */
115	const ENTITY_API_PATH: Partial<Record<AccountEntityType, string>> = {
116	  customer: '/api/v1/customers',
117	  courier: '/api/v1/operations/couriers',
118	  employee: '/api/v1/operations/employees',
119	  source: '/api/v1/operations/sources',
120	  shipping_company: '/api/v1/operations/shipping-companies',
121	};

123	/**
124	 * يربط الحساب المالي بسجل الكيان. الفشل هنا تحذير فقط: الحساب أُنشئ ولا يجوز التراجع عنه بصمت.
125	 * Links the account to the entity record; a failure is reported but never hides the created account.
126	 */
127	export async function linkEntityAccount(
128	  entityType: AccountEntityType,
129	  entityId: string,
130	  fields: { accountId?: string; accountCode?: string; monthlySalary?: number },
131	): Promise<boolean> {
132	  const basePath = ENTITY_API_PATH[entityType];
133	  if (!basePath || !entityId) return false;
134	  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
135	  if (fields.accountId !== undefined) payload.accountId = fields.accountId;
136	  if (fields.monthlySalary !== undefined) payload.monthlySalary = fields.monthlySalary;
137	  if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return false;
138	  try {
139	    await financeApiClient.patch(`${basePath}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}`, payload);
140	    return true;
141	  } catch (error) {
142	    console.warn(`[financeApi] تعذر ربط الحساب المالي بسجل ${entityType}:`, error);
143	    return false;
144	  }
145	}

147	/** التحقق من وجود قيد بمفتاح أتمتة معين — يمنع تكرار القيود التلقائية. */
148	export async function hasEntryForAutomationKey(automationKey: string): Promise<boolean> {
149	  const key = String(automationKey || '').trim();
150	  if (!key) return false;
151	  const { rows, total } = await readFinancePage('/api/v1/finance/entries', { automationKey: key, limit: 1 });
152	  return total > 0 || rows.some((row) => String(row?.automationKey ?? '') === key);
153	}

155	/** يعيد احتساب الأرصدة عبر الدالة الآمنة؛ بدون معرفات = كل الحسابات. */
156	export async function recalculateAccountBalances(
157	  accountIds?: string[],
158	): Promise<{ success: boolean; recalculatedCount: number }> {
159	  const res = await financeApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ result?: { success?: boolean; recalculatedCount?: number } }>>(
160	    '/api/v1/finance/accounts/recalculate',
161	    accountIds && accountIds.length > 0 ? { accountIds } : {},
162	  );
163	  const result = res?.data?.result ?? {};
164	  return {
165	    success: result.success !== false,
166	    recalculatedCount: Number(result.recalculatedCount ?? accountIds?.length ?? 0),
167	  };
168	}

188	/**
189	 * Subscribe to the same legacy collections and transform their snapshots exactly as
190	 * OrdersPage previously did. The injected API makes the data boundary replaceable

193	export function useOrderData(
194	  enabled: boolean,
195	  api: OrdersFeatureApi = ordersApiDataGateway,
196	): OrderDataState {

209	
210	  useEffect(() => {
211	    if (!enabled) return;
212	
213	    const unsubOrders = api.collections.orders.subscribe(

216	          const parsed = parseOrderRecord(record);

223	      },

228	      setCustomers(records.filter(isCustomerRecord));
229	    });
230	
231	    const unsubEmployees = api.collections.employees.subscribe(({ records }) => {
232	      setEmployees(records.filter(isEmployeeRecord).filter((entry) => !entry.disabled));
233	    });

236	      setCouriers(records.filter(isCourierRecord));

268	          type: readText(record.type),
269	        })),

278

283	            ...record,

292	          error,

294	      },

296

298	      ({ records }) => {

301	            ...record,
302	            productId: readText(record.productId) || record.id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  target_ids text[]; target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[]; requested_count integer; actual_count integer;
  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0; deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_notifications integer := 0; deleted_whatsapp_logs integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;
  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);
  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]), COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts FROM public.account_trans WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);
  DELETE FROM public.notifications WHERE data->>'orderId' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'order_id' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'orderNumber' = ANY(target_numbers); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_notifications = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_logs WHERE data->>'orderId' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'order_id' = ANY(target_ids) OR data->>'orderNumber' = ANY(target_numbers); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_whatsapp_logs = ROW_COUNT;
  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids); END IF;
  DELETE FROM public.account_trans WHERE account_trans_id = ANY(account_trans_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;
  DELETE FROM public.orders_history WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR order_number = ANY(target_numbers) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;
  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true); DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids); GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT; PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);
  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts); END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('orderIds', target_ids, 'orders', deleted_orders, 'shipments', deleted_shipments, 'products', deleted_order_items, 'mainEntries', deleted_main_entries, 'accountTrans', deleted_account_trans, 'notifications', deleted_notifications, 'whatsappLogs', deleted_whatsapp_logs, 'ordersHi

export interface CreateNotificationInput {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  type?: 'system' | 'order' | 'shipment' | 'finance' | 'alert' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
  category?: 'order' | 'finance' | 'system' | 'shipment' | 'alert';
  isPublic?: boolean;
  associatedUserIds?: readonly string[];
}

export const notificationsApiDataGateway = {
  /** قائمة الإشعارات المرئية للمستخدم المصادق عليه + العدد الكلي من الـ meta. */
  async listNotifications(query: NotificationListQuery = {}): Promise<{ items: ApiNotification[]; total: number }> {
    const path = query.scope === 'all' ? '/api/v1/notifications/all' : '/api/v1/notifications';
    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
      `${path}${toQueryString({
        limit: query.limit ?? 200,
        offset: query.offset ?? 0,
        isRead: query.isRead,
        category: query.category,
        search: query.search,
      })}`,
    );
    const items = asArray<unknown>(response.data).map(asNotification);
    return { items, total: Number(response.meta?.total ?? items.length) };
  },

  /** عدد الإشعارات غير المقروءة من العدّاد الخادمي، لا من طول الصفحة. */
  async getUnreadCount(scope: 'mine' | 'all' = 'mine'): Promise<number> {
    const { total } = await this.listNotifications({ limit: 1, offset: 0, isRead: false, scope });
    return total;
  },

  /** إنشاء إشعار داخلي — كل الحقول أعمدة رئيسية ولا حقل payload. */
  async createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<ApiNotification> {
    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/notifications', input);
    return asNotification(response.data);
  },

  /** تعليم إشعار كمقروء لهذا المستخدم (حالة القراءة لكل مستلم في الجدول العلائقي). */
  async markAsRead(notificationId: string): Promise<ApiNotification> {
    const response = await appApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
      `/api/v1/notifications/${encodeURIComponent(notificationId)}/read`,
      {},
    );
    return asNotification(response.data);
  },

  /** تعليم كل إشعارات المستخدم الحالي كمقروءة؛ يُرجع عدد السطور المحدّثة. */
  async markAllAsRead(): Promise<number> {
    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ updatedCount?: number }>>(
      '/api/v1/notifications/read-all',
      {},
    );
    return Number(response.data?.updatedCount ?? 0);
  },

  /** سجل أحداث الإرسال الخارجي (WhatsApp/Email/SMS) من جدول الـ Outbox. */
  async listDeliveryLogs(query: { limit?: number; offset?: number; status?: string; channel?: string } = {}): Promise<{ items: ApiDeliveryLog[]; total: number }> {
    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
      `/api/v1/notifications/delivery-logs${toQueryString({
        limit: query.limit ?? 150,
        offset: query.offset ?? 0,
        status: query.status,
        channel: query.channel,
      })}`,
    );

-- Migration: 0010_notifications_outbox.sql
-- Description: إنشاء جدول Outbox للإشعارات الخارجية (WhatsApp / Email / SMS) ومنح صلاحيات الـ runtime.
-- Creation of the external notification outbox (transactional outbox pattern) plus runtime grants.
-- Date: 2026-10-05 — revised 2026-10-14
--
-- ملاحظة تصحيحية: هذا الملف كان يُنشئ جدولا وهميا لـ public notifications بأعمدة
-- (body / notification_type / channel / metadata) غير موجودة في قاعدة البيانات الحقيقية،
-- وكان يستخدم حقل jsonb جامع. الإشعارات الداخلية تعيش في public.notifications (جدول قديم)
-- ويسطّحها الترحيل 0025_flatten_notifications.sql، ولا أعمدة jsonb بعد هذا الترحيل.
-- Corrective note: this file previously created a fictional notifications table with columns
-- that do not exist in the real database and a catch-all jsonb field. In-app notifications live in
-- public.notifications and are flattened by 0025; no jsonb payload columns remain.

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. جدول Outbox للإشعارات الخارجية (Transactional Outbox Pattern)
-- Outbox table for external notifications
-- كل الحقول أعمدة رئيسية — لا يوجد حقل payload جامع — every field is a first-class column.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alx_api_private.notification_outbox (
  -- المعرف الفريد لحدث الـ Outbox
  outbox_id             TEXT        NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,

  -- مفتاح الـ Idempotency لمنع تكرار الإرسال
  idempotency_key       TEXT        NOT NULL UNIQUE,

  -- القناة الخارجية: whatsapp | email | sms
  channel               TEXT        NOT NULL
                          CHECK (channel IN ('whatsapp', 'email', 'sms')),

  -- المستلم: رقم الهاتف أو البريد الإلكتروني
  recipient             TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- اسم المستلم القابل للقراءة (اختياري)
  recipient_name        TEXT,

  -- معرف قالب الرسالة (اختياري)
  template_id           TEXT,

  -- نص الرسالة
  message               TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- الإشعار الداخلي المرتبط إن وُجد (مرجع اختياري غير مقيد بإنشاء الجدول)
  notification_id       TEXT,

  -- حالة الإرسال: queued | processing | sent | failed | cancelled
  status                TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
                          CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'sent', 'failed', 'cancelled')),

  -- عدد محاولات الإرسال
  attempt_count         INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                          CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),

  -- أقصى عدد محاولات مسموحة
  max_attempts          INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 3
                          CHECK (max_attempts > 0),

  -- وقت آخر محاولة
  last_attempted_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,

1	-- Finance API phase 7 (tasks 7-ب / 7-ج):
2	--   1) complete the assets table with the administered fields,
3	--   2) grant the API runtime role DELETE on the tables the new admin endpoints write,
4	--   3) create the transactional entity financial footprint purge RPC.
5	-- Execution path: applied manually by the project owner in the Supabase dashboard
6	-- (the alx_api_runtime role has no DDL rights).
7	
8	-- 1) Assets schema completion / استكمال أعمدة الأصول
9	ALTER TABLE public.assets
10	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category text,
11	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cost numeric DEFAULT 0,
12	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS purchase_date text,
13	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS assigned_courier_id text,
14	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS assigned_courier_name text,
15	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS notes text,
16	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_logs jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
17	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by text,
18	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_by text;
19	
20	-- 2) DELETE grants for the finance admin surface and already-shipped product routes.
21	--    Without these, the API delete endpoints fail with 42501 at runtime.
22	GRANT DELETE ON
23	  public.assets,
24	  public.account,
25	  public.acc_main,
26	  public.acc_sub,
27	  public.acc_sub_group,
28	  public.accounts,
29	  public.default_accounts,
30	  public.salary_history,
31	  public.auto_entries,
32	  public.products,
33	  public.order_items,
34	  public.returned_products
35	TO alx_api_runtime;
36	
37	-- 3) Entity financial footprint purge / تطهير الأثر المالي للجهة
38	--    Deletes the entity's ledger footprint (accounts, movement legs, the entries those
39	--    legs form, related custody advances) and finally the entity row itself.
40	--    Guards: customers with orders and couriers with unsettled custody advances are refused.
41	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_entity_financial_footprint(
42	  p_entity_type text,
43	  p_entity_id text,
44	  p_actor text
45	) RETURNS jsonb
46	LANGUAGE plpgsql
47	SECURITY DEFINER
48	SET search_path = pg_catalog
49	AS $purge$
50	DECLARE
51	  v_accounts text[];
52	  v_entries  text[];
53	  v_open_orders integer;
54	  v_open_custodies integer;
55	  v_n_accounts integer;
56	  v_n_entries integer;
57	  v_n_legs integer;
58	  v_n_custodies integer;
59	  v_entity_table text;
60	  v_entity_pk text;
61	BEGIN
62	  IF p_entity_type NOT IN ('customers','couriers','employees','users','sources','shipping_companies') THEN
63	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_ENTITY_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: %', p_entity_type;
64	  END IF;
65	  IF p_entity_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_entity_id) = '' THEN
66	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_ENTITY_ID_REQUIRED';
67	  END IF;
68	
69	  -- Whitelisted table / primary-key map (verified against the live schema).
70	  v_entity_table := p_entity_type;
71	  v_entity_pk := CASE p_entity_type
72	    WHEN 'customers' THEN 'customer_id'
73	    WHEN 'couriers' THEN 'courier_id'
74	    WHEN 'employees' THEN 'employee_id'
75	    WHEN 'users' THEN 'user_id'
76	    WHEN 'sources' THEN 'source_id'
77	    WHEN 'shipping_companies' THEN 'shipping_company_id'
78	  END;
79	
80	  -- Guard: customers cannot be purged while orders reference them.
81	  IF p_entity_type = 'customers' THEN
82	    SELECT count(*) INTO v_open_orders FROM public.orders WHERE customer_id = p_entity_id;
83	    IF v_open_orders > 0 THEN
84	      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_BLOCKED_CUSTOMER_HAS_ORDERS: %', v_open_orders;
85	    END IF;
86	  END IF;
87	
88	  -- Guard: couriers cannot be purged with outstanding custody advances.
89	  IF p_entity_type = 'couriers' THEN
90	    SELECT count(*) INTO v_open_custodies
91	    FROM public.custody_advances
92	    WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id
93	      AND (status IS DISTINCT FROM 'settled')
94	      AND COALESCE(amount_outstanding, 0) > 0;
95	    IF v_open_custodies > 0 THEN
96	      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PURGE_BLOCKED_COURIER_HAS_OPEN_CUSTODY: %', v_open_custodies;
97	    END IF;
98	  END IF;
99	
100	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_id), '{}'::text[]) INTO v_accounts
101	  FROM public.accounts WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id;
102	
103	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT main_entry_id), '{}'::text[]) INTO v_entries
104	  FROM public.account_trans
105	  WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id
106	     OR (array_length(v_accounts, 1) IS NOT NULL AND account_id = ANY (v_accounts))
107	     OR custody_id IN (SELECT custody_advance_id FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id);
108	
109	  v_n_accounts := (SELECT count(*) FROM public.accounts WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id);
110	  v_n_entries  := COALESCE(array_length(v_entries, 1), 0);
111	  v_n_legs     := (SELECT count(*) FROM public.account_trans
112	                   WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id
113	                      OR (array_length(v_accounts, 1) IS NOT NULL AND account_id = ANY (v_accounts))
114	                      OR custody_id IN (SELECT custody_advance_id FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id));
115	
116	  DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE array_length(v_entries, 1) IS NOT NULL AND main_entry_id = ANY (v_entries);
117	
118	  DELETE FROM public.account_trans
119	  WHERE entity_id = p_entity_id
120	     OR (array_length(v_accounts, 1) IS NOT NULL AND account_id = ANY (v_accounts))
121	     OR custody_id IN (SELECT custody_advance_id FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id);
122	
123	  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE array_length(v_entries, 1) IS NOT NULL AND main_entry_id = ANY (v_entries);
124	
125	  SELECT count(*) INTO v_n_custodies FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id;
126	  DELETE FROM public.custody_advances WHERE recipient_id = p_entity_id;
127	
128	  DELETE FROM public.accounts WHERE array_length(v_accounts, 1) IS NOT NULL AND account_id = ANY (v_accounts);
129	
130	  -- Remove the entity row itself (table and primary key are whitelisted above).
131	  EXECUTE format('DELETE FROM public.%I WHERE %I = $1', v_entity_table, v_entity_pk)
132	  USING p_entity_id;
133	
134	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
135	    'entityType', p_entity_type,
136	    'entityId', p_entity_id,
137	    'actor', p_actor,
138	    'purgedAt', now(),
139	    'deleted', jsonb_build_object(
140	      'accounts', v_n_accounts,
141	      'entries', v_n_entries,
142	      'movements', v_n_legs,
143	      'custodyAdvances', v_n_custodies
144	    )
145	  );
146	END;
147	$purge$;
148	
149	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.purge_entity_financial_footprint(text, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
150	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.purge_entity_financial_footprint(text, text, text) TO alx_api_runtime;
151

target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[];\n  requested_count integer; actual_count integer;\n  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0;\n  deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids\n    FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned\n   WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;\n  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);\n  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers\n    FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids\n    FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids\n    FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]),\n         COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[])\n    INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts\n    FROM public.account_trans\n   WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);\n\n  -- 1) أرجل القيود ثم القيود نفسها — payment legs first, then the entries they belong to.\n  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN\n    DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);\n  END IF;\n  DELETE FROM public.account_trans\n    WHERE account_trans_id = ANY(account_trans_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;\n  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;\n\n  -- 2) السجل التاريخي قبل آباء مفاتيحه الأجنبية (shipments ثم orders).\n  --    History rows reference shipments and orders, so they go first; orders_history_change cascades.\n  DELETE FROM public.orders_history\n    WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR order_number = ANY(target_numbers) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;\n\n  -- 3) الشحنات ومنتجات الطلب — only now are shipments and order items removable.\n  DELETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;\n  DELETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;\n\n  -- 4) الطلب نفسه مع كبت مؤرِّق الحذف — the order itself, with the audit trigger suppressed.\n  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true);\n  DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT;\n  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);\n\n  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts);\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'orderIds', target_ids,\n    'orders', deleted_orders,\n    'shipments', deleted_shipments,\n    'products', deleted_order_items,\n    'mainEntries', deleted_main_entries,\n    'accountTrans', deleted_account_trans,\n    'notifications', 0,\n    'whatsappLogs', 0,\n    'ordersHistory', deleted_orders_history,\n    'activityLogsDeleted', 0);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- إعادة منح التنفيذ لصلاحية التشغيل بعد الاستبدال — re-grant EXECUTE after the replacement.\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(text[]) FROM PUBLIC;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(text[]) TO alx_api_runtime;\n\nCOMMIT;\n",

/** عمود maintenance_logs قد يرجع نصًا مخزّنًا قديمًا — نصّفه ونقبل السجلات الصالحة فقط. */
function toMaintenanceLogs(value: unknown): MaintenanceLog[] {
  let rows: unknown = value;
  if (typeof rows === 'string') {
    try {
      rows = JSON.parse(rows);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [];
  return rows
    .filter((entry): entry is Record<string, unknown> => Boolean(entry) && typeof entry === 'object')
    .map((entry) => ({
      logId: toText(entry.logId ?? entry.log_id),
      cost: toNumber(entry.cost),
      currency: toText(entry.currency),
      type: (toText(entry.type) || 'Repair') as MaintenanceType,
      notes: toText(entry.notes),
      doneBy: toText(entry.doneBy ?? entry.done_by),
      date: toText(entry.date),
      createdAt: toNumber(entry.createdAt ?? entry.created_at),
    }));
}

function mapAssetRow(row: any): FinancialAsset | null {
  const id = toText(row?.assetId ?? row?.id).trim();
  if (!id) return null;
  return {
    id,
    assetCode: toText(row.assetCode ?? row.asset_code),
    nameAr: toText(row.nameAr ?? row.name_ar),
    nameEn: toText(row.nameEn ?? row.name_en),
    category: (toText(row.category) || 'Other') as AssetCategory,
    type: (toText(row.type) || 'Fixed') as AssetType,
    cost: toNumber(row.cost),
    currency: toText(row.currency),
    purchaseDate: toText(row.purchaseDate ?? row.purchase_date),
    assignedCourierId: row.assignedCourierId ?? row.assigned_courier_id ?? null,
    assignedCourierName: row.assignedCourierName ?? row.assigned_courier_name ?? null,
    status: (toText(row.status) || 'Active') as AssetStatus,
    notes: toText(row.notes),
    maintenanceLogs: toMaintenanceLogs(row.maintenanceLogs ?? row.maintenance_logs),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false && row.is_active !== false,
    financialAccountId: toText(row.accountId ?? row.account_id) || undefined,
    financialAccountCode: toText(row.accountCode ?? row.account_code) || undefined,
    createdAt: row.createdAt ?? row.created_at,
  };
}

    cost: toNumber(input.cost),

  /** حذف أصل وسجلات صيانته — deletes the asset row together with its maintenance history. */
  async remove(assetId: string): Promise<void> {
    const id = String(assetId || '').trim();
    if (!id) throw new Error('معرّف الأصل مطلوب.');
    await financeApiClient.delete<ApiEnvelope<{ deleted: boolean }>>(`${ASSETS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  },

  /**
   * إضافة سجل صيانة: قراءة-تعديل-كتابة على القائمة الحالية حتى لا تُمسح سجلات سابقة.
   * Appends to the asset's current logs (read-modify-write) so no prior entry is lost.
   */
  async appendMaintenanceLog(asset: FinancialAsset, log: MaintenanceLog): Promise<FinancialAsset> {
    const response = await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<any>>(
      `${ASSETS_PATH}/${encodeURIComponent(asset.id)}`,
      { maintenanceLogs: [...(asset.maintenanceLogs ?? []), log] },
    );
    return unwrapAsset(response?.data);
  },
};

/** يقرأ سجلاً واحداً ويعيد null عندما يكون غير موجود بدل رمي خطأ. */
export async function readFinanceRecord(path: string): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<any>>(path);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isNotFoundError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * يحوّل صف الحساب القادم من alx_api إلى الشكل الذي تعرفه واجهات النظام.
 * Maps an accounts row (accountId/accountNameAr/subAccountId/currencyNo) to the legacy FinancialAccount shape.
 */
export function mapAccountRow(row: any): FinancialAccount | null {
  const accountId = String(row?.accountId ?? row?.id ?? '').trim();
  if (!accountId) return null;
  return {
    ...row,
    id: accountId,
    accountCode: String(row.accountCode ?? ''),
    accountPrefix: String(row.accountPrefix ?? ''),
    accountNumber: String(row.accountNumber ?? ''),
    entityType: row.entityType,
    entityId: String(row.entityId ?? ''),
    entityName: String(row.entityName ?? row.accountNameAr ?? row.accountNameEn ?? ''),
    currency: String(row.currency ?? ''),
    curNo: row.curNo ?? row.currencyNo ?? undefined,
    balance: Number(row.balance ?? 0),
    debitTotal: Number(row.debitTotal ?? 0),
    creditTotal: Number(row.creditTotal ?? 0),
    isActive: row.isActive !== false,
    type: row.type,
    parentCode: row.parentCode ?? undefined,
    accSubId: row.accSubId ?? row.subAccountId ?? undefined,
    groupId: row.groupId ?? undefined,
    accountSeq: row.accountSeq == null ? undefined : Number(row.accountSeq),
    accNameAr: row.accNameAr ?? row.accountNameAr ?? undefined,
    accNameEn: row.accNameEn ?? row.accountNameEn ?? undefined,
    limitedBalance: row.limitedBalance == null ? undefined : Number(row.limitedBalance),
    notes: row.notes ?? undefined,
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
  } as FinancialAccount;
}

61	async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
62	  collectionName: string
63	): Promise<T[]> {
64	  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
65	  if (!path)
66	    throw new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`);
67	  const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiPage<T>>>(path, {
68	    limit: 100,
69	    offset: 0,
70	  });
71	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data)
72	    ? response.data
73	    : (response.data.items ?? []);
74	  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];
75	}

77	export const financeApiDataGateway = {
78	  isEnabled,
79	  subscribeCollection<
80	    T extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>,
81	  >(
82	    collectionName: string,
83	    onData: (rows: T[]) => void,
84	    onError: (error: unknown) => void
85	  ): Unsubscribe {
86	    if (!isEnabled()) {
87	      void Promise.resolve().then(() => onError(new Error("FINANCE_API_REQUIRED")));
88	      return () => undefined;
89	    }
90	    if (!apiCollectionPaths[collectionName]) {
91	      void Promise.resolve().then(() => onError(new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`)));
92	      return () => undefined;
93	    }
94	
95	    let disposed = false;
96	    const load = async () => {
97	      try {
98	        const rows = await fetchRows<T>(collectionName);
99	        if (!disposed) onData(rows);
100	      } catch (error) {
101	        if (!disposed) onError(error);
102	      }
103	    };
104	    void load();
105	    const interval = setInterval(() => void load(), 30_000);
106	    return () => {
107	      disposed = true;
108	      clearInterval(interval);
109	    };
110	  },
111	
112	  subscribeOrderedCollection<
113	    T extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>,
114	  >(
115	    collectionName: string,
116	    _field: string,
117	    onData: (rows: T[]) => void,
118	    onError: (error: unknown) => void
119	  ): Unsubscribe {
120	    return this.subscribeCollection(collectionName, onData, onError);
121	  },
122

127	  async getAccountTransactions(accountId: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
128	    const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
129	    for (let offset = 0; offset < MAX_MOVEMENT_ROWS; offset += MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE) {
130	      const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<Record<string, unknown>[]>>(
131	        `/api/v1/finance/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/movements`,
132	        { limit: MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE, offset },
133	      );
134	      const page = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [];
135	      rows.push(...page);
136	      const total = Number(response.meta?.total ?? rows.length);
137	      if (page.length < MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE || rows.length >= total) break;
138	    }
139	    return normalizeRows("account_trans", rows);
140	  },
141	
142	  subscribeAccountMovements(
143	    accountId: string,
144	    onData: (rows: Record<string, unknown>[]) => void,
145	    onError: (error: unknown) => void,
146	  ): Unsubscribe {
147	    let disposed = false;
148	    const load = async () => {
149	      try {
150	        const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
151	        for (let offset = 0; offset < MAX_MOVEMENT_ROWS; offset += MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE) {
152	          const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<Record<string, unknown>[]>>(
153	            `/api/v1/finance/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/movements`,
154	            { limit: MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE, offset },
155	          );
156	          const page = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [];
157	          rows.push(...page);
158	          const total = Number(response.meta?.total ?? rows.length);
159	          if (page.length < MOVEMENT_PAGE_SIZE || rows.length >= total) break;
160	        }
161	        if (!disposed) onData(normalizeRows("account_trans", rows));
162	      } catch (error) {
163	        if (!disposed) onError(error);
164	      }
165	    };
166	    void load();
167	    const interval = setInterval(() => void load(), 30_000);
168	    return () => {
169	      disposed = true;
170	      clearInterval(interval);
171	    };

188	-- 2) المحفزات صفوف علائقية — fired triggers become relational rows.
189	DO $$
190	BEGIN
191	  IF NOT EXISTS (
192	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
193	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' AND column_name = 'data'
194	  ) THEN
195	    RETURN;
196	  END IF;
197	
198	  INSERT INTO public.order_fired_trigger (order_id, seq, trigger_name)
199	       SELECT o.order_id, (x.ordinality - 1)::integer, btrim(x.value)
200	         FROM public.orders o,
201	              jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(o.data->'firedTriggers', '[]'::jsonb))
202	                WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, ordinality)
203	        WHERE jsonb_typeof(o.data->'firedTriggers') = 'array'
204	          AND o.data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(o.data) = 'object'
205	          AND btrim(x.value) <> ''
206	       ON CONFLICT (order_id, seq) DO NOTHING;
207	END
208	$$;

213	
214	ALTER TABLE public.order_fired_trigger DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
215

67	async function page(
68	  pool: Pool,
69	  table: string,
70	  columns: string,
71	  order: string,
72	  input: PageQuery,
73	  searchColumns: string[],
74	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
75	  const values: unknown[] = [];
76	  const filters: string[] = [];
77	  if (input.search) {
78	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
79	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
80	  }
81	  if (input.customerId) {
82	    values.push(input.customerId);
83	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
84	  }
85	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
86	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
87	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
88	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
89	    values,
90	  );
91	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
92	}

        if (!(error instanceof ApiClientError) || error.code !== 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') throw error;
        await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>('/api/v1/shipments', body);
      }
    },

2	 * Shared SQL record helpers used by repository modules.
3	 * المساعدات المشتركة لبناء أعمدة السجلات في طبقة المستودعات.

5	
6	/**
7	 * Keep only fields the caller explicitly provided (undefined = unchanged,
8	 * null = clear the column) and map them through a camelCase→snake_case whitelist.
9	 * تُدخل الحقول المرسلة صراحة فقط (undefined = بدون تغيير، null = مسح القيمة) عبر قائمة أعمدة معتمدة.

11	export function presentColumnEntries(
12	  input: object,
13	  columnMap: Record<string, string>,
14	): Array<[string, unknown]> {
15	  const entries: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];
16	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
17	    const column = columnMap[key];
18	    if (column !== undefined && value !== undefined) entries.push([column, value ?? null]);
19	  }
20	  return entries;
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * Run a callback on a dedicated pooled connection inside a transaction where
25	 * request.jwt.claims is set to the acting user, so legacy SECURITY DEFINER RPCs
26	 * that resolve auth.uid() keep working when invoked through the API runtime role.
27	 * تنفيذ داخل معاملة على اتصال مخصص مع ضبط request.jwt.claims بمعرّف المستخدم المنفّذ
28	 * لتبقى دوال RPC الآمنة (auth.uid) تعمل عند استدعائها عبر حساب تشغيل alx_api.
29	 */
30	export async function withActorClaims<T>(
31	  connect: () => Promise<ActorClaimClient>,
32	  actorId: string,
33	  run: (client: ActorClaimClient) => Promise<T>,
34	): Promise<T> {
35	  const client = await connect();
36	  try {
37	    await client.query('BEGIN');
38	    await client.query("SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', $1, TRUE)", [JSON.stringify({ sub: actorId })]);
39	    const result = await run(client);
40	    await client.query('COMMIT');
41	    return result;
42	  } catch (error) {
43	    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
44	    throw error;
45	  } finally {
46	    client.release();
47	  }
48	}
49	
50	export interface ActorClaimClient {
51	  query: (sql: string, params?: unknown[]) => Promise<{ rows: unknown[] }>;
52	  release: () => void;
53	}

91	async function page(
92	  pool: Pool,
93	  table: string,
94	  columns: string,
95	  order: string,
96	  input: PageQuery,
97	  searchColumns: string[],
98	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
99	  const values: unknown[] = [];
100	  const filters: string[] = [];
101	  if (input.search) {
102	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
103	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
104	  }
105	  if (input.customerId) {
106	    values.push(input.customerId);
107	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
108	  }
109	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
110	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
111	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
112	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
113	    values,
114	  );
115	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
116	}
117	
118	/** صفحة الطلبات: استعلام مخصّص لأن القائمة تحتاج JOIN، و`page` لا يدعم الجداول المتعددة. */
119	/** Orders page uses its own builder because the list needs JOINs, which the generic `page` helper does not support. */
120	async function pageOrders(pool: Pool, input: PageQuery): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
121	  const values: unknown[] = [];
122	  const filters: string[] = [];
123	  if (input.search) {
124	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
125	    filters.push(`(o.order_number ILIKE $1 OR o.external_order_number ILIKE $1 OR o.tracking_number ILIKE $1)`);
126	  }
127	  if (input.customerId) {
128	    values.push(input.customerId);
129	    filters.push(`o.customer_id = $${values.length}`);
130	  }
131	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
132	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
133	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
134	    `SELECT ${orderListColumns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total ${orderListFrom} ${where} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.order_id ASC LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
135	    values,
136	  );
137	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
138	}

161	}

196	export function createOperationsRepository(pool: Pool): OperationsRepository {
197	  return {
198	    async deleteOrdersWithDependents({ orderIds }) {
199	      const result = await pool.query<{ summary: unknown }>(
200	        'SELECT public.delete_orders_with_dependents($1::text[]) AS summary',
201	        [orderIds],
202	      );
203	      const summary = result.rows[0]?.summary;
204	      if (!summary || typeof summary !== 'object' || Array.isArray(summary)) {
205	        throw new Error('ORDER_DELETION_SUMMARY_MISSING');
206	      }
207	      return summary as Record<string, unknown>;
208	    },
209	    listOrders: (input) => pageOrders(pool, input),
210	    async getOrder(orderId) {
211	      const result = await pool.query(
212	        `SELECT ${orderListColumns} ${orderListFrom} WHERE o.order_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,

185	END
186	$$;
187	
188	-- 2) المحفزات صفوف علائقية — fired triggers become relational rows.
189	DO $$
190	BEGIN
191	  IF NOT EXISTS (
192	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
193	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' AND column_name = 'data'
194	  ) THEN
195	    RETURN;
196	  END IF;
197	
198	  INSERT INTO public.order_fired_trigger (order_id, seq, trigger_name)
199	       SELECT o.order_id, (x.ordinality - 1)::integer, btrim(x.value)
200	         FROM public.orders o,
201	              jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(o.data->'firedTriggers', '[]'::jsonb))
202	                WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, ordinality)
203	        WHERE jsonb_typeof(o.data->'firedTriggers') = 'array'
204	          AND o.data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(o.data) = 'object'
205	          AND btrim(x.value) <> ''
206	       ON CONFLICT (order_id, seq) DO NOTHING;
207	END
208	$$;
209	
210	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS order_fired_trigger_order_idx ON public.order_fired_trigger (order_id);
211	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_total_cost_yer_idx ON public.orders (total_cost_yer);
212	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_portal_provenance_idx ON public.orders (customer_uid, portal_uid);
213	
214	ALTER TABLE public.order_fired_trigger DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
215	
216	GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.orders, public.order_fired_trigger TO alx_api_runtime;

123	/**
124	 * استخراج الأعمدة المباشرة المجهزة لقاعدة البيانات بنظافة وأمان
125	 * Safely extract direct relational columns for Supabase REST queries
126	 */
127	export function extractDirectColumns(table: string, data: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {
128	  const mapping = DIRECT_COLUMNS_MAP[table];
129	  if (!mapping || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return {};
130	  const extracted: Record<string, any> = {};
131	  for (const [key, col] of Object.entries(mapping)) {
132	    let val: any = undefined;
133	    if (data[key] !== undefined) {
134	      val = data[key];
135	    } else if (data[col] !== undefined) {
136	      val = data[col];
137	    }
138	
139	    if (val !== undefined) {
140	      // تحويل المفاتيح الأجنبية الفارغة أو المسافات والتواريخ الفارغة إلى null لتفادي أخطاء القيود والأنواع بقاعدة البيانات
141	      // Convert empty string or whitespace foreign keys, dates, and timestamps to null so Postgres FK & type check succeeds
142	      if (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '') {
143	        if (
144	          col.endsWith('_id') ||
145	          col === 'cur_no' ||
146	          col.endsWith('_at') ||
147	          col.endsWith('At') ||
148	          col.endsWith('_date') ||
149	          col.endsWith('Date')
150	        ) {
151	          val = null;
152	        }
153	      }
154	      if (key === 'disabled' && (table === 'customers' || table === 'couriers')) {
155	        extracted[col] = !val;
156	      } else if (
157	        col.endsWith('_at') ||
158	        col.endsWith('At') ||
159	        col.endsWith('_date') ||
160	        col.endsWith('Date') ||
161	        col === 'lastRecalculatedAt' ||
162	        col === 'effective_at' ||
163	        col === 'posted_at' ||
164	        col === 'voided_at' ||
165	        col === 'processed_at' ||
166	        col === 'returned_at'
167	      ) {
168	        if (val === null || val === undefined || (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '')) {
169	          extracted[col] = null;
170	        } else if (typeof val === 'number') {
171	          extracted[col] = new Date(val).toISOString();
172	        } else if (typeof val === 'string') {
173	          const trimmed = val.trim();
174	          if (/^\d+$/.test(trimmed)) {
175	            extracted[col] = new Date(Number(trimmed)).toISOString();
176	          } else {
177	            const parsed = Date.parse(trimmed);
178	            extracted[col] = !isNaN(parsed) ? new Date(parsed).toISOString() : null;
179	          }
180	        } else {
181	          extracted[col] = val;
182	        }
183	      } else {
184	        extracted[col] = val;
185	      }
186	    }
187	  }
188	
189	  // Safety checks for foreign key ID columns
190	  if (table === 'orders') {
191	    const rawStatus = extracted['order_status_id'];
192	    if (rawStatus === undefined || rawStatus === null || String(rawStatus).trim() === '' || String(rawStatus).trim() === '0') {
193	      extracted['order_status_id'] = '1';
194	    } else {
195	      extracted['order_status_id'] = String(rawStatus);
196	    }
197	    if (typeof extracted['customer_id'] === 'string' && extracted['customer_id'].trim() === '') {
198	      extracted['customer_id'] = null;
199	    }
200	    if (typeof extracted['order_source_id'] === 'string' && extracted['order_source_id'].trim() === '') {
201	      extracted['order_source_id'] = null;
202	    }
203	    if (typeof extracted['delivery_courier_id'] === 'string' && extracted['delivery_courier_id'].trim() === '') {
204	      extracted['delivery_courier_id'] = null;
205	    }
206	    if (typeof extracted['shipping_courier_id'] === 'string' && extracted['shipping_courier_id'].trim() === '') {
207	      extracted['shipping_courier_id'] = null;
208	    }
209	  }
210	
211	  return extracted;
212	}

21	function makeApiCollection<T extends ApiRow>(config: ApiCollectionConfig): OrdersCollectionRepository<T> {
22	  const list = async (): Promise<readonly T[]> => {
23	    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T[] | { items?: T[] }>>(config.readPath, { limit: 100, offset: 0 });
24	    return extractRows(response.data).map((row) => normalize(row, config.idKey) as T);
25	  };
26	  const pathFor = (id: string) => `${config.writePath ?? config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
27	  return {
28	    subscribe(onData: (snapshot: { records: readonly T[] }) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
29	      let disposed = false;
30	      const refresh = async () => {
31	        try { const records = await list(); if (!disposed) onData({ records }); }
32	        catch (error) { if (!disposed) onError?.(error); }
33	      };
34	      void refresh();
35	      const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000);
36	      return () => { disposed = true; clearInterval(timer); };
37	    },
38	    list,

45	      const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(config.writePath, { ...payload, [config.idKey]: id });
46	      return { id: String(response.data[config.idKey] ?? response.data.id ?? id) };
47	    },
48	    async set(id, payload) {
49	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`set:${config.readPath}`);
50	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
51	    },
52	    async update(id, payload) {
53	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`update:${config.readPath}`);
54	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
55	    },

57	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`delete:${config.readPath}`);
58	      await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id));
59	    },
60	  };

import type { Dispatch, FormEvent, SetStateAction } from "react";
import toast from "react-hot-toast";
import { activityLogService } from "../../../services/activityLogService";
import { autoEntryService } from "../../../services/autoEntryService";
import { financialAccountService } from "../../../services/financialAccountService";
import { notificationService } from "../../../services/notificationService";
import { orderHistoryService } from "../../../services/orderHistoryService";
import { whatsappService } from "../../../services/whatsappService";
import { findOrderParty } from "../../../services/orderPartyService";
import {
  getProcessedStatusIds,
  planOrderStatusTransition,
} from "../../../services/orderLifecycleService";
import { ORDER_STATUS_FALLBACKS } from "../constants/orders.constants";
import type { OrderRecord, OrderStatusDescriptor, ShippingRow, UpdateFormData } from "../types";

type LegacyPartyRecord = {
  id?: string; accountId?: string | null; financialAccountId?: string | null;
  fullName?: string | null; name?: string | null; phone?: string | null; address?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};
type LegacyOrderRecord = OrderRecord;
type LegacyShipmentRecord = ShippingRow;
type LegacyCourierRecord = LegacyPartyRecord & { courierType?: string; commissionRate?: string | number | null; financialAccountCode?: string | null };
type AuthContext = { currentUser?: { uid?: string; email?: string | null } | null };
type ProfileRecord = { id?: string; uid?: string; fullName?: string };
type SettingsRecord = { currency?: string };
type AutoVoucherRule = { id?: string; isActive?: boolean };
type OrderMutation = (id: string, changes: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;
type RateBuilder = (order: LegacyOrderRecord) => Record<string, number>;
type ShipmentMutation = (id: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;
const toText = (value: unknown): string => typeof value === "string" ? value : value == null ? "" : String(value);
const toNumber = (value: unknown): number => typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" ? Number.parseFloat(value) || 0 : 0;

export interface UpdateOrderStatusHandlerDependencies<T extends LegacyOrderRecord = LegacyOrderRecord> {
  isSubmitting: boolean;
  isAr: boolean;
  auth: AuthContext;
  autoVoucherRules: AutoVoucherRule[];
  buildOrderRates: RateBuilder;
  couriers: LegacyCourierRecord[];
  customers: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  dbRates: Record<string, number>;
  employees: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  getStatusByAny: (status: string | number) => OrderStatusDescriptor | undefined;
  orderStatusesList: OrderStatusDescriptor[];
  profile: ProfileRecord | null;
  selectedOrder: T | null;
  setIsSubmitting: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  setIsUpdateModalOpen: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  setSelectedOrder: Dispatch<SetStateAction<T | null>>;
  settings: SettingsRecord;
  shippingCompanies: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  sources: LegacyPartyRecord[];
  updateFormData: UpdateFormData;
  updateOrderRecord: OrderMutation;
  updateShippings: LegacyShipmentRecord[];
  upsertShipment: ShipmentMutation;
}

export function createUpdateOrderStatusHandler<T extends LegacyOrderRecord>(
  dependencies: UpdateOrderStatusHandlerDependencies<T>
) {
  const {
    isSubmitting,
    isAr,
    auth,
    autoVoucherRules,
    buildOrderRates,
    couriers,
    customers,
    dbRates,
    employees,
    getStatusByAny,
    orderStatusesList,
    profile,
    selectedOrder,
    setIsSubmitting,
    setIsUpdateModalOpen,
    setSelectedOrder,
    settings,
    shippingCompanies,
    sources,
    updateFormData,
    updateOrderRecord,
    updateShippings,
    upsertShipment,
  } = dependencies;

  return async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    if (!selectedOrder) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const currentStatus = selectedOrder.orderStatus || "طلب معلق";
      const newStatus = updateFormData.orderStatus;
      const firedTriggers = selectedOrder.firedTriggers || [];
      const newFiredTriggers = [...firedTriggers];

      const currentStatusItem =
        getStatusByAny(
          selectedOrder.order_status_id ||
            selectedOrder.orderStatusId ||
            currentStatus
        ) || orderStatusesList[0];
      const newStatusItem = getStatusByAny(newStatus) || orderStatusesList[0];

      const currentStageId =
        currentStatusItem?.id || ORDER_STATUS_FALLBACKS.individualUpdate;
      const newStageId =
        newStatusItem?.id || ORDER_STATUS_FALLBACKS.individualUpdate;
      const statusHistory = await orderHistoryService.listForContext({
        orderId: selectedOrder.id,
        orderNumber: toText(selectedOrder.orderNumber) || undefined,
        entityType: "order",
        label: toText(selectedOrder.orderNumber) || selectedOrder.id,
      });
      const transitionPlan = planOrderStatusTransition(
        orderStatusesList,
        currentStageId,
        newStageId,
        getProcessedStatusIds(statusHistory)
      );
      if (!transitionPlan.allowed) {

  "old_string": "async function appendCurrencyColumns(client: PoolClient, pairs: Array<[string, unknown]>): Promise<void> {\n  const byColumn = new Map(pairs);\n  const paidCode = text(byColumn.get('paid_currency_code'));\n  const purchaseCode = text(byColumn.get('order_currency_code'));\n  const paidId = await currencyIdByCode(client, paidCode);\n  if (paidCode && paidId !== null) pairs.push(['currency', paidId]);\n  const purchaseId = await currencyIdByCode(client, purchaseCode);\n  if (purchaseCode && purchaseId !== null) pairs.push(['order_currency', purchaseId]);\n}"

220	      const computedOrderStatusId = (() => {

222	        // Priority: direct approve > pay later > paid/unpaid

96	async function page(
97	  pool: Pool,
98	  table: string,
99	  columns: string,
100	  order: string,
101	  input: PageQuery,
102	  searchColumns: string[],
103	): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
104	  const values: unknown[] = [];
105	  const filters: string[] = [];
106	  if (input.search) {
107	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
108	    filters.push(`(${searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE $1`).join(' OR ')})`);
109	  }
110	  if (input.customerId) {
111	    values.push(input.customerId);
112	    filters.push(`customer_id = $${values.length}`);
113	  }
114	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
115	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
116	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
117	    `SELECT ${columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM public.${table} ${where} ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
118	    values,
119	  );
120	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
121	}

123	/** صفحة الطلبات: استعلام مخصّص لأن القائمة تحتاج JOIN، و`page` لا يدعم الجداول المتعددة. */
124	/** Orders page uses its own builder because the list needs JOINs, which the generic `page` helper does not support. */
125	async function pageOrders(pool: Pool, input: PageQuery): Promise<PageResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
126	  const values: unknown[] = [];
127	  const filters: string[] = [];
128	  if (input.search) {
129	    values.push(`%${input.search}%`);
130	    filters.push(`(o.order_number ILIKE $1 OR o.external_order_number ILIKE $1 OR o.tracking_number ILIKE $1)`);
131	  }
132	  if (input.customerId) {
133	    values.push(input.customerId);
134	    filters.push(`o.customer_id = $${values.length}`);
135	  }
136	  const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
137	  values.push(input.limit, input.offset);
138	  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
139	    `SELECT ${orderListColumns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total ${orderListFrom} ${where} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.order_id ASC LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
140	    values,
141	  );
142	  return { items: result.rows.map(({ _total, ...row }) => row), total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0) };
143	}

31	/**
32	 * Enrich order records with related party and source information.
33	 * This is a pure transformation: it does not mutate inputs or access UI/DB.
34	 */
35	export function enrichOrders(
36	  orders: OrderFilterRecord[],
37	  { customers, employees, couriers, sources }: OrderFilterEntities
38	): OrderFilterRecord[] {
39	  return orders.map(order => {
40	    const partyId =
41	      order.orderPartyId ||
42	      order.order_party_id ||
43	      order.customerId ||
44	      order.customer_id;
45	    const partyType =
46	      order.orderPartyType || order.order_party_type || "customer";
47	    let partyName = "";
48	    let partyPhone = "";
49	    let partyAddress = "";
50	
51	    if (partyType === "employee") {
52	      const employee = employees.find(record => record.id === partyId);
53	      partyName = readText(employee?.fullName || employee?.name);
54	      partyPhone = readText(employee?.phone);
55	      partyAddress = readText(employee?.address);
56	    } else if (partyType === "courier") {
57	      const courier = couriers.find(record => record.id === partyId);
58	      partyName = readText(courier?.fullName || courier?.name);
59	      partyPhone = readText(courier?.phone);
60	    } else {
61	      const customerId = order.customerId || order.customer_id || partyId;
62	      const customer = customers.find(record => record.id === customerId);
63	      partyName = readText(customer?.fullName || customer?.name);
64	      partyPhone = readText(customer?.phone || customer?.mobile);
65	      partyAddress = readText(customer?.address);
66	    }
67	
68	    const sourceId = order.orderSourceId || order.order_source_id;
69	    const source = sources.find(record => record.id === sourceId);
70	    const sourceName = readText(
71	      source?.name || order.orderSourceType || order.order_source_type
72	    );
73	
74	    return {
75	      ...order,
76	      customerName: partyName || readText(order.customerName),
77	      customerPhone: partyPhone || readText(order.customerPhone),
78	      customerAddress: partyAddress || readText(order.customerAddress),
79	      orderSourceName: sourceName,
80	      customerId: order.customerId || order.customer_id || "",
81	      orderPartyId: order.orderPartyId || order.order_party_id || "",
82	      orderPartyType:
83	        order.orderPartyType || order.order_party_type || "customer",
84	      isStaffOrder: Boolean(order.isStaffOrder ?? order.is_staff_order ?? false),
85	      employeeId: order.employeeId || order.employee_id || "",
86	      courierId: order.courierId || order.courier_id || "",
87	      orderPartyAccountId:
88	        order.orderPartyAccountId || order.order_party_account_id || "",
89	      orderSourceId: order.orderSourceId || order.order_source_id || "",
90	      orderSourceType: order.orderSourceType || order.order_source_type || "",
91	      deliveryCourierId:
92	        order.deliveryCourierId || order.delivery_courier_id || "",
93	      shippingCourierId:
94	        order.shippingCourierId || order.shipping_courier_id || "",
95	    };
96	  });
97	}

99	/** Apply the existing search, status, courier and source rules, then sort. */
100	export function filterAndSortOrders(
101	  orders: OrderFilterRecord[],
102	  {
103	    searchText,
104	    statusFilter,
105	    courierFilter,
106	    sourceFilter,
107	    sortBy,
108	  }: OrderFilterCriteria
109	): OrderFilterRecord[] {
110	  return orders
111	    .filter(order => {
112	      const orderNumber = String(
113	        order.orderNumber || order.order_number || ""
114	      ).toUpperCase();
115	      const customerName = String(order.customerName || "").toLowerCase();
116	      const customerPhone = String(order.customerPhone || "");
117	      const trackingNumber = String(
118	        order.trackingNumber || order.tracking_number || ""
119	      ).toUpperCase();
120	      const query = searchText.toLowerCase();
121	
122	      const matchesSearch =
123	        orderNumber.includes(query.toUpperCase()) ||
124	        customerName.includes(query) ||
125	        customerPhone.includes(searchText) ||
126	        trackingNumber.includes(query.toUpperCase());
127	
128	      const matchesStatus =
129	        statusFilter === "all" ||
130	        String(order.order_status_id || order.orderStatusId) ===
131	          String(statusFilter) ||
132	        order.orderStatus === statusFilter;
133	
134	      const matchesCourier =
135	        courierFilter === "all" ||
136	        order.deliveryCourierId === courierFilter ||
137	        order.shippingCourierId === courierFilter;
138	
139	      const matchesSource =
140	        sourceFilter === "all" || order.orderSourceId === sourceFilter;
141	
142	      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesCourier && matchesSource;
143	    })
144	    .sort((a, b) => {
145	      if (sortBy === "date-desc")
146	        return readNumber(b.createdAt) - readNumber(a.createdAt);
147	      if (sortBy === "date-asc") return readNumber(a.createdAt) - readNumber(b.createdAt);
148	      if (sortBy === "amount-desc") {
149	        return (
150	          readNumber(b.amountPaid) +
151	          readNumber(b.amountRemaining) -
152	          (readNumber(a.amountPaid) + readNumber(a.amountRemaining))
153	        );
154	      }
155	      return 0;
156	    });
157	}
