36	type StatusRow = Record<string, unknown>;
37	
38	function readText(value: unknown): string | undefined {
39	  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '' ? value : undefined;
40	}
41	
42	function toStatusItem(row: StatusRow): OrderStatusItem | null {
43	  const id = Number(row.statusId ?? row.orderStatusId ?? row.id);
44	  const nameAr = readText(row.nameAr ?? row.name_ar);
45	  if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0 || !nameAr) return null;
46	  return {
47	    id,
48	    nameAr,
49	    nameEn: readText(row.nameEn ?? row.name_en) ?? nameAr,
50	    isFirst: row.isFirst === true || row.is_first === true,
51	    isLast: row.isLast === true || row.is_last === true,
52	    sortOrder: typeof row.sortOrder === 'number' ? row.sortOrder : typeof row.sort_order === 'number' ? row.sort_order : undefined,
53	    color: readText(row.color),
54	    code: readText(row.code),
55	    description: readText(row.description),
56	    createdAt: readText(row.createdAt),
57	  };
58	}

60	export async function fetchOrderStatuses(): Promise<OrderStatusItem[]> {
61	  const response = await client.get<{ success: true; data: StatusRow[] }>('/api/v1/operations/order-statuses');
62	  const rows = Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [];
63	  return rows.map(toStatusItem).filter((item): item is OrderStatusItem => item !== null);
64	}

66	export async function saveOrderStatus(input: OrderStatusItem): Promise<void> {

68	    statusId: input.id,
69	    nameAr: input.nameAr,
70	    nameEn: input.nameEn || input.nameAr,
71	    isFirst: input.isFirst,
72	    isLast: input.isLast,
73	    sortOrder: input.sortOrder ?? input.id,
74	    color: input.color,
75	    code: input.code,
76	    description: input.description,
77	  });
78	}

80	export async function removeOrderStatus(id: number): Promise<void> {
81	  await client.delete(`/api/v1/operations/order-statuses/${encodeURIComponent(String(id))}`);
82	}
83	
84	export function useOrderStatuses() {
85	  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<OrderStatusItem[]>(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
86	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
87	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
88	
89	  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
90	    try {
91	      const rows = await fetchOrderStatuses();
92	      setStatuses(rows.length > 0 ? rows : DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
93	      setError(null);
94	    } catch (err) {
95	      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'order-statuses request failed');
96	    } finally {
97	      setLoading(false);
98	    }
99	  }, []);
100	
101	  useEffect(() => {
102	    void refresh();
103	  }, [refresh]);
104	
105	  // Helper functions
106	  const getStatusById = (id: number | string | undefined | null): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
107	    if (id === undefined || id === null || id === '') return undefined;
108	    const numId = typeof id === 'number' ? id : parseInt(String(id), 10);
109	    if (!isNaN(numId)) {
110	      const found = statuses.find(s => s.id === numId);
111	      if (found) return found;
112	    }
113	    return statuses.find(s => String(s.id) === String(id));
114	  };
115	
116	  const getStatusByName = (name: string): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
117	    if (!name) return undefined;
118	    const clean = name.trim().toLowerCase();
119	    return statuses.find(s => s.nameAr.toLowerCase() === clean || s.nameEn.toLowerCase() === clean || s.code?.toLowerCase() === clean);
120	  };
121	
122	  const getStatusByAny = (val: number | string | undefined | null): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
123	    if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return undefined;
124	    return getStatusById(val) || getStatusByName(String(val));
125	  };
126	
127	  const getFirstStatus = (): OrderStatusItem => {
128	    return statuses.find(s => s.isFirst) || statuses[0] || DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES[0];
129	  };
130	
131	  const getLastStatus = (): OrderStatusItem => {
132	    return statuses.find(s => s.isLast) || statuses[statuses.length - 1] || DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES[7];
133	  };
134	
135	  const getNextStatus = (currentStatusIdOrName: number | string): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
136	    let currentItem: OrderStatusItem | undefined = getStatusByAny(currentStatusIdOrName);
137	    if (!currentItem) return undefined;
138	    const currentIndex = statuses.findIndex(s => s.id === currentItem!.id);
139	    if (currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < statuses.length - 1) {
140	      return statuses[currentIndex + 1];
141	    }
142	    return undefined;
143	  };
144	
145	  return {
146	    statuses,
147	    loading,
148	    error,
149	    refresh,
150	    getStatusById,
151	    getStatusByName,
152	    getStatusByAny,
153	    getFirstStatus,
154	    getLastStatus,
155	    getNextStatus
156	  };
157	}

357	export async function listOrders(params: PageParams = {}): Promise<PagedResult<OrderRecord>> {
358	  const query = new URLSearchParams();
359	  if (params.limit !== undefined) query.set('limit', String(params.limit));
360	  if (params.offset !== undefined) query.set('offset', String(params.offset));
361	  if (params.search) query.set('search', params.search);
362	
363	  const result = await alxRequest<OrderRecord[]>(`/api/v1/orders?${query}`);
364	  if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error.message);
365	
366	  return {
367	    items: result.data,
368	    total: (result.meta?.['total'] as number | undefined) ?? result.data.length,
369	    limit: params.limit ?? 25,
370	    offset: params.offset ?? 0,
371	  };
372	}

374	/**
375	 * جلب طلب واحد بمعرفه.
376	 * Get a single order by ID.
377	 */
378	export async function getOrder(orderId: string): Promise<OrderRecord | null> {
379	  const result = await alxRequest<OrderRecord>(`/api/v1/orders/${orderId}`);
380	  if (!result.success) {
381	    if (result.error.code === 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') return null;
382	    throw new Error(result.error.message);
383	  }
384	  return result.data;
385	}

2	import type { GatewayPage, GatewayQuery } from '../../contracts/common.gateway';
3	import type { OrdersViewModel } from '../../../features/orders/types';
4	import { supabase } from '../supabase.client';
5	import { mapRow, mapSupabaseError } from '../supabase.mapper';
6	
7	function mapOrder(row: Record<string, unknown>): OrdersViewModel {
8	  return { id: String(row.order_id ?? row.id ?? '') };
9	}
10	
11	function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
12	  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
13	  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
14	  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
15	}
16	
17	export class CurrentSupabaseOrdersGateway implements OrdersGateway {
18	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<OrdersViewModel>> {
19	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
20	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
21	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
22	      .from('orders')
23	      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at', { count: 'exact' })
24	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
25	      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
26	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
27	    return page((data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapOrder)), { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
28	  }
29	
30	  async getById(orderId: string): Promise<OrdersViewModel | null> {
31	    const { data, error } = await supabase
32	      .from('orders')
33	      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at')
34	      .eq('order_id', orderId)
35	      .maybeSingle();
36	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
37	    return data ? mapRow(data, mapOrder) : null;
38	  }
39	
40	  async changeStatus(orderId: string, orderStatusId: string, actorId: string): Promise<OrdersViewModel> {
41	    const { data, error } = await supabase
42	      .from('orders')
43	      .update({ order_status_id: orderStatusId, updated_by: actorId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
44	      .eq('order_id', orderId)
45	      .select('order_id,order_status_id,created_at,updated_at')
46	      .single();
47	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
48	    return mapRow(data, mapOrder);
49	  }
50	}

230	/**
231	 * resolving a stage by id or by its Arabic/English/code name, so the text column and the id column never disagree.
232	 * تُحلّ المرحلة بالمعرّف أو بالاسم العربي/الإنجليزي/الرمز حتى لا يتعارض النص مع معرّف المرحلة في الأعمدة المسطّحة.
233	 */
234	async function findStage(client: PoolClient, ref: { id?: string | undefined; name?: string | undefined }): Promise<OrderStage | null> {
235	  const id = text(ref.id);
236	  const name = text(ref.name);
237	  if (!id && !name) return null;
238	  const result = await client.query<{ orderStatusId: string; name: string; sortOrder: number | null }>(
239	    `SELECT order_status_id AS "orderStatusId", COALESCE(NULLIF(name_ar, ''), NULLIF(name_en, ''), order_status_id) AS name, sort_order AS "sortOrder"
240	       FROM public.order_status
241	      WHERE ($1 = '' AND (name_ar = $2 OR name_en = $2 OR code = $2))
242	         OR ($1 <> '' AND (order_status_id = $1 OR name_ar = $1 OR name_en = $1 OR code = $1))
243	      ORDER BY (order_status_id = $1) DESC NULLS LAST
244	      LIMIT 1`,
245	    [id, name],
246	  );
247	  const row = result.rows[0];
248	  return row ? { orderStatusId: String(row.orderStatusId), name: String(row.name), sortOrder: row.sortOrder === null || row.sortOrder === undefined ? null : Number(row.sortOrder) } : null;
249	}

252	  await client.query('DELETE FROM public.order_fired_trigger WHERE order_id = $1', [orderId]);
253	  for (const [index, triggerName] of triggers.entries()) {
254	    await client.query(

257	    );
258	  }
259	}

4	-- Order-deletion fix: the RPC deleted shipments before their history rows, so every real

6	-- Also removes the dead jsonb predicates: no notification or whatsapp log row carries an order

9	-- Date: 2026-10-15
10	
11	BEGIN;
12	
13	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])
14	 RETURNS jsonb
15	 LANGUAGE plpgsql
16	 SECURITY DEFINER
17	-- منع انتحال search_path عند تنفيذ الدالة بصلاحيات المالك — fixed search_path, no hijack.
18	SET search_path = pg_catalog
19	AS $function$
20	DECLARE
21	  target_ids text[]; target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[];
22	  requested_count integer; actual_count integer;
23	  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0;
24	  deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;
25	BEGIN
26	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids
27	    FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned
28	   WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;
29	  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);
30	  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;
31	
32	  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers
33	    FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
34	  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;
35	
36	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids
37	    FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
38	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids
39	    FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
40	  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]),
41	         COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[])
42	    INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts
43	    FROM public.account_trans
44	   WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);
45	
46	  -- 1) أرجل القيود ثم القيود نفسها — payment legs first, then the entries they belong to.
47	  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN
48	    DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);
49	  END IF;
50	  DELETE FROM public.account_trans
51	    WHERE account_trans_id = ANY(account_trans_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids);
52	  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;
53	  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids) OR order_id = ANY(target_ids);
54	  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;
55	
56	  -- 2) السجل التاريخي قبل آباء مفاتيحه الأجنبية (shipments ثم orders).
57	  --    History rows reference shipments and orders, so they go first; orders_history_change cascades.
58	  DELETE FROM public.orders_history
59	    WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR order_number = ANY(target_numbers) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids);
60	  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;
61	
62	  -- 3) الشحنات ومنتجات الطلب — only now are shipments and order items removable.
63	  DELETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids);
64	  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;
65	  DELETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
66	  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;
67	
68	  -- 4) الطلب نفسه مع كبت مؤرِّق الحذف — the order itself, with the audit trigger suppressed.
69	  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true);
70	  DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
71	  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT;
72	  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);
73	
74	  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN
75	    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts);
76	  END IF;
77	
78	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
79	    'orderIds', target_ids,
80	    'orders', deleted_orders,
81	    'shipments', deleted_shipments,
82	    'products', deleted_order_items,
83	    'mainEntries', deleted_main_entries,
84	    'accountTrans', deleted_account_trans,
85	    'notifications', 0,
86	    'whatsappLogs', 0,
87	    'ordersHistory', deleted_orders_history,
88	    'activityLogsDeleted', 0);
89	END;
90	$function$;
91	
92	-- إعادة منح التنفيذ لصلاحية التشغيل بعد الاستبدال — re-grant EXECUTE after the replacement.
93	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(text[]) FROM PUBLIC;
94	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(text[]) TO alx_api_runtime;
95	
96	COMMIT;

3	export type NotificationType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
4	
5	interface NotificationParams {
6	  title: string;
7	  message: string;
8	  type: NotificationType;
9	  orderId?: string;
10	  userId?: string; // Target specific user
11	  associatedUserIds?: string[]; // Users associated with this notification
12	  isPublic?: boolean;
13	  category?: 'order' | 'finance' | 'system';
14	}
15	
16	// ─── Electron API bridge helper ────────────────────────────────────────────
17	const electronAPI = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).electronAPI)
18	  ? (window as any).electronAPI
19	  : null;
20	
21	export const notificationService = {
22	  async notify({ title, message, type, orderId, userId, associatedUserIds, isPublic = true, category }: NotificationParams) {
23	    try {
24	      // 1. Show local toast (always)
25	      switch (type) {
26	        case 'success':
27	          toast.success(message, { duration: 4000 });
28	          break;
29	        case 'error':
30	          toast.error(message, { duration: 5000 });
31	          break;
32	        default:
33	          toast(message, { icon: type === 'warning' ? '⚠️' : 'ℹ️', duration: 4000 });
34	      }
35	
36	      // 2. Show native OS notification when running inside Electron
37	      if (electronAPI?.showNotification) {
38	        try {
39	          await electronAPI.showNotification({ title, body: message, type });
40	        } catch (nativeErr) {
41	          console.warn('[notificationService] native notification failed:', nativeErr);
42	        }
43	      }
44	    } catch (error) {
45	      console.error('Failed to create notification:', error);
46	    }
47	  }
48	};

58	      return { label: isAr ? 'ملغي' : 'Cancelled', className: 'bg-slate-950/30 text-slate-500 border border-slate-850' };
59	    case 'failed':
60	      return { label: isAr ? 'فاشل' : 'Failed', className: 'bg-rose-950/20 text-rose-455 border border-rose-950/40 font-extrabold' };
61	    case 'queued':
62	      return { label: isAr ? 'في الانتظار' : 'Queued', className: 'bg-sky-950/25 text-sky-400 border border-sky-900/40' };
63	    default:
64	      return { label: status ?? '-', className: 'bg-slate-950/30 text-slate-500 border border-slate-850' };
65	  }
66	};

8	import { appApiClient, type ApiEnvelope } from '../../../data/http/app-api-client';
9	
10	// سجل إشعار كما تُرجعه الواجهة الخلفية (أعمدة مسطّحة، بلا payload)
11	// Notification record as returned by alx_api — flat columns, no payload bag.
12	export interface ApiNotification {
13	  notificationId: string;
14	  userId: string | null;
15	  title: string;
16	  message: string;
17	  type: string;
18	  category: string | null;
19	  isPublic: boolean;
20	  isRead: boolean;
21	  creatorId: string | null;
22	  creatorName: string | null;
23	  associatedUserIds: string[];
24	  createdAt: string;
25	  updatedAt: string | null;
26	}
27	
28	// سجل حدث إرسال خارجي من جدول الـ Outbox
29	// External delivery event read from the outbox delivery log.
30	export interface ApiDeliveryLog {
31	  outboxId: string;
32	  channel: string;
33	  recipient: string;
34	  templateId: string | null;
35	  message: string;
36	  status: string;
37	  attemptCount: number;
38	  maxAttempts: number;
39	  lastAttemptedAt: string | null;
40	  sentAt: string | null;
41	  errorMessage: string | null;
42	  createdAt: string;
43	  updatedAt: string | null;
44	}
45	
46	export interface NotificationListQuery {
47	  limit?: number;
48	  offset?: number;
49	  isRead?: boolean;
50	  category?: string;
51	  search?: string;
52	  /**
53	   * 'all' يستخدم مسار مدير الإشعارات غير المحد النطاق — requires manage_notifications server-side.
54	   */
55	  scope?: 'mine' | 'all';
56	}
57	
58	// بناء سلسلة الاستعلام بدل تمرير كائن غير معلوم الأنواع
59	// Query string is built explicitly so untyped keys cannot leak into the request.
60	function toQueryString(params: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>): string {
61	  const search = new URLSearchParams();
62	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
63	    if (value !== undefined) search.set(key, String(value));
64	  }
65	  const encoded = search.toString();
66	  return encoded ? `?${encoded}` : '';
67	}
68	
69	const asArray = <T>(value: unknown): T[] => (Array.isArray(value) ? value as T[] : []);
70	
71	const asNotification = (value: unknown): ApiNotification => {
72	  const row = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
73	  return {
74	    notificationId: String(row.notificationId ?? ''),
75	    userId: row.userId === null || row.userId === undefined ? null : String(row.userId),
76	    title: String(row.title ?? ''),
77	    message: String(row.message ?? ''),
78	    type: String(row.type ?? 'system'),
79	    category: row.category === null || row.category === undefined ? null : String(row.category),
80	    isPublic: Boolean(row.isPublic),
81	    isRead: Boolean(row.isRead),
82	    creatorId: row.creatorId === null || row.creatorId === undefined ? null : String(row.creatorId),
83	    creatorName: row.creatorName === null || row.creatorName === undefined ? null : String(row.creatorName),
84	    associatedUserIds: asArray<unknown>(row.associatedUserIds).map((item) => String(item)),
85	    createdAt: String(row.createdAt ?? ''),
86	    updatedAt: row.updatedAt === null || row.updatedAt === undefined ? null : String(row.updatedAt),
87	  };
88	};
89	
90	const asDeliveryLog = (value: unknown): ApiDeliveryLog => {
91	  const row = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
92	  return {
93	    outboxId: String(row.outboxId ?? ''),
94	    channel: String(row.channel ?? ''),
95	    recipient: String(row.recipient ?? ''),
96	    templateId: row.templateId === null || row.templateId === undefined ? null : String(row.templateId),
97	    message: String(row.message ?? ''),
98	    status: String(row.status ?? 'queued'),
99	    attemptCount: Number(row.attemptCount ?? 0),
100	    maxAttempts: Number(row.maxAttempts ?? 0),
101	    lastAttemptedAt: row.lastAttemptedAt === null || row.lastAttemptedAt === undefined ? null : String(row.lastAttemptedAt),
102	    sentAt: row.sentAt === null || row.sentAt === undefined ? null : String(row.sentAt),
103	    errorMessage: row.errorMessage === null || row.errorMessage === undefined ? null : String(row.errorMessage),
104	    createdAt: String(row.createdAt ?? ''),
105	    updatedAt: row.updatedAt === null || row.updatedAt === undefined ? null : String(row.updatedAt),
106	  };
107	};
108	
109	export interface CreateNotificationInput {
110	  title: string;
111	  message: string;
112	  userId?: string | null;
113	  type?: 'system' | 'order' | 'shipment' | 'finance' | 'alert' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
114	  category?: 'order' | 'finance' | 'system' | 'shipment' | 'alert';
115	  isPublic?: boolean;
116	  associatedUserIds?: readonly string[];
117	}
118	
119	export const notificationsApiDataGateway = {
120	  /** قائمة الإشعارات المرئية للمستخدم المصادق عليه + العدد الكلي من الـ meta. */
121	  async listNotifications(query: NotificationListQuery = {}): Promise<{ items: ApiNotification[]; total: number }> {
122	    const path = query.scope === 'all' ? '/api/v1/notifications/all' : '/api/v1/notifications';
123	    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
124	      `${path}${toQueryString({
125	        limit: query.limit ?? 200,
126	        offset: query.offset ?? 0,
127	        isRead: query.isRead,
128	        category: query.category,
129	        search: query.search,
130	      })}`,
131	    );
132	    const items = asArray<unknown>(response.data).map(asNotification);
133	    return { items, total: Number(response.meta?.total ?? items.length) };
134	  },
135	
136	  /** عدد الإشعارات غير المقروءة من العدّاد الخادمي، لا من طول الصفحة. */
137	  async getUnreadCount(scope: 'mine' | 'all' = 'mine'): Promise<number> {
138	    const { total } = await this.listNotifications({ limit: 1, offset: 0, isRead: false, scope });
139	    return total;
140	  },
141	
142	  /** إنشاء إشعار داخلي — كل الحقول أعمدة رئيسية ولا حقل payload. */
143	  async createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<ApiNotification> {
144	    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/notifications', input);
145	    return asNotification(response.data);
146	  },
147	
148	  /** تعليم إشعار كمقروء لهذا المستخدم (حالة القراءة لكل مستلم في الجدول العلائقي). */
149	  async markAsRead(notificationId: string): Promise<ApiNotification> {
150	    const response = await appApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
151	      `/api/v1/notifications/${encodeURIComponent(notificationId)}/read`,
152	      {},
153	    );
154	    return asNotification(response.data);
155	  },
156	
157	  /** تعليم كل إشعارات المستخدم الحالي كمقروءة؛ يُرجع عدد السطور المحدّثة. */
158	  async markAllAsRead(): Promise<number> {
159	    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ updatedCount?: number }>>(
160	      '/api/v1/notifications/read-all',
161	      {},
162	    );
163	    return Number(response.data?.updatedCount ?? 0);
164	  },
165	
166	  /** سجل أحداث الإرسال الخارجي (WhatsApp/Email/SMS) من جدول الـ Outbox. */
167	  async listDeliveryLogs(query: { limit?: number; offset?: number; status?: string; channel?: string } = {}): Promise<{ items: ApiDeliveryLog[]; total: number }> {
168	    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>(
169	      `/api/v1/notifications/delivery-logs${toQueryString({
170	        limit: query.limit ?? 150,
171	        offset: query.offset ?? 0,
172	        status: query.status,
173	        channel: query.channel,
174	      })}`,
175	    );
176	    return {
177	      items: asArray<unknown>(response.data).map(asDeliveryLog),
178	      total: Number(response.meta?.total ?? asArray(response.data).length),
179	    };
180	  },
181	
182	  /** تسجيل رسالة واتساب في قائمة انتظار الإرسال؛ الإرسال الفعلي يتم من العامل الخلفي. */
183	  async sendExternal(input: {
184	    recipient: string;
185	    channel: 'whatsapp' | 'email' | 'sms';
186	    message: string;
187	    templateId?: string;
188	    idempotencyKey?: string;
189	  }): Promise<{ outboxId: string; status: string }> {
190	    const response = await appApiClient.post<ApiEnvelope<{ outboxId?: string; status?: string }>>(
191	      '/api/v1/notifications/send-external',
192	      input,
193	    );
194	    return { outboxId: String(response.data?.outboxId ?? ''), status: String(response.data?.status ?? 'queued') };
195	  },
196	};

95	export function createNotificationsRepository(pool: Pool): NotificationsRepository {
96	  return {
97	    async listNotifications(query: PageQuery): Promise<PageResult<NotificationRecord>> {
98	      // المعرّف المشاهد دائمًا في الموضع الأول حتى مع غياب باقي الفلاتر.
99	      // The viewer id is always the first parameter so placeholders stay stable.
100	      const viewerId = query.visibilityFor ?? null;
101	      const values: unknown[] = [viewerId];
102	      // أساس التصفية: بلا مشاهد تُعرض كل الإشعارات، ومع مشاهد يُقصر على ما يراه.
103	      // Without a viewer the feed is unscoped; with one it is limited to what they may see.
104	      const conditions: string[] = [`($1::text IS NULL OR ${visibilityCondition('$1::text')})`];
105	
106	      if (query.userId) {
107	        values.push(query.userId);
108	        conditions.push(`(n.user_id = $${values.length} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_recipient q
109	                          WHERE q.notification_id = n.notification_id AND q.user_id = $${values.length}))`);
110	      }
111	      if (query.isRead !== undefined) {
112	        values.push(query.isRead);
113	        conditions.push(`COALESCE(viewer.is_read, n.is_read, false) = $${values.length}`);
114	      }
115	      if (query.category) {
116	        values.push(query.category);
117	        conditions.push(`n.category = $${values.length}`);
118	      }
119	      if (query.search) {
120	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
121	        const needle = values.length;
122	        conditions.push(`(n.title ILIKE $${needle} OR n.message ILIKE $${needle} OR n.creator_name ILIKE $${needle})`);
123	      }
124	
125	      const where = `WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}`;
126	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
127	
128	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
129	        `SELECT${notificationColumns},
130	                count(*) OVER()::text AS _total ${notificationFrom}
131	           ${where}
132	          ORDER BY n.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, n.notification_id DESC
133	          LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
134	        values,
135	      );
136	
137	      return {
138	        items: result.rows.map(toRecord),
139	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?.['_total'] ?? 0),
140	      };

export interface ErrorDetails {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  details?: unknown[];
  requestId?: string;
}

export interface ErrorEnvelope {
  success: false;
  error: ErrorDetails;
}

/** A safe, transport-neutral application error suitable for Gateway and HTTP boundaries. */
export class ApplicationError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly details?: unknown[];
  readonly requestId?: string;
  readonly causeValue?: unknown;

  constructor(details: ErrorDetails, cause?: unknown) {
    super(details.message);
    this.name = 'ApplicationError';
    this.code = details.code;
    this.details = details.details;
    this.requestId = details.requestId;
    this.causeValue = cause;
  }

  toEnvelope(): ErrorEnvelope {
    const error: ErrorDetails = { code: this.code, message: this.message };
    if (this.details !== undefined) error.details = this.details;
    if (this.requestId !== undefined) error.requestId = this.requestId;
    return { success: false, error };
  }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function toErrorDetails(value: unknown): ErrorDetails | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.code !== 'string' || typeof value.message !== 'string') return null;
  const result: ErrorDetails = { code: value.code, message: value.message };
  if (Array.isArray(value.details)) result.details = value.details;
  if (typeof value.requestId === 'string') result.requestId = value.requestId;
  return result;
}

export function errorDetailsFromUnknown(error: unknown, fallbackCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'): ErrorDetails {
  if (error instanceof ApplicationError) {
    return {
      code: error.code,
      message: error.message,
      ...(error.details !== undefined ? { details: error.details } : {}),
      ...(error.requestId !== undefined ? { requestId: error.requestId } : {}),
    };
  }

  if (isRecord(error)) {
    const envelopeDetails = toErrorDetails(error.error);

function toErrorDetails(value: unknown): ErrorDetails | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.code !== 'string' || typeof value.message !== 'string') return null;
  const result: ErrorDetails = { code: value.code, message: value.message };
  if (Array.isArray(value.details)) result.details = value.details;
  if (typeof value.requestId === 'string') result.requestId = value.requestId;
  return result;
}

export function errorDetailsFromUnknown(error: unknown, fallbackCode = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'): ErrorDetails {
  if (error instanceof ApplicationError) {
    return {
      code: error.code,
      message: error.message,
      ...(error.details !== undefined ? { details: error.details } : {}),
      ...(error.requestId !== undefined ? { requestId: error.requestId } : {}),
    };
  }

  if (isRecord(error)) {
    const envelopeDetails = toErrorDetails(error.error);
    if (error.success === false && envelopeDetails) return envelopeDetails;

    const directDetails = toErrorDetails(error);
    if (directDetails) return directDetails;
  }

  if (error instanceof Error) return { code: fallbackCode, message: error.message };
  if (typeof error === 'string') return { code: fallbackCode, message: error };
  return { code: fallbackCode, message: 'An unexpected error occurred.' };
}

function parseOrderRecord(value: unknown): OrderRecord | null {
  if (!isEntityRecord(value)) return null;
  const orderStatusId = value.orderStatusId;
  const amountRemaining = value.amountRemaining;
  const createdAt = value.createdAt;
  return {
    ...value,
    id: value.id,

    status: readText(value.status) ?? undefined,

    createdAt:
      typeof createdAt === 'string' || typeof createdAt === 'number' ? createdAt : undefined,
  };
```json
}
```

/**
 * إرفاق سجلات الصيانة بالصفوف المقروءة في استعلام واحد —
 * attaches maintenance logs to the read asset rows with a single query (no N+1, no jsonb).
 */
async function attachMaintenanceLogs(
  pool: Pool,
  rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
): Promise<Array<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  const assetIds = rows.map((row) => String(row['assetId'] ?? '')).filter((value) => value.length > 0);
  if (assetIds.length === 0) return rows;
  const logs = await pool.query(
    `SELECT asset_id AS "assetId", ${maintenanceLogColumns}
       FROM public.asset_maintenance_log
      WHERE asset_id = ANY($1::text[])
      ORDER BY asset_id, seq`,
    [assetIds],
  );
  const byAsset = new Map<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>>();
  for (const { assetId, ...log } of logs.rows as Array<Record<string, unknown> & { assetId: string }>) {
    const bucket = byAsset.get(assetId) ?? [];
    bucket.push({ ...log, cost: Number(log['cost'] ?? 0), createdAt: Number(log['createdAt'] ?? 0) });
    byAsset.set(assetId, bucket);
  }
  return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, maintenanceLogs: byAsset.get(String(row['assetId'] ?? '')) ?? [] }));
```json
}
```

**Input:**

```json
  "command": "cd /f/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/alx_api && cat src/db/migrations/0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql",
  "description": "Read migration 0037"
}
```

**Response:**

-- 0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql
-- إصلاح تباعد المرحلة: المسارات القديمة كانت تكتب نص الحالة (orders.order_status1) دون تحديث
-- orders.order_status_id، فبقي المعرّف قديمًا وتظهر الواجهة مرحلة لا تطابق ما يراه المشغّل.
-- Stage divergence repair: legacy write paths updated only the status text (orders.order_status1)
-- and never orders.order_status_id, so the stage id went stale while the text stayed current.
-- النص هو المرجح هنا لأنه آخر ما كتبه المشغّل؛ تُعاد تهيئة المعرّف منه فقط.
-- The text is authoritative because it is the operator's most recent write; only the id is re-seeded from it.
-- Date: 2026-10-15

BEGIN;

-- 1) إعادة تهيئة معرّف المرحلة من اسمها العربي المطابق حرفيًا لكتالوج المراحل.
--    Re-seed the stage id from the Arabic catalog name matched exactly (trim-only, no fuzzy match).
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(os.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;

-- 2) الاسم الإنجليزي احتياطيًا للصفوف التي لا تحمل اسمًا عربيًا مطابقًا.
--    English names cover rows whose text carries the English label instead of the Arabic one.
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(coalesce(os.name_en, '')) <> ''
   AND btrim(os.name_en) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM public.order_status ar WHERE btrim(ar.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   );

-- 3) الحزم القديمة بلا نص حالة تستمد المرحلة من حقل jsonb قبل إسقاطه (0034) —
--    rows with no status text take their stage from the legacy payload before 0034 drops it.
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(o.order_status1, '')), '') IS NULL
   AND os.order_status_id = NULLIF(btrim(o.data ->> 'orderStatusId'), '')
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;

-- 4) التحقق: لا يجوز أن يبقى نص مرحلة مطابق للكتالوج ومعرّفه يخالفه.
--    Guard: a status text that matches the catalog must never disagree with the stored stage id.
DO $$
DECLARE
  leftover integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) INTO leftover
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_status os ON btrim(os.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   WHERE o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;
  IF leftover > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_status_id is still inconsistent with order_status1 for % rows', leftover;
  END IF;
END $$;

COMMIT;

## 2. Short sessions / repeated 401

- TTL: `alx_api\src\config\env.ts:26-27` — `ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` clamp `min 300 max 900 default 600`; `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS default 2_592_000`. Actual `.env:28-29` = `600` / `2592000`. Enforced again in `modules\auth\access-token.ts:71-72` ("5 to 15 minutes"), `:85 exp = iat + ttl`.
- Validation has **zero clock-skew tolerance**: `access-token.ts:138-146` rejects `exp <= nowSeconds`, `nbf > nowSeconds`, `iat > now+30`, `exp-iat > 900`.
- Per-request auth: `auth.use-cases.ts:268-285` → any failure = `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` = `:114` `401 AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.'`; `:282` DB read `drizzle-auth.repository.ts:303-322` (`isNull(revokedAt) AND expiresAt > now`). No `last_seen`/touch write found. Session row expiry = refresh expiry (`:135-140`).
- Refresh exists (`auth.routes.ts:89-105`) and rotates (`auth.use-cases.ts:214-260`), and the frontend does call it — but **only inside `src\lib\alxApiClient.ts:125-171, 231-241`**. The shared client used by all feature gateways has no 401 handling: `src\data\http\api-client.ts:25-210` (no refresh hook) and `src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23-27` (`maxReadRetries: 0`, `accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken`). 27 files instantiate `ApiClient`/`appApiClient`, including `features\notifications\services\notificationsApiDataGateway.ts:8`.
- 401 is therefore surfaced as an error message, not retried or logged out (only `src\services\securityPinService.ts:36` special-cases `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`).
- Retry storms: pollers every 30 s — `src\components\Layout.tsx:287, 344`, `src\features\notifications\pages\NotificationsPage.tsx:154, 196`; plus `SettingsContext.tsx:346-349` (5 min) — after 10 min each tick 401s, matching ~24 events in minutes.
- Rate limits: global `app.ts:113-119` (`RATE_LIMIT_MAX` 120/60 s, `env.ts:16`); a **single shared `authLimiter`** (`auth.routes.ts:54-68`, `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10`/60 s, `.env:16`) guards login+refresh+logout+logout-all, so refresh bursts return 429 → `alxApiClient.ts:143-147` `!response.ok → clearTokens()` (silent logout).
- Idle logout (`Layout.tsx:352-354`) depends on `settings.userSessionTimeout`, which comes from the broken settings read (default `0` at `SettingsContext.tsx:180`) although the DB column exists (`0031:66`).

فحصتُ آليًا **كل مفتاح jsonb** مقابل أسماء الأعمدة. كل «شذوذ» ثبت أنه تكرار بقيمة متطابقة 100%: `portal_users.uid = auth_uid` (5/5)، `salary_history.salaryMonth = month`، `browser_pages.name = name_ar/name_en`، `announcements/order_status → data->id = المفتاح الأساسي` (2/2 و 12/12)، `auto_entries.currencyId` null في 3/3، و`cust_details.acquisitionSource` مستند معشّش كل حقوله منقولة أصلًا إلى `join_by`/`referrer_id`.

الفجوتان الحقيقيّتان — وكلتاهما مغلقتان في كود 0038 بانتظار التشغيل:
- `cust_details.body_details` و `cust_details.location`: عمودا text يحملان مستندات JSON في 3 صفوف من 7 (آخر انتهاك لقاعدتك «لا حقول داخل jsonb»). 0038 §2 و §18 ينقلانهما إلى أعمدة حقيقية، والمستودعات تقرأ وتكتب المسطّح الآن مع الحفاظ على شكل الاستجابة نفسه للعميل.
- `salary_history.createdByUid` (صف واحد) — §4 ينقله إلى عمود `created_by_uid` جديد.

#### Thinking

Key findings:
- Login itself took 16.3s (!) — very slow.
- Many requests hit 10000ms ceiling (status '0' = aborted/timeout by the ApiClient 10s timeout) — the frontend client has timeoutMs default 10000, and requests are aborting at 10s. So server queries take >10s → "تقطع وتأخير كبير في جلب البيانات في كل مكان".
- 24 requests returned 401 → auth invalid.
- Status '0' entries: many (finance/entries 20 calls some aborted, entry-types 10015ms etc).

So the real perf problem is server-side slowness: pool size, N+1, missing indexes, and per-request fan-out (37 calls to /finance/accounts!). Also polling gateways with subscribe intervals.

Let me look at what's slow server-side. Check the API: does it have logging? Let's measure query times directly for the slowest endpoints: /finance/entries, /finance/accounts, /finance/account-movements, /reporting/sources, /reporting/couriers, /shipping-companies, /products, /currencies, /orders, auth/login.

Plan: run a probe timing each SQL behind these endpoints. Also check pool config (pg Pool max), and whether each request opens new connection, and whether connection to Supabase goes through session vs pooler. Note: DATABASE_URL uses pooler presumably. High latency per query (network RTT) × N queries = slow. If each endpoint runs dozens of sequential queries, that's 10s.

Let me check: RTT per query, and count queries per endpoint by reading repositories for loops (N+1 patterns). Let me time a trivial query 10 times.

Also: check `finance/entries` repository for N+1 (attach lines per entry).

## 1. Company name / logo never reach the UI

**Frontend reads them from `SettingsContext`, which starts from hardcoded defaults:**
- `F:\...\src\context\SettingsContext.tsx:135-139` — `systemName: 'ALX'`, `systemLogo: ''`, `companyName: 'الكس-تراك'`; `:263` fetches `settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.getSettings('general')`; `:267-269` swallows failure ("keeping current settings"); `:385` `document.title = settings.systemName || settings.companyName`.
- Consumers exist and are correct: `src\pages\Login.tsx:246`, `src\components\layout\Sidebar.tsx:98-101` (`settings.systemLogo`), `index.html:7` is static (`<title>alx — نظام إدارة الشحنات</title>`, no favicon link).
- Transport: `src\data\http\settings-currencies-api.gateway.ts:44-52` → `GET /api/v1/settings/general`, reads `dto.settings` as a **jsonb object**.

**Backend break — repository queries a table the schema no longer has:**
- `alx_api\src\modules\settings\settings.repository.ts:4-12` projects `COALESCE(data,'{}'::jsonb) AS settings`, `category`; `:28` `FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id=$1 OR category=$1`; `:35-41` INSERT into the same columns.
- `alx_api\src\db\migrations\0034_drop_legacy_jsonb_payloads.sql:35-36` — `ALTER TABLE public.settings DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS data;` / `DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS category;` → every `GET /api/v1/settings/*` throws (42703) → 500 → frontend keeps defaults.
- The real brand columns are never read by any code: `0031_flatten_settings.sql:22-41` creates `settings_general (system_name, system_logo, invoice_logo, company_name, company_address, company_email, company_phone, company_website, tax_id, user_session_timeout …)`; `:79-93` migrates them from `data->>'companyName'`. Grepping `settings_general` in `alx_api\src` hits only the migration file — no route/repository selects it.
- Additionally `settings.routes.ts:19-25` wraps reads in `authenticate`, so on the login screen (`App.tsx:95-99` mounts `SettingsProvider` above the route) there is no token → `auth.routes.ts:33-37` 401; brand can never render pre-login even if the SQL were fixed.
- No branding endpoint elsewhere: `alx_api\src\modules\site-content\site-content.routes.ts` only exposes `/site/tickets|announcements|job-applications|portal-orders` (`:52,83,137,177`).
- `FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED` is finance-only (`src\components\financeAccounting\FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:105,124`), not the settings path.

## 2. Short sessions / repeated 401

- TTL: `alx_api\src\config\env.ts:26-27` — `ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` clamp `min 300 max 900 default 600`; `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS default 2_592_000`. Actual `.env:28-29` = `600` / `2592000`. Enforced again in `modules\auth\access-token.ts:71-72` ("5 to 15 minutes"), `:85 exp = iat + ttl`.
- Validation has **zero clock-skew tolerance**: `access-token.ts:138-146` rejects `exp <= nowSeconds`, `nbf > nowSeconds`, `iat > now+30`, `exp-iat > 900`.
- Per-request auth: `auth.use-cases.ts:268-285` → any failure = `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` = `:114` `401 AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.'`; `:282` DB read `drizzle-auth.repository.ts:303-322` (`isNull(revokedAt) AND expiresAt > now`). No `last_seen`/touch write found. Session row expiry = refresh expiry (`:135-140`).
- Refresh exists (`auth.routes.ts:89-105`) and rotates (`auth.use-cases.ts:214-260`), and the frontend does call it — but **only inside `src\lib\alxApiClient.ts:125-171, 231-241`**. The shared client used by all feature gateways has no 401 handling: `src\data\http\api-client.ts:25-210` (no refresh hook) and `src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23-27` (`maxReadRetries: 0`, `accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken`). 27 files instantiate `ApiClient`/`appApiClient`, including `features\notifications\services\notificationsApiDataGateway.ts:8`.
- 401 is therefore surfaced as an error message, not retried or logged out (only `src\services\securityPinService.ts:36` special-cases `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`).
- Retry storms: pollers every 30 s — `src\components\Layout.tsx:287, 344`, `src\features\notifications\pages\NotificationsPage.tsx:154, 196`; plus `SettingsContext.tsx:346-349` (5 min) — after 10 min each tick 401s, matching ~24 events in minutes.
- Rate limits: global `app.ts:113-119` (`RATE_LIMIT_MAX` 120/60 s, `env.ts:16`); a **single shared `authLimiter`** (`auth.routes.ts:54-68`, `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10`/60 s, `.env:16`) guards login+refresh+logout+logout-all, so refresh bursts return 429 → `alxApiClient.ts:143-147` `!response.ok → clearTokens()` (silent logout).
- Idle logout (`Layout.tsx:352-354`) depends on `settings.userSessionTimeout`, which comes from the broken settings read (default `0` at `SettingsContext.tsx:180`) although the DB column exists (`0031:66`).

412	      } catch (err) {
413	        console.error('[SettingsContext] updateSettings (general) failed:', err);
414	        throw err;
415	      }
416	    }
417	
418	    // حفظ إعدادات المستخدم / Save user settings
419	    if (Object.keys(userUpdates).length > 0) {
420	      const userId = getCurrentUserId();
421	      if (userId) {
422	        try {
423	          await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.updateUserSettings(
424	            userUpdates as Parameters<typeof settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.updateUserSettings>[0]
425	          );
426	          setUserSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...userUpdates } as Partial<Settings>));
427	        } catch (err) {
428	          console.warn('[SettingsContext] updateUserSettings failed — saving to local state only:', err);
429	          // الحفظ المحلي كاحتياط / Local state fallback
430	          setUserSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...userUpdates } as Partial<Settings>));
431	        }
432	      } else {
433	        // المستخدم غير مسجل — الحفظ في الحالة المحلية فقط (صفحة تسجيل الدخول)
434	        // User not logged in — local state only (login screen language)
435	        setUserSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...userUpdates } as Partial<Settings>));
436	      }
437	    }
438	  }, []);
439	
440	  return (
441	    <SettingsContext.Provider value={{ settings, updateSettings, loading, t }}>
442	      {children}
443	    </SettingsContext.Provider>
444	  );
445	}

451	  const context = useContext(SettingsContext);
452	  if (context === undefined) {
453	    throw new Error('useSettings must be used within a SettingsProvider');
454	  }
455	  return context;

13	export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
14	  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
15	  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
16	  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
17	  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
18	  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
19	  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
20	    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
21	      try {
22	        const record = await repository.get(category);
23	        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
24	      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
25	    });
26	    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
27	      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
28	      const actor = principal(response);
29	      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
30	      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
31	      catch (error) { return next(error); }
32	    });
33	  }
34	  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
35	    const actor = principal(response);
36	    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
37	    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
38	    catch (error) { return next(error); }
39	  });
40	  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
41	    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
42	    const actor = principal(response);
43	    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
44	    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
45	    catch (error) { return next(error); }
46	  });

6	import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, RequestHandler, Response } from 'express';
7	import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
8	import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
9	import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';

20	/**
21	 * صلاحيات مستعملة أصلًا في النظام (`view_website_management` / `manage_website`) — لا حاجة لترحيل صلاحيات جديدة.
22	 * Reuses the two permission codes the site-management page already requires, so no permission seeding is needed.
23	 */
24	const READ_PERMISSION = 'view_website_management';
25	const WRITE_PERMISSION = 'manage_website';
26	const ADMIN_REPLY_SENDER = 'Admin Support';
27	
28	const requestId = (response: Response) => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
29	const route = (permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined): RequestHandler[] => [
30	  requireAuthenticatedUser(auth),
31	  requirePermission(auth, permission),
32	];
33	
34	function idParam(request: Request, response: Response): string | null {
35	  const id = request.params.id;
36	  return typeof id === 'string' && id.trim().length > 0
37	    ? id.trim()
38	    : (sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_IDENTIFIER', 'المعرّف غير صالح.', requestId(response)), null);
39	}
40	
41	/** يولّد معرّف إعلان آمنًا نصيًا فقط — لا يُمرر مُدخل المستخدم إلى SQL كمعامل مُركّب. */
42	function announcementId(title: string): string {
43	  const slug = title.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 24);
44	  return `ann_${Date.now()}_${slug || 'item'}`;
45	}

50	  repository: SiteContentRepository,

52	  app.get('/api/v1/site/tickets', ...route(READ_PERMISSION, auth), async (request, response, next) => {
53	    const query = siteContentListSchema.safeParse(request.query as unknown);
54	    if (!query.success) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SITE_QUERY', 'معاملات قائمة التذاكر غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
55	    try {
56	      const result = await repository.listTickets(query.data);
57	      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
58	    } catch (error) {
59	      return next(error);
60	    }
61	  });

25	export function requireAuthenticatedUser(useCases?: AuthUseCases): RequestHandler {
26	  return async (request, response, next) => {
27	    const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId);
28	    if (!useCases) {
29	      sendFailure(response, 503, 'AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED', 'خدمة المصادقة غير مهيأة بعد.', requestId);
30	      return;

34	    const token = /^Bearer ([A-Za-z0-9._~-]+)$/i.exec(authorization)?.[1];
35	    if (!token) {
36	      sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId);
37	      return;
38	    }
39	
40	    try {
41	      response.locals.authPrincipal = await useCases.authenticateAccessToken({ accessToken: token });
42	      next();
43	    } catch (error) {
44	      handleAuthError(error, response, requestId, next);
45	    }
46	  };
47	}

async completePasswordReset(input: { token: string; newPassword: string }): Promise<void> {
    this.requirePasswordCutover();
    const completed = await this.repository.completePasswordReset({
      tokenHash: hashRefreshToken(input.token),
      passwordHash: await this.passwordHasher(input.newPassword),
      completedAt: this.now(),
    });
    if (!completed) throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
  }

  async listPermissions(input: { userId: string }): Promise<readonly string[]> {

  private requirePasswordCutover(): void {
    if (this.options.legacyPasswordAuthEnabled !== false || this.options.passwordChangesEnabled !== true) {
      throw new AuthServiceError(
        503,
        'AUTH_PASSWORD_CHANGE_UNAVAILABLE',
        'تدفق تغيير كلمة المرور متوقف حتى اكتمال تحويل العملاء إلى API.',

  private async createTokenPair(user: AuthUser, now: Date, sessionId: string): Promise<AuthTokenPairDto> {
    const familyId = randomUUID();
    const refreshToken = randomBytes(48).toString('base64url');
    const accessToken = await this.tokenIssuer.issue({
      subject: user.userId,
      role: user.role,
      sessionId,
      expiresInSeconds: this.options.accessTokenTtlSeconds,
    });
    await this.repository.createSession({
      sessionId,
      familyId,
      userId: user.userId,
      refreshTokenHash: hashRefreshToken(refreshToken),
      createdAt: now,
      refreshExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + this.options.refreshTokenTtlSeconds * 1_000),
    });
    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresInSeconds: this.options.accessTokenTtlSeconds,
    };
  }

}

export class Ed25519AccessTokenIssuer implements AccessTokenIssuer {
  private readonly privateKey: KeyObject;

  constructor(
    privateKeyPem: string,
    private readonly issuer: string,
    private readonly audience: string,
    private readonly now: () => Date = () => new Date(),
  ) {
    this.privateKey = requireEd25519Key(createPrivateKey(normalizePem(privateKeyPem)));
    if (!issuer.trim() || !audience.trim()) throw new TypeError('JWT issuer and audience must be configured.');
  }

  async issue(input: { subject: string; role: string; sessionId: string; expiresInSeconds: number }): Promise<string> {
    if (!Number.isInteger(input.expiresInSeconds) || input.expiresInSeconds < 300 || input.expiresInSeconds > 900) {
      throw new RangeError('Access token lifetime must be between 5 and 15 minutes.');
    }
    const issuedAt = Math.floor(this.now().getTime() / 1_000);
    const header = encodeJson({ alg: 'EdDSA', typ: 'JWT' });
    const payload = encodeJson({
      iss: this.issuer,
      aud: this.audience,
      sub: input.subject,
      sid: input.sessionId,
      jti: randomUUID(),
      role: input.role,
      iat: issuedAt,
      nbf: issuedAt,
      exp: issuedAt + input.expiresInSeconds,
    });
    const signingInput = `${header}.${payload}`;
    const signature = signBytes(null, Buffer.from(signingInput, 'utf8'), this.privateKey).toString('base64url');
    return `${signingInput}.${signature}`;
  }
}

export function verifyAccessToken(
  token: string,
  options: {
    publicKeyPem: string;
    issuer: string;
    audience: string;
    now?: () => Date;
  },
): AccessTokenClaims {
  if (token.length > 8_192) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();
  const parts = token.split('.');
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some((part) => part.length === 0)) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();
  const [encodedHeader, encodedClaims, encodedSignature] = parts;
  if (!encodedHeader || !encodedClaims || !encodedSignature) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();

  const header = headerSchema.safeParse(decodeJson(encodedHeader));
  const claims = claimsSchema.safeParse(decodeJson(encodedClaims));
  if (!header.success || !claims.success) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();

Note: `app.post('/api/v1/auth/refresh', authLimiter, ...)` — the same authLimiter instance (limit 10 per 60s window) is shared across login, refresh, logout, logout-all etc. So if frontend refreshes on 401 for many requests, each 401 triggers a refresh → after 10 refresh attempts in a minute → 429 → refreshAccessToken receives !response.ok → clearTokens() → silent logout.

Important: the authLimiter closure is created once in registerAuthRoutes and used for all auth routes — yes.

        username: fallbackName,
        email: user.email ?? null,
        fullName: fallbackName,
        role: user.role,
        isRoot: user.userId === 'usr_root',
        disabled: user.disabled,
      },
    };
  }

  async refresh(input: { refreshToken: string }): Promise<AuthTokenPairDto> {
    const now = this.now();
    const oldTokenHash = hashRefreshToken(input.refreshToken);
    const stored = await this.repository.findRefreshToken(oldTokenHash);
    if (stored?.usedAt !== null && stored?.usedAt !== undefined) {
      await this.repository.revokeRefreshTokenFamily(oldTokenHash, now);
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }
    if (
      !stored ||
      stored.disabled ||
      stored.revokedAt !== null ||
      stored.expiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime() ||
      stored.sessionRevokedAt !== null ||
      stored.sessionExpiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime()
    ) {
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }

    const user: AuthUser = { userId: stored.userId, role: stored.role, disabled: stored.disabled };
    const sessionId = stored.sessionId;
    const nextRefreshToken = randomBytes(48).toString('base64url');
    const nextTokenHash = hashRefreshToken(nextRefreshToken);
    const nextExpiry = new Date(now.getTime() + this.options.refreshTokenTtlSeconds * 1_000);
    const accessToken = await this.tokenIssuer.issue({
      subject: user.userId,
      role: user.role,
      sessionId,
      expiresInSeconds: this.options.accessTokenTtlSeconds,
    });
    const rotated = await this.repository.rotateRefreshToken({
      oldTokenHash,
      newTokenHash: nextTokenHash,
      newTokenId: randomUUID(),
      rotatedAt: now,
      newExpiresAt: nextExpiry,
    });
    if (!rotated) {
      await this.repository.revokeRefreshTokenFamily(oldTokenHash, now);
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken: nextRefreshToken,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresInSeconds: this.options.accessTokenTtlSeconds,
    };
  }

  async logout(input: { refreshToken: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.repository.revokeRefreshToken(hashRefreshToken(input.refreshToken), this.now());
  }

  async authenticateAccessToken(input: { accessToken: string }): Promise<AuthPrincipalDto> {
    const { accessTokenPublicKeyPem, jwtIssuer, jwtAudience } = this.options;
    if (!accessTokenPublicKeyPem || !jwtIssuer || !jwtAudience) throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();

    let claims;
    try {
      claims = verifyAccessToken(input.accessToken, {
        publicKeyPem: accessTokenPublicKeyPem,
        issuer: jwtIssuer,
        audience: jwtAudience,
        now: this.now,
      });
    } catch {
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }

    const activeUser = await this.repository.findActiveSession({
      userId: claims.sub,
      sessionId: claims.sid,
      now: this.now(),
    });
    if (!activeUser || activeUser.disabled) throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();

    return { userId: activeUser.userId, sessionId: claims.sid, role: activeUser.role };
  }

  async listSessions(input: { userId: string; currentSessionId: string }): Promise<readonly AuthSessionDto[]> {
    return this.repository.listSessions({ ...input, now: this.now() });
  }

  async revokeSession(input: { userId: string; sessionId: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.repository.revokeSession({ ...input, revokedAt: this.now() });
  }

=== activity-audit usage ===
/**
 * activity-audit.ts
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * كاتب سجل النشاط الموحّد لكل وحدات الـ API (Unified activity-log writer).
 * One writer for every activity-log insert so no module invents its own columns:
 * identity is resolved from the database, summaries stay plain text, and structured
 * fields go to the activity_log_detail child table instead of a jsonb blob.
 */

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { PoolClient } from 'pg';
import type { ActivityLogDetailValue } from '../../modules/activity-logs/activity-logs.contracts';

export interface ActivityAuditEvent {
  action: string;
  category?: string | undefined;
  target?: string | undefined;
  summary?: string | undefined;
  /** هوية الفاعل من الـ principal المصادَق عليه فقط — never taken from client input. */
  actorUserId?: string | null | undefined;
}

/**
 * يكتب قيد النشاط ويعيد الصف المسطّح، مع اسم المستخدم ودوره من قاعدة البيانات.
 * Inserts the log row and returns its flat projection; user name/role are resolved
 * server-side from `public.users`, so a missing profile still records the event.
 */
export async function insertActivityLog(
  client: PoolClient,
  event: ActivityAuditEvent,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  const activityLogId = `act_${randomUUID()}`;
  const result = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
    `INSERT INTO public.activity_logs
       (activity_log_id, action, category, target, type, summary,
        user_id, user_name, user_role, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
     SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, 'api', $5,
            source.user_id, u.full_name, u.role, NOW(), NOW(), $6, $6
       FROM (SELECT $6::text AS user_id) AS source
       LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = source.user_id
     ON CONFLICT (activity_log_id) DO NOTHING
     RETURNING activity_log_id AS "activityLogId", action, category, target, type, summary,
               user_id AS "userId", user_name AS "userName", user_role AS "userRole",
               created_at AS "createdAt"`,
    [
      activityLogId,
      event.action,
      event.category ?? null,
      event.target ?? null,
      event.summary ?? null,
      event.actorUserId ?? null,
    ],
  );
  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
}

/**
 * يسطّر تفاصيل الحدث حقلاً في كل سطر.
 * Writes one child row per detail field; nested objects are rejected by the schema upstream.
 */

=== app-api-client ===
/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeoutMinutes = settings.userSessionTimeout;
    if (!timeoutMinutes || timeoutMinutes <= 0 || !auth.currentUser) return;

    const timeoutMs = timeoutMinutes * 60 * 1000;
    let lastActivity = Date.now();

    const updateActivity = () => {
      lastActivity = Date.now();
    };

    const activityEvents = ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'touchstart', 'click'];
    activityEvents.forEach(evt => window.addEventListener(evt, updateActivity, { passive: true }));

    const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - lastActivity;
      if (elapsed >= timeoutMs) {
        clearInterval(checkInterval);
        activityEvents.forEach(evt => window.removeEventListener(evt, updateActivity));

        });

function movementsPath(accountId: string): string {
  return `/api/v1/finance/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/movements`;

async function fetchAllPages<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  path: string,
  query: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined> = {}
): Promise<T[]> {
  const rows: T[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < MAX_ROWS; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {
    const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiPage<T>>>(path, {
      ...query,
      limit: PAGE_SIZE,
      offset,
    });
    const page = Array.isArray(response.data)
      ? response.data
      : (response.data.items ?? []);
    rows.push(...page);
    const total = Number(response.meta?.total ?? rows.length);
    if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE || rows.length >= total) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  collectionName: string
): Promise<T[]> {
  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
  if (!path)
    throw new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`);
  const rows = await fetchAllPages<T>(path, collectionName === "accounts" ? { includeInactive: true } : {});
  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];
}

Note: `value.nbf > nowSeconds` — zero tolerance (strict, no skew allowance); if the API server clock is behind the issuing clock... actually same process. - `alx_api\src\db\migrations\0034_drop_legacy_jsonb_payloads.sql:35-36` — `ALTER TABLE public.settings DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS data;` / `DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS category;` → every `GET /api/v1/settings/*` throws (42703) → 500 → frontend keeps defaults.

- TTL: `alx_api\src\config\env.ts:26-27` — `ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` clamp `min 300 max 900 default 600`; `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS default 2_592_000`. Actual `.env:28-29` = `600` / `2592000`. Enforced again in `modules\auth\access-token.ts:71-72` ("5 to 15 minutes"), `:85 exp = iat + ttl`.
- Validation has **zero clock-skew tolerance**: `access-token.ts:138-146` rejects `exp <= nowSeconds`, `nbf > nowSeconds`, `iat > now+30`, `exp-iat > 900`.

The shared client used by all feature gateways has no 401 handling: `src\data\http\api-client.ts:25-210` (no refresh hook) and `src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23-27` (`maxReadRetries: 0`, `accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken`). 27 files instantiate `ApiClient`/`appApiClient`, including `features\notifications\services\notificationsApiDataGateway.ts:8`.

- Retry storms: pollers every 30 s — `src\components\Layout.tsx:287, 344`, `src\features\notifications\pages\NotificationsPage.tsx:154, 196`; plus `SettingsContext.tsx:346-349` (5 min) — after 10 min each tick 401s, matching ~24 events in minutes.

- Idle logout (`Layout.tsx:352-354`) depends on `settings.userSessionTimeout`, which comes from the broken settings read (default `0` at `SettingsContext.tsx:180`) although the DB column exists (`0031:66`).

import { Pool, type PoolConfig } from 'pg';
import { drizzle, type NodePgDatabase } from 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres';
import * as schema from './schema';

export interface DatabaseConnection {
  pool: Pool;
  db: NodePgDatabase<typeof schema>;
}

export interface DatabasePoolOptions {
  connectionString: string;
  nodeEnv: 'development' | 'test' | 'production';
  sslMode: 'disable' | 'require' | 'verify-full';
  sslCaPem?: string;
  runtimeRole?: 'alx_api_runtime';
  maxConnections?: number;
  connectionTimeoutMs?: number;
  idleTimeoutMs?: number;
}

export function createDatabaseConnection(options: DatabasePoolOptions): DatabaseConnection {
  const connectionUrl = new URL(options.connectionString);
  connectionUrl.searchParams.delete('sslmode');
  connectionUrl.searchParams.delete('sslrootcert');
  if (options.sslMode === 'verify-full' && !options.sslCaPem) {
    throw new Error('DATABASE_SSL_CA_REQUIRED');
  }
  if (options.runtimeRole && options.nodeEnv === 'production') {
    throw new Error('DATABASE_RUNTIME_ROLE_OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PRODUCTION');
  }
  const config: PoolConfig = {
    connectionString: connectionUrl.toString(),
    ssl:
      options.sslMode === 'disable'
        ? undefined
        : options.sslMode === 'verify-full'
          ? { ca: options.sslCaPem, rejectUnauthorized: true }
          : { rejectUnauthorized: false },
    ...(options.runtimeRole ? { options: '-c role=alx_api_runtime' } : {}),
    max: options.maxConnections ?? 10,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: options.connectionTimeoutMs ?? 15_000,
    idleTimeoutMillis: options.idleTimeoutMs ?? 30_000,
  };
  const pool = new Pool(config);
  pool.on('error', (error: Error) => {
    // Never log the connection string or query values.
    console.error('[alx_api] idle PostgreSQL client error', { name: error.name });
  });

  return { pool, db: drizzle(pool, { schema }) };
}

88	export function createReportingRepository(pool: Pool): ReportingRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async list(resource, query) {
91	      const definition = definitions[resource];
92	      const values: unknown[] = [];
93	      const filters: string[] = [];
94	      if (query.search) {
95	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
96	        const placeholder = `$${values.length}`;
97	        filters.push(`(${definition.searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE ${placeholder}`).join(' OR ')})`);
98	      }
99	      const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
100	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
101	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
102	        `SELECT ${definition.columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM ${definition.from} ${where} ORDER BY ${definition.orderBy} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
103	        values,
104	      );
105	      return {
106	        items: result.rows.map(({ _total: _ignored, ...row }) => definition.map?.(row) ?? (row as ReportingRow)),
107	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0),
108	      };
109	    },
110	  };
111	}

SMOKING GUN: `record_order_payment_v2` reads/writes the **jsonb `data`** column for amounts (`amountPaid`, `amountRemaining`, `totalAmount`, `orderPartyAccountId`, `customerAccountId`) — legacy DB function. After 0030 flattened the columns (amount_paid/amount_remaining/total_cost_yer...), the `data` payload no longer holds those keys (data was backfilled FROM data; the flat columns are now authoritative and writes via new flat code don't update `data`... or data still has stale values).

So payment fails with "المتبقي: 0.00" because data->>'amountRemaining' is absent/empty → total=0 → remaining=0 → any payment > 0 rejected. Also `orderPartyAccountId`/`customerAccountId` missing → would fail next.

This is exactly the user's complaint "عملية دفعة طلب تفشل". Fix = rewrite this DB function (and its siblings: create_financial_entry_v2, auto-entry trigger functions, order update triggers) to use FLAT columns. That's DB DDL (CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION) → must be run by the user in dashboard (alx_api_runtime has no DDL rights... actually CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION requires ownership; runtime role can't).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.secure_record_order_payment(p_order_id text, p_payment_amount numeric, p_entry jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE v_actor_id text; v_payload jsonb; v_result jsonb; BEGIN v_actor_id := public.require_financial_permission('create_receipt_vouchers'); v_payload := jsonb_set(COALESCE(p_entry, '{}'::jsonb), '{createdByUid}', to_jsonb(v_actor_id), true); PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_update_history', 'on', true); v_result := public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id, p_payment_amount, v_payload, v_actor_id); PERFORM public.replace_financial_entry_payment_details(v_result->>'entryId', v_payload->'paymentDetails', v_actor_id); RETURN v_result; END; $function$

function entryPayload(input: CreateEntryInput): Record<string, unknown> {
  const firstLine = input.lines[0];
  if (!firstLine) throw new Error('FINANCIAL_ENTRY_LINES_REQUIRED');
  return {
    entryNumber: input.entryNumber,
    moduleId: input.moduleId,
    entryTypeId: input.entryTypeId,
    entryCategory: input.entryCategory,
    postingStatus: input.postingStatus,
    amountOriginal: String(firstLine.amountOriginal),
    currencyOriginalNo: String(firstLine.currencyOriginalNo),
    currencyPriceId: input.lines[0]?.currencyPriceId ? String(input.lines[0].currencyPriceId) : '',
    currencyPriceSeq: input.lines[0]?.currencyPriceSeq ? String(input.lines[0].currencyPriceSeq) : '',
    description: input.description,
    notes: input.notes ?? '',
    attachments: input.attachments ?? [],
    paymentMethod: input.paymentMethod ?? '',
    orderId: input.orderId ?? '',
    shipmentId: input.shipmentId ?? '',
    custodyId: input.custodyId ?? '',
    automationKey: input.automationKey ?? '',
    autoRuleId: input.autoRuleId ?? '',
    isAutomatic: input.isAutomatic ?? false,
    effectiveAt: input.effectiveAt ?? '',
    createdByUid: input.createdByUid,
    lines: input.lines.map((line) => ({
      ...line,
      amount: String(line.amount),
      amountOriginal: String(line.amountOriginal),
      accountCurNo: String(line.accountCurNo),
      currencyOriginalNo: String(line.currencyOriginalNo),
    })),
  };
}

};

export interface UserSettingsRecord {
  userSettingId: string;

  settings: UserSettingsData;
  createdAt: string | null;
  updatedAt: string | null;
  createdBy: string | null;
  updatedBy: string | null;
}

export interface SettingsRepository {
  get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null>;
  update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord>;

}

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

import type { SettingsApiDto, UserSettingsApiDto, SystemSettingsData } from '../dtos/settings.dto';

export interface ApiCurrencyDto {
  currencyId: number;
  code: string;
  mainNameAr: string;
  subNameAr: string | null;
  mainNameEn: string | null;
  subNameEn: string | null;
  symbol: string;
  flag: string | null;
  isDefault: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  currentPrice: number | null;
  lastSeq: number | null;
  lastUpdateBy: string | null;
  lastUpdateDate: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyRateDto {
  rateId: number;
  currencyId: number;
  price: number;
  dayDate: string;
  sequence: number;
  updatedBy: string | null;
  createdAt: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyCreateInput {
  code: string;
  mainNameAr: string;
  subNameAr?: string | null;
  mainNameEn?: string | null;
  subNameEn?: string | null;
  symbol: string;
  flag?: string | null;
  isDefault?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
}

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

  },

    return response.data;
  },
  async getUserSettings(): Promise<UserSettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<UserSettingsApiDto>>('/api/v1/settings/user');
    return response.data;
  },
