    const response = await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<UserSettingsApiDto>>('/api/v1/settings/user', { settings });
    return response.data;
  },
  async listCurrencies(activeOnly = true): Promise<ApiCurrencyDto[]> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyDto[]>>(`/api/v1/currencies?activeOnly=${activeOnly ? 'true' : 'false'}`);
    return response.data;
  },
  async createCurrency(data: ApiCurrencyCreateInput): Promise<ApiCurrencyDto> {
    const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyDto>>('/api/v1/currencies', {
      ...data,
      isDefault: data.isDefault ?? false,
      isActive: data.isActive ?? true,
    });
    return response.data;
  },
  async updateCurrency(currencyId: number, data: Partial<ApiCurrencyCreateInput>): Promise<ApiCurrencyDto> {
    const response = await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyDto>>(`/api/v1/currencies/${currencyId}`, data);
    return response.data;
  },
  async deleteCurrency(currencyId: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const response = await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<{ deleted: boolean }>>(`/api/v1/currencies/${currencyId}`);
    return response.data?.deleted ?? true;
  },
  async getCurrencyRates(currencyId: number): Promise<ApiCurrencyRateDto[]> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyRateDto[]>>(`/api/v1/currencies/${currencyId}/rates`);

/** المستند القديم يخزن المصفوفة داخل settings.data — نقبل الصفوف الصالحة فقط. */
function asCategoryList(value: unknown): ExpenseCategory[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.filter(
    (entry): entry is ExpenseCategory =>
      Boolean(entry) && typeof entry === 'object' && typeof (entry as ExpenseCategory).id === 'string',
  );
}

async function readStored(): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
  try {
    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<SettingsRecord>>(SETTINGS_PATH);
    return asCategoryList(response?.data?.settings?.data);
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as { code?: string } | null)?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return [];
    throw error;
  }
}

async function readSettingsRecord(category: string): Promise<{ settings?: unknown } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<{ settings?: unknown }>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as { code?: string })?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

  /**
   * Generates strictly unique, non-colliding account identifiers:
   * accountNumber, accountCode, code, and accountId.

=== auto voucher patch 745-775 ===
  async ensureAutomaticVoucherRules(): Promise<any[]> {
    const normalizedDefaultRules = buildDefaultAutomaticVoucherRules();

    try {
      const record = await readSettingsRecord('automatic_voucher_rules');
      const storedRules = (record?.settings as { data?: unknown } | undefined)?.data;
      const currentRules: any[] = Array.isArray(storedRules) ? storedRules : [];

      const existingRulesIds = new Set(currentRules.map((rule) => rule?.id));
      const missingRules = normalizedDefaultRules.filter((rule: any) => !existingRulesIds.has(rule.id));
      if (record && missingRules.length === 0) return currentRules;

      const mergedRules = [...currentRules, ...missingRules];
      try {
        await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/settings/automatic_voucher_rules', {
          settings: { data: mergedRules },
        });
      } catch (writeError) {
        // الحفظ يحتاج edit_general_settings؛ القارئ بلا صلاحية يستعمل القواعد المدموجة محلياً.
        // Seeding needs edit_general_settings; a read-only user still gets the merged rules locally.
        console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر حفظ قواعد القيود التلقائية في الإعدادات:', writeError);
      }

      return mergedRules;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(
        "[FinancialAccountService] Failed to seed automatic voucher rules:",
        e,
      );
      return normalizedDefaultRules;
    }

}).strict();
export const updateCurrencySchema = createCurrencySchema.partial().strict();
export const createCurrencyRateSchema = z.object({

  dayDate: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
}).strict();

Only `general` is actually consumed by the UI (SettingsContext via getSettings('general')); logistics/whatsapp gateways exist but no UI callers found (no getSettings('whatsapp') usage outside gateway def). expense_categories + automatic_voucher_rules ARE used by services.

So implement flat adapters for: general, expense_categories, automatic_voucher_rules, logistics, whatsapp (all five, since the route exposes them and 0034 drops settings.data). Keep logistics/whatsapp simple/explicit.

Now write settings.repository.ts. Design:

```ts
const generalColumnMap = { ... } as const;  // camel -> column
type SqlValue = string | number | boolean | null;

function buildUpdates(map, settings): { clauses: string[]; values: SqlValue[]; keys: string[] }

async function readGeneral(): returns Record<string, unknown> with customCurrencies + backupCollections
async function writeGeneral(settings, actor)
...
```

Row timestamps: settings_general has only updated_at (no created_at/created_by). SettingsRecord requires createdAt/updatedAt/createdBy/updatedBy — return nulls/updated_at.

For update: settings_general PK settings_key='general' — upsert with ON CONFLICT.

expense_categories: {data: [...]} — write: DELETE all rows then INSERT provided (in a transaction). Keep seq ordering. Also `is_system` preserved.

automatic_voucher_rules: rules live in auto_entries. Read: map auto_entries rows → rule objects {id, statusId, statusNameAr, nameAr, nameEn, isActive, amountSource, amountSources, amountStrategy, currency, curNo, skipWhenZero, autoPost, debitAccount, creditAccount, descriptionTemplateAr, descriptionTemplateEn}. Write: upsert each rule (ON CONFLICT auto_entry_id) + delete rules missing from payload? Careful: auto_entries is the finance-owned table; settings patch would delete rows not present. Safer: upsert only (no delete) to avoid destroying finance data; note in comment.

whatsapp: read settings_whatsapp + child rows; write upsert + replace child rows. Never return secrets? Legacy returned config including token. The DTO for reads hides them (that's another route). Keep parity with legacy document shape: return config with values (UI edit form needs them). Security note: it's an authenticated admin-only path (edit_general_settings for writes; reads require auth). Acceptable but prefer masking? Changing might break UI. Keep parity, add comment.

logistics: settings_logistics row keyed provider_key='logistics'. Read: {provider, enabled, apiKey, defaultDestinationCountry}. Write upsert.

Also need the brand read for the public endpoint: reuse readGeneral but only non-sensitive brand keys.

async function fetchRules(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
  const rows = await readFinanceRows('/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules', { limit: 1000, offset: 0 });
  return (rows as AutoEntryRuleRow[]).map(fromApiRow);
}

export const autoEntryService = {
  /**
   * قراءة القواعد كما هي من alx_api بلا بذر وبلا ابتلاع للأخطاء — تستخدمها الواجهات التي يجب أن تُظهر الفشل.
   * Reads the stored rules as-is (no seeding, no swallowed errors) for UI providers that must surface failures.
   */
  async loadRules(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
    return fetchRules();
  },

  /**
   * قراءة القواعد من API وبذر الافتراضيات إن كانت فارغة.
   * Reads rules from the API and seeds the defaults when the table is empty.
   */
  async ensureAutoEntries(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
    try {
      const rules = await fetchRules();
      if (rules.length > 0) return rules;
      for (const rule of DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES) {
        await financeApiClient.post('/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules', { autoEntryId: rule.id, ...toApiPayload(rule) });
      }
      return fetchRules();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[autoEntryService] ensureAutoEntries failed:', err);
      return [];
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get auto entries linked to a specific statusId
   */
  async getAutoEntriesForStatus(statusId: number | string): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
    try {
      const all = await this.ensureAutoEntries();
      const numId = typeof statusId === 'number' ? statusId : parseInt(String(statusId), 10);
      return all.filter(r => (r.statusId === numId || String(r.statusId) === String(statusId)) && r.isActive);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[autoEntryService] getAutoEntriesForStatus failed:', err);
      return [];
    }
  },

  /**
   * إنشاء أو تحديث قاعدة قيد تلقائي — create or update through the API.
   */

export type ApiResult<T = unknown> = ApiSuccess<T> | ApiError;

// ── أخطاء API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class AlxApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: string,
    message: string,
    public readonly statusCode: number,
    public readonly requestId: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AlxApiError';
  }
}

// ── دالة التجديد التلقائي للـ Access Token ────────────────────────────────────

let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;

/** تجديد Access Token تلقائيًا باستخدام Refresh Token */
async function refreshAccessToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  // منع التجديد المتعدد في نفس الوقت
  if (refreshPromise) return refreshPromise;

  const refreshToken = getStoredRefreshToken();
  if (!refreshToken || !ALX_API_URL) return null;

  refreshPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${ALX_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/refresh`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-Request-Id': generateRequestId(),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        // Refresh Token منتهي أو ملغى — مسح الجلسة
        clearTokens();
        return null;
      }

      const result = (await response.json()) as ApiResult<{
        accessToken: string;
        refreshToken: string;
        sessionId: string;
      }>;

      if (!result.success) {
        clearTokens();
        return null;
      }

      storeTokens(result.data.accessToken, result.data.refreshToken, result.data.sessionId);
      return result.data.accessToken;
    } catch {
      return null;
    } finally {
      refreshPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  return refreshPromise;
}

  authenticated?: boolean;
  /** مفتاح لمنع التكرار — مطلوب عند إنشاء الطلبات */

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

```ts
import { clearTokens, getStoredRefreshToken, storeTokens } from "../../lib/alxApiClient";

let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;
const AUTH_URL = ...base url...
export async function refreshSessionAccessToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  if (refreshPromise) return refreshPromise;
  const refreshToken = getStoredRefreshToken();
  if (!refreshToken) return null;
  refreshPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${APP_API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/refresh`, {...});
      if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) { clearTokens(); return null; }   // انتهاء صلاحية التجديد فعلًا
      if (!response.ok) return null;   // 429/5xx: لا نمسح الجلسة، المحاولة التالية تكمل
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!result?.success) return null;
      storeTokens(result.data.accessToken, result.data.refreshToken, result.data.sessionId);
      return result.data.accessToken as string;
    } catch { return null; }
    finally { refreshPromise = null; }
  })();
  return refreshPromise;
}
```

The outer `return refreshPromise` happens after assignment; the finally clears the module var. That matches existing alxApiClient pattern... #### Thinking

Very informative:
- cust_details: `location` jsonb object with lat/lng/city/street/country/governorate/addressDetails → the "flat" columns city/country exist but NOT street/governorate/address_details/lat/lng. And `acquisitionSource` is actually an object `{notes, joinBy, referrerId}` — weird nesting (it's `data->acquisitionSource`? Actually my query pulled `data->>'acquisitionSource'` and it returned JSON text, meaning it's an object). Hmm it printed as object string because ->> on an object returns null normally... it printed `{"notes": "", "joinBy": "facebook"...}` meaning the payload key `acquisitionSource` holds an object. Wait `->>` returns text representation for objects? No, `->>` on object returns the JSON text (it does work for any type, returning text for scalars and JSON text for composites). Yes, `->>` on jsonb object returns its JSON text.
  So cust_details needs flattening: location lat/lng/city/street/country/governorate/addressDetails + acquisition_source (joinBy/referrerId/notes → but joinBy/referrerId already flat columns? cust_details has join_by, referrer_id!). And `notes` column exists.
  Also `address` payload key with '' values → no address column; but empty. Only rows with '' → ignorable but rule says first-class column. Add `address_details`? The location object has addressDetails.
- portal_users: `uid` == portal_user_id and auth_uid; `linkedAccId` ('cust_0012') vs financial_account_id ('1132-0012') — DIFFERENT semantics! linkedAccId is an account table id, financial_account_id looks like account code. So portal_users needs `linked_acc_id` column, backfilled. `commercialRegister` ('' ) vs commercial_register_url — p_cr is '' or null → ignorable but add? It's basically same. `linkedCourierId`/`linkedSourceId` all null in rows.
- browser_pages.name == name_ar/name_en → duplicate, safe.

BEGIN;

 RETURNS jsonb

-- 0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql
-- إصلاح تباعد المرحلة: المسارات القديمة كانت تكتب نص الحالة (orders.order_status1) دون تحديث
-- orders.order_status_id، فبقي المعرّف قديمًا وتظهر الواجهة مرحلة لا تطابق ما يراه المشغّل.
-- Stage divergence repair: legacy write paths updated only the status text (orders.order_status1)
-- and never orders.order_status_id, so the stage id went stale while the text stayed current.
-- النص هو المرجح هنا لأنه آخر ما كتبه المشغّل؛ تُعاد تهيئة المعرّف منه فقط.
-- The text is authoritative because it is the operator's most recent write; only the id is re-seeded from it.
-- Date: 2026-10-15

BEGIN;

-- 1) إعادة تهيئة معرّف المرحلة من اسمها العربي المطابق حرفيًا لكتالوج المراحل.
--    Re-seed the stage id from the Arabic catalog name matched exactly (trim-only, no fuzzy match).
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(os.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;

-- 2) الاسم الإنجليزي احتياطيًا للصفوف التي لا تحمل اسمًا عربيًا مطابقًا.
--    English names cover rows whose text carries the English label instead of the Arabic one.
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(coalesce(os.name_en, '')) <> ''
   AND btrim(os.name_en) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM public.order_status ar WHERE btrim(ar.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   );

--- public.orders_history_from_activity_logs ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_activity_logs()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  activity_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;
  activity_action text := lower(COALESCE(activity_row->>'action', ''));
  order_ref text := COALESCE(activity_row->'data'->'details'->>'orderId', activity_row->'data'->'details'->>'order_id', activity_row->'data'->'details'->>'orderNumber', activity_row->'data'->>'orderId', activity_row->'data'->>'order_id', activity_row->'data'->>'orderNumber', activity_row->>'target');
  resolved_order record;
  event_summary text;
BEGIN
  IF activity_action = ANY (ARRAY['add_order', 'edit_order', 'edit_delivered_order', 'delete_order']) THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);
  IF resolved_order.order_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
  END IF;
  event_summary := CASE activity_action
    WHEN 'add_payment' THEN 'تم تسجيل دفعة مرتبطة بالطلب'
    WHEN 'financial_transaction' THEN 'تم تسجيل حركة مالية مرتبطة بالطلب'
    WHEN 'account_order_charge' THEN 'تم تسجيل استحقاق مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
    WHEN 'account_payment_received' THEN 'تم تسجيل تحصيل مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
    ELSE 'تم تسجيل نشاط تشغيلي مرتبط بالطلب'
  END;
  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
    resolved_order.order_id, resolved_order.order_number, NULL, NULL, NULL, COALESCE(NEW.activity_log_id, OLD.activity_log_id),
    'activity.' || COALESCE(NULLIF(activity_action, ''), lower(TG_OP)), 'activity', lower(TG_OP), 'activity_log', 'activity_log', event_summary,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,
    jsonb_build_object('activityAction', activity_action, 'activityTarget', activity_row->>'target', 'activityDetails', COALESCE(activity_row->'data'->'details', activity_row->'data', '{}'::jsonb), 'trigger', TG_NAME),
    activity_row->>'userId', activity_row->'data'->>'userName', activity_row->'data'->>'userRole'
  );
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$


===== main_entry :: trg_orders_history_main_entry_financial =====
--- public.orders_history_from_main_entry ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_main_entry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order_id text;
  v_order_number text;
  v_actor record;
  v_line_count integer;
  v_event_type text;
  v_summary text;
  v_amount_original numeric;
  v_currency_original_no integer;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.posting_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.posting_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF NEW.order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  v_order_id := NEW.order_id;
  IF v_order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT s.order_id INTO v_order_id FROM public.shipments s WHERE s.shipment_id = NEW.shipment_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT o.order_number INTO v_order_number FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_id = v_order_id;
  IF v_order_id IS NULL OR v_order_number IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_actor FROM public.orders_history_actor(COALESCE(NEW.posted_by_uid, NEW.voided_by_uid, NEW.updated_by_uid, NEW.created_by_uid));
  
  -- تحديث: استخدام main_entry_id بدلاً من entry_id
  -- Updated: use main_entry_id instead of entry_id
  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(amount_original) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'Debit'), 0), COALESCE(MAX(currency_original_no), 1)
  INTO v_line_count, v_amount_original, v_currency_original_no
  FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = NEW.main_entry_id;

  v_event_type := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'financial.entry_posted' WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'financial.entry_voided' ELSE 'financial.entry_status_changed' END;
  v_summary := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'تم ترحيل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'تم إبطال قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' ELSE 'تم تغيير حالة قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END;

  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (
    orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, source, summary, after_data, metadata, main_entry_id, account_trans_count, occurred_at, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    'oh_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || txid_current()::text), 1, 24),
    v_order_id, v_order_number, NEW.shipment_id, v_event_type, 'financial', lower(NEW.posting_status), 'main_entry',
    v_actor.actor_id, v_actor.actor_name, v_actor.actor_role, 'financial_trigger', v_summary,
    jsonb_build_object('entryNumber', NEW.entry_number, 'entryCategory', NEW.entry_category, 'postingStatus', NEW.posting_status, 'amountOriginal', v_amount_original, 'currencyOriginalNo', v_currency_original_no, 'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method, 'description', NEW.description, 'effectiveAt', NEW.effective_at),
    jsonb_build_object('mainEntryId', NEW.main_entry_id, 'accountTransCount', v_line_count, 'orderId', NEW.order_id, 'shipmentId', NEW.shipment_id, 'trigger', TG_NAME),
    NEW.main_entry_id, v_line_count, now(), now()
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

--- public.orders_history_from_orders ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_orders()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  before_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;
  after_row  jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;
  changed_fields text[] := public.orders_history_changed_fields(before_row, after_row);
  event_name    text;
  event_summary text;
  order_ref     text;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND current_setting('swiftship.suppress_order_update_history', true) = 'on' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND current_setting('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', true) = 'on' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND COALESCE(array_length(changed_fields, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  order_ref := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN NULL
                    ELSE COALESCE(NEW.order_id::text, OLD.order_id::text)
               END;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    event_name    := 'order.created';
    event_summary := 'تم إنشاء الطلب';
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    event_name    := 'order.deleted';
    event_summary := 'تم حذف الطلب';
  ELSIF OLD.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_status_id THEN
    event_name    := 'order.status_changed';
    event_summary := 'تم تحديث حالة الطلب';
  ELSE
    event_name    := 'order.updated';
    event_summary := 'تم تعديل بيانات الطلب';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
    order_ref,
    COALESCE(NEW.order_number, OLD.order_number),
    NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    event_name, 'order', lower(TG_OP), 'order', 'database_trigger',
    event_summary, before_row, after_row,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'changedFields', changed_fields,
      'changes', public.orders_history_change_details(before_row, after_row),
      'deletedOrderId', CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD.order_id ELSE NULL END,
      'trigger', TG_NAME
    )
  );

  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_shipments()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  before_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;
  after_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;
  changed_fields text[] := public.orders_history_changed_fields(before_row, after_row);
  resolved_order record;
  order_ref text := COALESCE(NEW.order_id, OLD.order_id);
  shipment_ref text := COALESCE(NEW.shipment_id, OLD.shipment_id);
  event_name text;
  event_summary text;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND COALESCE(array_length(changed_fields, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    event_name := 'shipment.created';
    event_summary := 'تم إنشاء شحنة مرتبطة بالطلب';
  ELSIF OLD.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.shipment_status THEN
    event_name := 'shipment.status_changed';
    event_summary := 'تم تحديث حالة الشحنة';
  ELSE
    event_name := 'shipment.updated';
    event_summary := 'تم تعديل بيانات الشحنة';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
    resolved_order.order_id,
    resolved_order.order_number,
    shipment_ref, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    event_name, 'shipment', lower(TG_OP), 'shipment', 'database_trigger', event_summary,
    before_row, after_row,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'changedFields', changed_fields,
      'changes', public.orders_history_change_details(before_row, after_row),
      'orderReference', order_ref,
      'trigger', TG_NAME
    )
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;

#### Thinking

Now the full picture is clear. The history subsystem is built on jsonb: `orders_history_write(...)` takes jsonb before/after/metadata and stores them into before_data/after_data/metadata; `orders_history_change_details` produces the changes array.

To satisfy "no jsonb anywhere", the migration must:
- Change `orders_history_write` to write flat: keep event columns, and write field-level changes into `orders_history_change` rows (old/new text) instead of before_data/after_data, and known metadata keys into flat columns (already added: trigger_name, changed_fields, deleted_order_id, order_reference, activity_target/action/details...).
- The trigger functions still need to compute the row snapshot; they can do it with `row_to_json`/jsonb internally (a transient value, not a stored column). Storing into orders_history_change (field_name, old_value, new_value as text) is flat. The rule is about *fields living inside a jsonb column*; using jsonb as an in-memory computation in a plpgsql function and persisting as rows is acceptable and is what 0032 already does.

########## orders_history_write ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_write(p_order_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_order_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_shipment_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_journal_entry_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_transaction_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_activity_log_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_event_type text DEFAULT 'custom'::text, p_event_category text DEFAULT 'general'::text, p_operation text DEFAULT 'custom'::text, p_entity_type text DEFAULT 'custom'::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'database'::text, p_summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_before_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_after_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_actor_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_role text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  actor_record record;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO actor_record
  FROM public.orders_history_actor(p_actor_id, p_actor_name, p_actor_role);

  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (
    orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id,
    activity_log_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type,
    actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, source, summary,
    before_data, after_data, metadata, occurred_at, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    'oh_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || txid_current()::text), 1, 24),
    p_order_id, p_order_number, p_shipment_id,
    p_activity_log_id, p_event_type, p_event_category, p_operation, p_entity_type,
    actor_record.actor_id, actor_record.actor_name, actor_record.actor_role, COALESCE(p_source, 'database'), p_summary,
    COALESCE(p_before_data, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(p_after_data, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), now(), now()
  );
END;
$function$


########## orders_history_change_details ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_change_details(p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  WITH base_changes AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_before, '{}'::jsonb)) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_after, '{}'::jsonb)) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) <> 'data' AND before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  data_changes AS (
    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_before->'data') = 'object' THEN p_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_after->'data') = 'object' THEN p_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  combined AS (SELECT * FROM base_changes UNION ALL SELECT * FROM data_changes)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, jsonb_build_object('before', before_value, 'after', after_value) ORDER BY key), '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM combined;
$function$


########## orders_history_changed_fields ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_changed_fields(p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(key ORDER BY key), ARRAY[]::text[])
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key
    FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_before, '{}'::jsonb)) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_after, '{}'::jsonb)) AS after_row
      ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ) AS changes;
$function$


########## orders_history_resolve_order ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_resolve_order(p_reference text)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id text, order_number text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number
  FROM public.orders o
  WHERE p_reference IS NOT NULL
    AND (o.order_id = p_reference OR o.order_number = p_reference)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.order_id = p_reference THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  LIMIT 1;
$function$


########## orders_history_actor ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_actor(p_actor_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_role text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(actor_id text, actor_name text, actor_role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  resolved_actor_id text := COALESCE(p_actor_id, auth.uid()::text);
  jwt_email text := auth.jwt() ->> 'email';
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    resolved_actor_id,
    COALESCE(
      p_actor_name,
      NULLIF(u.username, ''),
      NULLIF(u.email, ''),
      jwt_email,
      'النظام'
    ),
    COALESCE(p_actor_role, NULLIF(u.role, ''), CASE WHEN resolved_actor_id IS NULL THEN 'system' ELSE NULL END)
  FROM (SELECT 1) AS seed
  LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = resolved_actor_id
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

===== record_order_payment_v2 =====
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id text, p_payment_amount numeric, p_entry jsonb, p_updated_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  order_record public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_order_data jsonb;
  v_old_paid numeric;
  v_old_remaining numeric;
  v_total numeric;
  v_new_paid numeric;
  v_new_remaining numeric;
  v_payment_status text;
  v_entry_result jsonb;
  v_party_account_id text;
BEGIN
  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_order_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف الطلب مطلوب.';
  END IF;
  IF p_payment_amount IS NULL OR p_payment_amount <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';
  END IF;
  IF p_entry IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_entry) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات سند القبض مطلوبة.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO order_record FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  v_order_data := COALESCE(order_record.data, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_old_paid := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_order_data->>'amountPaid', '')::numeric, 0);
  v_total := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'totalAmount', '')::numeric,
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'totalCostYER', '')::numeric,
    0
  );
  v_old_remaining := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'amountRemaining', '')::numeric,
    GREATEST(v_total - v_old_paid, 0)
  );

  IF p_payment_amount > (v_old_remaining + 0.01) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي للطلب. المتبقي: %, الدفعة: %',
      round(v_old_remaining, 2), round(p_payment_amount, 2);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'orderId', '') <> p_order_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مرجع الطلب في سند القبض غير مطابق.';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryTypeId', '') <> 'type_order_payment' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تحصيل الطلب يجب أن يستخدم نوع قيد دفعة الطلب.';
  END IF;

  v_party_account_id := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(btrim(v_order_data->>'orderPartyAccountId'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(v_order_data->>'customerAccountId'), '')
  );
  IF v_party_account_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب لا يحمل حسابًا ماليًا لطرف التحصيل.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_entry->'lines', '[]'::jsonb)) AS line(value)
    WHERE line.value->>'transType' = 'Credit'
      AND line.value->>'accountId' = v_party_account_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الساق الدائنة في سند القبض يجب أن تطابق حساب طرف الطلب.';
  END IF;

  IF p_updated_by_uid IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE user_id = p_updated_by_uid)
  THEN
    p_updated_by_uid := NULL;
  END IF;

  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(p_entry);

  v_new_paid := v_old_paid + p_payment_amount;
  v_new_remaining := GREATEST(v_old_remaining - p_payment_amount, 0);
  v_payment_status := CASE WHEN v_new_remaining <= 0.005 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Partial Paid' END;

  UPDATE public.orders
  SET data = v_order_data || jsonb_build_object(
    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,
    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,
    'paymentStatus', v_payment_status,
    'updatedAt', floor(extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint
  )
  WHERE order_id = p_order_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'orderId', p_order_id,
    'entryId', v_entry_result->>'id',
    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,
    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,
    'paymentStatus', v_payment_status
  );
END;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb

AS $function$ DECLARE v_actor_id text; v_payload jsonb; v_result jsonb; BEGIN v_actor_id := public.require_financial_permission('create_receipt_vouchers'); v_payload := jsonb_set(COALESCE(p_entry, '{}'::jsonb), '{createdByUid}', to_jsonb(v_actor_id), true); PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_update_history', 'on', true); v_result := public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id, p_payment_amount, v_payload, v_actor_id); PERFORM public.replace_financial_entry_payment_details(v_result->>'entryId', v_payload->'paymentDetails', v_actor_id); RETURN v_result; END; $function$


===== rewrite_account_reference_jsonb =====
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rewrite_account_reference_jsonb(source jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  pair record;
  rewritten jsonb := COALESCE(source, '{}'::jsonb);
  mapped_value text;
  key_name text;
BEGIN
  FOR pair IN SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each(rewritten)
  LOOP
    key_name := lower(pair.key);
    IF jsonb_typeof(pair.value) = 'object' THEN
      rewritten := jsonb_set(rewritten, ARRAY[pair.key], public.rewrite_account_reference_jsonb(pair.value), true);
    ELSIF jsonb_typeof(pair.value) = 'array' THEN
      rewritten := jsonb_set(
        rewritten,
        ARRAY[pair.key],
        COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object' THEN public.rewrite_account_reference_jsonb(value) ELSE value END) FROM jsonb_array_elements(pair.value)), '[]'::jsonb),
        true
      );
    ELSIF jsonb_typeof(pair.value) = 'string' THEN
      IF key_name = ANY (ARRAY['accountid', 'account_id', 'financialaccountid', 'financial_account_id', 'linkedaccountid', 'linked_account_id', 'orderpartyaccountid', 'order_party_account_id', 'debitaccountid', 'debit_account_id', 'creditaccountid', 'credit_account_id']) THEN
        SELECT new_account_id INTO mapped_value FROM public.account_id_migration_map WHERE old_account_id = trim(both '"' FROM pair.value::text) LIMIT 1;
      ELSIF key_name = ANY (ARRAY['accountcode', 'account_code', 'financialaccountcode', 'financial_account_code', 'linkedaccountcode', 'linked_account_code', 'debitaccountcode', 'debit_account_code', 'creditaccountcode', 'credit_account_code']) THEN
        SELECT new_account_id INTO mapped_value FROM public.account_id_migration_map WHERE old_account_code = trim(both '"' FROM pair.value::text) LIMIT 1;
      ELSE
        mapped_value := NULL;
      END IF;
      IF mapped_value IS NOT NULL THEN
        rewritten := jsonb_set(rewritten, ARRAY[pair.key], to_jsonb(mapped_value), true);
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN rewritten;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  target_ids text[]; target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[];
  requested_count integer; actual_count integer;
  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0;
  deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids
    FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned
   WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;
  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);
  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;

  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers
    FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids
    FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids
    FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]),
         COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[])
    INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts
    FROM public.account_trans
   WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);

  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN
    EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY($1)' USING main_entry_ids;
  END IF;
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.account_trans WHERE account_trans_id = ANY($1) OR main_entry_id = ANY($2) OR order_id = ANY($3)' USING account_trans_ids, main_entry_ids, target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY($1) OR order_id = ANY($2)' USING main_entry_ids, target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;

  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.orders_history WHERE order_id = ANY($1) OR order_number = ANY($2) OR shipment_id = ANY($3)' USING target_ids, target_numbers, shipment_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;

  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY($1)' USING shipment_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY($1)' USING target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;

  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true);
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY($1)' USING target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT;
  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);

  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts);
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'orderIds', target_ids,
    'orders', deleted_orders,

COALESCE((details->>'highValueReview')::boolean, requires_high_value_review)\n WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'\n   AND (details ? 'hazardReview' OR details ? 'highValueReview');\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 2. تفاصيل العميل: كائن الموقع والـ address يصيران أعمدة حقيقية.\n--    Customer details: the location document and the address key become columns.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALTER TABLE public.cust_details\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS latitude numeric,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS longitude numeric,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS street text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS governorate text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address_details text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address text;\n\nDO $$\nDECLARE\n  rec record;\nBEGIN\n  FOR rec IN\n    SELECT d.cust_detail_id, alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(d.location) AS loc\n      FROM public.cust_details d\n     WHERE alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(d.location) IS NOT NULL\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.cust_details\n       SET latitude        = COALESCE(latitude,  (rec.loc->>'lat')::numeric),\n           longitude       = COALESCE(longitude, (rec.loc->>'lng')::numeric),\n           street          = COALESCE(NULLIF(stress := '', ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'street', '')), '')),\n           governorate     = COALESCE(NULLIF(governorate, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'governorate', '')), '')),\n           address_details = COALESCE(NULLIF(address_details, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'addressDetails', '')), '')),\n           city            = COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'city', '')), '')),\n           country         = COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'country', '')), ''))\n     WHERE cust_detail_id = rec.cust_detail_id;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  UPDATE public.cust_details\n     SET address = COALESCE(NULLIF(address, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(data->>'address', '')), ''))\n   WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object' AND data ? 'address';\nEND\n$$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 3. مستخدمو البوابة: الحساب المالي الرابط وروابط الموظم والمصدر أعمدة حقيقية.\n--    Portal users: linked financial account, courier and source links become columns.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALTER TABLE public.portal_users\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_acc_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_courier_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_source_id text;\n\nUPDATE public.portal_users\n   SET linked_acc_id     = COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_acc_id, ''),     NULLIF(data->>'linkedAccId', '')),\n       linked_courier_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_courier_id, ''), NULLIF(data->>'linkedCourierId', '')),\n       linked_source_id  = COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_source_id, ''),  NULLIF(data->>'linkedSourceId', ''))\n WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 4. سجل الرواتب: معرّف المنشئ كان داخل data فقط.\n--    Salary history: the creator uid existed only inside the payload.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALTER TABLE public.salary_history ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by_uid text;\n\nUPDATE public.salary_history\n   SET created_by_uid = COALESCE(NULLIF(created_by_uid, ''), NULLIF(data->>'createdByUid', ''), NULLIF(created_by, ''))\n WHERE created_by_uid IS NULL;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 5. سجل الطلبات: عمود مفقود كان يتجاهله كاتِب السجل + إعادة توليد صفوف التغيير.\n--    Order history: the writer silently dropped p_account_transaction_id, so the column is added,\n--    and the change rows are regenerated (0032 ran before any history row existed).\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALTER TABLE public.orders_history\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS account_trans_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS automation_key text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_rule_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_automatic boolean;\n\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns\n     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders_history'\n       AND column_name = 'after_data' AND data_type = 'jsonb'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- تغييرات المستوى الأعلى — top-level field diffs.\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change AS ohc (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT h.orders_history_id, x.key,\n         COALESCE(h.before_data #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key]),\n         COALESCE(h.after_data  #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key])\n    FROM public.orders_history h,\n         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)\n   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'\n     AND x.key NOT IN ('data')\n  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE\n    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;\n\n  -- المفاتيح المتداخلة داخل data القديم تحفظ مسارًا منقوطًا — nested legacy \"data\" keys keep a dotted path.\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT h.orders_history_id, 'data.' || x.key,\n         h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key],\n         h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key]\n    FROM public.orders_history h,\n         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data', '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)\n   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data')) = 'object'\n   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE\n     SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;\n\n  -- metadata.changes كان خريطة jsonb — the legacy changes map also becomes change rows.\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT h.orders_history_id, c.key, c.value->'before' #>> '{}', c.value->'after' #>> '{}'\n    FROM public.orders_history h,\n         jsonb_each(h.metadata->'changes') c(key, value)\n   WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.metadata->'changes') = 'object'\n   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO NOTHING;\n\n  -- بقية مفاتيح metadata إلى أعمدة حقيقية — remaining metadata keys into first-class columns.\n  UPDATE public.orders_history\n     SET automation_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(automation_key, ''), NULLIF(metadata->>'automationKey', '')),\n         auto_rule_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(auto_rule_id, ''),   NULLIF(metadata->>'autoRuleId', '')),\n         status_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(status_id, ''),      NULLIF(metadata->>'statusId', '')),\n         is_automatic   = COALESCE(is_automatic, (metadata->>'isAutomatic')::boolean),\n         trigger_name   = COALESCE(NULLIF(trigger_name, ''),  NULLIF(metadata->>'trigger', ''))\n   WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object';\nEND\n$$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 6. كاتِب سجل الطلبات: لم يعد يلمس before_data/after_data/metadata.\n--    The history writer no longer touches the legacy jsonb columns.\n--    التوقيع不变: المحفّظات تمرّر لقطات محسوبة داخل الذاكرة، وتُكتب الآن كصفوف تغيير.\n--    Signature unchanged: triggers pass in-memory row snapshots, now persisted as change rows.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_write(\n  p_order_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_order_number text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_shipment_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_journal_entry_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_account_transaction_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_activity_log_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_event_type text DEFAULT 'custom',\n  p_event_category text DEFAULT 'general',\n  p_operation text DEFAULT 'custom',\n  p_entity_type text DEFAULT 'custom',\n  p_source text DEFAULT 'database',\n  p_summary text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_before_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n  p_after_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n  p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n  p_actor_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_actor_name text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_actor_role text DEFAULT NULL\n)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  actor_record record;\n  v_history_id text;\n  v_before jsonb := COALESCE(p_before_data, '{}'::jsonb);\n  v_after jsonb := COALESCE(p_after_data, '{}'::jsonb);\n  v_meta jsonb := COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb);\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO actor_record FROM public.orders_history_actor(p_actor_id, p_actor_name, p_actor_role);\n  v_history_id := 'oh_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || txid_current()::text), 1, 24);\n\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (\n    orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, main_entry_id, account_trans_id, activity_log_id,\n    event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, source, summary,\n    trigger_name, changed_fields, deleted_order_id, order_reference, activity_target, activity_action, activity_details,\n    automation_key, auto_rule_id, status_id, is_automatic, occurred_at, created_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_history_id, p_order_id, p_order_number, p_shipment_id, p_journal_entry_id, p_account_transaction_id, p_activity_log_id,\n    p_event_type, p_event_category, p_operation, p_entity_type,\n    actor_record.actor_id, actor_record.actor_name, actor_record.actor_role, COALESCE(p_source, 'database'), p_summary,\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'trigger', '')), ''),\n    (SELECT array_agg(btrim(y.value) ORDER BY y.ordinality)\n       FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(v_meta->'changedFields', '[]'::jsonb)) y(value, ordinality)\n      WHERE jsonb_typeof(v_meta->'changedFields') = 'array'),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'deletedOrderId', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'orderReference', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'activityTarget', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'activityAction', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'automationKey', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'autoRuleId', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'statusId', '')), ''),\n    (v_meta->>'isAutomatic')::boolean,\n    now(), now()\n  );\n\n  -- اللقطة صارت صفوف تغيير: مستوًى أعلى + المفاتيح المتداخلة داخل data القديم.\n  -- The snapshot is now change rows: top level plus nested legacy \"data\" keys.\n  WITH diffs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(b.key, a.key) AS field_name, b.value #>> '{}' AS old_value, a.value #>> '{}' AS new_value\n      FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_before) = 'object' THEN v_before ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) b\n      FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_after) = 'object' THEN v_after ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a\n        ON b.key = a.key\n     WHERE COALESCE(b.key, a.key) <> 'data' AND b.value IS DISTINCT FROM a.value\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(b.key, a.key), b.value #>> '{}', a.value #>> '{}'\n      FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_before->'data') = 'object' THEN v_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) b\n      FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_after->'data') = 'object' THEN v_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a\n        ON b.key = a.key\n     WHERE b.value IS DISTINCT FROM a.value\n  )\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT v_history_id, d.field_name, d.old_value, d.new_value FROM diffs d\n  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE\n    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;\nEND;\n$function$;\n\nCOMMENT ON FUNCTION public.orders_history_write IS\n  'Writes one order-history event plus its field-level change rows; no jsonb column is touched.';\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 7. محفّظة القيد المالي: كانت تدرج after_data/metadata مباشرة.\n--    The main-entry audit trigger inserted the legacy jsonb columns directly.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_main_entry()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id text;\n  v_order_number text;\n  v_actor record;\n  v_line_count integer;\n  v_event_type text;\n  v_summary text;\n  v_amount_original numeric;\n  v_currency_original_no integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.posting_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.posting_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  IF NEW.order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  v_order_id := NEW.order_id;\n  IF v_order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT s.order_id INTO v_order_id FROM public.shipments s WHERE s.shipment_id = NEW.shipment_id;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT o.order_number INTO v_order_number FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_id = v_order_id;\n  IF v_order_id IS NULL OR v_order_number IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_actor FROM public.orders_history_actor(COALESCE(NEW.posted_by_uid, NEW.voided_by_uid, NEW.updated_by_uid, NEW.created_by_uid));\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(amount_original) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'Debit'), 0), COALESCE(MAX(currency_original_no), 1)\n    INTO v_line_count, v_amount_original, v_currency_original_no\n    FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = NEW.main_entry_id;\n\n  v_event_type := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'financial.entry_posted'\n                       WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'financial.entry_voided'\n                       ELSE 'financial.entry_status_changed' END;\n  v_summary := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'تم ترحيل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                    WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'تم إبطال قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                    ELSE 'تم تغيير حالة قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END;\n\n  -- لقطة القيد تُحسب داخل الذاكرة وتُكتب كصفوف تغيير لا كأعمدة jsonb.\n  -- The entry snapshot stays in memory and is persisted as change rows, never as jsonb columns.\n  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(\n    p_order_id => v_order_id,\n    p_order_number => v_order_number,\n    p_shipment_id => NEW.shipment_id,\n    p_journal_entry_id => NEW.main_entry_id,\n    p_event_type => v_event_type,\n    p_event_category => 'financial',\n    p_operation => lower(NEW.posting_status),\n    p_entity_type => 'main_entry',\n    p_source => 'financial_trigger',\n    p_summary => v_summary,\n    p_after_data => jsonb_build_object(\n      'entryNumber', NEW.entry_number, 'entryCategory', NEW.entry_category, 'postingStatus', NEW.posting_status,\n      'amountOriginal', v_amount_original, 'currencyOriginalNo', v_currency_original_no,\n      'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method, 'description', NEW.description, 'effectiveAt', NEW.effective_at),\n    p_metadata => jsonb_build_object(\n      'accountTransCount', v_line_count, 'orderId', NEW.order_id, 'shipmentId', NEW.shipment_id, 'trigger', TG_NAME),\n    p_actor_id => v_actor.actor_id,\n    p_actor_name => v_actor.actor_name,\n    p_actor_role => v_actor.actor_role\n  );\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 8. محفّظة النشاط: لم تعد تقرأ activity_logs.data ولا details.\n--    The activity audit trigger no longer reads the payload columns being dropped.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_activity_logs()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n  v_action text := lower(COALESCE(v_row->>'action', ''));\n  v_log_id text := COALESCE(NEW.activity_log_id, OLD.activity_log_id);\n  order_ref text;\n  resolved_order record;\n  event_summary text;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_action = ANY (ARRAY['add_order', 'edit_order', 'edit_delivered_order', 'delete_order']) THEN\n    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\n  END IF;\n\n  -- مرجع الطلب صار صفا في جدول تفاصيل النشاط بدل مسار داخل الحمولة.\n  -- The order reference is a detail row now, not a path inside a payload.\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n           MAX(d.field_value) FILTER (WHERE d.field_name IN ('orderId', 'order_id', 'orderNumber', 'order_number')),\n           NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_row->>'target', '')), ''))\n    INTO order_ref\n    FROM public.activity_log_detail d\n   WHERE d.activity_log_id = v_log_id;\n\n  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);\n  IF resolved_order.order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\n  END IF;\n\n  event_summary := CASE v_action\n    WHEN 'add_payment' THEN 'تم تسجيل دفعة مرتبطة بالطلب'\n    WHEN 'financial_transaction' THEN 'تم تسجيل حركة مالية مرتبطة بالطلب'\n    WHEN 'account_order_charge' THEN 'تم تسجيل استحقاق مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n    WHEN 'account_payment_received' THEN 'تم تسجيل تحصيل مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n    ELSE 'تم تسجيل نشاط تشغيلي مرتبط بالطلب'\n  END;\n\n  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(\n    p_order_id => resolved_order.order_id,\n    p_order_number => resolved_order.order_number,\n    p_activity_log_id => v_log_id,\n    p_event_type => 'activity.' || COALESCE(NULLIF(v_action, ''), lower(TG_OP)),\n    p_event_category => 'activity',\n    p_operation => lower(TG_OP),\n    p_entity_type => 'activity_log',\n    p_source => 'activity_trigger',\n    p_summary => event_summary,\n    p_before_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,\n    p_after_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,\n    p_metadata => jsonb_build_object('activityAction', v_action, 'activityTarget', v_row->>'target', 'trigger', TG_NAME),\n    p_actor_id => v_row->>'user_id',\n    p_actor_name => v_row->>'user_name',\n    p_actor_role => v_row->>'user_role'\n  );\n\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 9. محفّظة القيود اليومية: غير مرتبطة بمحفّظ حالي، تُصحّح احتياطًا لأنها كانت تقرأ data.\n--    The journal audit trigger is unbound today; fixed defensively because it read payload paths.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_journal_entries()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n  order_ref text := COALESCE(v_row->>'order_id', v_row->>'order_number');\n  automation_key text := NULLIF(v_row->>'automation_key', '');\n  resolved_order record;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);\n  IF resolved_order.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM public.orders_history_write(\n      p_order_id => resolved_order.order_id,\n      p_order_number => resolved_order.order_number,\n      p_journal_entry_id => COALESCE(NEW.main_entry_id, OLD.main_entry_id),\n      p_event_type => CASE WHEN automation_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'financial.automatic_voucher' ELSE 'financial.journal_' || lower(TG_OP) END,\n      p_event_category => 'financial',\n      p_operation => lower(TG_OP),\n      p_entity_type => 'main_entry',\n      p_source => 'database_trigger',\n      p_summary => CASE WHEN automation_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'تم تنفيذ قيد طلب تلقائي'\n                        WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN 'تم إنشاء قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                        WHEN TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN 'تم تعديل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                        ELSE 'تم حذف قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END,\n      p_before_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,\n      p_after_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,\n      p_metadata => jsonb_build_object(\n        'orderReference', order_ref, 'automationKey', automation_key,\n        'autoRuleId', NULLIF(v_row->>'auto_rule_id', ''), 'statusId', NULLIF(v_row->>'status_id', ''),\n        'isAutomatic', automation_key IS NOT NULL, 'trigger', TG_NAME)\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 10. سند قبض الطلب: كان يقرأ ويكتب orders.data.\n--     The order payment receipt read and wrote orders.data. Flat orders keep their totals in\n--     their own columns, so that read always resolved to zero and every receipt failed with\n--     \"الدفعة تتجاوز المتبقي\" — the exact failure reported for the payment batch.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2(\n  p_order_id text,\n  p_payment_amount numeric,\n  p_entry jsonb,\n  p_updated_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL\n)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  order_record public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_old_paid numeric;\n  v_old_remaining numeric;\n  v_total numeric;\n  v_new_paid numeric;\n  v_new_remaining numeric;\n  v_payment_status text;\n  v_entry_result jsonb;\n  v_party_account_id text;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_order_id) = '' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف الطلب مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_payment_amount IS NULL OR p_payment_amount <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_entry IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_entry) <> 'object' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات سند القبض مطلوبة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO order_record FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- الإجماليات تُقرأ من أعمتها الرئيسية — totals come from their own columns.\n  v_total := COALESCE(order_record.total_cost_yer, order_record.products_sum, 0);\n  v_old_paid := COALESCE(order_record.amount_paid, 0);\n  v_old_remaining := COALESCE(order_record.amount_remaining, GREATEST(v_total - v_old_paid, 0));\n\n  IF p_payment_amount > (v_old_remaining + 0.01) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي للطلب. المتبقي: %, الدفعة: %',\n      round(v_old_remaining, 2), round(p_payment_amount, 2);\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'orderId', '') <> p_order_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مرجع الطلب في سند القبض غير مطابق.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryTypeId', '') <> 'type_order_payment' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تحصيل الطلب يجب أن يستخدم نوع قيد دفعة الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_party_account_id := COALESCE(\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(order_record.order_party_account_id, '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(order_record.customer_account_id, '')), ''));\n  IF v_party_account_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب لا يحمل حسابًا ماليًا لطرف التحصيل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_entry->'lines', '[]'::jsonb)) AS line(value)\n     WHERE line.value->>'transType' = 'Credit'\n       AND line.value->>'accountId' = v_party_account_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الساق الدائنة في سند القبض يجب أن تطابق حساب طرف الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_updated_by_uid IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE user_id = p_updated_by_uid)\n  THEN\n    p_updated_by_uid := NULL;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(p_entry);\n\n  v_new_paid := v_old_paid + p_payment_amount;\n  v_new_remaining := GREATEST(v_old_remaining - p_payment_amount, 0);\n  v_payment_status := CASE WHEN v_new_remaining <= 0.005 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Partial Paid' END;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n     SET amount_paid = v_new_paid,\n         amount_remaining = v_new_remaining,\n         payment_status = v_payment_status,\n         updated_at = now(),\n         updated_by = COALESCE(p_updated_by_uid, order_record.updated_by)\n   WHERE order_id = p_order_id;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'orderId', p_order_id,\n    'entryId', v_entry_result->>'id',\n    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,\n    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,\n    'paymentStatus', v_payment_status);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\nCOMMENT ON FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2 IS\n  'Atomic order receipt: reads and writes first-class order payment columns only.';\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 11. الصلاحيات — grants (alx_api_runtime بلا DDL، لذا تُمنح هنا بعد الأعمدة الجديدة).\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(text) TO alx_api_runtime;\nGRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON TABLE public.orders_history_change, public.orders_history TO alx_api_runtime;\nGRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE\n  public.activity_log_detail, public.orders_history_change TO alx_api_runtime;\n",

#### Thinking

The API's writeHistory is used for semantic events (order created with item count, updated with field list). The DB trigger also records the same events (order.created / order.updated) — so there's duplication: two history rows per update (one from trigger, one from API). Hmm, actually the trigger suppresses updates with no changed fields; the API writes a row with afterData={fields:[...]}.

Design: keep API-written events but store them flat: `changed_fields` = the list of written columns, and change rows for the meaningful values. For 'order.created' with afterData {status, items} — flat equivalent: summary already says it; store as change rows field 'status'/'items'? The cleanest flat model: writeHistory(orderId, orderNumber, actorId, eventType, operation, summary, changes: [{fieldName, oldValue, newValue}], changedFields?: string[], shipmentId?).

So:
```ts
type HistoryChange = { fieldName: string; oldValue?: string | null; newValue?: string | null };
async function writeHistory(client, input: {orderId, orderNumber, actorId, eventType, operation, summary, shipmentId?, changes?: HistoryChange[], changedFields?: string[]}) {
  const historyId = `hist_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, source, summary, changed_fields, occurred_at, created_at, created_by, updated_by)
  VALUES (...)
  then batch insert change rows.
}
```
Callers:
- 500: afterData {status, items} → changes: [{fieldName:'status', newValue: ...}, {fieldName:'itemCount', newValue: String(input.items.length)}]
- 556: afterData {fields:[...]} → changedFields: [...writes.keys()]
- others: need to look at 592, 691, 736.

Then listOrderHistory: select flat + aggregate changes into `changes: [{fieldName, oldValue, newValue}]` per row, keeping response keys. The frontend currently expects beforeData/afterData/metadata. Since I'm changing the API contract, I must update the frontend (OrderHistoryModal, orderHistoryService, orderHistoryFilters, orderLifecycleService, supabase-adapter-columns, database-schema-map). That's task #10 territory — I'll do it after.

```ts
type HistoryChange = { fieldName: string; oldValue?: unknown; newValue?: unknown };

function toText(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  return String(value);
}

// تحويل الفرق بين صفّين إلى صفوف تغيير — diff two row snapshots into change rows.
function diffRows(before: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, after: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): HistoryChange[] {
  const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];
  return keys
    .filter((key) => toText(before?.[key]) !== toText(after?.[key]))
    .map((key) => ({ fieldName: key, oldValue: before?.[key], newValue: after?.[key] }));
}
```

```ts
async function writeHistory(client, input) {
  const historyId = `hist_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  const changedFields = input.changedFields ?? input.changes?.map(c=>c.fieldName) ?? [];
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO public.orders_history
      (orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, source, summary, changed_fields, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'api', $6, 'order', $7, 'alx_api', $8, $9::text[], NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), $7, $7)`,
    [historyId, input.orderId, input.orderNumber, input.shipmentId ?? null, input.eventType, input.operation, input.actorId, input.summary, changedFields.length ? changedFields : null]);
  const changes = input.changes ?? [];
  if (changes.length === 0) return;
  const values: unknown[] = [];
  const rows = changes.map((change, index) => {
    const n = index * 4;
    values.push(historyId, change.fieldName, toText(change.oldValue), toText(change.newValue));
    return `($${n+1}, $${n+2}, $${n+3}, $${n+4})`;
  });
  await client.query(`INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value) VALUES ${rows.join(', ')} ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value`, values);
}
```

import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';

const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
type ApiRow = Record<string, unknown>;

export type OrderHistoryContext = {
  orderId?: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
  shipmentId?: string;
  entityType: 'order' | 'shipment';
  label: string;
};

export type OrderHistoryEvent = {
  id: string;
  orderId?: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
  shipmentId?: string;
  mainEntryId?: string;
  accountTransId?: string;
  activityLogId?: string;
  eventType: string;
  eventCategory: string;
  operation: string;
  entityType: string;
  actorId?: string;
  actorName?: string;
  actorRole?: string;
  source?: string;
  summary?: string;
  beforeData?: Record<string, unknown>;
  afterData?: Record<string, unknown>;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  occurredAt?: string | number;
  createdAt?: string | number;
};

const REDUNDANT_LEGACY_ACTIVITY_EVENTS = new Set([
  'activity.add_order',
  'activity.edit_order',
  'activity.edit_delivered_order',
  'activity.delete_order',
]);

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function readText(value: unknown): string | undefined {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
}

function readRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
  if (isRecord(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().startsWith('{')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
      return isRecord(parsed) ? parsed : undefined;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function readTime(value: unknown): string | number | undefined {
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') return value;
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
  return undefined;
}

function readEvent(row: ApiRow): OrderHistoryEvent {
  return {
    id: readText(row.historyId ?? row.ordersHistoryId ?? row.id) ?? '',
    orderId: readText(row.orderId ?? row.order_id),
    orderNumber: readText(row.orderNumber ?? row.order_number),
    shipmentId: readText(row.shipmentId ?? row.shipment_id),
    mainEntryId: readText(row.mainEntryId ?? row.main_entry_id),
    accountTransId: readText(row.accountTransId ?? row.account_trans_id),
    activityLogId: readText(row.activityLogId ?? row.activity_log_id),
    eventType: readText(row.eventType ?? row.event_type) ?? 'legacy.unknown',
    eventCategory: readText(row.eventCategory ?? row.event_category) ?? 'legacy',
    operation: readText(row.operation) ?? 'unknown',
    entityType: readText(row.entityType ?? row.entity_type) ?? 'unknown',
    actorId: readText(row.actorId ?? row.actor_id),
    actorName: readText(row.actorName ?? row.actor_name),
    actorRole: readText(row.actorRole ?? row.actor_role),
    source: readText(row.source),
    summary: readText(row.summary),
    beforeData: readRecord(row.beforeData ?? row.before_data),
    afterData: readRecord(row.afterData ?? row.after_data),
    metadata: readRecord(row.metadata),
    occurredAt: readTime(row.occurredAt ?? row.occurred_at),
    createdAt: readTime(row.createdAt ?? row.created_at),
  };
}

function eventTime(event: OrderHistoryEvent): number {
  const raw = event.occurredAt ?? event.createdAt;
  if (typeof raw === 'number') return raw;
  const parsed = raw ? new Date(raw).getTime() : 0;
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

function deduplicate(events: OrderHistoryEvent[]): OrderHistoryEvent[] {
  return Array.from(new Map(events.map((event) => [event.id, event])).values())
    .filter((event) => !REDUNDANT_LEGACY_ACTIVITY_EVENTS.has(event.eventType))
    .sort((left, right) => eventTime(right) - eventTime(left));
}

async function fetchHistoryRows(path: string, query?: Record<string, string | number>): Promise<ApiRow[]> {
  const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow[] | { items?: ApiRow[] }>>(path, query);
  const data = response.data;
  return Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : [];

```json
  "new_string": "// توحيد تسمية الحقول في سجل التغيير إلى camelCase مطابقةً لعُرف النظام.\n// Change-field names are normalised to camelCase to match the system naming convention.\nfunction toCamelCase(name: string): string {\n  return name.replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, character: string) => character.toUpperCase());\n}\n\n// مقارنة صفّين وتجاهل أعمدة التدقيق — compare two row snapshots, ignoring audit columns.\nfunction diffHistoryRows(\n  before: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,\n  after: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,\n  ignored: string[] = ['updatedAt', 'updatedBy', 'createdAt', 'createdBy'],\n): HistoryChange[] {\n  const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];\n  return keys\n    .filter((key) => !ignored.some((name) => toCamelCase(key) === name))\n    .map((key) => ({ fieldName: toCamelCase(key), oldValue: before?.[key], newValue: after?.[key] }))\n    .filter((change) => stringifyChangeValue(change.oldValue) !== stringifyChangeValue(change.newValue));\n}",
  "old_string": "// مقارنة صفّين وتجاهل الأعمدة النصية الطويلة — compare two row snapshots, ignoring audit columns.\nfunction diffHistoryRows(\n  before: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,\n  after: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,\n  ignored: string[] = ['updatedAt', 'updatedBy', 'createdAt', 'createdBy'],\n): HistoryChange[] {\n  const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];\n  return keys\n    .filter((key) => !ignored.includes(key))\n    .map((key) => ({ fieldName: key, oldValue: before?.[key], newValue: after?.[key] }))\n    .filter((change) => stringifyChangeValue(change.oldValue) !== stringifyChangeValue(change.newValue));\n}"
}
```

Now the profile keys used: status, trackingNumber, orderNumber, customerName, customerPhone, customerAddress, weight, cbm, shippingCompany, amountPaid, amountRemaining, totalCostYER, currency, products, history, locationYemen.

Flat columns exist for: customer_name, customer_phone, customer_address, weight, cbm, shipping_company, amount_paid, amount_remaining, total_cost_yer, currency, status, order_number, location_yemen, is_published. Missing: trackingNumber (tracking_id itself), products, history (arrays — genuinely relational data; products could come from order_items and history from orders_history). 

This is a real design decision. The public tracking page reads products/history from the profile. Flattening: those should be resolved by joins at read time (order_id → order_items; shipment/order → orders_history). Does public_tracking have order_number to link? Yes. But products belong to the order.

Simplest correct approach: expose flat scalar columns in the API; for `products` and `history`, derive from the linked order at read time (getTrackingProfile joins order_items and tracking events by order_number). Then update TrackingPage to read row-level fields instead of row.data.

Then readHistoryRows for products/history join. For getTrackingProfile, return row + products + history:

```ts
async getTrackingProfile(trackingId) {
  const result = await pool.query(`SELECT ${trackingProfileSelect}, (SELECT order_id FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_number = public_tracking.order_number LIMIT 1) AS "orderId" FROM public.public_tracking WHERE tracking_id = $1`, [trackingId]);
  const row = result.rows[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  if (!row) return null;
  const orderId = typeof row.orderId === 'string' ? row.orderId : undefined;
  const products = orderId ? (await pool.query(`SELECT ${orderItemColumns} FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, order_item_id ASC`,[orderId])).rows : [];
  const history = orderId ? await readHistoryRows(pool, 'WHERE order_id = $1', [orderId]) : [];
  const { orderId: _omit, ...profile } = row;
  return { ...profile, products, history };
}
```
