3	 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4	 * كاتب سجل النشاط الموحّد لكل وحدات الـ API (Unified activity-log writer).
5	 * One writer for every activity-log insert so no module invents its own columns:
6	 * identity is resolved from the database, summaries stay plain text, and structured
7	 * fields go to the activity_log_detail child table instead of a jsonb blob.
8	 */

10	import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
11	import type { PoolClient } from 'pg';
12	import type { ActivityLogDetailValue } from '../../modules/activity-logs/activity-logs.contracts';
13	
14	export interface ActivityAuditEvent {
15	  action: string;
16	  category?: string | undefined;
17	  target?: string | undefined;
18	  summary?: string | undefined;
19	  /** هوية الفاعل من الـ principal المصادَق عليه فقط — never taken from client input. */
20	  actorUserId?: string | null | undefined;
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * يكتب قيد النشاط ويعيد الصف المسطّح، مع اسم المستخدم ودوره من قاعدة البيانات.
25	 * Inserts the log row and returns its flat projection; user name/role are resolved
26	 * server-side from `public.users`, so a missing profile still records the event.
27	 */
28	export async function insertActivityLog(
29	  client: PoolClient,
30	  event: ActivityAuditEvent,
31	): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
32	  const activityLogId = `act_${randomUUID()}`;
33	  const result = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
34	    `INSERT INTO public.activity_logs
35	       (activity_log_id, action, category, target, type, summary,
36	        user_id, user_name, user_role, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
37	     SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, 'api', $5,
38	            source.user_id, u.full_name, u.role, NOW(), NOW(), $6, $6
39	       FROM (SELECT $6::text AS user_id) AS source
40	       LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = source.user_id
41	     ON CONFLICT (activity_log_id) DO NOTHING
42	     RETURNING activity_log_id AS "activityLogId", action, category, target, type, summary,
43	               user_id AS "userId", user_name AS "userName", user_role AS "userRole",
44	               created_at AS "createdAt"`,
45	    [
46	      activityLogId,
47	      event.action,
48	      event.category ?? null,
49	      event.target ?? null,
50	      event.summary ?? null,
51	      event.actorUserId ?? null,
52	    ],
53	  );
54	  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
55	}

57	/**
58	 * يسطّر تفاصيل الحدث حقلاً في كل سطر.
59	 * Writes one child row per detail field; nested objects are rejected by the schema upstream.
60	 */
61	export async function insertActivityLogDetails(
62	  client: PoolClient,
63	  activityLogId: string,
64	  details: Readonly<Record<string, ActivityLogDetailValue>>,
65	): Promise<void> {
66	  for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(details)) {
67	    await client.query(
68	      `INSERT INTO public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id, field_name, field_value)
69	       VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
70	       ON CONFLICT (activity_log_id, field_name) DO UPDATE SET field_value = EXCLUDED.field_value`,
71	      [activityLogId, field, value === null ? null : String(value)],
72	    );
73	  }
74	}

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_financial_entry_settings_permission(p_permission text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id text := auth.uid()::text;
  v_role text;
  v_disabled boolean;
  v_permissions jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تتطلب عملية إعدادات القيود جلسة مستخدم موثقة.';
  END IF;
  SELECT u.role, COALESCE(u.disabled, false) INTO v_role, v_disabled FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = v_actor_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_disabled THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير صالح أو معطل.';
  END IF;
  IF v_role = 'Admin' THEN
    RETURN v_actor_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT r.data->'permissions' INTO v_permissions FROM public.roles r WHERE r.role_id = v_role;
  IF COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? '*' OR COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? p_permission THEN
    RETURN v_actor_id;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا تملك صلاحية % لإدارة إعدادات القيود.', p_permission;
END;
$function$


========
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_financial_permission(p_permission text, p_fallback_uid text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE 
  v_actor_id text := auth.uid()::text; 
  v_role text; 
  v_disabled boolean; 
  v_permissions jsonb; 
BEGIN 
  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN 
    IF p_fallback_uid IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p_fallback_uid) <> '' THEN
      SELECT u.user_id INTO v_actor_id FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = p_fallback_uid AND NOT COALESCE(u.disabled, false);
    END IF;

    IF v_actor_id IS NULL THEN
      SELECT u.user_id INTO v_actor_id FROM public.users u WHERE NOT COALESCE(u.disabled, false) ORDER BY (role = 'Admin') DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 1;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN 
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تتطلب العملية المالية جلسة مستخدم موثقة.'; 
  END IF;

  SELECT u.role, COALESCE(u.disabled, false) INTO v_role, v_disabled FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = v_actor_id; 
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_disabled THEN 
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير صالح أو معطل.'; 
  END IF; 

  IF v_role = 'Admin' THEN 
    RETURN v_actor_id; 
  END IF; 

  SELECT r.data->'permissions' INTO v_permissions FROM public.roles r WHERE r.role_id = v_role; 
  IF COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? '*' OR COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? p_permission THEN 
    RETURN v_actor_id; 
  END IF; 

  RETURN v_actor_id;
END; 
$function$

async function inTransaction<T>(pool: Pool, operation: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const result = await operation(client);
    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

464	-- 10. سند قبض الطلب: كان يقرأ ويكتب orders.data.
465	--     The order payment receipt read and wrote orders.data. Flat orders keep their totals in
466	--     their own columns, so that read always resolved to zero and every receipt failed with
467	--     "الدفعة تتجاوز المتبقي" — the exact failure reported for the payment batch.
468	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
469	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2(
470	  p_order_id text,
471	  p_payment_amount numeric,
472	  p_entry jsonb,
473	  p_updated_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL
474	)
475	 RETURNS jsonb
476	 LANGUAGE plpgsql
477	 SECURITY DEFINER
478	 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
479	AS $function$
480	DECLARE
481	  order_record public.orders%ROWTYPE;
482	  v_old_paid numeric;
483	  v_old_remaining numeric;
484	  v_total numeric;
485	  v_new_paid numeric;
486	  v_new_remaining numeric;
487	  v_payment_status text;
488	  v_entry_result jsonb;
489	  v_party_account_id text;
490	BEGIN
491	  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_order_id) = '' THEN
492	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف الطلب مطلوب.';
493	  END IF;
494	  IF p_payment_amount IS NULL OR p_payment_amount <= 0 THEN
495	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';
496	  END IF;
497	  IF p_entry IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_entry) <> 'object' THEN
498	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات سند القبض مطلوبة.';
499	  END IF;
500	
501	  SELECT * INTO order_record FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
502	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
503	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب غير موجود.';
504	  END IF;
505	
506	  -- الإجماليات تُقرأ من أعمتها الرئيسية — totals come from their own columns.
507	  v_total := COALESCE(order_record.total_cost_yer, order_record.products_sum, 0);
508	  v_old_paid := COALESCE(order_record.amount_paid, 0);
509	  v_old_remaining := COALESCE(order_record.amount_remaining, GREATEST(v_total - v_old_paid, 0));
510	
511	  IF p_payment_amount > (v_old_remaining + 0.01) THEN
512	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي للطلب. المتبقي: %, الدفعة: %',
513	      round(v_old_remaining, 2), round(p_payment_amount, 2);
514	  END IF;
515	
516	  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'orderId', '') <> p_order_id THEN
517	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مرجع الطلب في سند القبض غير مطابق.';
518	  END IF;
519	
520	  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryTypeId', '') <> 'type_order_payment' THEN
521	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تحصيل الطلب يجب أن يستخدم نوع قيد دفعة الطلب.';
522	  END IF;
523	
524	  v_party_account_id := COALESCE(
525	    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(order_record.order_party_account_id, '')), ''),
526	    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(order_record.customer_account_id, '')), ''));
527	  IF v_party_account_id IS NULL THEN
528	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب لا يحمل حسابًا ماليًا لطرف التحصيل.';
529	  END IF;
530	
531	  IF NOT EXISTS (
532	    SELECT 1
533	      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_entry->'lines', '[]'::jsonb)) AS line(value)
534	     WHERE line.value->>'transType' = 'Credit'
535	       AND line.value->>'accountId' = v_party_account_id
536	  ) THEN
537	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الساق الدائنة في سند القبض يجب أن تطابق حساب طرف الطلب.';
538	  END IF;

Now generalize into a shared test helper that scans all repository source files statically (a lint-style guard) rather than per-mock call. A repo-wide static guard is stronger and cheaper: read every `*.repository.ts` under src/modules, assert no payload-column SQL patterns, with an explicit allowlist for legitimate jsonb (idempotency cache, RPC parameters, auth_events.metadata).

Let me create `alx_api/tests/unit/db/no-legacy-payload-columns.test.ts` that walks src/modules/**/*.ts + src/core/**/*.ts and asserts:
- no `->>` / `->` / `#>` / `#>>` on the legacy column names: `data`, `details`, `metadata`, `permissions`, `replies`, `before_data`, `after_data`, `body_details`, `preferred_categories`, `location`, `exchange_rates`, `filters`, `associated_user_ids`.
- no `INSERT INTO <table> (... data ...)`.
- no `::jsonb` except in an allowlist of file+line markers.

Simpler and robust: regex for jsonb operators `->>`, `->`, `#>`, `#>>`, `jsonb_`, `to_jsonb`, `::jsonb` and allow a curated allowlist of files (idempotency + RPC entry payloads). Since those legitimately use `jsonb` for RPC parameters (create_financial_entry_v2 takes a jsonb entry document — that's an API contract, not a stored column).

The guard's purpose: forbid payload *column* access. So pattern: `/(?:\b\w+\.)?(?:data|details|metadata|permissions|replies|before_data|after_data|exchange_rates|filters|associated_user_ids|body_details|preferred_categories)\s*(->>|->|#>>|#>)/` and `(INSERT INTO\s+\w+\.\w+[^)]*\bdata\b)` is harder. Also `jsonb_set(`/`jsonb_object_agg(` and `data ||`.

Let me write a focused guard:
1. No jsonb path operators anywhere in repository/route/service source files under alx_api/src (except *.sql). 
2. No `::jsonb` casts in a column position — approximate by forbidding `\bdata\s*=\s*\$` and `\bdata\s*=\s*EXCLUDED` and `jsonb_set(`.
3. No `SELECT ... FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id` etc.? Too specific.

Given RPCs legitimately pass `$n::jsonb` (entry documents), a blanket `::jsonb` ban fails. So ban:
- `->>`, `->`, `#>`, `#>>`, `jsonb_set(`, `jsonb_object_agg(`, `to_jsonb(`, `jsonb_build_object(` — hmm jsonb_build_object is used in DB triggers not TS. In TS it may appear in RPC payloads? Possibly. Let me test which files currently violate; then decide the allowlist.

58	/** يبني عبارات SET من المفاتيح المُرسلة فقط؛ ما لم يُرسل يبقى مخزَّنًا كما هو.
59	 *  Builds SET clauses only from submitted keys; anything absent in the payload keeps its stored value. */
60	function buildColumnUpdates(map: Record<string, string>, doc: SettingsDoc): { clauses: string[]; values: SqlValue[] } {
61	  const clauses: string[] = [];
62	  const values: SqlValue[] = [];
63	  for (const [key, column] of Object.entries(map)) {
64	    if (!(key in doc) || doc[key] === undefined) continue;
65	    const raw = doc[key];
66	    if (raw !== null && typeof raw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw)) continue;
67	    values.push(raw === null || typeof raw === 'object' ? null : (raw as SqlValue));
68	    clauses.push(`${column} = $${values.length}`);
69	  }
70	  return { clauses, values };
71	}

75	function flattenSettingsDoc(doc: SettingsDoc): SettingsDoc {
76	  const merged: SettingsDoc = { ...doc };
77	  const config = merged.config;
78	  if (config && typeof config === 'object' && !Array.isArray(config)) {
79	    delete merged.config;
80	    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(config as SettingsDoc)) merged[`config.${key}`] = value;
81	  }
82	  for (const key of ['templates', 'triggers']) {
83	    const container = merged[key];
84	    if (container && typeof container === 'object' && !Array.isArray(container)) delete merged[key];
85	  }
86	  return merged;
87	}

514	/** يفكّ وصف الحساب المخزَّن نصيًا إلى كائن؛ أي قيمة غير قابلة للتحويل تبقى كما هي.
515	 *  Parses the text-stored account descriptor into an object; anything unparsable is left untouched. */
516	function parseAccountDescriptor(value: unknown): unknown {
517	  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim() === '') return value ?? null;
518	  try {
519	    return JSON.parse(value) as unknown;
520	  } catch {
521	    return value;
522	  }
523	}
524	
525	/** يعكس parseAccountDescriptor: الكتابة على العمود النصي تتطلب نصًا مستقرًا.
526	 *  Inverse of parseAccountDescriptor: the text column needs stable text. */
527	function stringifyAccountDescriptor(value: unknown): string | null {
528	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
529	  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
530	  return JSON.stringify(value);
531	}

13	export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {

18	  app.get('/api/v1/settings/brand', async (_request, response, next) => {
19	    try {

25	      }

31	  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
32	  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {

50	    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
51	    catch (error) { return next(error); }

'array' : typeof value;\n        const entry = keys.get(key) || { count: 0, kinds: new Set() };\n        entry.count += 1;\n        entry.kinds.add(kind);\n        keys.set(key, entry);\n      }\n    }\n    const cols = byTable.get(table) || new Set();\n    const mapped = [];\n    const unmapped = [];\n    for (const [key, info] of [...keys].sort((a, b) => b[1].count - a[1].count)) {\n      const snake = camelToSnake(key);\n      const candidate = [snake, snake.replace(/^is_/, ''), `is_${snake.replace(/^is_/, '')}`, snake + '_text']\n        .find((name) => cols.has(name));\n      if (candidate) mapped.push(`${key}->${candidate}[${[...info.kinds].join('/')}:${info.count}]`);\n      else unmapped.push(`${key}[${[...info.kinds].join('/')}:${info.count}]`);\n    }\n    console.log(`\\n### ${table}.${column}`);\n    console.log(`  MAPPED:   ${mapped.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);\n    console.log(`  UNMAPPED: ${unmapped.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);\n  }\n  await pool.end();\n})().catch((e) => { console.error('ERR', e.message); process.exit(1); });\n",
```json
  "file_path": "F:\\system\\swiftship-tracker\\swiftshift2\\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\\alx_api\\probe_tmp.cjs"
}
```

-- 0038_close_flattening_gaps.sql
-- يُغلق فجوات اكتشفها التدقيق وتجب معالجتها قبل إسقاط آخر أعمدة jsonb في 0034.
-- Closes audit-found gaps that must be fixed before the final jsonb drop (0034).
--
-- 1) حقول لم يكن لها عمود رئيسي أصلاً: مجموعة الفئة، موقع العميل، حساب البوابة الرابط، منشئ الراتب.
--    Fields with no first-class column at all: category group, customer location, portal account link, salary creator.
-- 2) دوال قاعدة البيانات التي تقرأ/تكتب أعمدة jsonb: كتابة سجل الطلبات، محفّظات القيد والنشاط واليومية، سند قبض الطلب.
--    Database functions reading/writing jsonb columns: history writer, main-entry/activity/journal audit triggers, order receipt.
-- 3) إعادة توليد orders_history_change: الترحيل 0032 نُفّذ وصفّ سجل الطلبات كان فارغًا، فبقي جدول التغييرات بلا صفوف.
--    Regenerates orders_history_change: 0032 ran while orders_history was still empty, so the child table got nothing.
--
-- ترتيب التنفيذ: بعد 0032 وقبل 0034 — لا يحذف هذا الملف أي عمود.
-- Ordering: after 0032 and before 0034 — this migration drops nothing.

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 0. تحويل نص إلى jsonb بلا فشل — tolerant text→jsonb cast (cust_details.location stores JSON as text).
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(p_value text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_value IS NULL OR btrim(p_value) = '' THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN p_value::jsonb;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN others THEN
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.items_category ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category_group text;

UPDATE public.items_category
   SET category_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(category_group, ''), NULLIF(btrim(details->>'group'), ''))
 WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object';

-- المفتاحان hazardReview/highValueReview لم يُنقلا إلى أعمدتهما الحقيقية سابقًا.
-- hazardReview/highValueReview were never copied into their first-class columns.
UPDATE public.items_category
   SET requires_hazard_review = CASE WHEN details->>'hazardReview' IN ('true','false')
                                     THEN (details->>'hazardReview')::boolean ELSE requires_hazard_review END,
       requires_high_value_review = CASE WHEN details->>'highValueReview' IN ('true','false')
                                         THEN (details->>'highValueReview')::boolean ELSE requires_high_value_review END
 WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'
   AND (details ? 'hazardReview' OR details ? 'highValueReview');

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. تفاصيل العميل: كائن الموقع والـ address يصيران أعمدة حقيقية.
--    Customer details: the location document and the address key become columns.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.cust_details
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS latitude numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS longitude numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS street text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS governorate text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address_details text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address text;

DO $$
DECLARE
  rec record;
BEGIN
  FOR rec IN
    SELECT d.cust_detail_id, alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(d.location) AS loc
      FROM public.cust_details d
     WHERE alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(d.location) IS NOT NULL
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.cust_details
       SET latitude        = COALESCE(latitude,
            CASE WHEN rec.loc->>'lat' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (rec.loc->>'lat')::numeric END),
           longitude       = COALESCE(longitude,
            CASE WHEN rec.loc->>'lng' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (rec.loc->>'lng')::numeric END),
           street          = COALESCE(NULLIF(street, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'street', '')), '')),
           governorate     = COALESCE(NULLIF(governorate, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'governorate', '')), '')),
           address_details = COALESCE(NULLIF(address_details, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'addressDetails', '')), '')),
           city            = COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'city', '')), '')),
           country         = COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'country', '')), ''))
     WHERE cust_detail_id = rec.cust_detail_id;
  END LOOP;

  UPDATE public.cust_details
     SET address = COALESCE(NULLIF(address, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(data->>'address', '')), ''))
   WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object' AND data ? 'address';
END
$$;

UPDATE public.portal_users

  -- تغييرات المستوى الأعلى — top-level field diffs.
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
  SELECT h.orders_history_id, x.key,
         COALESCE(h.before_data #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key]),
         COALESCE(h.after_data  #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key])
    FROM public.orders_history h,
         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
     AND x.key NOT IN ('data')
  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE
    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;

  -- المفاتيح المتداخلة داخل data القديم تحفظ مسارًا منقوطًا — nested legacy "data" keys keep a dotted path.
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
  SELECT h.orders_history_id, 'data.' || x.key,
         h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key],
         h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key]
    FROM public.orders_history h,
         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data', '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data')) = 'object'
   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE
     SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;

  -- metadata.changes كان خريطة jsonb — the legacy changes map also becomes change rows.
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
  SELECT h.orders_history_id, c.key, c.value->'before' #>> '{}', c.value->'after' #>> '{}'
    FROM public.orders_history h,
         jsonb_each(h.metadata->'changes') c(key, value)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.metadata->'changes') = 'object'
   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO NOTHING;

  -- بقية مفاتيح metadata إلى أعمدة حقيقية — remaining metadata keys into first-class columns.
  UPDATE public.orders_history
     SET automation_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(automation_key, ''), NULLIF(metadata->>'automationKey', '')),

   WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object';
END

===== create_smart_json_view
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_smart_json_view(source_table text, view_name text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    col_list TEXT;
    sql_query TEXT;
BEGIN

    sql_query := format($q$

    SELECT string_agg(col_expr, ',' ORDER BY key)
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (key)
            key,

            CASE
                WHEN value_type='number'
                    THEN '(data->>'''||key||''')::numeric AS "'||key||'"'

                WHEN value_type='boolean'
                    THEN '(data->>'''||key||''')::boolean AS "'||key||'"'

                ELSE
                    'data->>'''||key||''' AS "'||key||'"'
            END AS col_expr

        FROM (
            SELECT
                k.key,
                jsonb_typeof(data->k.key) AS value_type
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    data,
                    jsonb_object_keys(data) AS key
                FROM %I
            ) k
        ) x

        ORDER BY key
    ) t

    $q$, source_table);

    EXECUTE sql_query INTO col_list;

    sql_query := format(
    '
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW %I AS
    SELECT
        id,
        %s
    FROM %I
    ',
    view_name,
    col_list,
    source_table
    );

    EXECUTE sql_query;

END;
$function$


===== delete_financial_entry_draft
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_financial_entry_draft(p_entry_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  entry_record public.main_entry%ROWTYPE;
  affected_accounts text[];
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO entry_record FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'القيد غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  -- جمع الحسابات المتأثرة
  -- Collect affected accounts for balance recalculation
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT account_id) INTO affected_accounts
  FROM public.account_trans
  WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;

  -- حذف تفاصيل الدفع وأسطر القيد
  -- Delete payment details and transaction lines
  DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;
  DELETE FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;
  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;

  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(unnest(affected_accounts));
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', p_entry_id, 'deleted', true);
END;
$function$


===== orders_history_change_details
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_change_details(p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  WITH base_changes AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_before, '{}'::jsonb)) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_after, '{}'::jsonb)) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) <> 'data' AND before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  data_changes AS (
    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_before->'data') = 'object' THEN p_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_after->'data') = 'object' THEN p_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  combined AS (SELECT * FROM base_changes UNION ALL SELECT * FROM data_changes)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, jsonb_build_object('before', before_value, 'after', after_value) ORDER BY key), '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM combined;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_order_party()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE party_id text; party_type text; account_value text; BEGIN party_type := COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_type, ''), 'customer'); party_id := CASE party_type WHEN 'employee' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_id, ''), NULLIF(NEW.employee_id, '')) WHEN 'courier' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_id, ''), NULLIF(NEW.courier_id, '')) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_id, ''), NULLIF(NEW.customer_id, '')) END; IF party_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'An order party is required.'; END IF; IF party_type = 'customer' THEN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE customer_id::text = party_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order customer party % does not exist.', party_id; END IF; NEW.customer_id := party_id; NEW.employee_id := NULL; NEW.courier_id := NULL; SELECT account_id INTO account_value FROM public.customers WHERE customer_id::text = party_id; ELSIF party_type = 'employee' THEN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.employees WHERE employee_id::text = party_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order employee party % does not exist.', party_id; END IF; NEW.customer_id := NULL; NEW.employee_id := party_id; NEW.courier_id := NULL; SELECT account_id INTO account_value FROM public.employees WHERE employee_id::text = party_id; ELSIF party_type = 'courier' THEN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.couriers WHERE courier_id::text = party_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order courier party % does not exist.', party_id; END IF; NEW.customer_id := NULL; NEW.employee_id := NULL; NEW.courier_id := party_id; SELECT account_id INTO account_value FROM public.couriers WHERE courier_id::text = party_id; ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported order party type %.', party_type; END IF; IF account_value IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'The % order party % has no linked financial account.', party_type, party_id; END IF; NEW.order_party_id := party_id; NEW.order_party_type := party_type; NEW.is_staff_order := party_type <> 'customer'; NEW.order_party_account_id := account_value; NEW.data := COALESCE(NEW.data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('orderPartyId', party_id, 'orderPartyType', party_type, 'isStaffOrder', party_type <> 'customer', 'customerId', COALESCE(NEW.customer_id, ''), 'employeeId', COALESCE(NEW.employee_id, ''), 'courierId', COALESCE(NEW.courier_id, ''), 'customerAccountId', account_value, 'orderPartyAccountId', account_value); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

#### Thinking

The adapter writes `data` for any table except "explicit financial columns" tables. To be safe after the drop, the adapter should never write a `data` column. Key design: `extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean)` maps known camel→snake columns; `data` holds the remainder. If we stop writing data, remainder fields are lost unless they have columns — which is exactly the invariant we've enforced (all fields are columns now).

Minimal, safe change set for the adapter:
1. Write payloads: drop `, data` from inserts/updates (line 627, 675, 716/717, 808/809) — always use direct columns.
2. Read path `extractRowPayload`: currently parses `row.data` and merges. After the drop, `row.data` is undefined → returns `{}` merged with top columns. If it does `const {data: _, ...topCols} = row` and merges rawData + topCols, then reads still work from flat columns (row now has flat columns). Need to read the mapper to confirm it prefers flat columns.

But careful: extractDirectColumns only maps keys present in DIRECT_COLUMNS_MAP; fields not mapped and not real columns would now be dropped entirely on write. Actually — better idea to prevent silent loss without inventing columns: make the adapter log a warning listing unmapped keys dropped on write? Adds noise. Hmm. #### Thinking

The adapter map is thin for many tables (orders map lacks dozens of real columns like customer_name, total_cost_yer etc. — those lived in `data`). If I remove `data` writes without extending maps, the UI's direct-DB writes would silently drop most order fields. That's a big deal.

Critical question: does the live UI write orders through the adapter or through the API? The API createOrder/updateOrder exists (operations.repository) and OrdersPage likely uses ordersApiDataGateway. The adapter path is legacy (used by useOrderData? Agent said useOrderData only handles `record.data` from API envelopes).

Decision: rather than rewriting the adapter's write path wholesale (risk of silent data loss for tables whose maps are incomplete), the safer, honest step is:
- Keep `extractRowPayload` reading `row.data` defensively (it's already a no-op when the column is gone).
- For writes: adding `data` to a payload for a table whose column no longer exists → PostgREST error → the adapter throws createWriteError → UI breaks. So writes MUST stop sending `data`, otherwise legacy write paths fail hard.

So: extend EXPLICIT_FINANCIAL_TABLES (rename concept) to cover ALL tables — i.e., the adapter never writes `data` — and accept that fields not in DIRECT_COLUMNS_MAP are not persisted by the legacy path. 27	export function historyEventDate(event: OrderHistoryEvent): Date | null {
28	  const value = event.occurredAt ?? event.createdAt;

41	  try {
42	    return JSON.stringify(value).toLocaleLowerCase();
43	  } catch {
44	    return String(value).toLocaleLowerCase();
45	  }
46	}

48	function matchesTimeRange(eventDate: Date, timeRange: HistoryTimeRange, now: Date): boolean {
49	  if (timeRange === 'all') return true;
50	  const timestamp = eventDate.getTime();
51	  if (timeRange === 'today') {
52	    const start = new Date(now);
53	    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
54	    return timestamp >= start.getTime() && timestamp <= now.getTime();
55	  }
56	
57	  const durationMs = timeRange === 'last_24_hours'
58	    ? 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
59	    : timeRange === 'last_7_days'
60	      ? 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
61	      : 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
62	  return timestamp >= now.getTime() - durationMs && timestamp <= now.getTime();
63	}
64	
65	function matchesDateAndTime(eventDate: Date, filters: OrderHistoryFilters): boolean {
66	  if (filters.dateFrom) {
67	    const from = new Date(`${filters.dateFrom}T00:00:00`);
68	    if (eventDate.getTime() < from.getTime()) return false;
69	  }
70	
71	  if (filters.dateTo) {
72	    const to = new Date(`${filters.dateTo}T23:59:59.999`);
73	    if (eventDate.getTime() > to.getTime()) return false;
74	  }
75	
76	  if (!filters.timeFrom && !filters.timeTo) return true;
77	  const minute = eventDate.getHours() * 60 + eventDate.getMinutes();
78	  const toMinute = (value: string) => {
79	    const [hours, minutes] = value.split(':').map(Number);
80	    return Number.isFinite(hours) && Number.isFinite(minutes) ? hours * 60 + minutes : null;
81	  };
82	  const from = filters.timeFrom ? toMinute(filters.timeFrom) : null;
83	  const to = filters.timeTo ? toMinute(filters.timeTo) : null;
84	
85	  if (from !== null && to !== null) {
86	    return from <= to ? minute >= from && minute <= to : minute >= from || minute <= to;
87	  }
88	  if (from !== null) return minute >= from;
89	  return to === null || minute <= to;
90	}

118	export function filterOrderHistoryEvents(
119	  events: OrderHistoryEvent[],
120	  filters: OrderHistoryFilters,
121	  now = new Date(),
122	): OrderHistoryEvent[] {
123	  return events.filter((event) => {
124	    if (filters.eventType && event.eventType !== filters.eventType) return false;
125	    if (filters.actorKey && historyActorKey(event) !== filters.actorKey) return false;
126	    if (!matchesSearch(event, filters.query)) return false;
127

129	    const needsDate = filters.timeRange !== 'all' || Boolean(filters.dateFrom || filters.dateTo || filters.timeFrom || filters.timeTo);
130	    if (needsDate && !eventDate) return false;
131	    if (!eventDate) return true;
132	
133	    return matchesTimeRange(eventDate, filters.timeRange, now) && matchesDateAndTime(eventDate, filters);
134	  });
135	}

4	export type StatusTransitionPlan = {
5	  allowed: boolean;
6	  reason?: 'same_status' | 'backward_transition' | 'status_previously_processed' | 'unknown_status';
7	  stagesToProcess: OrderStatusItem[];
8	  skippedStages: OrderStatusItem[];
9	};
10	
11	function statusIdFromEvent(event: OrderHistoryEvent): number | null {
12	  if (event.eventType !== 'order.status_changed' && event.eventType !== 'order.created') return null;
13	  const after = event.afterData ?? {};
14	  const raw = after.order_status_id ?? after.orderStatusId ?? after.orderStatus;
15	  const id = Number(raw);
16	  return Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
17	}
18	
19	export function getProcessedStatusIds(events: OrderHistoryEvent[]): Set<number> {
20	  return new Set(events.map(statusIdFromEvent).filter((id): id is number => id !== null));
21	}
22	
23	export function planOrderStatusTransition(
24	  statuses: OrderStatusItem[],
25	  currentStatusId: number,
26	  targetStatusId: number,
27	  processedStatusIds: Set<number>,
28	): StatusTransitionPlan {
29	  const ordered = [...statuses]
30	    .filter((status) => status.code !== 'cancelled')
31	    .sort((left, right) => (left.sortOrder ?? left.id) - (right.sortOrder ?? right.id));
32	  const target = statuses.find((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);
33	  const currentIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === currentStatusId);
34	  const targetIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);
35	
36	  if (!target || currentIndex < 0 || (target.code !== 'cancelled' && targetIndex < 0)) {
37	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'unknown_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
38	  }
39	
40	  if (target.code === 'cancelled') {
41	    return { allowed: true, stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
42	  }
43	  if (targetStatusId === currentStatusId) {
44	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'same_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
45	  }
46	  if (targetIndex < currentIndex) {
47	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'backward_transition', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
48	  }
49	  if (processedStatusIds.has(targetStatusId)) {
50	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'status_previously_processed', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
51	  }
52	
53	  const stagesToProcess = ordered.slice(currentIndex + 1, targetIndex + 1);
54	  return {
55	    allowed: true,
56	    stagesToProcess,
57	    skippedStages: stagesToProcess.slice(0, -1),
58	  };
59	}

184	  function readRecord(value: unknown): ApiRow {
185	    if (typeof value === 'string') {
186	      try {
187	        const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
188	        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed as ApiRow : {};
189	      } catch {
190	        return {};
191	      }
192	    }
193	    return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as ApiRow : {};
194	  }

196	  // Staff fallback: resolve published tracking profiles and internal orders through alx_api.
197	  const lookupInternalViaApi = async (queryStr: string): Promise<boolean> => {
198	    const publicId = queryStr.toUpperCase();
199	    try {
200	      const envelope = await client.get<{ success: true; data: ApiRow }>(profilePath(publicId));
201	      const row = envelope.data;
202	      const profile = readRecord(row.data);
203	      const status = readText(row.status) || readText(profile.status) || 'تم تسجيل الطلب';
204	      setTrackingData({
205	        id: readText(row.trackingId) || publicId,
206	        trackingNumber: readText(profile.trackingNumber) || publicId,
207	        orderNumber: readText(profile.orderNumber) || readText(row.orderNumber),
208	        status,
209	        customerName: readText(profile.customerName),
210	        customerPhone: readText(profile.customerPhone),
211	        customerAddress: readText(profile.customerAddress) || 'صنعاء، اليمن',
212	        weight: readNumber(profile.weight),
213	        cbm: readNumber(profile.cbm),
214	        shippingCompany: readText(profile.shippingCompany),
215	        amountPaid: readNumber(profile.amountPaid),
216	        amountRemaining: readNumber(profile.amountRemaining),
217	        totalCostYER: readNumber(profile.totalCostYER),
218	        currency: readText(profile.currency) || 'YER',
219	        products: readArray(profile.products),
220	        history: readArray(profile.history),
221	      });
222	      setResolvedSource('public');
223	      setGpsLocation(readText(row.locationYemen) || readText(profile.locationYemen) || 'مستودع الفرز والتبريد');
224	      setStatusSelector(status);
225	      return true;
226	    } catch (error) {
227	      if (!isNotFound(error)) console.error('[TrackingPage] tracking profile lookup failed:', error);
228	    }
229	
230	    try {
231	      const envelope = await client.get<{ success: true; data: ApiRow[] | { items?: ApiRow[] } }>('/api/v1/orders', { limit: 20, offset: 0, search: queryStr });
232	      const rows = Array.isArray(envelope.data) ? envelope.data : Array.isArray(envelope.data?.items) ? envelope.data.items : [];
233	      const match =
234	        rows.find((row) => readText(row.trackingNumber).toUpperCase() === publicId) ??
235	        rows.find((row) => readText(row.orderNumber).toUpperCase() === publicId);
236	      if (!match) return false;
237	      const detail = await client.get<{ success: true; data: ApiRow }>(`/api/v1/orders/${encodeURIComponent(readText(match.orderId))}`);
238	      const order = readRecord(detail.data.data);
239	      const status = readText(detail.data.orderStatus) || readText(order.orderStatus) || 'تم تسجيل الطلب';
240	      setTrackingData({
241	        id: readText(detail.data.orderId),
242	        trackingNumber: readText(detail.data.trackingNumber) || readText(detail.data.orderNumber) || publicId,
243	        orderNumber: readText(detail.data.orderNumber),
244	        status,
245	        customerName: readText(order.customerName),
246	        customerPhone: readText(order.customerPhone),
247	        customerAddress: readText(order.customerAddress) || readText(order.destination) || 'صنعاء، اليمن',
248	        weight: readNumber(order.totalWeight),
249	        cbm: readNumber(order.totalCBM),
250	        shippingCompany: readText(order.shippingCompany),
251	        amountPaid: readNumber(order.amountPaid),
252	        amountRemaining: readNumber(order.amountRemaining),
253	        totalCostYER: readNumber(order.totalCostYER),
254	        currency: readText(order.currency) || readText(detail.data.currency) || 'YER',
255	        products: readArray(order.items),
256	        history: readArray(order.history),
257	      });
258	      setResolvedSource('orders_db');
259	      setGpsLocation(readText(order.locationYemen) || 'مستودع الفرز والتبريد');
260	      setStatusSelector(status);
261	      return true;
262	    } catch (error) {

265	    }

359	      console.error(err);

362	    }

338	// حقل واحد تغيّر بين لقطتين — a single field diff stored as its own row.
339	type HistoryChange = { fieldName: string; oldValue?: unknown; newValue?: unknown };
340	
341	function stringifyChangeValue(value: unknown): string | null {
342	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
343	  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
344	  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
345	  return String(value);
346	}
347	
348	// توحيد تسمية الحقول في سجل التغيير إلى camelCase مطابقةً لعُرف النظام.
349	// Change-field names are normalised to camelCase to match the system naming convention.
350	function toCamelCase(name: string): string {
351	  return name.replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, character: string) => character.toUpperCase());
352	}
353	
354	// مقارنة صفّين وتجاهل أعمدة التدقيق — compare two row snapshots, ignoring audit columns.
355	function diffHistoryRows(
356	  before: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
357	  after: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
358	  ignored: string[] = ['updatedAt', 'updatedBy', 'createdAt', 'createdBy', 'data'],
359	): HistoryChange[] {
360	  const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];
361	  return keys
362	    .filter((key) => !ignored.some((name) => toCamelCase(key) === name))
363	    .map((key) => ({ fieldName: toCamelCase(key), oldValue: before?.[key], newValue: after?.[key] }))
364	    .filter((change) => stringifyChangeValue(change.oldValue) !== stringifyChangeValue(change.newValue));
365	}

Good. Now let me check what the route handler returns for tracking profile and order detail (`/api/v1/orders/:id`) so we know exact field names. The TrackingPage uses `detail.data.data` — i.e. response envelope `data` field which contains the order object with a `data` key. Let's check what orderListColumns gives: orderStatus, customerName, totalWeight, totalCBM, currency, destination, trackingNumber, etc. Let's grep orderListColumns.

Also check order history route (orders/:id/history) to confirm response shape — `changedFields` (text[] -> array) and `changes` array. Also check tracking route: the GET tracking-profiles/:id returns `{...profile, products, history}` where profile has flat camelCase keys directly at `data`. So TrackingPage should read flat fields off `row` (envelope.data) itself.

Note: trackingProfileSelect doesn't return `trackingNumber`; trackingId is the tracking number essentially. In the page `trackingData.trackingNumber` used everywhere; we can set trackingNumber = readText(row.trackingId) || publicId.

Also `history` from readHistoryRows returns order history events (flat, with changes) — but the TrackingPage timeline UI expects history entries with `status`, `timestamp`, `location`, `notes`, `coordinates`. Hmm. That's the public_tracking_event table shape... but the API returns `history` from readHistoryRows (orders_history events). Wait — getTrackingProfile: `const history = linkedOrderId ? await readHistoryRows(...) : []`. So history entries are orders_history events with eventType, summary, occurredAt, changes... Not status/location/notes.

Hmm, but the current page already reads `profile.history` from `row.data`. Now with the API, history comes as orders_history rows. The UI renders event.status, event.location, event.notes, event.timestamp. For robustness I should map history entries into the timeline shape: status from summary or from changes field 'status' newValue, timestamp from occurredAt/createdAt, location ... there's no location field in orders_history flat columns. #### Thinking

The PUT body accepts only flat fields (unknown keys are stripped by zod default .strip). So `history`/`products` in a write body are ignored. The frontend write should send flat keys only (no `data` object). The history write from the tracking page: `handlePushLogEvent` patches with status/locationYemen + history inside data. Since the API cannot store history (public_tracking_event isn't wired), sending flat `status`/`locationYemen` is right; the history can no longer be persisted through the profile write. I'll keep it local-only for the UI, and comment bilingually that the log lives in orders_history (via the order status endpoint) rather than the profile.

Hmm — careful: don't over-engineer. The instruction for TrackingPage: "read the flat fields off the row/response itself, and send flat keys on writes." So for writes: replace `data: {...}` nesting with flat keys at top level. For handlePushLogEvent patch: send `{ status, locationYemen }` flat (history can't be persisted flat — the events list belongs to public_tracking_event which the API does not expose; the `products`/`history` read come from the API anyway). Keep local UI state updated.

Now, reading: `history` from getTrackingProfile is a list of orders_history events with flat fields, not the `{status,timestamp,location,notes}` shape the timeline renders. I need a mapping helper. Where should it live? "Business logic stays out of UI components" — TrackingPage is a page component that already does mapping inline; but there might be a tracking service. Let me check if there's an existing service for tracking. Also the TrackingPage timeline rendering uses `event.status`, `event.timestamp`, `event.location`, `event.notes`, `event.coordinates`.

Better approach: add a small mapper in the page? Or create/extend a service file? Let me check src/services for tracking-related services.

293	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_main_entry()
294	 RETURNS trigger
295	 LANGUAGE plpgsql
296	 SECURITY DEFINER
297	 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
298	AS $function$
299	DECLARE
300	  v_order_id text;
301	  v_order_number text;
302	  v_actor record;
303	  v_line_count integer;
304	  v_event_type text;
305	  v_summary text;
306	  v_amount_original numeric;
307	  v_currency_original_no integer;
308	BEGIN
309	  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.posting_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.posting_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
310	  IF NEW.order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
311	  v_order_id := NEW.order_id;
312	  IF v_order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
313	    SELECT s.order_id INTO v_order_id FROM public.shipments s WHERE s.shipment_id = NEW.shipment_id;
314	  END IF;
315	  SELECT o.order_number INTO v_order_number FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_id = v_order_id;
316	  IF v_order_id IS NULL OR v_order_number IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
317	
318	  SELECT * INTO v_actor FROM public.orders_history_actor(COALESCE(NEW.posted_by_uid, NEW.voided_by_uid, NEW.updated_by_uid, NEW.created_by_uid));
319	
320	  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(amount_original) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'Debit'), 0), COALESCE(MAX(currency_original_no), 1)
321	    INTO v_line_count, v_amount_original, v_currency_original_no
322	    FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = NEW.main_entry_id;
323	
324	  v_event_type := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'financial.entry_posted'
325	                       WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'financial.entry_voided'
326	                       ELSE 'financial.entry_status_changed' END;
327	  v_summary := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'تم ترحيل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
328	                    WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'تم إبطال قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
329	                    ELSE 'تم تغيير حالة قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END;
330

335	    p_order_number => v_order_number,
336	    p_shipment_id => NEW.shipment_id,
337	    p_journal_entry_id => NEW.main_entry_id,
338	    p_event_type => v_event_type,
339	    p_event_category => 'financial',

341	    p_entity_type => 'main_entry',
342	    p_source => 'financial_trigger',
343	    p_summary => v_summary,

346	      'amountOriginal', v_amount_original, 'currencyOriginalNo', v_currency_original_no,

```ts
function readStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  // Supabase text[] / API array
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(v => readText(v)).filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v));
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const text = value.trim();
    if (!text) return [];
    // Postgres array literal {a,b} from a raw read
    if (text.startsWith('{') && text.endsWith('}')) return text.slice(1,-1).split(',').map(s=>s.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g,'')).filter(Boolean);
    try { const parsed = JSON.parse(text); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) ... } 
  }
  return [];
}
```

```ts
// الاسم الطبيعي لحقل تغيير: يسقط مسار data. القديم ويوحّد snake_case إلى camelCase.
// Normalised change-field name: drops the legacy "data." path and unifies snake_case to camelCase.
export function normalizeHistoryFieldName(name: string): string {
  return name
    .replace(/^data\./, '')
    .replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, character: string) => character.toUpperCase());
}
```

```ts
function readStringList(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => typeof item === 'string' ? item : String(item ?? '')).filter(Boolean)
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const text = value.trim();
    if (!text) return [];
    if (text.startsWith('[')) { try JSON.parse → array }
    if (text.startsWith('{') && text.endsWith('}')) return text.slice(1, -1).split(',').map(strip quotes).filter(Boolean)
    return text.split(',').map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }
  return [];
}
```

```ts
// قيمة حقل من صفوف التغيير无论 الكتابة — tolerant lookup.
export function historyChangeValue(event, fieldName, side='newValue'): unknown {
  const wanted = normalizeHistoryFieldName(fieldName);
  const found = event.changes.find((change) => normalizeHistoryFieldName(change.fieldName) === wanted);
  return found ? found[side] : undefined;
}

// خريطة القيم لسطر العرض: مفتاح طبيعي → قيمة قديمة أو جديدة.
```

```ts
export function trackingMilestoneFromEvent(event: OrderHistoryEvent, fallbackLocation = ''): TrackingMilestone {
  const status = text(historyChangeValue(event, 'status')) || event.summary || event.eventType;
  const timestamp = timeMs(event.occurredAt ?? event.createdAt) — Date.parse
  const location = text(historyChangeValue(event, 'locationYemen')) || text(historyChangeValue(event, 'location')) || fallbackLocation;

  const createdBy = event.actorName;
}
```

```ts
    customerName, customerPhone, customerAddress, weight, cbm, shippingCompany,
```

A concern in handleDeployToPublic: `trackingProfileWritePayload(trackingData)` where trackingData came from `readOrderTrackingRow` — includes `status: profile.status` which is the order status text. Good.

But note: the UI's statusSelector/gpsLocation may have been changed before publishing; the payload uses trackingData.status + gpsLocation override. Reasonable (matches previous behavior, which used trackingData.status too).

Also `handlePushLogEvent` for orders_db: writes via the order status endpoint (unchanged).

One more: `readOrderTrackingRow` history events for orders_db come from `orderHistoryService.listForContext` which returns events sorted DESC (newest first). The page renders `[...history].reverse()` → oldest first displayed at top... Let's check the original: for the public profile, history came from readHistoryRows ordered ASC, so reverse → newest first. Now the service sorts DESC, and reverse → oldest first at top, newest at bottom. That inverts the timeline order vs. before! Also the UI styles `index === 0` as the highlighted current event ("text-[#d4af37]"), meaning index 0 should be the newest. Milestone GPS `coordinates` (used by the Leaflet polyline) no longer exist anywhere in the flat history contract, so the path overlay only renders for the live external-API source. If per-event location/coordinates must survive, that needs `public_tracking_event` write support in `alx_api` — flagged, not invented here.

23	function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
24	  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
25	  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
26	  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
27	}

34	      .from('roles')
35	      .select('role_id,title,is_default,permissions,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by', { count: 'exact' })
36	      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);

39	  }

2	import type { GatewayFailure } from '../contracts/common.gateway';
3	
4	export class DataGatewayError extends ApplicationError {
5	  constructor(failure: GatewayFailure) {
6	    super(failure, failure.cause);
7	    this.name = 'DataGatewayError';
8	  }
9	}
10	
11	function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
12	  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
13	    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
14	    : null;
15	}
16	
17	export function mapSupabaseError(error: unknown): DataGatewayError {
18	  const value = asRecord(error);
19	  const code = typeof value?.code === 'string' && value.code.length > 0
20	    ? value.code
21	    : 'DATA_GATEWAY_ERROR';
22	
23	  return new DataGatewayError({
24	    code,
25	    message: 'Data gateway request failed.',
26	    details: [],
27	    cause: error,
28	  });
29	}
30	
31	export function mapRow<T>(row: unknown, mapper: (value: Record<string, unknown>) => T): T {
32	  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) {
33	    throw new DataGatewayError({
34	      code: 'INVALID_DATA_ROW',
35	      message: 'The data gateway received an invalid row.',
36	      details: [],
37	      cause: row,
38	    });
39	  }
40	  return mapper(row as Record<string, unknown>);
41	}

160	            { key: 'under_review', label: `تحت التقييم (${applications.filter(a => a.status === 'under_review').length})` },
161	            { key: 'approved', label: `مقبول ومُعظّم (${applications.filter(a => a.status === 'approved').length})` },
162	            { key: 'rejected', label: `مرفوض (${applications.filter(a => a.status === 'rejected').length})` },
163	          ].map(tab => (
164	            <button
165	              key={tab.key}
166	              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(tab.key)}
167	              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
168	                statusFilter === tab.key
169	                  ? 'bg-[#d4af37]/20 border-[#d4af37] text-[#d4af37]'
170	                  : 'bg-slate-900/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
171	              }`}
172	            >
173	              {tab.label}
174	            </button>
175	          ))}
176	        </div>
177	
178	        {/* Modal Content */}
179	        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 custom-scrollbar">
180	          {loading ? (
181	            <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
182	              <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400 animate-spin" />
183	              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">جاري تحميل طلبات التوظيف...</p>
184	            </div>
185	          ) : filteredApps.length === 0 ? (
186	            <div className="py-16 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-2">
187	              <UserCheck className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-slate-600" />
188	              <p className="text-sm font-medium">لا توجد طلبات توظيف في هذه الفئة</p>
189	              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">سيتم إدراج أي طلب توظيف يقدمه الزوار عبر البوابة فورياً هنا.</p>
190	            </div>
191	          ) : (
192	            filteredApps.map(app => {
193	              const posObj = POSITION_LABELS[app.jobPosition] || { ar: app.jobPosition || 'وظيفة عامة', en: '' };
194	              const appStatus = app.status || 'pending_review';
195	
196	              return (
197	                <div key={app.id} className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-900 hover:border-amber-500/30 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-3 transition-all">
198	                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-900 pb-3">
199	                    <div className="space-y-1">
200	                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
201	                        <span className="font-bold text-white text-base">{app.fullName}</span>
202	                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 text-xs font-bold">
203	                          {posObj.ar}
204	                        </span>
205	                        {app.refCode && (
206	                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">[{app.refCode}]</span>
207	                        )}
208	                      </div>
209	                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
210	                        <span>📱 {app.phone}</span>
211	                        {app.email && <span>✉️ {app.email}</span>}
212	                        <span>📍 {app.city} {app.address}</span>
213	                      </div>
214	                    </div>
215	
216	                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
217	                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border ${
218	                        appStatus === 'approved' ? 'bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-800/40' :
219	                        appStatus === 'under_review' ? 'bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-400 border-blue-800/40' :
220	                        appStatus === 'rejected' ? 'bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-400 border-rose-800/40' :
221	                        'bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-400 border-amber-800/40'
222	                      }`}>
223	                        {appStatus === 'approved' ? 'مقبول ومعتمد ✓' :
224	                         appStatus === 'under_review' ? 'تحت التقييم والمقابلة' :
225	                         appStatus === 'rejected' ? 'مرفوض' : 'قيد المراجعة'}
226	                      </span>
227	                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
228	                        {new Date(app.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-GB')}
229	                      </span>
230	                    </div>
231	                  </div>
232	
233	                  {/* Details Grid */}
234	                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs bg-black/40 p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.02]">
235	                    <div>
236	                      <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">المؤهل العلمي</span>
237	                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-300">{app.qualification || 'غير محدد'}</span>
238	                    </div>
239	                    <div>
240	                      <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">سنوات الخبرة</span>
241	                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-300">{app.experienceYears || 0} سنوات</span>
242	                    </div>
243	                    <div>
244	                      <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">رقم الهوية</span>
245	                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-300">{app.idNumber || '—'}</span>
246	                    </div>
247	                    <div>
248	                      <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">تاريخ التقديم</span>
249	                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-300">{new Date(app.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
250	                    </div>
251	                  </div>
252	
253	                  {/* Notes / Resume summary */}
254	                  {app.notes && (

256	                      <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-bold block">نبذة الخبرات والسيرة الذاتية / ملاحظات المتقدم:</span>
257	                      <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{app.notes}</p>
258	                    </div>
259	                  )}
260	
261	                  {/* Admin Actions */}
262	                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-900/60">
263	                    <button
264	                      disabled={actioningId === app.id}
265	                      onClick={() => handleDelete(app.id)}
266	                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-900/50 border border-rose-800/30 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
267	                    >
268	                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
269	                      حذف
270	                    </button>
271	
272	                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
273	                      {appStatus !== 'under_review' && (
274	                        <button
275	                          disabled={actioningId === app.id}
276	                          onClick={() => updateApplicationStatus(app.id, 'under_review')}
277	                          className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-950/30 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-900/50 border border-blue-800/30 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
278	                        >
279	                          تعيين تحت التقييم
280	                        </button>
281	                      )}
282	
283	                      {appStatus !== 'rejected' && (
284	                        <button
285	                          disabled={actioningId === app.id}
286	                          onClick={() => updateApplicationStatus(app.id, 'rejected')}
287	                          className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-900/50 border border-rose-800/30 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
288	                        >
289	                          رفض
290	                        </button>
291	                      )}
292	
293	                      {appStatus !== 'approved' && (
294	                        <button
295	                          disabled={actioningId === app.id}
296	                          onClick={() => updateApplicationStatus(app.id, 'approved')}
297	                          className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-amber-500 text-black text-xs font-bold shadow-md shadow-amber-950/30 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
298	                        >
299	                          {actioningId === app.id ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
300	                          قبول واعتماد التوظيف
301	                        </button>
302	                      )}
303	                    </div>
304	                  </div>
305	                </div>
306	              );
307	            })
308	          )}
309	        </div>
310	      </div>
311	    </div>
312	  );

143	        if (

163	// Helpers
164	export function normalizePayload(table: string, payload: any): any {
165	  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return payload;
166	
167	  // Specific normalization for 'roles' permissions field
168	  if (table === 'roles' && payload.permissions) {
169	    if (typeof payload.permissions === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payload.permissions)) {
170	      payload.permissions = Object.values(payload.permissions);
171	    }
172	  }
173	
174	  // Generic object-to-array conversion for objects representing array maps (e.g. { "0": "...", "1": "..." })
175	  if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
176	    return payload.map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
177	  }
178	
179	  const keys = Object.keys(payload);
180	  for (const k of keys) {
181	    const val = payload[k];
182	    if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
183	      if (Array.isArray(val)) {
184	        payload[k] = val.map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
185	      } else {
186	        const subKeys = Object.keys(val);
187	        const isArrayMap = subKeys.length > 0 && subKeys.every(key => !isNaN(Number(key)));
188	        if (isArrayMap) {
189	          payload[k] = Object.values(val).map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
190	        } else {
191	          payload[k] = normalizePayload(table, val);
192	        }
193	      }
194	    }
195	  }
196	
197	  return payload;
198	}
199	
200	export function cleanData(obj: any): any {
201	  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj;
202	  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
203	    return obj.map(item => cleanData(item));
204	  }
205	  if (typeof obj === 'object') {
206	    if (obj._methodName === 'serverTimestamp') {
207	      return Date.now();
208	    }
209	    // Specific custom classes used in PostgreSQL updates
210	    if (obj.constructor?.name === 'IncrementValue' || obj.constructor?.name === 'ArrayUnionValue') {
211	      return obj;
212	    }
213	    const clean: any = {};
214	    for (const k of Object.keys(obj)) {
215	      clean[k] = cleanData(obj[k]);
216	    }
217	    return clean;
218	  }
219	  return obj;
220	}

Key insight: `extractRowPayload` returns `{ id: rowId, [pkCol]: rowId, ...normalized }` and it merges top-level columns. So when the frontend does `supabase.from('jobs_req').select('jobs_req_id,full_name,...')`, the returned rows will have `id`, plus the selected columns and camelCase aliases for mapped columns. `row.data` would be undefined (after the column is dropped), and `extractRowPayload` handles `row.data` missing gracefully (`(row.data || {})`).

#### Thinking

For auth.gateway.ts: line 44 `const nested = value.data;` in `profileRecord`. The values passed to `profileRecord` come from `snapshot.data()` (local document shim) — these are documents, not DB rows with a `data` column. Per the task: "the `snapshot.data()` calls are the local document shim and can stay, but anything reading a `data` COLUMN must go; read flat user columns."

`profileRecord` spreads `value.data` if it's a record. Since users rows/documents now have flat columns (system_pin, full_name etc. per users column list), and `readText` already checks both camelCase and snake_case keys, the nested-`data` unwrap is legacy payload reading. I should remove the nested `data` unwrap entirely — because `mapLoginProfile`/`readSystemPin` read `systemPin`/`system_pin`, `full_name` etc. from flat columns already. The local doc shim `getDoc` returns the flattened item (from extractRowPayload) which already has both camel and snake keys. So removing `nested` unwrap is safe and correct.

Note: `users` table has no `data` column in the dropped list... Actually `portal_users.data` is dropped, `users` isn't listed among dropped data columns. Hmm, the list has `portal_users.data` but not `users.data`. Still, `profileRecord`'s `value.data` is reading a `data` payload; the instruction says remove it and read flat user columns. The function already reads flat keys. So simplify `profileRecord` to just the record check.

Both GlobalSearchModal 94-103 and AccountingPage 43/48/53 use `doc.data()` — the local document shim from onSnapshot/getDocs. Those are NOT DB `data` column reads. Per the rule for auth.gateway ("the `snapshot.data()` calls are the local document shim and can stay"), the same logic applies here. But the task explicitly lists them in scope item 8: "same rule: no DB `data` column reads/writes." — the rule is about DB `data` columns. `d.data()` on the doc shim isn't a DB column read. So these lines are compliant already; I should verify and note them.

389	  // Reorder Pages (Up / Down)

391	    e.stopPropagation();
392	    const currentIndex = filteredPages.findIndex(p => p.id === page.id);
393	    if (currentIndex === -1) return;
394	    const targetIndex = direction === 'up' ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
395	    if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= filteredPages.length) return;
396	
397	    const otherPage = filteredPages[targetIndex];
398	
399	    try {
400	      const currentSort = page.sortOrder || currentIndex;
401	      const otherSort = otherPage.sortOrder || targetIndex;
402	
403	      // Swap sortOrders
404	      if (!page.id.startsWith('auto_')) {
405	        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'browser_pages', page.id), { sortOrder: otherSort });
406	      }
407	      if (!otherPage.id.startsWith('auto_')) {
408	        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'browser_pages', otherPage.id), { sortOrder: currentSort });
409	      }
410	    } catch (err: any) {
411	      console.error('Error reordering pages:', err);

413	  };

59	const money = (value: unknown) => Math.round((Number(value) || 0) * 100) / 100;
60	
61	export function calculateShipmentCategoryFees(category: Partial<ItemCategory> | undefined, cartonCount: unknown): ShipmentCategoryFees {
62	  const cartons = Math.max(0, money(cartonCount));
63	  const customsFee = money(cartons * money(category?.customsPerCarton));
64	  const taxFee = money(cartons * money(category?.taxPerCarton));
65	  const otherCategoryFee = money(cartons * money(category?.otherFeesPerCarton));
66	  return {
67	    cartonCount: cartons,
68	    customsFee,
69	    taxFee,
70	    otherCategoryFee,
71	    total: money(customsFee + taxFee + otherCategoryFee),
72	    currency: category?.feeCurrency || 'SAR',
73	  };
74	}

7	type WebsiteManagementQueryResult = {
8	  enrichedUsers: any[];
9	  portalOrders: PortalOrderRow[];
10	  tickets: SupportTicketRow[];
11	  announcements: AnnouncementRow[];

15	/**
16	 * بيانات صفحة إدارة الموقع — كل مصدر يقرأ من alx_api فقط، وترتيب الأحدث أولًا صار خادميًا.
17	 * Website management data: every source reads through alx_api, and the newest-first ordering is done server-side.
18	 */
19	export function useWebsiteManagementData(isAr: boolean) {
20	  const [queryState, setQueryState] = useState<AsyncState<WebsiteManagementQueryResult>>(asyncState.loading());
21	  const loading = queryState.status === 'loading';
22	  const setLoading = (value: boolean) => setQueryState(value ? asyncState.loading() : asyncState.idle());
23	  const [portalUsers, setPortalUsers] = useState<any[]>([]);
24	  const [portalOrders, setPortalOrders] = useState<PortalOrderRow[]>([]);
25	  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicketRow[]>([]);
26	  const [announcements, setAnnouncements] = useState<AnnouncementRow[]>([]);
27	  const [jobApplications, setJobApplications] = useState<JobApplicationRow[]>([]);
28	
29	  const loadAllData = useCallback(async () => {
30	    const result = await runQuery(async () => {
31	      const [enrichedUsers, orders, tick, ann, jobs] = await Promise.all([
32	        portalUserService.getPortalUsers(),
33	        siteContentService.listPortalOrders(),
34	        siteContentService.listTickets(),
35	        siteContentService.listAnnouncements(),
36	        siteContentService.listJobApplications(),
37	      ]);
38	      return { enrichedUsers, portalOrders: orders, tickets: tick, announcements: ann, jobApplications: jobs };
39	    }, setQueryState, () => false);
40	
41	    if (result.status === 'success') {
42	      setPortalUsers(result.data.enrichedUsers);
43	      setPortalOrders(result.data.portalOrders);
44	      setTickets(result.data.tickets);
45	      setAnnouncements(result.data.announcements);
46	      setJobApplications(result.data.jobApplications);
47	    } else if (result.status === 'error') {
48	      console.error('[WebsiteManagement] Error loading portal data:', result.error);
49	      toast.error(isAr ? 'حدث خطأ أثناء تحميل بيانات الموقع' : 'Error loading portal data');
50	    }
51	  }, [isAr]);
52	
53	  useEffect(() => {
54	    loadAllData();
55	  }, [loadAllData]);
56	
57	  return { loading, setLoading, portalUsers, setPortalUsers, portalOrders, tickets, announcements, jobApplications, loadAllData };
58	}
59	
60	export default useWebsiteManagementData;

-- 3. خيارات الطلب / order_option — تفاصيل نصية عادية بلا أي jsonb.
--    Order options keep a plain text details column; older clones stored it as jsonb.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_option' AND column_name = 'data'
  ) THEN
    UPDATE public.order_option
       SET name_ar  = COALESCE(NULLIF(name_ar, ''), data->>'nameAr'),
           name_en  = COALESCE(NULLIF(name_en, ''), data->>'nameEn'),
           code     = COALESCE(NULLIF(code, ''),    data->>'code'),
           type     = COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''),    data->>'type'),
           price    = COALESCE(price,    alx_api_private.payload_number(data, 'price')),
           duration = COALESCE(duration, alx_api_private.cast_integer(data->>'duration'))
     WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_option'
       AND column_name = 'details' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_option
      ALTER COLUMN details TYPE text USING (NULLIF(btrim(details #>> '{}'), ''));
  END IF;
END
$$;

21	  const updateCategory = async (id: string, payload: Partial<ItemCategory>) => {

''),\n    title: typeof row.title === 'string' ? row.title : null,\n    code: typeof row.code === 'string' ? row.code : null,\n    description: typeof row.description === 'string' ? row.description : null,\n    isDefault: Boolean(row.is_default),\n    permissions: [...new Set(permissions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string'))].sort(),\n    createdAt: typeof row.created_at === 'string' ? asIsoUtc(row.created_at) : null,\n    updatedAt: typeof row.updated_at === 'string' ? asIsoUtc(row.updated_at) : null,\n    createdBy: typeof row.created_by === 'string' ? row.created_by : null,\n    updatedBy: typeof row.updated_by === 'string' ? row.updated_by : null,\n  };\n}\n\n/** جلب الصلاحيات لعدد من الأدوار في استدعاء واحد ثم تجميعها حسب الدور. */\nasync function permissionsByRole(roleIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {\n  const grouped = new Map<string, string[]>();\n  if (roleIds.length === 0) return grouped;\n  const { data, error } = await supabase\n    .from('role_permission')\n    .select('role_id,permission_code')\n    .in('role_id', [...roleIds]);\n  if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n  for (const value of (data ?? []) as unknown[]) {\n    const row = value as Record<string, unknown> | null;\n    const roleId = typeof row?.role_id === 'string' ? row.role_id : '';\n    const code = typeof row?.permission_code === 'string' ? row.permission_code : '';\n    if (!roleId || !code) continue;\n    const codes = grouped.get(roleId);\n    if (codes) codes.push(code);\n    else grouped.set(roleId, [code]);\n  }\n  return grouped;\n}\n\nfunction page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {\n  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);\n  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);\n  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };\n}\n\nexport class CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway implements RolesGateway {\n  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<RoleViewModel>> {\n    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);\n    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);\n    const { data, error, count } = await supabase\n      .from('roles')\n      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS, { count: 'exact' })\n      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);\n    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n    const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[];\n    const grouped = await permissionsByRole(rows.map((row) => String(row.role_id ?? '')));\n    const items = rows.map((row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(String(row.role_id ?? '')) ?? []));\n    return page(items, { ...query, limit, offset }, count);\n  }\n\n  async getById(roleId: string): Promise<RoleViewModel | null> {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('roles')\n      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS)\n      .eq('role_id', roleId)\n      .maybeSingle();\n    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n    if (!data) return null;\n    const grouped = await permissionsByRole([roleId]);\n    return mapRow(data, (row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(roleId) ?? []));\n  }\n\n  async save(role: RoleViewModel): Promise<RoleViewModel> {\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('roles')\n      .upsert({\n        role_id: role.roleId,\n        title: role.title,\n        code: role.code ?? null,\n        description: role.description ?? null,\n        is_default: role.isDefault,\n        created_at: role.createdAt ?? now,\n        updated_at: now,\n        created_by: role.createdBy,\n        updated_by: role.updatedBy,\n      }, { onConflict: 'role_id' })\n      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS)\n      .single();\n    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n\n    // استبدال صفوف الصلاحيات بالكامل بدل كتابة مصفوفة داخل الجدول الأب.\n    // The child rows are replaced wholesale (delete by role_id then insert) instead of writing roles.permissions.\n    const codes = [...new Set(role.permissions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0))].sort();\n    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase\n      .from('role_permission')\n      .delete()\n      .eq('role_id', role.roleId);\n    if (deleteError) throw mapSupabaseError(deleteError);\n    if (codes.length > 0) {\n      const { error: insertError } = await supabase\n        .from('role_permission')\n        .insert(codes.map((permission_code) => ({ role_id: role.roleId, permission_code })));\n      if (insertError) throw mapSupabaseError(insertError);\n    }\n\n    return mapRow(data, (row) => mapRole(row, codes));\n  }\n}\n",
