63	const money = (value: unknown) => Math.round((Number(value) || 0) * 100) / 100;
64	
65	export function calculateShipmentCategoryFees(category: Partial<ItemCategory> | undefined, cartonCount: unknown): ShipmentCategoryFees {
66	  const cartons = Math.max(0, money(cartonCount));
67	  const customsFee = money(cartons * money(category?.customsPerCarton));
68	  const taxFee = money(cartons * money(category?.taxPerCarton));
69	  const otherCategoryFee = money(cartons * money(category?.otherFeesPerCarton));
70	  return {
71	    cartonCount: cartons,
72	    customsFee,
73	    taxFee,
74	    otherCategoryFee,
75	    total: money(customsFee + taxFee + otherCategoryFee),
76	    currency: category?.feeCurrency || 'SAR',
77	  };
78	}

1	import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
2	import { DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES, ItemCategory } from '../services/itemCategoryService';
3	
4	export function useItemCategories() {
5	  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<ItemCategory[]>(DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES);
6	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
7	
8	  useEffect(() => {
9	    setCategories(DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES);
10	    setLoading(false);
11	  }, []);
12	
13	  const activeCategories = useMemo(() => categories.filter((category) => category.isActive), [categories]);
14	
15	  const addCategory = async (payload: Omit<ItemCategory, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => {
16	    const id = `cat_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
17	    const newCategory: ItemCategory = { ...payload, id, createdAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now() };
18	    setCategories(prev => [...prev, newCategory]);
19	  };
20	
21	  const updateCategory = async (id: string, payload: Partial<ItemCategory>) => {
22	    setCategories(prev => prev.map(cat => cat.id === id ? { ...cat, ...payload, updatedAt: Date.now() } : cat));
23	  };
24	
25	  const deleteCategory = async (id: string) => {
26	    setCategories(prev => prev.filter(cat => cat.id !== id));
27	  };
28	
29	  const toggleCategoryStatus = async (category: ItemCategory) => {
30	    await updateCategory(category.id, { isActive: !category.isActive });
31	  };
32	
33	  return { categories, activeCategories, loading, addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, toggleCategoryStatus };
34	}

8	/**
9	 * صلاحيات الأدوار صارت صفوفًا في role_permission بعد إسقاط roles.permissions (jsonb).
10	 * Role permissions are rows in role_permission now that the roles.permissions jsonb column is gone,
11	 * so every read assembles the string array the UI expects from that child table.
12	 */
13	const ROLE_COLUMNS = 'role_id,code,title,description,is_default,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by';
14	
15	function mapRole(row: Record<string, unknown>, permissions: readonly string[] = []): RoleViewModel {
16	  return {
17	    roleId: String(row.role_id ?? ''),
18	    title: typeof row.title === 'string' ? row.title : null,
19	    code: typeof row.code === 'string' ? row.code : null,
20	    description: typeof row.description === 'string' ? row.description : null,
21	    isDefault: Boolean(row.is_default),
22	    permissions: [...new Set(permissions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string'))].sort(),
23	    createdAt: typeof row.created_at === 'string' ? asIsoUtc(row.created_at) : null,
24	    updatedAt: typeof row.updated_at === 'string' ? asIsoUtc(row.updated_at) : null,
25	    createdBy: typeof row.created_by === 'string' ? row.created_by : null,
26	    updatedBy: typeof row.updated_by === 'string' ? row.updated_by : null,
27	  };
28	}

30	/** جلب الصلاحيات لعدد من الأدوار في استدعاء واحد ثم تجميعها حسب الدور. */
31	async function permissionsByRole(roleIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
32	  const grouped = new Map<string, string[]>();
33	  if (roleIds.length === 0) return grouped;
34	  const { data, error } = await supabase
35	    .from('role_permission')
36	    .select('role_id,permission_code')
37	    .in('role_id', [...roleIds]);
38	  if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
39	  for (const value of (data ?? []) as unknown[]) {
40	    const row = value as Record<string, unknown> | null;
41	    const roleId = typeof row?.role_id === 'string' ? row.role_id : '';
42	    const code = typeof row?.permission_code === 'string' ? row.permission_code : '';
43	    if (!roleId || !code) continue;
44	    const codes = grouped.get(roleId);
45	    if (codes) codes.push(code);
46	    else grouped.set(roleId, [code]);
47	  }
48	  return grouped;
49	}

51	function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
52	  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
53	  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
54	  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
55	}

57	export class CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway implements RolesGateway {
58	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<RoleViewModel>> {
59	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
60	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
61	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
62	      .from('roles')
63	      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS, { count: 'exact' })
64	      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
65	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
66	    const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[];
67	    const grouped = await permissionsByRole(rows.map((row) => String(row.role_id ?? '')));
68	    const items = rows.map((row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(String(row.role_id ?? '')) ?? []));
69	    return page(items, { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
70	  }

#### Thinking

Review points:

1. `api-client.ts`: the `request` for GET: readWithRetries, then 401 refresh path calls `this.send(url, {...spec, retried:true})` — for GET that's fine. Behavior change: previously POST had different error message construction (`normalized.message || fallback`) vs unified `apiErrorFromResponse` which sets message only when code === fallbackCode. Slight behavior difference: previously for POST, if normalized.message existed it was used. Now: `message: normalized.code === fallbackCode ? 'API request failed with status X' : normalized.message`. That's equivalent-ish. Check tests for api-client error contract.

2. `session-refresh.ts`: uses `clearTokens`, `getStoredRefreshToken`, `storeTokens` from `../../lib/alxApiClient`. Need to verify those exports exist. Also `baseUrl` — the refresher builds `${baseUrl}/api/v1/auth/refresh`. Is baseUrl already including `/api/v1`? Check ApiClient usage: `new URL(path, this.options.baseUrl)`. If baseUrl is like `http://localhost:3000/api/v1` then the refresh URL becomes `.../api/v1/api/v1/auth/refresh` — a bug. Need to check.

Also the retry-on-401: `accessTokenFactory` must re-read from sessionStorage after storeTokens, otherwise the retried request sends the stale token. Check that.

continue; }\n    const filled = await q(`select count(*)::int as payload_rows from ${table} where ${column} is not null and ${column} <> 'null'::jsonb and ${column} <> '{}'::jsonb`);\n    const unmapped = rows.map(r => r.key).filter(k => !cols.includes(k) && !cols.includes(camelToSnake(k)));\n    console.log(`\\n### ${table}.${column}  payload_rows=${filled[0].payload_rows}`);\n    console.log(`   keys: ${rows.map(r => `${r.key}(${r.n})`).join(' ') || '(none)'}`);\n    console.log(`   UNMAPPED: ${unmapped.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);\n  }\n\n  await pool.end();\n})().catch((e) => { console.error('ERROR', e.message); process.exit(1); });\n",

async function upsertCustomerDetails(
  pool: Pool,
  input: { detailId: string; userUid: string; customerId: string; details: PortalCustomerDetailsInput; updatedAt: Date },
): Promise<PortalCustomerDetailsDto | null> {
  const keys = (Object.keys(DETAILS_COLUMNS) as DetailKey[]).filter((key) => input.details[key] !== undefined);
  if (keys.length === 0) {
    const existing = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(detailsSelectSql, [input.detailId]);
    return existing.rows[0] ? mapDetails(existing.rows[0]) : null;
  }

  const columns = ['cust_detail_id', 'user_uid', 'customer_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at', ...keys.map((key) => DETAILS_COLUMNS[key])];
  const values: unknown[] = [input.detailId, input.userUid, input.customerId, input.updatedAt, input.updatedAt];
  for (const key of keys) {
    const value = input.details[key];
    values.push(key === 'preferredCategories' && Array.isArray(value)
      ? (value as readonly string[]).map((item) => String(item).trim()).filter((item) => item !== '')
      : value);
  }

  const placeholders = values.map((_, index) => `$${index + 1}`).join(', ');
  const updates = keys.map((key) => `${DETAILS_COLUMNS[key]} = EXCLUDED.${DETAILS_COLUMNS[key]}`).join(', ');
  // updated_at لا يُشتق من نص مستخدم؛ يُمرر كمعامل رقمي في الموضع الصحيح.
  // updated_at is a bound parameter, never interpolated text.
  const updatedAtPlaceholder = `$${columns.indexOf('updated_at') + 1}`;

  await pool.query(
    `INSERT INTO public.cust_details (${columns.join(', ')}) VALUES (${placeholders})
       ON CONFLICT (cust_detail_id) DO UPDATE SET ${updates}, updated_at = ${updatedAtPlaceholder}`,
    values,
  );

  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(detailsSelectSql, [input.detailId]);
  return result.rows[0] ? mapDetails(result.rows[0]) : null;
}

const optionalValue = <T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>) => z.union([z.null(), schema])
  .optional()
  .transform((value) => (value === null ? undefined : value));

export const portalCustomerDetailsSchema = z.object({
  age: optionalValue(z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(130)),
  gender: optionalText(40),
  city: optionalText(120),
  country: optionalText(120),
  companyName: optionalText(200),
  idNumber: optionalText(60),
  maxDebt: optionalValue(z.coerce.number().min(0).max(1_000_000_000_000)),
  notes: optionalText(4000),
  gpsLocation: optionalText(500),
  bodyDetails: optionalText(1000),
  location: optionalText(500),
  preferredCategories: optionalValue(z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(60)).max(50)),
  joinBy: optionalText(60),
  referrerId: optionalText(120),
  onboardingCompleted: z.boolean().optional(),
  privacyPolicyAgreed: z.boolean().optional(),
}).strict();

export const portalCustomerDetailsWriteSchema = portalCustomerDetailsSchema.extend({
  userUid: optionalText(120),
}).strict();

  fullName: z.string().trim().min(2).max(200),

## 1) هل نُفِّذت الترحيلات بنجاح؟

| الترحيل | الحالة | الدليل المرصود |
|---|---|---|
| 0010 (`notification_outbox`) | ✅ مطبَّق | `alx_api_private.notification_outbox` موجود |
| 0023 (`assets` + سجل الصيانة) | ✅ مطبَّق | الأعمدة الأربعة موجودة + `public.asset_maintenance_log` موجود |
| 0021، 0022، 0024 → 0032، 0036، 0037 | ✅ مطبَّقة | الجداول الابنة موجودة ومعمَّرة (`role_permission` 185 صفًا، `activity_log_detail` 84، `settings_*` كلها) |
| **0038** (إغلاق الفجوات، 20 قسمًا) | ❌ **لم تُطبَّق** | لا أثر لأي عمود من أعمدتها (`cust_details.latitude/street/coat_size…`, `portal_users.linked_acc_id`, `orders.package_type`, `settings_general.timezone`, `user_settings.sidebar_*`)، و`alx_api_private.safe_jsonb` غير موجودة، و`public.validate_order_party` ما زالت النسخة القديمة التي تكتب `NEW.data` |
| **0034** (إسقاط `data`) | ❌ لم تُطبَّق | بقي 29 عمود jsonb في `public` |

## 2) هل انتقلت البيانات من `data` إلى الحقول الرئيسية؟

نعم، بدليل مباشر لا بالاستنتاج: `notifications.data` فيه 188 صفًا و**صفر** مفاتيح (`title`/`message`/`type`) قيمتها غائبة عن عمودها؛ `orders.data` لا يترك أي مفتاح بلا عمود مطابق؛ تذاكر البوابة سليمة؛ و`customers.location/body_details/preferred_categories` كلها null (0 من 8) فالإسقاط هناك بلا فقدان.

فحصتُ آليًا **كل مفتاح jsonb** مقابل أسماء الأعمدة. كل «شذوذ» ثبت أنه تكرار بقيمة متطابقة 100%: `portal_users.uid = auth_uid` (5/5)، `salary_history.salaryMonth = month`، `browser_pages.name = name_ar/name_en`، `announcements/order_status → data->id = المفتاح الأساسي` (2/2 و 12/12)، `auto_entries.currencyId` null في 3/3، و`cust_details.acquisitionSource` مستند معشّش كل حقوله منقولة أصلًا إلى `join_by`/`referrer_id`.

الفجوتان الحقيقيّتان — وكلتاهما مغلقتان في كود 0038 بانتظار التشغيل:
- `cust_details.body_details` و `cust_details.location`: عمودا text يحملان مستندات JSON في 3 صفوف من 7 (آخر انتهاك لقاعدتك «لا حقول داخل jsonb»). 0038 §2 و §18 ينقلانهما إلى أعمدة حقيقية، والمستودعات تقرأ وتكتب المسطّح الآن مع الحفاظ على شكل الاستجابة نفسه للعميل.
- `salary_history.createdByUid` (صف واحد) — §4 ينقله إلى عمود `created_by_uid` جديد.

## 3) حذف حقل `data` — المطلوب منك فقط

لا أستطيع تنفيذ DDL: الموصل `alx_api_runtime` للمعاملات فقط، والـ MCP محجوب. الترتيب **إجباري**:

2. [alx_api/src/db/migrations/0034_drop_legacy_jsonb_payloads.sql](file:///F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/alx_api/src/db/migrations/0034_drop_legacy_jsonb_payloads.sql).

## 1. Company name / logo never reach the UI

**Frontend reads them from `SettingsContext`, which starts from hardcoded defaults:**
- `F:\...\src\context\SettingsContext.tsx:135-139` — `systemName: 'ALX'`, `systemLogo: ''`, `companyName: 'الكس-تراك'`; `:263` fetches `settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.getSettings('general')`; `:267-269` swallows failure ("keeping current settings"); `:385` `document.title = settings.systemName || settings.companyName`.
- Consumers exist and are correct: `src\pages\Login.tsx:246`, `src\components\layout\Sidebar.tsx:98-101` (`settings.systemLogo`), `index.html:7` is static (`<title>alx — نظام إدارة الشحنات</title>`, no favicon link).
- Transport: `src\data\http\settings-currencies-api.gateway.ts:44-52` → `GET /api/v1/settings/general`, reads `dto.settings` as a **jsonb object**.

**Backend break — repository queries a table the schema no longer has:**
- `alx_api\src\modules\settings\settings.repository.ts:4-12` projects `COALESCE(data,'{}'::jsonb) AS settings`, `category`; `:28` `FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id=$1 OR category=$1`; `:35-41` INSERT into the same columns.
- `alx_api\src\db\migrations\0034_drop_legacy_jsonb_payloads.sql:35-36` — `ALTER TABLE public.settings DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS data;` / `DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS category;` → every `GET /api/v1/settings/*` throws (42703) → 500 → frontend keeps defaults.
- The real brand columns are never read by any code: `0031_flatten_settings.sql:22-41` creates `settings_general (system_name, system_logo, invoice_logo, company_name, company_address, company_email, company_phone, company_website, tax_id, user_session_timeout …)`; `:79-93` migrates them from `data->>'companyName'`. Grepping `settings_general` in `alx_api\src` hits only the migration file — no route/repository selects it.
- Additionally `settings.routes.ts:19-25` wraps reads in `authenticate`, so on the login screen (`App.tsx:95-99` mounts `SettingsProvider` above the route) there is no token → `auth.routes.ts:33-37` 401; brand can never render pre-login even if the SQL were fixed.
- No branding endpoint elsewhere: `alx_api\src\modules\site-content\site-content.routes.ts` only exposes `/site/tickets|announcements|job-applications|portal-orders` (`:52,83,137,177`).
- `FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED` is finance-only (`src\components\financeAccounting\FinanceApiDataGateway.ts:105,124`), not the settings path.

## 2. Short sessions / repeated 401

- TTL: `alx_api\src\config\env.ts:26-27` — `ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` clamp `min 300 max 900 default 600`; `REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS default 2_592_000`. Actual `.env:28-29` = `600` / `2592000`. Enforced again in `modules\auth\access-token.ts:71-72` ("5 to 15 minutes"), `:85 exp = iat + ttl`.
- Validation has **zero clock-skew tolerance**: `access-token.ts:138-146` rejects `exp <= nowSeconds`, `nbf > nowSeconds`, `iat > now+30`, `exp-iat > 900`.
- Per-request auth: `auth.use-cases.ts:268-285` → any failure = `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` = `:114` `401 AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.'`; `:282` DB read `drizzle-auth.repository.ts:303-322` (`isNull(revokedAt) AND expiresAt > now`). No `last_seen`/touch write found. Session row expiry = refresh expiry (`:135-140`).
- Refresh exists (`auth.routes.ts:89-105`) and rotates (`auth.use-cases.ts:214-260`), and the frontend does call it — but **only inside `src\lib\alxApiClient.ts:125-171, 231-241`**. The shared client used by all feature gateways has no 401 handling: `src\data\http\api-client.ts:25-210` (no refresh hook) and `src\data\http\app-api-client.ts:23-27` (`maxReadRetries: 0`, `accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken`). 27 files instantiate `ApiClient`/`appApiClient`, including `features\notifications\services\notificationsApiDataGateway.ts:8`.
- 401 is therefore surfaced as an error message, not retried or logged out (only `src\services\securityPinService.ts:36` special-cases `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`).
- Retry storms: pollers every 30 s — `src\components\Layout.tsx:287, 344`, `src\features\notifications\pages\NotificationsPage.tsx:154, 196`; plus `SettingsContext.tsx:346-349` (5 min) — after 10 min each tick 401s, matching ~24 events in minutes.
- Rate limits: global `app.ts:113-119` (`RATE_LIMIT_MAX` 120/60 s, `env.ts:16`); a **single shared `authLimiter`** (`auth.routes.ts:54-68`, `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10`/60 s, `.env:16`) guards login+refresh+logout+logout-all, so refresh bursts return 429 → `alxApiClient.ts:143-147` `!response.ok → clearTokens()` (silent logout).
- Idle logout (`Layout.tsx:352-354`) depends on `settings.userSessionTimeout`, which comes from the broken settings read (default `0` at `SettingsContext.tsx:180`) although the DB column exists (`0031:66`).

5	import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
6	import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
7	import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
8	import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';
9	
10	const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
11	const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
12	
13	export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
14	  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
15	  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
16	  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
17	  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
18	  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
19	  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
20	    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
21	      try {
22	        const record = await repository.get(category);
23	        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
24	      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
25	    });
26	    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
27	      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
28	      const actor = principal(response);
29	      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
30	      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
31	      catch (error) { return next(error); }
32	    });
33	  }
34	  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
35	    const actor = principal(response);
36	    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
37	    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
38	    catch (error) { return next(error); }
39	  });
40	  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
41	    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
42	    const actor = principal(response);
43	    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
44	    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
45	    catch (error) { return next(error); }
46	  });
47	}

4	const settingsColumns = `
5	  setting_id AS "settingId",
6	  COALESCE(category, setting_id) AS category,
7	  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
8	  created_at AS "createdAt",
9	  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
10	  created_by AS "createdBy",
11	  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
12	`;
13	
14	const userSettingsColumns = `
15	  user_setting_id AS "userSettingId",
16	  user_id AS "userId",
17	  COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) AS settings,
18	  created_at AS "createdAt",
19	  updated_at AS "updatedAt",
20	  created_by AS "createdBy",
21	  updated_by AS "updatedBy"
22	`;
23	
24	export function createSettingsRepository(pool: Pool): SettingsRepository {
25	  return {
26	    async get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null> {
27	      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
28	        `SELECT ${settingsColumns} FROM public.settings WHERE setting_id = $1 OR category = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
29	        [category],
30	      );
31	      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
32	    },
33	    async update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord> {
34	      const result = await pool.query<SettingsRecord>(
35	        `INSERT INTO public.settings (setting_id, category, data, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
36	         VALUES ($1, $1, $2::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $3, $3)
37	         ON CONFLICT (setting_id) DO UPDATE SET
38	           category = EXCLUDED.category,
39	           data = COALESCE(public.settings.data, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.data,
40	           updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
41	         RETURNING ${settingsColumns}`,
42	        [category, JSON.stringify(settings), actorId],
43	      );
44	      const row = result.rows[0];
45	      if (!row) throw new Error('SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
46	      return row;
47	    },
48	    async getUser(userId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord | null> {
49	      const result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
50	        `SELECT ${userSettingsColumns} FROM public.user_settings
51	         WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1`,
52	        [userId],
53	      );
54	      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
55	    },
56	    async updateUser(userId: string, settings: UserSettingsData, actorId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord> {
57	      const existing = await this.getUser(userId);
58	      const data = JSON.stringify(settings);
59	      let result;
60	      if (existing) {
61	        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
62	          `UPDATE public.user_settings SET data = COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb) || $1::jsonb,
63	             language = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'language'), language),
64	             theme = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'theme'), theme),
65	             font_size = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'fontSize'), font_size),
66	             dashboard_grid_columns = COALESCE(($1::jsonb ->> 'dashboardGridColumns')::numeric, dashboard_grid_columns),
67	             visible_metrics = COALESCE($1::jsonb -> 'visibleMetrics', visible_metrics),
68	             updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = $2
69	           WHERE user_setting_id = $3 RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
70	          [data, actorId, existing.userSettingId],
71	        );
72	      } else {
73	        result = await pool.query<UserSettingsRecord>(
74	          `INSERT INTO public.user_settings
75	             (user_setting_id, user_id, data, language, theme, font_size, dashboard_grid_columns, visible_metrics, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
76	           VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $9, $9)
77	           RETURNING ${userSettingsColumns}`,
78	          [
79	            `user_${userId}`,
80	            userId,
81	            data,
82	            settings.language ?? null,
83	            settings.theme ?? null,
84	            settings.fontSize ?? null,
85	            settings.dashboardGridColumns ?? null,
86	            settings.visibleMetrics ? JSON.stringify(settings.visibleMetrics) : null,
87	            actorId,
88	          ],
89	        );
90	      }
91	      const row = result.rows[0];
92	      if (!row) throw new Error('USER_SETTINGS_UPDATE_READBACK_FAILED');
93	      return row;
94	    },
95	  };
96	}

export class Ed25519AccessTokenIssuer implements AccessTokenIssuer {
  private readonly privateKey: KeyObject;

  constructor(
    privateKeyPem: string,
    private readonly issuer: string,
    private readonly audience: string,
    private readonly now: () => Date = () => new Date(),
  ) {
    this.privateKey = requireEd25519Key(createPrivateKey(normalizePem(privateKeyPem)));
    if (!issuer.trim() || !audience.trim()) throw new TypeError('JWT issuer and audience must be configured.');
  }

  async issue(input: { subject: string; role: string; sessionId: string; expiresInSeconds: number }): Promise<string> {
    if (!Number.isInteger(input.expiresInSeconds) || input.expiresInSeconds < 300 || input.expiresInSeconds > 900) {
      throw new RangeError('Access token lifetime must be between 5 and 15 minutes.');
    }
    const issuedAt = Math.floor(this.now().getTime() / 1_000);
    const header = encodeJson({ alg: 'EdDSA', typ: 'JWT' });
    const payload = encodeJson({
      iss: this.issuer,
      aud: this.audience,
      sub: input.subject,
      sid: input.sessionId,
      jti: randomUUID(),
      role: input.role,
      iat: issuedAt,
      nbf: issuedAt,
      exp: issuedAt + input.expiresInSeconds,
    });
    const signingInput = `${header}.${payload}`;
    const signature = signBytes(null, Buffer.from(signingInput, 'utf8'), this.privateKey).toString('base64url');
    return `${signingInput}.${signature}`;
  }
}

export function verifyAccessToken(
  token: string,
  options: {
    publicKeyPem: string;
    issuer: string;
    audience: string;
    now?: () => Date;
  },
): AccessTokenClaims {
  if (token.length > 8_192) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();
  const parts = token.split('.');
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some((part) => part.length === 0)) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();
  const [encodedHeader, encodedClaims, encodedSignature] = parts;
  if (!encodedHeader || !encodedClaims || !encodedSignature) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();

  const header = headerSchema.safeParse(decodeJson(encodedHeader));
  const claims = claimsSchema.safeParse(decodeJson(encodedClaims));
  if (!header.success || !claims.success) throw new InvalidAccessTokenError();

  async refresh(input: { refreshToken: string }): Promise<AuthTokenPairDto> {
    const now = this.now();
    const oldTokenHash = hashRefreshToken(input.refreshToken);
    const stored = await this.repository.findRefreshToken(oldTokenHash);
    if (stored?.usedAt !== null && stored?.usedAt !== undefined) {
      await this.repository.revokeRefreshTokenFamily(oldTokenHash, now);
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }
    if (
      !stored ||
      stored.disabled ||
      stored.revokedAt !== null ||
      stored.expiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime() ||
      stored.sessionRevokedAt !== null ||
      stored.sessionExpiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime()
    ) {
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }

    const user: AuthUser = { userId: stored.userId, role: stored.role, disabled: stored.disabled };
    const sessionId = stored.sessionId;
    const nextRefreshToken = randomBytes(48).toString('base64url');
    const nextTokenHash = hashRefreshToken(nextRefreshToken);
    const nextExpiry = new Date(now.getTime() + this.options.refreshTokenTtlSeconds * 1_000);
    const accessToken = await this.tokenIssuer.issue({
      subject: user.userId,
      role: user.role,
      sessionId,
      expiresInSeconds: this.options.accessTokenTtlSeconds,
    });
    const rotated = await this.repository.rotateRefreshToken({
      oldTokenHash,
      newTokenHash: nextTokenHash,
      newTokenId: randomUUID(),
      rotatedAt: now,
      newExpiresAt: nextExpiry,
    });
    if (!rotated) {
      await this.repository.revokeRefreshTokenFamily(oldTokenHash, now);
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }

    return {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken: nextRefreshToken,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresInSeconds: this.options.accessTokenTtlSeconds,
    };
  }

  async logout(input: { refreshToken: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.repository.revokeRefreshToken(hashRefreshToken(input.refreshToken), this.now());
  }

  async authenticateAccessToken(input: { accessToken: string }): Promise<AuthPrincipalDto> {
    const { accessTokenPublicKeyPem, jwtIssuer, jwtAudience } = this.options;
    if (!accessTokenPublicKeyPem || !jwtIssuer || !jwtAudience) throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();

    let claims;
    try {
      claims = verifyAccessToken(input.accessToken, {
        publicKeyPem: accessTokenPublicKeyPem,
        issuer: jwtIssuer,
        audience: jwtAudience,
        now: this.now,
      });
    } catch {
      throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();
    }

    const activeUser = await this.repository.findActiveSession({
      userId: claims.sub,
      sessionId: claims.sid,
      now: this.now(),
    });
    if (!activeUser || activeUser.disabled) throw INVALID_CREDENTIALS();

    return { userId: activeUser.userId, sessionId: claims.sid, role: activeUser.role };
  }

  async listSessions(input: { userId: string; currentSessionId: string }): Promise<readonly AuthSessionDto[]> {
    return this.repository.listSessions({ ...input, now: this.now() });
  }

  async revokeSession(input: { userId: string; sessionId: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.repository.revokeSession({ ...input, revokedAt: this.now() });

=== activity-audit usage ===
/**
 * activity-audit.ts
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * كاتب سجل النشاط الموحّد لكل وحدات الـ API (Unified activity-log writer).
 * One writer for every activity-log insert so no module invents its own columns:
 * identity is resolved from the database, summaries stay plain text, and structured
 * fields go to the activity_log_detail child table instead of a jsonb blob.
 */

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { PoolClient } from 'pg';
import type { ActivityLogDetailValue } from '../../modules/activity-logs/activity-logs.contracts';

export interface ActivityAuditEvent {
  action: string;
  category?: string | undefined;
  target?: string | undefined;
  summary?: string | undefined;
  /** هوية الفاعل من الـ principal المصادَق عليه فقط — never taken from client input. */
  actorUserId?: string | null | undefined;
}

/**
 * يكتب قيد النشاط ويعيد الصف المسطّح، مع اسم المستخدم ودوره من قاعدة البيانات.
 * Inserts the log row and returns its flat projection; user name/role are resolved
 * server-side from `public.users`, so a missing profile still records the event.
 */
export async function insertActivityLog(
  client: PoolClient,
  event: ActivityAuditEvent,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  const activityLogId = `act_${randomUUID()}`;
  const result = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
    `INSERT INTO public.activity_logs
       (activity_log_id, action, category, target, type, summary,
        user_id, user_name, user_role, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
     SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, 'api', $5,
            source.user_id, u.full_name, u.role, NOW(), NOW(), $6, $6
       FROM (SELECT $6::text AS user_id) AS source
       LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = source.user_id
     ON CONFLICT (activity_log_id) DO NOTHING
     RETURNING activity_log_id AS "activityLogId", action, category, target, type, summary,
               user_id AS "userId", user_name AS "userName", user_role AS "userRole",
               created_at AS "createdAt"`,
    [
      activityLogId,
      event.action,
      event.category ?? null,
      event.target ?? null,
      event.summary ?? null,
      event.actorUserId ?? null,
    ],
  );
  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
}

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

  return `/api/v1/finance/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/movements`;

async function fetchAllPages<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  path: string,
  query: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined> = {}
): Promise<T[]> {
  const rows: T[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < MAX_ROWS; offset += PAGE_SIZE) {
    const response = await apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiPage<T>>>(path, {
      ...query,
      limit: PAGE_SIZE,
      offset,
    });
    const page = Array.isArray(response.data)
      ? response.data
      : (response.data.items ?? []);
    rows.push(...page);
    const total = Number(response.meta?.total ?? rows.length);
    if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE || rows.length >= total) break;
  }
  return rows;
}

async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  collectionName: string
): Promise<T[]> {
  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
  if (!path)
    throw new Error(`FINANCE_API_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED:${collectionName}`);
  const rows = await fetchAllPages<T>(path, collectionName === "accounts" ? { includeInactive: true } : {});
  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];
}

import { Pool, type PoolConfig } from 'pg';
import { drizzle, type NodePgDatabase } from 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres';
import * as schema from './schema';

export interface DatabaseConnection {
  pool: Pool;
  db: NodePgDatabase<typeof schema>;
}

export interface DatabasePoolOptions {
  connectionString: string;
  nodeEnv: 'development' | 'test' | 'production';
  sslMode: 'disable' | 'require' | 'verify-full';
  sslCaPem?: string;
  runtimeRole?: 'alx_api_runtime';
  maxConnections?: number;
  connectionTimeoutMs?: number;
  idleTimeoutMs?: number;
}

export function createDatabaseConnection(options: DatabasePoolOptions): DatabaseConnection {
  const connectionUrl = new URL(options.connectionString);
  connectionUrl.searchParams.delete('sslmode');
  connectionUrl.searchParams.delete('sslrootcert');
  if (options.sslMode === 'verify-full' && !options.sslCaPem) {
    throw new Error('DATABASE_SSL_CA_REQUIRED');
  }
  if (options.runtimeRole && options.nodeEnv === 'production') {
    throw new Error('DATABASE_RUNTIME_ROLE_OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PRODUCTION');
  }
  const config: PoolConfig = {
    connectionString: connectionUrl.toString(),
    ssl:
      options.sslMode === 'disable'
        ? undefined
        : options.sslMode === 'verify-full'
          ? { ca: options.sslCaPem, rejectUnauthorized: true }
          : { rejectUnauthorized: false },
    ...(options.runtimeRole ? { options: '-c role=alx_api_runtime' } : {}),
    max: options.maxConnections ?? 10,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: options.connectionTimeoutMs ?? 15_000,
    idleTimeoutMillis: options.idleTimeoutMs ?? 30_000,
  };
  const pool = new Pool(config);
  pool.on('error', (error: Error) => {
    // Never log the connection string or query values.
    console.error('[alx_api] idle PostgreSQL client error', { name: error.name });
  });

  return { pool, db: drizzle(pool, { schema }) };
}

35	        `INSERT INTO public.settings (setting_id, category, data, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
36	         VALUES ($1, $1, $2::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), $3, $3)
37	         ON CONFLICT (setting_id) DO UPDATE SET
38	           category = EXCLUDED.category,
39	           data = COALESCE(public.settings.data, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.data,
40	           updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
41	         RETURNING ${settingsColumns}`,
42	        [category, JSON.stringify(settings), actorId],
43	      );
44	      const row = result.rows[0];

88	export function createReportingRepository(pool: Pool): ReportingRepository {
89	  return {
90	    async list(resource, query) {
91	      const definition = definitions[resource];
92	      const values: unknown[] = [];
93	      const filters: string[] = [];
94	      if (query.search) {
95	        values.push(`%${query.search}%`);
96	        const placeholder = `$${values.length}`;
97	        filters.push(`(${definition.searchColumns.map((column) => `${column} ILIKE ${placeholder}`).join(' OR ')})`);
98	      }
99	      const where = filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';
100	      values.push(query.limit, query.offset);
101	      const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
102	        `SELECT ${definition.columns}, count(*) OVER()::text AS _total FROM ${definition.from} ${where} ORDER BY ${definition.orderBy} LIMIT $${values.length - 1} OFFSET $${values.length}`,
103	        values,
104	      );
105	      return {
106	        items: result.rows.map(({ _total: _ignored, ...row }) => definition.map?.(row) ?? (row as ReportingRow)),
107	        total: Number(result.rows[0]?._total ?? 0),
108	      };
109	    },
110	  };
111	}

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id text, p_payment_amount numeric, p_entry jsonb, p_updated_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  order_record public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_order_data jsonb;
  v_old_paid numeric;
  v_old_remaining numeric;
  v_total numeric;
  v_new_paid numeric;
  v_new_remaining numeric;
  v_payment_status text;
  v_entry_result jsonb;
  v_party_account_id text;
BEGIN
  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_order_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف الطلب مطلوب.';
  END IF;
  IF p_payment_amount IS NULL OR p_payment_amount <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';
  END IF;
  IF p_entry IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_entry) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات سند القبض مطلوبة.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO order_record FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  v_order_data := COALESCE(order_record.data, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_old_paid := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_order_data->>'amountPaid', '')::numeric, 0);
  v_total := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'totalAmount', '')::numeric,
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'totalCostYER', '')::numeric,
    0
  );
  v_old_remaining := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'amountRemaining', '')::numeric,
    GREATEST(v_total - v_old_paid, 0)
  );

  IF p_payment_amount > (v_old_remaining + 0.01) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي للطلب. المتبقي: %, الدفعة: %',
      round(v_old_remaining, 2), round(p_payment_amount, 2);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'orderId', '') <> p_order_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مرجع الطلب في سند القبض غير مطابق.';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryTypeId', '') <> 'type_order_payment' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تحصيل الطلب يجب أن يستخدم نوع قيد دفعة الطلب.';
  END IF;

  v_party_account_id := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(btrim(v_order_data->>'orderPartyAccountId'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(v_order_data->>'customerAccountId'), '')
  );
  IF v_party_account_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب لا يحمل حسابًا ماليًا لطرف التحصيل.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_entry->'lines', '[]'::jsonb)) AS line(value)
    WHERE line.value->>'transType' = 'Credit'
      AND line.value->>'accountId' = v_party_account_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الساق الدائنة في سند القبض يجب أن تطابق حساب طرف الطلب.';
  END IF;

  IF p_updated_by_uid IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE user_id = p_updated_by_uid)
  THEN
    p_updated_by_uid := NULL;
  END IF;

  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(p_entry);

  v_new_paid := v_old_paid + p_payment_amount;
  v_new_remaining := GREATEST(v_old_remaining - p_payment_amount, 0);
  v_payment_status := CASE WHEN v_new_remaining <= 0.005 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Partial Paid' END;

  UPDATE public.orders
  SET data = v_order_data || jsonb_build_object(
    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,
    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.secure_record_order_payment(p_order_id text, p_payment_amount numeric, p_entry jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE v_actor_id text; v_payload jsonb; v_result jsonb; BEGIN v_actor_id := public.require_financial_permission('create_receipt_vouchers'); v_payload := jsonb_set(COALESCE(p_entry, '{}'::jsonb), '{createdByUid}', to_jsonb(v_actor_id), true); PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_update_history', 'on', true); v_result := public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id, p_payment_amount, v_payload, v_actor_id); PERFORM public.replace_financial_entry_payment_details(v_result->>'entryId', v_payload->'paymentDetails', v_actor_id); RETURN v_result; END; $function$

function entryPayload(input: CreateEntryInput): Record<string, unknown> {
  const firstLine = input.lines[0];
  if (!firstLine) throw new Error('FINANCIAL_ENTRY_LINES_REQUIRED');
  return {
    entryNumber: input.entryNumber,
    moduleId: input.moduleId,
    entryTypeId: input.entryTypeId,
    entryCategory: input.entryCategory,
    postingStatus: input.postingStatus,
    amountOriginal: String(firstLine.amountOriginal),
    currencyOriginalNo: String(firstLine.currencyOriginalNo),
    currencyPriceId: input.lines[0]?.currencyPriceId ? String(input.lines[0].currencyPriceId) : '',
    currencyPriceSeq: input.lines[0]?.currencyPriceSeq ? String(input.lines[0].currencyPriceSeq) : '',
    description: input.description,
    notes: input.notes ?? '',
    attachments: input.attachments ?? [],
    paymentMethod: input.paymentMethod ?? '',
    orderId: input.orderId ?? '',
    shipmentId: input.shipmentId ?? '',
    custodyId: input.custodyId ?? '',
    automationKey: input.automationKey ?? '',
    autoRuleId: input.autoRuleId ?? '',
    isAutomatic: input.isAutomatic ?? false,
    effectiveAt: input.effectiveAt ?? '',
    createdByUid: input.createdByUid,
    lines: input.lines.map((line) => ({
      ...line,
      amount: String(line.amount),
      amountOriginal: String(line.amountOriginal),
      accountCurNo: String(line.accountCurNo),
      currencyOriginalNo: String(line.currencyOriginalNo),
    })),
  };
}

// الفئات الإضافية تخزّن مستندات {data:[...]} مثلما كان يقرأها الواجهة القديمة.
// Extra categories store {data:[...]} documents exactly as the legacy settings docs did.
export type SettingsCategory = 'general' | 'logistics' | 'whatsapp' | 'expense_categories' | 'automatic_voucher_rules';

export interface SettingsRecord {
  settingId: string;
  category: string;
  settings: Record<string, unknown>;
  createdAt: string | null;
  updatedAt: string | null;
  createdBy: string | null;
  updatedBy: string | null;
}

export type UserSettingsData = {
  language?: 'ar' | 'en' | undefined;
  theme?: 'light' | 'dark' | undefined;
  fontSize?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | undefined;
  dashboardGridColumns?: number | undefined;
  visibleMetrics?: string[] | undefined;
  sidebarCollapsed?: boolean | undefined;
  sidebarItems?: string[] | undefined;
};

export interface UserSettingsRecord {
  userSettingId: string;
  userId: string | null;
  settings: UserSettingsData;
  createdAt: string | null;
  updatedAt: string | null;
  createdBy: string | null;
  updatedBy: string | null;
}

export interface SettingsRepository {
  get(category: SettingsCategory): Promise<SettingsRecord | null>;
  update(category: SettingsCategory, settings: Record<string, unknown>, actorId: string): Promise<SettingsRecord>;
  getUser(userId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord | null>;
  updateUser(userId: string, settings: UserSettingsData, actorId: string): Promise<UserSettingsRecord>;
}
=== ROUTES ===
import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { SettingsRepository } from './settings.contracts';
import { updateSettingsSchema, updateUserSettingsSchema } from './settings.schemas';

const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {
  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
  // الإعدادات المشتركة بيانات مرجعية تحتاجها كل واجهة (SettingsContext) — القراءة مصادقة فقط.
  // Shared settings are reference data needed by every client (SettingsContext) — reads require authentication only.
  // الكتابة العامة تبقى محمية بصلاحية edit_general_settings، وإعدادات المستخدم خاصة بصاحبها (userId من الرمز).
  for (const category of ['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules'] as const) {
    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
      try {
        const record = await repository.get(category);
        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
      const actor = principal(response);
      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
      catch (error) { return next(error); }
    });
  }
  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (_request, response, next) => {
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actor = principal(response);
    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
    catch (error) { return next(error); }
  });
}

-- 0031_flatten_settings.sql
-- تسطير الإعدادات: جدول لكل فئة إعدادات بأعمدة حقيقية، والجداول التابعة للمصفوفات.
-- Flattens settings: one table per settings category with real columns, child tables for the arrays.
-- لا يبقى أي مستند jsonb في الإعدادات بعد هذا الترحيل. — no jsonb document survives in settings.
--
-- ترتيب التنفيذ: هذا الترحيل يقرأ public.settings.data، لذا يجب أن يسبق 0034.
-- إن كان العمود قد حُذف مسبقاً فإن التنفيذ يتوقف برسالة واضحة بدل فشل نصفي.
-- Ordering: run before 0034 (it reads the settings payload); a missing payload stops with a clear message.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'settings' AND column_name = 'data'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '0031 must run before 0034: public.settings.data is already gone.'
      USING HINT = 'Restoring settings from the payload is impossible after the drop; verify the flat tables instead.';
  END IF;
END
$$;

import { ApiClient } from './api-client';
import type { SettingsApiDto, UserSettingsApiDto, SystemSettingsData } from '../dtos/settings.dto';

export interface ApiCurrencyDto {
  currencyId: number;
  code: string;
  mainNameAr: string;
  subNameAr: string | null;
  mainNameEn: string | null;
  subNameEn: string | null;
  symbol: string;
  flag: string | null;
  isDefault: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  currentPrice: number | null;
  lastSeq: number | null;
  lastUpdateBy: string | null;
  lastUpdateDate: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyRateDto {
  rateId: number;
  currencyId: number;
  price: number;
  dayDate: string;
  sequence: number;
  updatedBy: string | null;
  createdAt: string | null;
}

export interface ApiCurrencyCreateInput {
  code: string;
  mainNameAr: string;
  subNameAr?: string | null;
  mainNameEn?: string | null;
  subNameEn?: string | null;
  symbol: string;
  flag?: string | null;
  isDefault?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
}

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

export const settingsCurrenciesApiGateway = {
  async getSettings(category: 'general' | 'logistics' | 'whatsapp'): Promise<SettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<SettingsApiDto>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`);
    return response.data;
  },
  async updateSettings(category: 'general' | 'logistics' | 'whatsapp', settings: Partial<SystemSettingsData>): Promise<SettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<SettingsApiDto>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, { settings });
    return response.data;
  },
  async getUserSettings(): Promise<UserSettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<UserSettingsApiDto>>('/api/v1/settings/user');
    return response.data;
  },
  async updateUserSettings(settings: Partial<Pick<SystemSettingsData, 'language' | 'theme' | 'fontSize' | 'dashboardGridColumns' | 'visibleMetrics'>>): Promise<UserSettingsApiDto> {
    const response = await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<UserSettingsApiDto>>('/api/v1/settings/user', { settings });
    return response.data;
  },
  async listCurrencies(activeOnly = true): Promise<ApiCurrencyDto[]> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyDto[]>>(`/api/v1/currencies?activeOnly=${activeOnly ? 'true' : 'false'}`);
    return response.data;
  },
  async createCurrency(data: ApiCurrencyCreateInput): Promise<ApiCurrencyDto> {
    const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyDto>>('/api/v1/currencies', {
      ...data,
      isDefault: data.isDefault ?? false,
      isActive: data.isActive ?? true,
    });
    return response.data;
  },
  async updateCurrency(currencyId: number, data: Partial<ApiCurrencyCreateInput>): Promise<ApiCurrencyDto> {
    const response = await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyDto>>(`/api/v1/currencies/${currencyId}`, data);
    return response.data;
  },
  async deleteCurrency(currencyId: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const response = await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<{ deleted: boolean }>>(`/api/v1/currencies/${currencyId}`);
    return response.data?.deleted ?? true;
  },
  async getCurrencyRates(currencyId: number): Promise<ApiCurrencyRateDto[]> {
    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiCurrencyRateDto[]>>(`/api/v1/currencies/${currencyId}/rates`);
    return response.data;
  },

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.settings_report_account (
  settings_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'report_accounts',

  account_id text NOT NULL,
  seq integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

);

INSERT INTO public.settings_report_account (settings_key, account_group, account_id, seq)
     SELECT 'report_accounts', g.key, btrim(x.value), (x.ordinality)::integer
       FROM public.settings s
       JOIN jsonb_each(s.data) g(key, value) ON jsonb_typeof(g.value) = 'array'
       CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(g.value) WITH ORDINALITY x(value, ordinality)
      WHERE s.setting_id = 'report_accounts'
     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  label_en text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

  is_system boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  account_id text,
  account_code text,
  seq integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

INSERT INTO public.expense_category (category_id, label_ar, label_en, icon, is_system, account_id, account_code, seq)
     SELECT x.value->>'id', COALESCE(x.value->>'labelAr', ''), COALESCE(x.value->>'labelEn', ''),
            COALESCE(x.value->>'icon', ''), COALESCE(alx_api_private.payload_boolean(x.value, 'isSystem'), false),
            x.value->>'accountId', x.value->>'accountCode', (x.ordinality)::integer
       FROM public.settings s,
            jsonb_array_elements(s.data->'data') WITH ORDINALITY x(value, ordinality)
      WHERE s.setting_id = 'expense_categories' AND jsonb_typeof(s.data->'data') = 'array'
        AND COALESCE(x.value->>'id', '') <> ''
     ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

interface SettingsRecord {
  settingId?: string;
  category?: string;
  settings?: { data?: unknown };
}

/** المستند القديم يخزن المصفوفة داخل settings.data — نقبل الصفوف الصالحة فقط. */
function asCategoryList(value: unknown): ExpenseCategory[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.filter(
    (entry): entry is ExpenseCategory =>
      Boolean(entry) && typeof entry === 'object' && typeof (entry as ExpenseCategory).id === 'string',
  );
}

async function readStored(): Promise<ExpenseCategory[]> {
  try {
    const response = await appApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<SettingsRecord>>(SETTINGS_PATH);
    return asCategoryList(response?.data?.settings?.data);
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as { code?: string } | null)?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return [];
    throw error;
  }
}

 * Reads a settings document, treating "not stored yet" as null instead of an error.
 */
async function readSettingsRecord(category: string): Promise<{ settings?: unknown } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await financeApiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<{ settings?: unknown }>>(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`);
    return res?.data ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as { code?: string })?.code === 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND') return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

    private resolveAutomaticVoucherAccount(
    accountConfig: any,
    systemAccounts: Record<string, string>,
    order: any,
    entities: AutomaticVoucherEntities,
  ): { id: string; code: string } {
    return resolveAutomaticVoucherAccount(accountConfig, systemAccounts, order, entities);

  /**
   * Generates strictly unique, non-colliding account identifiers:
   * accountNumber, accountCode, code, and accountId.
   * Checks ALL existing accounts in database to ensure zero collisions.
=== auto voucher patch 745-775 ===
  async ensureAutomaticVoucherRules(): Promise<any[]> {
    const normalizedDefaultRules = buildDefaultAutomaticVoucherRules();

    try {
      const record = await readSettingsRecord('automatic_voucher_rules');
      const storedRules = (record?.settings as { data?: unknown } | undefined)?.data;
      const currentRules: any[] = Array.isArray(storedRules) ? storedRules : [];

      const existingRulesIds = new Set(currentRules.map((rule) => rule?.id));
      const missingRules = normalizedDefaultRules.filter((rule: any) => !existingRulesIds.has(rule.id));
      if (record && missingRules.length === 0) return currentRules;

      const mergedRules = [...currentRules, ...missingRules];
      try {
        await financeApiClient.patch<ApiEnvelope<unknown>>('/api/v1/settings/automatic_voucher_rules', {
          settings: { data: mergedRules },
        });
      } catch (writeError) {
        // الحفظ يحتاج edit_general_settings؛ القارئ بلا صلاحية يستعمل القواعد المدموجة محلياً.
        // Seeding needs edit_general_settings; a read-only user still gets the merged rules locally.
        console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] تعذر حفظ قواعد القيود التلقائية في الإعدادات:', writeError);
      }

      return mergedRules;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(
        "[FinancialAccountService] Failed to seed automatic voucher rules:",
        e,
      );
      return normalizedDefaultRules;
    }

import { z } from 'zod';

const settingsObject = z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).refine((value) => Object.keys(value).length <= 200, {
  message: 'Too many settings fields.',
});

export const settingsCategorySchema = z.enum(['general', 'logistics', 'whatsapp', 'expense_categories', 'automatic_voucher_rules']);
export const updateSettingsSchema = z.object({ settings: settingsObject }).strict();

export const userSettingsSchema = z.object({
  language: z.enum(['ar', 'en']).optional(),
  theme: z.enum(['light', 'dark']).optional(),
  fontSize: z.enum(['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl']).optional(),
  dashboardGridColumns: z.number().int().min(1).max(12).optional(),
  visibleMetrics: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(100).optional(),
  sidebarCollapsed: z.boolean().optional(),
  sidebarItems: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(100)).max(100).optional(),
}).strict();
export const updateUserSettingsSchema = z.object({ settings: userSettingsSchema }).strict();

export const currencyCodeSchema = z.string().trim().regex(/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_-]{1,9}$/);
export const currencyIdSchema = z.coerce.number().int().positive();
export const listCurrenciesQuerySchema = z.object({
  activeOnly: z.enum(['true', 'false']).default('false').transform((value) => value === 'true'),
});
export const createCurrencySchema = z.object({
  code: currencyCodeSchema,
  mainNameAr: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120),
  subNameAr: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().nullable(),
  mainNameEn: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().nullable(),
  subNameEn: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().nullable(),
  symbol: z.string().trim().min(1).max(20),
  flag: z.string().trim().max(20).optional().nullable(),
  isDefault: z.boolean().default(false),
  isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
}).strict();
export const updateCurrencySchema = createCurrencySchema.partial().strict();
export const createCurrencyRateSchema = z.object({
  price: z.coerce.number().finite().positive(),
  dayDate: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
}).strict();

async function fetchRules(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
  const rows = await readFinanceRows('/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules', { limit: 1000, offset: 0 });
  return (rows as AutoEntryRuleRow[]).map(fromApiRow);
}

export const autoEntryService = {
  /**
   * قراءة القواعد كما هي من alx_api بلا بذر وبلا ابتلاع للأخطاء — تستخدمها الواجهات التي يجب أن تُظهر الفشل.
   * Reads the stored rules as-is (no seeding, no swallowed errors) for UI providers that must surface failures.
   */
  async loadRules(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
    return fetchRules();
  },

  /**
   * قراءة القواعد من API وبذر الافتراضيات إن كانت فارغة.
   * Reads rules from the API and seeds the defaults when the table is empty.
   */
  async ensureAutoEntries(): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
    try {
      const rules = await fetchRules();
      if (rules.length > 0) return rules;
      for (const rule of DEFAULT_AUTO_ENTRIES) {
        await financeApiClient.post('/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules', { autoEntryId: rule.id, ...toApiPayload(rule) });
      }
      return fetchRules();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[autoEntryService] ensureAutoEntries failed:', err);
      return [];
    }
  },

  /**
   * Get auto entries linked to a specific statusId
   */
  async getAutoEntriesForStatus(statusId: number | string): Promise<AutoEntryRule[]> {
    try {
      const all = await this.ensureAutoEntries();
      const numId = typeof statusId === 'number' ? statusId : parseInt(String(statusId), 10);
      return all.filter(r => (r.statusId === numId || String(r.statusId) === String(statusId)) && r.isActive);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[autoEntryService] getAutoEntriesForStatus failed:', err);
      return [];
    }
  },

  /**
   * إنشاء أو تحديث قاعدة قيد تلقائي — create or update through the API.
   */
  async saveAutoEntry(rule: AutoEntryRule): Promise<void> {
    const payload = toApiPayload(rule);
    const id = rule.id || `auto_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
    if (rule.id) {
      try {
        await financeApiClient.patch(`/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules/${encodeURIComponent(rule.id)}`, payload);
        return;
      } catch (error) {
        // قاعدة غير موجودة بعد → أنشئها بالمعرّف نفسه (upsert سابق عبر setDoc).
        // Rule not stored yet → create it with the same id (previous setDoc upsert behaviour).
        if ((error as { code?: string }).code !== 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND') throw error;
      }
    }
    await financeApiClient.post('/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules', { autoEntryId: id, ...payload });
  },

  /**
   * Delete an auto entry rule
   */
  async deleteAutoEntry(ruleId: string): Promise<void> {
    await financeApiClient.delete(`/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules/${encodeURIComponent(ruleId)}`);
  },

export type ApiResult<T = unknown> = ApiSuccess<T> | ApiError;

// ── أخطاء API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class AlxApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: string,
    message: string,
    public readonly statusCode: number,
    public readonly requestId: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AlxApiError';
  }
}

// ── دالة التجديد التلقائي للـ Access Token ────────────────────────────────────

let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;

/** تجديد Access Token تلقائيًا باستخدام Refresh Token */
async function refreshAccessToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  // منع التجديد المتعدد في نفس الوقت
  if (refreshPromise) return refreshPromise;

  const refreshToken = getStoredRefreshToken();
  if (!refreshToken || !ALX_API_URL) return null;

  refreshPromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${ALX_API_URL}/api/v1/auth/refresh`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-Request-Id': generateRequestId(),
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        // Refresh Token منتهي أو ملغى — مسح الجلسة
        clearTokens();
        return null;
      }

      const result = (await response.json()) as ApiResult<{
        accessToken: string;
        refreshToken: string;
        sessionId: string;
      }>;

      if (!result.success) {
        clearTokens();
        return null;
      }

      storeTokens(result.data.accessToken, result.data.refreshToken, result.data.sessionId);
      return result.data.accessToken;
    } catch {
      return null;
    } finally {
      refreshPromise = null;
    }
  })();

  return refreshPromise;
}

/**
 * app-api-client.ts
 * عميل HTTP واحد للتطبيق كله — مصدر وحيد لعنوان الخادم ومصنع رمز الوصول وإعدادات إعادة المحاولة.
 * One shared ApiClient for the whole app: a single source of truth for the base URL,
 * the access-token factory and the read-retry policy (DRY).
 */
import { ApiClient } from './api-client';

/** عنوان alx_api — يمكن تجاوزه بمتغيرات البيئة. API base URL, overridable per environment. */
export const APP_API_BASE_URL: string =
  import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001';

/**
 * قراءة رمز الوصول من جلسة المتصفح فقط — لا يُخزَّن الرمز في أي وحدة أو ذاكرة تخزين دائمة.
 * The access token is read from the browser session on every request; it is never cached in module state.
 */
function readAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
  return sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
}

/** لا إعادة محاولة للقراءة: الأخطاء يجب أن تظهر للواجهة فوراً بدل إخفائها بمحاولة ثانية. */
export const appApiClient = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: APP_API_BASE_URL,
  accessTokenFactory: readAccessToken,
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

/** غلاف الاستجابة الموحّد لكل مسارات alx_api — Unified response envelope of every alx_api route. */
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: { total?: number };
}

-- 0036_fix_order_deletion.sql
-- إصلاح حذف الطلبات: كان الدالة تحذف الشحنات قبل سجلّاتها، فيفشل الحذف بـ 23503
-- (orders_history.shipment_id → shipments بـ NO ACTION).
-- Order-deletion fix: the RPC deleted shipments before their history rows, so every real
-- deletion aborted with 23503 (orders_history.shipment_id → shipments is ON DELETE NO ACTION).
-- Also removes the dead jsonb predicates: no notification or whatsapp log row carries an order
-- reference (verified on the live database: 0 of 201 notifications, 0 of 19 logs), so reading
-- data->>'orderId' deleted nothing while blocking the 0034 jsonb cleanup.
-- Date: 2026-10-15

BEGIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
-- منع انتحال search_path عند تنفيذ الدالة بصلاحيات المالك — fixed search_path, no hijack.
SET search_path = pg_catalog
AS $function$
DECLARE
...
-- 0037_sync_order_status_id_from_text.sql
-- إصلاح تباعد المرحلة: المسارات القديمة كانت تكتب نص الحالة (orders.order_status1) دون تحديث
-- orders.order_status_id، فبقي المعرّف قديمًا وتظهر الواجهة مرحلة لا تطابق ما يراه المشغّل.
-- Stage divergence repair: legacy write paths updated only the status text (orders.order_status1)
-- and never orders.order_status_id, so the stage id went stale while the text stayed current.
-- النص هو المرجح هنا لأنه آخر ما كتبه المشغّل؛ تُعاد تهيئة المعرّف منه فقط.
-- The text is authoritative because it is the operator's most recent write; only the id is re-seeded from it.
-- Date: 2026-10-15

BEGIN;

-- 1) إعادة تهيئة معرّف المرحلة من اسمها العربي المطابق حرفيًا لكتالوج المراحل.
--    Re-seed the stage id from the Arabic catalog name matched exactly (trim-only, no fuzzy match).
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(os.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id;

-- 2) الاسم الإنجليزي احتياطيًا للصفوف التي لا تحمل اسمًا عربيًا مطابقًا.
--    English names cover rows whose text carries the English label instead of the Arabic one.
UPDATE public.orders AS o
   SET order_status_id = os.order_status_id
  FROM public.order_status AS os
 WHERE btrim(coalesce(os.name_en, '')) <> ''
   AND btrim(os.name_en) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   AND o.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM os.order_status_id
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM public.order_status ar WHERE btrim(ar.name_ar) = btrim(o.order_status1)
   );

128	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
129	-- 4. سجل الطلبات: تغييرات الحقل صفوف بدل كائنات before/after.
130	--    Order history: each changed field becomes a row instead of before/after jsonb blobs.
131	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
132	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.orders_history_change (
133	  orders_history_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders_history (orders_history_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
134	  field_name text NOT NULL,
135	  old_value text,
136	  new_value text,
137	  PRIMARY KEY (orders_history_id, field_name)
138	);
139	
140	DO $$
141	BEGIN
142	  IF NOT EXISTS (
143	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
144	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders_history'
145	       AND column_name = 'after_data' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
146	  ) THEN
147	    RETURN;
148	  END IF;
149	
150	  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
151	       SELECT h.orders_history_id, x.key,
152	              COALESCE(h.before_data #>> ARRAY[x.key], (h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key])),
153	              COALESCE(h.after_data #>> ARRAY[x.key], (h.after_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key]))
154	         FROM public.orders_history h,
155	              jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)
156	        WHERE COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data) IS NOT NULL
157	          AND x.key NOT IN ('data')
158	       ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO NOTHING;
159	
160	  -- تغييرات متداخلة داخل مفتاح data القديم — nested snapshot keys flatten with a dotted path.
161	  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
162	       SELECT h.orders_history_id, 'data.' || x.key,
163	              COALESCE(h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.before_data #>> ARRAY[x.key]),
164	              COALESCE(h.after_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.after_data #>> ARRAY[x.key])
165	         FROM public.orders_history h,
166	              jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data', '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)
167	        WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data')) = 'object'
168	       ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO NOTHING;
169	END
170	$$;
171	
172	-- مفاتيح metadata المعروفة أعمدة حقيقية — known metadata keys become first-class columns.
173	ALTER TABLE public.orders_history
174	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS trigger_name text,
175	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS changed_fields text[],
176	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deleted_order_id text,
177	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_reference text,
178	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS activity_target text,
179	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS activity_action text,
180	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS activity_details text;
181	
182	DO $$
183	BEGIN
184	  IF NOT EXISTS (
185	    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
186	     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders_history'
187	       AND column_name = 'metadata' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
188	  ) THEN
189	    RETURN;
190	  END IF;
191	
192	  UPDATE public.orders_history
193	     SET trigger_name       = COALESCE(NULLIF(trigger_name, ''), metadata->>'trigger'),
194	         deleted_order_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(deleted_order_id, ''), metadata->>'deletedOrderId'),
195	         order_reference    = COALESCE(NULLIF(order_reference, ''), metadata->>'orderReference'),
196	         activity_target    = COALESCE(NULLIF(activity_target, ''), metadata->>'activityTarget'),
197	         activity_action    = COALESCE(NULLIF(activity_action, ''), metadata->>'activityAction'),
198	         activity_details   = COALESCE(NULLIF(activity_details, ''), metadata->>'activityDetails'),
199	         changed_fields     = COALESCE(changed_fields,
200	             (SELECT array_agg(btrim(y.value)) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(metadata->'changedFields', '[]'::jsonb)) y(value)
201	               WHERE jsonb_typeof(metadata->'changedFields') = 'array')),
202	         main_entry_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(main_entry_id, ''), alx_api_private.payload_text(metadata, 'mainEntryId')),
203	         shipment_id        = COALESCE(NULLIF(shipment_id, ''), alx_api_private.payload_text(metadata, 'shipmentId')),
204	         account_trans_count = COALESCE(account_trans_count, alx_api_private.cast_integer(metadata->>'accountTransCount'))
205	   WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object';
206	END
207	$$;
208

210	-- 5. الفهارس والصلاحيات — indexes and grants (alx_api_runtime بلا DDL).
211	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
212	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_history_change_history_idx ON public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id);
213	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS role_permission_role_idx ON public.role_permission (role_id);
214	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS role_permission_code_idx ON public.role_permission (permission_code);
215	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS report_template_filter_template_idx ON public.report_template_filter (report_template_id);
216	
217	ALTER TABLE public.role_permission DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
218	ALTER TABLE public.report_exchange_rate DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
219	ALTER TABLE public.report_template_filter DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
220	ALTER TABLE public.orders_history_change DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
221	
222	GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE
223	  public.role_permission, public.report_exchange_rate, public.report_template_filter,
224	  public.orders_history_change, public.orders_history, public.report_templates, public.report_settings, public.roles
