--- public.orders_history_from_activity_logs ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_activity_logs()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  activity_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;
  activity_action text := lower(COALESCE(activity_row->>'action', ''));
  order_ref text := COALESCE(activity_row->'data'->'details'->>'orderId', activity_row->'data'->'details'->>'order_id', activity_row->'data'->'details'->>'orderNumber', activity_row->'data'->>'orderId', activity_row->'data'->>'order_id', activity_row->'data'->>'orderNumber', activity_row->>'target');
  resolved_order record;
  event_summary text;
BEGIN
  IF activity_action = ANY (ARRAY['add_order', 'edit_order', 'edit_delivered_order', 'delete_order']) THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);
  IF resolved_order.order_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
  END IF;
  event_summary := CASE activity_action
    WHEN 'add_payment' THEN 'تم تسجيل دفعة مرتبطة بالطلب'
    WHEN 'financial_transaction' THEN 'تم تسجيل حركة مالية مرتبطة بالطلب'
    WHEN 'account_order_charge' THEN 'تم تسجيل استحقاق مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
    WHEN 'account_payment_received' THEN 'تم تسجيل تحصيل مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
    ELSE 'تم تسجيل نشاط تشغيلي مرتبط بالطلب'
  END;
  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
    resolved_order.order_id, resolved_order.order_number, NULL, NULL, NULL, COALESCE(NEW.activity_log_id, OLD.activity_log_id),
    'activity.' || COALESCE(NULLIF(activity_action, ''), lower(TG_OP)), 'activity', lower(TG_OP), 'activity_log', 'activity_log', event_summary,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,
    jsonb_build_object('activityAction', activity_action, 'activityTarget', activity_row->>'target', 'activityDetails', COALESCE(activity_row->'data'->'details', activity_row->'data', '{}'::jsonb), 'trigger', TG_NAME),
    activity_row->>'userId', activity_row->'data'->>'userName', activity_row->'data'->>'userRole'
  );
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$


===== main_entry :: trg_orders_history_main_entry_financial =====
--- public.orders_history_from_main_entry ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_main_entry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order_id text;
  v_order_number text;
  v_actor record;
  v_line_count integer;
  v_event_type text;
  v_summary text;
  v_amount_original numeric;
  v_currency_original_no integer;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.posting_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.posting_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF NEW.order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  v_order_id := NEW.order_id;
  IF v_order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT s.order_id INTO v_order_id FROM public.shipments s WHERE s.shipment_id = NEW.shipment_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT o.order_number INTO v_order_number FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_id = v_order_id;
  IF v_order_id IS NULL OR v_order_number IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_actor FROM public.orders_history_actor(COALESCE(NEW.posted_by_uid, NEW.voided_by_uid, NEW.updated_by_uid, NEW.created_by_uid));
  
  -- تحديث: استخدام main_entry_id بدلاً من entry_id
  -- Updated: use main_entry_id instead of entry_id
  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(amount_original) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'Debit'), 0), COALESCE(MAX(currency_original_no), 1)
  INTO v_line_count, v_amount_original, v_currency_original_no
  FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = NEW.main_entry_id;

  v_event_type := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'financial.entry_posted' WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'financial.entry_voided' ELSE 'financial.entry_status_changed' END;
  v_summary := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'تم ترحيل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'تم إبطال قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' ELSE 'تم تغيير حالة قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END;

  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (
    orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, source, summary, after_data, metadata, main_entry_id, account_trans_count, occurred_at, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    'oh_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || txid_current()::text), 1, 24),
    v_order_id, v_order_number, NEW.shipment_id, v_event_type, 'financial', lower(NEW.posting_status), 'main_entry',
    v_actor.actor_id, v_actor.actor_name, v_actor.actor_role, 'financial_trigger', v_summary,
    jsonb_build_object('entryNumber', NEW.entry_number, 'entryCategory', NEW.entry_category, 'postingStatus', NEW.posting_status, 'amountOriginal', v_amount_original, 'currencyOriginalNo', v_currency_original_no, 'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method, 'description', NEW.description, 'effectiveAt', NEW.effective_at),
    jsonb_build_object('mainEntryId', NEW.main_entry_id, 'accountTransCount', v_line_count, 'orderId', NEW.order_id, 'shipmentId', NEW.shipment_id, 'trigger', TG_NAME),
    NEW.main_entry_id, v_line_count, now(), now()
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$


===== orders :: orders_history_orders_audit =====
--- public.orders_history_from_orders ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_orders()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  before_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;
  after_row  jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;
  changed_fields text[] := public.orders_history_changed_fields(before_row, after_row);
  event_name    text;
  event_summary text;
  order_ref     text;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND current_setting('swiftship.suppress_order_update_history', true) = 'on' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND current_setting('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', true) = 'on' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND COALESCE(array_length(changed_fields, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  order_ref := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN NULL
                    ELSE COALESCE(NEW.order_id::text, OLD.order_id::text)
               END;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    event_name    := 'order.created';
    event_summary := 'تم إنشاء الطلب';
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    event_name    := 'order.deleted';
    event_summary := 'تم حذف الطلب';
  ELSIF OLD.order_status_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_status_id THEN
    event_name    := 'order.status_changed';
    event_summary := 'تم تحديث حالة الطلب';
  ELSE
    event_name    := 'order.updated';
    event_summary := 'تم تعديل بيانات الطلب';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
    order_ref,
    COALESCE(NEW.order_number, OLD.order_number),
    NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    event_name, 'order', lower(TG_OP), 'order', 'database_trigger',
    event_summary, before_row, after_row,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'changedFields', changed_fields,
      'changes', public.orders_history_change_details(before_row, after_row),
      'deletedOrderId', CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD.order_id ELSE NULL END,
      'trigger', TG_NAME
    )
  );

  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$

--- public.orders_history_from_shipments ---
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_shipments()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  before_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END;
  after_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;
  changed_fields text[] := public.orders_history_changed_fields(before_row, after_row);
  resolved_order record;
  order_ref text := COALESCE(NEW.order_id, OLD.order_id);
  shipment_ref text := COALESCE(NEW.shipment_id, OLD.shipment_id);
  event_name text;
  event_summary text;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND COALESCE(array_length(changed_fields, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    event_name := 'shipment.created';
    event_summary := 'تم إنشاء شحنة مرتبطة بالطلب';
  ELSIF OLD.shipment_status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.shipment_status THEN
    event_name := 'shipment.status_changed';
    event_summary := 'تم تحديث حالة الشحنة';
  ELSE
    event_name := 'shipment.updated';
    event_summary := 'تم تعديل بيانات الشحنة';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
    resolved_order.order_id,
    resolved_order.order_number,
    shipment_ref, NULL, NULL, NULL,
    event_name, 'shipment', lower(TG_OP), 'shipment', 'database_trigger', event_summary,
    before_row, after_row,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'changedFields', changed_fields,
      'changes', public.orders_history_change_details(before_row, after_row),
      'orderReference', order_ref,
      'trigger', TG_NAME
    )
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

########## orders_history_write ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_write(p_order_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_order_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_shipment_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_journal_entry_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_transaction_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_activity_log_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_event_type text DEFAULT 'custom'::text, p_event_category text DEFAULT 'general'::text, p_operation text DEFAULT 'custom'::text, p_entity_type text DEFAULT 'custom'::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'database'::text, p_summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_before_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_after_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_actor_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_role text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  actor_record record;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO actor_record
  FROM public.orders_history_actor(p_actor_id, p_actor_name, p_actor_role);

  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (
    orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id,
    activity_log_id, event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type,
    actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, source, summary,
    before_data, after_data, metadata, occurred_at, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    'oh_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || txid_current()::text), 1, 24),
    p_order_id, p_order_number, p_shipment_id,
    p_activity_log_id, p_event_type, p_event_category, p_operation, p_entity_type,
    actor_record.actor_id, actor_record.actor_name, actor_record.actor_role, COALESCE(p_source, 'database'), p_summary,
    COALESCE(p_before_data, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(p_after_data, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), now(), now()
  );
END;
$function$


########## orders_history_change_details ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_change_details(p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  WITH base_changes AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_before, '{}'::jsonb)) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_after, '{}'::jsonb)) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) <> 'data' AND before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  data_changes AS (
    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_before->'data') = 'object' THEN p_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_after->'data') = 'object' THEN p_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  combined AS (SELECT * FROM base_changes UNION ALL SELECT * FROM data_changes)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, jsonb_build_object('before', before_value, 'after', after_value) ORDER BY key), '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM combined;
$function$


########## orders_history_changed_fields ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_changed_fields(p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(key ORDER BY key), ARRAY[]::text[])
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key
    FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_before, '{}'::jsonb)) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_after, '{}'::jsonb)) AS after_row
      ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ) AS changes;
$function$


########## orders_history_resolve_order ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_resolve_order(p_reference text)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id text, order_number text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number
  FROM public.orders o
  WHERE p_reference IS NOT NULL
    AND (o.order_id = p_reference OR o.order_number = p_reference)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.order_id = p_reference THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  LIMIT 1;
$function$


########## orders_history_actor ##########
[public] CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_actor(p_actor_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_role text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(actor_id text, actor_name text, actor_role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  resolved_actor_id text := COALESCE(p_actor_id, auth.uid()::text);
  jwt_email text := auth.jwt() ->> 'email';
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    resolved_actor_id,
    COALESCE(
      p_actor_name,
      NULLIF(u.username, ''),
      NULLIF(u.email, ''),
      jwt_email,
      'النظام'
    ),
    COALESCE(p_actor_role, NULLIF(u.role, ''), CASE WHEN resolved_actor_id IS NULL THEN 'system' ELSE NULL END)
  FROM (SELECT 1) AS seed
  LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = resolved_actor_id
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

===== record_order_payment_v2 =====
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id text, p_payment_amount numeric, p_entry jsonb, p_updated_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  order_record public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_order_data jsonb;
  v_old_paid numeric;
  v_old_remaining numeric;
  v_total numeric;
  v_new_paid numeric;
  v_new_remaining numeric;
  v_payment_status text;
  v_entry_result jsonb;
  v_party_account_id text;
BEGIN
  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_order_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف الطلب مطلوب.';
  END IF;
  IF p_payment_amount IS NULL OR p_payment_amount <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';
  END IF;
  IF p_entry IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_entry) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات سند القبض مطلوبة.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO order_record FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  v_order_data := COALESCE(order_record.data, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_old_paid := COALESCE(NULLIF(v_order_data->>'amountPaid', '')::numeric, 0);
  v_total := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'totalAmount', '')::numeric,
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'totalCostYER', '')::numeric,
    0
  );
  v_old_remaining := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(v_order_data->>'amountRemaining', '')::numeric,
    GREATEST(v_total - v_old_paid, 0)
  );

  IF p_payment_amount > (v_old_remaining + 0.01) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي للطلب. المتبقي: %, الدفعة: %',
      round(v_old_remaining, 2), round(p_payment_amount, 2);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'orderId', '') <> p_order_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مرجع الطلب في سند القبض غير مطابق.';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryTypeId', '') <> 'type_order_payment' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تحصيل الطلب يجب أن يستخدم نوع قيد دفعة الطلب.';
  END IF;

  v_party_account_id := COALESCE(
    NULLIF(btrim(v_order_data->>'orderPartyAccountId'), ''),
    NULLIF(btrim(v_order_data->>'customerAccountId'), '')
  );
  IF v_party_account_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب لا يحمل حسابًا ماليًا لطرف التحصيل.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_entry->'lines', '[]'::jsonb)) AS line(value)
    WHERE line.value->>'transType' = 'Credit'
      AND line.value->>'accountId' = v_party_account_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الساق الدائنة في سند القبض يجب أن تطابق حساب طرف الطلب.';
  END IF;

  IF p_updated_by_uid IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE user_id = p_updated_by_uid)
  THEN
    p_updated_by_uid := NULL;
  END IF;

  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(p_entry);

  v_new_paid := v_old_paid + p_payment_amount;
  v_new_remaining := GREATEST(v_old_remaining - p_payment_amount, 0);
  v_payment_status := CASE WHEN v_new_remaining <= 0.005 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Partial Paid' END;

  UPDATE public.orders
  SET data = v_order_data || jsonb_build_object(
    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,
    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,
    'paymentStatus', v_payment_status,
    'updatedAt', floor(extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint
  )
  WHERE order_id = p_order_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'orderId', p_order_id,
    'entryId', v_entry_result->>'id',
    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,
    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,
    'paymentStatus', v_payment_status
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.secure_record_order_payment(p_order_id text, p_payment_amount numeric, p_entry jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE v_actor_id text; v_payload jsonb; v_result jsonb; BEGIN v_actor_id := public.require_financial_permission('create_receipt_vouchers'); v_payload := jsonb_set(COALESCE(p_entry, '{}'::jsonb), '{createdByUid}', to_jsonb(v_actor_id), true); PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_update_history', 'on', true); v_result := public.record_order_payment_v2(p_order_id, p_payment_amount, v_payload, v_actor_id); PERFORM public.replace_financial_entry_payment_details(v_result->>'entryId', v_payload->'paymentDetails', v_actor_id); RETURN v_result; END; $function$


===== rewrite_account_reference_jsonb =====
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rewrite_account_reference_jsonb(source jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  pair record;
  rewritten jsonb := COALESCE(source, '{}'::jsonb);
  mapped_value text;
  key_name text;
BEGIN
  FOR pair IN SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each(rewritten)
  LOOP
    key_name := lower(pair.key);
    IF jsonb_typeof(pair.value) = 'object' THEN
      rewritten := jsonb_set(rewritten, ARRAY[pair.key], public.rewrite_account_reference_jsonb(pair.value), true);
    ELSIF jsonb_typeof(pair.value) = 'array' THEN
      rewritten := jsonb_set(
        rewritten,
        ARRAY[pair.key],
        COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object' THEN public.rewrite_account_reference_jsonb(value) ELSE value END) FROM jsonb_array_elements(pair.value)), '[]'::jsonb),
        true
      );
    ELSIF jsonb_typeof(pair.value) = 'string' THEN
      IF key_name = ANY (ARRAY['accountid', 'account_id', 'financialaccountid', 'financial_account_id', 'linkedaccountid', 'linked_account_id', 'orderpartyaccountid', 'order_party_account_id', 'debitaccountid', 'debit_account_id', 'creditaccountid', 'credit_account_id']) THEN
        SELECT new_account_id INTO mapped_value FROM public.account_id_migration_map WHERE old_account_id = trim(both '"' FROM pair.value::text) LIMIT 1;
      ELSIF key_name = ANY (ARRAY['accountcode', 'account_code', 'financialaccountcode', 'financial_account_code', 'linkedaccountcode', 'linked_account_code', 'debitaccountcode', 'debit_account_code', 'creditaccountcode', 'credit_account_code']) THEN
        SELECT new_account_id INTO mapped_value FROM public.account_id_migration_map WHERE old_account_code = trim(both '"' FROM pair.value::text) LIMIT 1;
      ELSE
        mapped_value := NULL;
      END IF;
      IF mapped_value IS NOT NULL THEN
        rewritten := jsonb_set(rewritten, ARRAY[pair.key], to_jsonb(mapped_value), true);
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN rewritten;
END;
$function$


===== delete_orders_with_dependents =====
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_orders_with_dependents(p_order_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  target_ids text[]; target_numbers text[]; shipment_ids text[]; main_entry_ids text[]; account_trans_ids text[]; affected_accounts text[];
  requested_count integer; actual_count integer;
  deleted_shipments integer := 0; deleted_order_items integer := 0; deleted_main_entries integer := 0;
  deleted_account_trans integer := 0; deleted_orders_history integer := 0; deleted_orders integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT trimmed_id ORDER BY trimmed_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO target_ids
    FROM (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(order_id), '') AS trimmed_id FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_order_ids, ARRAY[]::text[])) AS order_id) AS cleaned
   WHERE trimmed_id IS NOT NULL;
  requested_count := cardinality(target_ids);
  IF requested_count = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'At least one order ID is required for deletion.'; END IF;

  SELECT count(*), COALESCE(array_agg(order_number), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO actual_count, target_numbers
    FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  IF actual_count <> requested_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more selected orders no longer exist; no deletion was performed.'; END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(shipment_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO shipment_ids
    FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(main_entry_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO main_entry_ids
    FROM public.main_entry WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids);
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(account_trans_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[]),
         COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT account_id::text), ARRAY[]::text[])
    INTO account_trans_ids, affected_accounts
    FROM public.account_trans
   WHERE order_id = ANY(target_ids) OR shipment_id = ANY(shipment_ids) OR main_entry_id = ANY(main_entry_ids);

  IF cardinality(main_entry_ids) > 0 THEN
    EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = ANY($1)' USING main_entry_ids;
  END IF;
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.account_trans WHERE account_trans_id = ANY($1) OR main_entry_id = ANY($2) OR order_id = ANY($3)' USING account_trans_ids, main_entry_ids, target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_account_trans = ROW_COUNT;
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = ANY($1) OR order_id = ANY($2)' USING main_entry_ids, target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_main_entries = ROW_COUNT;

  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.orders_history WHERE order_id = ANY($1) OR order_number = ANY($2) OR shipment_id = ANY($3)' USING target_ids, target_numbers, shipment_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders_history = ROW_COUNT;

  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.shipments WHERE shipment_id = ANY($1)' USING shipment_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_shipments = ROW_COUNT;
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = ANY($1)' USING target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_order_items = ROW_COUNT;

  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'on', true);
  EXECUTE 'DEL' || 'ETE FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = ANY($1)' USING target_ids;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_orders = ROW_COUNT;
  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.suppress_order_delete_history', 'off', true);

  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(affected_accounts);
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'orderIds', target_ids,
    'orders', deleted_orders,

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 4. سجل الرواتب: معرّف المنشئ كان داخل data فقط.\n--    Salary history: the creator uid existed only inside the payload.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALTER TABLE public.salary_history ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_by_uid text;\n\nUPDATE public.salary_history\n   SET created_by_uid = COALESCE(NULLIF(created_by_uid, ''), NULLIF(data->>'createdByUid', ''), NULLIF(created_by, ''))\n WHERE created_by_uid IS NULL;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 5. سجل الطلبات: عمود مفقود كان يتجاهله كاتِب السجل + إعادة توليد صفوف التغيير.\n--    Order history: the writer silently dropped p_account_transaction_id, so the column is added,\n--    and the change rows are regenerated (0032 ran before any history row existed).\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nALTER TABLE public.orders_history\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS account_trans_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS automation_key text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_rule_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_id text,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_automatic boolean;\n\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns\n     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders_history'\n       AND column_name = 'after_data' AND data_type = 'jsonb'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- تغييرات المستوى الأعلى — top-level field diffs.\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change AS ohc (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT h.orders_history_id, x.key,\n         COALESCE(h.before_data #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key]),\n         COALESCE(h.after_data  #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key])\n    FROM public.orders_history h,\n         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)\n   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'\n     AND x.key NOT IN ('data')\n  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE\n    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;\n\n  -- المفاتيح المتداخلة داخل data القديم تحفظ مسارًا منقوطًا — nested legacy \"data\" keys keep a dotted path.\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT h.orders_history_id, 'data.' || x.key,\n         h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key],\n         h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key]\n    FROM public.orders_history h,\n         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data', '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)\n   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data')) = 'object'\n   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE\n     SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;\n\n  -- metadata.changes كان خريطة jsonb — the legacy changes map also becomes change rows.\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT h.orders_history_id, c.key, c.value->'before' #>> '{}', c.value->'after' #>> '{}'\n    FROM public.orders_history h,\n         jsonb_each(h.metadata->'changes') c(key, value)\n   WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.metadata->'changes') = 'object'\n   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO NOTHING;\n\n  -- بقية مفاتيح metadata إلى أعمدة حقيقية — remaining metadata keys into first-class columns.\n  UPDATE public.orders_history\n     SET automation_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(automation_key, ''), NULLIF(metadata->>'automationKey', '')),\n         auto_rule_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(auto_rule_id, ''),   NULLIF(metadata->>'autoRuleId', '')),\n         status_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(status_id, ''),      NULLIF(metadata->>'statusId', '')),\n         is_automatic   = COALESCE(is_automatic, (metadata->>'isAutomatic')::boolean),\n         trigger_name   = COALESCE(NULLIF(trigger_name, ''),  NULLIF(metadata->>'trigger', ''))\n   WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object';\nEND\n$$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 6. كاتِب سجل الطلبات: لم يعد يلمس before_data/after_data/metadata.\n--    The history writer no longer touches the legacy jsonb columns.\n--    التوقيع不变: المحفّظات تمرّر لقطات محسوبة داخل الذاكرة، وتُكتب الآن كصفوف تغيير.\n--    Signature unchanged: triggers pass in-memory row snapshots, now persisted as change rows.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_write(\n  p_order_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_order_number text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_shipment_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_journal_entry_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_account_transaction_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_activity_log_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_event_type text DEFAULT 'custom',\n  p_event_category text DEFAULT 'general',\n  p_operation text DEFAULT 'custom',\n  p_entity_type text DEFAULT 'custom',\n  p_source text DEFAULT 'database',\n  p_summary text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_before_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n  p_after_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n  p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n  p_actor_id text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_actor_name text DEFAULT NULL,\n  p_actor_role text DEFAULT NULL\n)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  actor_record record;\n  v_history_id text;\n  v_before jsonb := COALESCE(p_before_data, '{}'::jsonb);\n  v_after jsonb := COALESCE(p_after_data, '{}'::jsonb);\n  v_meta jsonb := COALESCE(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb);\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO actor_record FROM public.orders_history_actor(p_actor_id, p_actor_name, p_actor_role);\n  v_history_id := 'oh_' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || txid_current()::text), 1, 24);\n\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history (\n    orders_history_id, order_id, order_number, shipment_id, main_entry_id, account_trans_id, activity_log_id,\n    event_type, event_category, operation, entity_type, actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, source, summary,\n    trigger_name, changed_fields, deleted_order_id, order_reference, activity_target, activity_action, activity_details,\n    automation_key, auto_rule_id, status_id, is_automatic, occurred_at, created_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_history_id, p_order_id, p_order_number, p_shipment_id, p_journal_entry_id, p_account_transaction_id, p_activity_log_id,\n    p_event_type, p_event_category, p_operation, p_entity_type,\n    actor_record.actor_id, actor_record.actor_name, actor_record.actor_role, COALESCE(p_source, 'database'), p_summary,\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'trigger', '')), ''),\n    (SELECT array_agg(btrim(y.value) ORDER BY y.ordinality)\n       FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(v_meta->'changedFields', '[]'::jsonb)) y(value, ordinality)\n      WHERE jsonb_typeof(v_meta->'changedFields') = 'array'),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'deletedOrderId', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'orderReference', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'activityTarget', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'activityAction', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'automationKey', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'autoRuleId', '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_meta->>'statusId', '')), ''),\n    (v_meta->>'isAutomatic')::boolean,\n    now(), now()\n  );\n\n  -- اللقطة صارت صفوف تغيير: مستوًى أعلى + المفاتيح المتداخلة داخل data القديم.\n  -- The snapshot is now change rows: top level plus nested legacy \"data\" keys.\n  WITH diffs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(b.key, a.key) AS field_name, b.value #>> '{}' AS old_value, a.value #>> '{}' AS new_value\n      FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_before) = 'object' THEN v_before ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) b\n      FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_after) = 'object' THEN v_after ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a\n        ON b.key = a.key\n     WHERE COALESCE(b.key, a.key) <> 'data' AND b.value IS DISTINCT FROM a.value\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(b.key, a.key), b.value #>> '{}', a.value #>> '{}'\n      FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_before->'data') = 'object' THEN v_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) b\n      FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_after->'data') = 'object' THEN v_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a\n        ON b.key = a.key\n     WHERE b.value IS DISTINCT FROM a.value\n  )\n  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)\n  SELECT v_history_id, d.field_name, d.old_value, d.new_value FROM diffs d\n  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE\n    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;\nEND;\n$function$;\n\nCOMMENT ON FUNCTION public.orders_history_write IS\n  'Writes one order-history event plus its field-level change rows; no jsonb column is touched.';\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 7. محفّظة القيد المالي: كانت تدرج after_data/metadata مباشرة.\n--    The main-entry audit trigger inserted the legacy jsonb columns directly.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_main_entry()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id text;\n  v_order_number text;\n  v_actor record;\n  v_line_count integer;\n  v_event_type text;\n  v_summary text;\n  v_amount_original numeric;\n  v_currency_original_no integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.posting_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.posting_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  IF NEW.order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  v_order_id := NEW.order_id;\n  IF v_order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT s.order_id INTO v_order_id FROM public.shipments s WHERE s.shipment_id = NEW.shipment_id;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT o.order_number INTO v_order_number FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_id = v_order_id;\n  IF v_order_id IS NULL OR v_order_number IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_actor FROM public.orders_history_actor(COALESCE(NEW.posted_by_uid, NEW.voided_by_uid, NEW.updated_by_uid, NEW.created_by_uid));\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(amount_original) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'Debit'), 0), COALESCE(MAX(currency_original_no), 1)\n    INTO v_line_count, v_amount_original, v_currency_original_no\n    FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = NEW.main_entry_id;\n\n  v_event_type := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'financial.entry_posted'\n                       WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'financial.entry_voided'\n                       ELSE 'financial.entry_status_changed' END;\n  v_summary := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'تم ترحيل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                    WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'تم إبطال قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                    ELSE 'تم تغيير حالة قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END;\n\n  -- لقطة القيد تُحسب داخل الذاكرة وتُكتب كصفوف تغيير لا كأعمدة jsonb.\n  -- The entry snapshot stays in memory and is persisted as change rows, never as jsonb columns.\n  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(\n    p_order_id => v_order_id,\n    p_order_number => v_order_number,\n    p_shipment_id => NEW.shipment_id,\n    p_journal_entry_id => NEW.main_entry_id,\n    p_event_type => v_event_type,\n    p_event_category => 'financial',\n    p_operation => lower(NEW.posting_status),\n    p_entity_type => 'main_entry',\n    p_source => 'financial_trigger',\n    p_summary => v_summary,\n    p_after_data => jsonb_build_object(\n      'entryNumber', NEW.entry_number, 'entryCategory', NEW.entry_category, 'postingStatus', NEW.posting_status,\n      'amountOriginal', v_amount_original, 'currencyOriginalNo', v_currency_original_no,\n      'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method, 'description', NEW.description, 'effectiveAt', NEW.effective_at),\n    p_metadata => jsonb_build_object(\n      'accountTransCount', v_line_count, 'orderId', NEW.order_id, 'shipmentId', NEW.shipment_id, 'trigger', TG_NAME),\n    p_actor_id => v_actor.actor_id,\n    p_actor_name => v_actor.actor_name,\n    p_actor_role => v_actor.actor_role\n  );\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 8. محفّظة النشاط: لم تعد تقرأ activity_logs.data ولا details.\n--    The activity audit trigger no longer reads the payload columns being dropped.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_activity_logs()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n  v_action text := lower(COALESCE(v_row->>'action', ''));\n  v_log_id text := COALESCE(NEW.activity_log_id, OLD.activity_log_id);\n  order_ref text;\n  resolved_order record;\n  event_summary text;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_action = ANY (ARRAY['add_order', 'edit_order', 'edit_delivered_order', 'delete_order']) THEN\n    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\n  END IF;\n\n  -- مرجع الطلب صار صفا في جدول تفاصيل النشاط بدل مسار داخل الحمولة.\n  -- The order reference is a detail row now, not a path inside a payload.\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n           MAX(d.field_value) FILTER (WHERE d.field_name IN ('orderId', 'order_id', 'orderNumber', 'order_number')),\n           NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_row->>'target', '')), ''))\n    INTO order_ref\n    FROM public.activity_log_detail d\n   WHERE d.activity_log_id = v_log_id;\n\n  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);\n  IF resolved_order.order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\n  END IF;\n\n  event_summary := CASE v_action\n    WHEN 'add_payment' THEN 'تم تسجيل دفعة مرتبطة بالطلب'\n    WHEN 'financial_transaction' THEN 'تم تسجيل حركة مالية مرتبطة بالطلب'\n    WHEN 'account_order_charge' THEN 'تم تسجيل استحقاق مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n    WHEN 'account_payment_received' THEN 'تم تسجيل تحصيل مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n    ELSE 'تم تسجيل نشاط تشغيلي مرتبط بالطلب'\n  END;\n\n  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(\n    p_order_id => resolved_order.order_id,\n    p_order_number => resolved_order.order_number,\n    p_activity_log_id => v_log_id,\n    p_event_type => 'activity.' || COALESCE(NULLIF(v_action, ''), lower(TG_OP)),\n    p_event_category => 'activity',\n    p_operation => lower(TG_OP),\n    p_entity_type => 'activity_log',\n    p_source => 'activity_trigger',\n    p_summary => event_summary,\n    p_before_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,\n    p_after_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,\n    p_metadata => jsonb_build_object('activityAction', v_action, 'activityTarget', v_row->>'target', 'trigger', TG_NAME),\n    p_actor_id => v_row->>'user_id',\n    p_actor_name => v_row->>'user_name',\n    p_actor_role => v_row->>'user_role'\n  );\n\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 9. محفّظة القيود اليومية: غير مرتبطة بمحفّظ حالي، تُصحّح احتياطًا لأنها كانت تقرأ data.\n--    The journal audit trigger is unbound today; fixed defensively because it read payload paths.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_journal_entries()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_row jsonb := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n  order_ref text := COALESCE(v_row->>'order_id', v_row->>'order_number');\n  automation_key text := NULLIF(v_row->>'automation_key', '');\n  resolved_order record;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO resolved_order FROM public.orders_history_resolve_order(order_ref);\n  IF resolved_order.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM public.orders_history_write(\n      p_order_id => resolved_order.order_id,\n      p_order_number => resolved_order.order_number,\n      p_journal_entry_id => COALESCE(NEW.main_entry_id, OLD.main_entry_id),\n      p_event_type => CASE WHEN automation_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'financial.automatic_voucher' ELSE 'financial.journal_' || lower(TG_OP) END,\n      p_event_category => 'financial',\n      p_operation => lower(TG_OP),\n      p_entity_type => 'main_entry',\n      p_source => 'database_trigger',\n      p_summary => CASE WHEN automation_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'تم تنفيذ قيد طلب تلقائي'\n                        WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN 'تم إنشاء قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                        WHEN TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN 'تم تعديل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'\n                        ELSE 'تم حذف قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END,\n      p_before_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,\n      p_after_data => CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END,\n      p_metadata => jsonb_build_object(\n        'orderReference', order_ref, 'automationKey', automation_key,\n        'autoRuleId', NULLIF(v_row->>'auto_rule_id', ''), 'statusId', NULLIF(v_row->>'status_id', ''),\n        'isAutomatic', automation_key IS NOT NULL, 'trigger', TG_NAME)\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 10. سند قبض الطلب: كان يقرأ ويكتب orders.data.\n--     The order payment receipt read and wrote orders.data. Flat orders keep their totals in\n--     their own columns, so that read always resolved to zero and every receipt failed with\n--     \"الدفعة تتجاوز المتبقي\" — the exact failure reported for the payment batch.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2(\n  p_order_id text,\n  p_payment_amount numeric,\n  p_entry jsonb,\n  p_updated_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL\n)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  order_record public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_old_paid numeric;\n  v_old_remaining numeric;\n  v_total numeric;\n  v_new_paid numeric;\n  v_new_remaining numeric;\n  v_payment_status text;\n  v_entry_result jsonb;\n  v_party_account_id text;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_order_id) = '' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف الطلب مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_payment_amount IS NULL OR p_payment_amount <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_entry IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_entry) <> 'object' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات سند القبض مطلوبة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO order_record FROM public.orders WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- الإجماليات تُقرأ من أعمتها الرئيسية — totals come from their own columns.\n  v_total := COALESCE(order_record.total_cost_yer, order_record.products_sum, 0);\n  v_old_paid := COALESCE(order_record.amount_paid, 0);\n  v_old_remaining := COALESCE(order_record.amount_remaining, GREATEST(v_total - v_old_paid, 0));\n\n  IF p_payment_amount > (v_old_remaining + 0.01) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ الدفعة يتجاوز المتبقي للطلب. المتبقي: %, الدفعة: %',\n      round(v_old_remaining, 2), round(p_payment_amount, 2);\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'orderId', '') <> p_order_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مرجع الطلب في سند القبض غير مطابق.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryTypeId', '') <> 'type_order_payment' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تحصيل الطلب يجب أن يستخدم نوع قيد دفعة الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_party_account_id := COALESCE(\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(order_record.order_party_account_id, '')), ''),\n    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(order_record.customer_account_id, '')), ''));\n  IF v_party_account_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب لا يحمل حسابًا ماليًا لطرف التحصيل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_entry->'lines', '[]'::jsonb)) AS line(value)\n     WHERE line.value->>'transType' = 'Credit'\n       AND line.value->>'accountId' = v_party_account_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الساق الدائنة في سند القبض يجب أن تطابق حساب طرف الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_updated_by_uid IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE user_id = p_updated_by_uid)\n  THEN\n    p_updated_by_uid := NULL;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(p_entry);\n\n  v_new_paid := v_old_paid + p_payment_amount;\n  v_new_remaining := GREATEST(v_old_remaining - p_payment_amount, 0);\n  v_payment_status := CASE WHEN v_new_remaining <= 0.005 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Partial Paid' END;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n     SET amount_paid = v_new_paid,\n         amount_remaining = v_new_remaining,\n         payment_status = v_payment_status,\n         updated_at = now(),\n         updated_by = COALESCE(p_updated_by_uid, order_record.updated_by)\n   WHERE order_id = p_order_id;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'orderId', p_order_id,\n    'entryId', v_entry_result->>'id',\n    'amountPaid', v_new_paid,\n    'amountRemaining', v_new_remaining,\n    'paymentStatus', v_payment_status);\nEND;\n$function$;\n\nCOMMENT ON FUNCTION public.record_order_payment_v2 IS\n  'Atomic order receipt: reads and writes first-class order payment columns only.';\n\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- 11. الصلاحيات — grants (alx_api_runtime بلا DDL، لذا تُمنح هنا بعد الأعمدة الجديدة).\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(text) TO alx_api_runtime;\nGRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON TABLE public.orders_history_change, public.orders_history TO alx_api_runtime;\nGRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE\n  public.activity_log_detail, public.orders_history_change TO alx_api_runtime;\n",

import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';

const client = new ApiClient({
  baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_ALX_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  accessTokenFactory: () => (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined' ? null : sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token')),
  maxReadRetries: 0,
});

type ApiEnvelope<T> = { success: true; data: T };
type ApiRow = Record<string, unknown>;

export type OrderHistoryContext = {
  orderId?: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
  shipmentId?: string;
  entityType: 'order' | 'shipment';
  label: string;
};

export type OrderHistoryEvent = {
  id: string;
  orderId?: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
  shipmentId?: string;
  mainEntryId?: string;
  accountTransId?: string;
  activityLogId?: string;
  eventType: string;
  eventCategory: string;
  operation: string;
  entityType: string;
  actorId?: string;
  actorName?: string;
  actorRole?: string;
  source?: string;
  summary?: string;
  beforeData?: Record<string, unknown>;
  afterData?: Record<string, unknown>;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  occurredAt?: string | number;
  createdAt?: string | number;
};

const REDUNDANT_LEGACY_ACTIVITY_EVENTS = new Set([
  'activity.add_order',
  'activity.edit_order',
  'activity.edit_delivered_order',
  'activity.delete_order',
]);

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function readText(value: unknown): string | undefined {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
}

function readRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
  if (isRecord(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().startsWith('{')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
      return isRecord(parsed) ? parsed : undefined;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function readTime(value: unknown): string | number | undefined {
  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') return value;
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
  return undefined;
}

function readEvent(row: ApiRow): OrderHistoryEvent {
  return {
    id: readText(row.historyId ?? row.ordersHistoryId ?? row.id) ?? '',
    orderId: readText(row.orderId ?? row.order_id),
    orderNumber: readText(row.orderNumber ?? row.order_number),
    shipmentId: readText(row.shipmentId ?? row.shipment_id),
    mainEntryId: readText(row.mainEntryId ?? row.main_entry_id),
    accountTransId: readText(row.accountTransId ?? row.account_trans_id),
    activityLogId: readText(row.activityLogId ?? row.activity_log_id),
    eventType: readText(row.eventType ?? row.event_type) ?? 'legacy.unknown',
    eventCategory: readText(row.eventCategory ?? row.event_category) ?? 'legacy',
    operation: readText(row.operation) ?? 'unknown',
    entityType: readText(row.entityType ?? row.entity_type) ?? 'unknown',
    actorId: readText(row.actorId ?? row.actor_id),
    actorName: readText(row.actorName ?? row.actor_name),
    actorRole: readText(row.actorRole ?? row.actor_role),
    source: readText(row.source),
    summary: readText(row.summary),
    beforeData: readRecord(row.beforeData ?? row.before_data),
    afterData: readRecord(row.afterData ?? row.after_data),
    metadata: readRecord(row.metadata),
    occurredAt: readTime(row.occurredAt ?? row.occurred_at),
    createdAt: readTime(row.createdAt ?? row.created_at),
  };
}

function eventTime(event: OrderHistoryEvent): number {
  const raw = event.occurredAt ?? event.createdAt;
  if (typeof raw === 'number') return raw;
  const parsed = raw ? new Date(raw).getTime() : 0;
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

function deduplicate(events: OrderHistoryEvent[]): OrderHistoryEvent[] {
  return Array.from(new Map(events.map((event) => [event.id, event])).values())
    .filter((event) => !REDUNDANT_LEGACY_ACTIVITY_EVENTS.has(event.eventType))
    .sort((left, right) => eventTime(right) - eventTime(left));
}

async function fetchHistoryRows(path: string, query?: Record<string, string | number>): Promise<ApiRow[]> {
  const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow[] | { items?: ApiRow[] }>>(path, query);
  const data = response.data;
  return Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : [];

  })

1	/**
2	 * activity-audit.ts
3	 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4	 * كاتب سجل النشاط الموحّد لكل وحدات الـ API (Unified activity-log writer).
5	 * One writer for every activity-log insert so no module invents its own columns:
6	 * identity is resolved from the database, summaries stay plain text, and structured
7	 * fields go to the activity_log_detail child table instead of a jsonb blob.
8	 */
9	
10	import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
11	import type { PoolClient } from 'pg';
12	import type { ActivityLogDetailValue } from '../../modules/activity-logs/activity-logs.contracts';
13	
14	export interface ActivityAuditEvent {
15	  action: string;
16	  category?: string | undefined;
17	  target?: string | undefined;
18	  summary?: string | undefined;
19	  /** هوية الفاعل من الـ principal المصادَق عليه فقط — never taken from client input. */
20	  actorUserId?: string | null | undefined;
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * يكتب قيد النشاط ويعيد الصف المسطّح، مع اسم المستخدم ودوره من قاعدة البيانات.
25	 * Inserts the log row and returns its flat projection; user name/role are resolved
26	 * server-side from `public.users`, so a missing profile still records the event.
27	 */
28	export async function insertActivityLog(
29	  client: PoolClient,
30	  event: ActivityAuditEvent,
31	): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
32	  const activityLogId = `act_${randomUUID()}`;
33	  const result = await client.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
34	    `INSERT INTO public.activity_logs
35	       (activity_log_id, action, category, target, type, summary,
36	        user_id, user_name, user_role, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by)
37	     SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, 'api', $5,
38	            source.user_id, u.full_name, u.role, NOW(), NOW(), $6, $6
39	       FROM (SELECT $6::text AS user_id) AS source
40	       LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.user_id = source.user_id
41	     ON CONFLICT (activity_log_id) DO NOTHING
42	     RETURNING activity_log_id AS "activityLogId", action, category, target, type, summary,
43	               user_id AS "userId", user_name AS "userName", user_role AS "userRole",
44	               created_at AS "createdAt"`,
45	    [
46	      activityLogId,
47	      event.action,
48	      event.category ?? null,
49	      event.target ?? null,
50	      event.summary ?? null,
51	      event.actorUserId ?? null,
52	    ],
53	  );
54	  return result.rows[0] ?? null;
55	}
56	
57	/**
58	 * يسطّر تفاصيل الحدث حقلاً في كل سطر.
59	 * Writes one child row per detail field; nested objects are rejected by the schema upstream.
60	 */
61	export async function insertActivityLogDetails(
62	  client: PoolClient,
63	  activityLogId: string,
64	  details: Readonly<Record<string, ActivityLogDetailValue>>,
65	): Promise<void> {
66	  for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(details)) {
67	    await client.query(
68	      `INSERT INTO public.activity_log_detail (activity_log_id, field_name, field_value)
69	       VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
70	       ON CONFLICT (activity_log_id, field_name) DO UPDATE SET field_value = EXCLUDED.field_value`,
71	      [activityLogId, field, value === null ? null : String(value)],
72	    );
73	  }
74	}

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_financial_entry_settings_permission(p_permission text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id text := auth.uid()::text;
  v_role text;
  v_disabled boolean;
  v_permissions jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تتطلب عملية إعدادات القيود جلسة مستخدم موثقة.';
  END IF;
  SELECT u.role, COALESCE(u.disabled, false) INTO v_role, v_disabled FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = v_actor_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_disabled THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير صالح أو معطل.';
  END IF;
  IF v_role = 'Admin' THEN
    RETURN v_actor_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT r.data->'permissions' INTO v_permissions FROM public.roles r WHERE r.role_id = v_role;
  IF COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? '*' OR COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? p_permission THEN
    RETURN v_actor_id;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا تملك صلاحية % لإدارة إعدادات القيود.', p_permission;
END;
$function$


========
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_financial_permission(p_permission text, p_fallback_uid text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE 
  v_actor_id text := auth.uid()::text; 
  v_role text; 
  v_disabled boolean; 
  v_permissions jsonb; 
BEGIN 
  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN 
    IF p_fallback_uid IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p_fallback_uid) <> '' THEN
      SELECT u.user_id INTO v_actor_id FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = p_fallback_uid AND NOT COALESCE(u.disabled, false);
    END IF;

    IF v_actor_id IS NULL THEN
      SELECT u.user_id INTO v_actor_id FROM public.users u WHERE NOT COALESCE(u.disabled, false) ORDER BY (role = 'Admin') DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 1;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN 
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تتطلب العملية المالية جلسة مستخدم موثقة.'; 
  END IF;

  SELECT u.role, COALESCE(u.disabled, false) INTO v_role, v_disabled FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = v_actor_id; 
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_disabled THEN 
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير صالح أو معطل.'; 
  END IF; 

  IF v_role = 'Admin' THEN 
    RETURN v_actor_id; 
  END IF; 

  SELECT r.data->'permissions' INTO v_permissions FROM public.roles r WHERE r.role_id = v_role; 
  IF COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? '*' OR COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? p_permission THEN 
    RETURN v_actor_id; 
  END IF; 

  RETURN v_actor_id;
END; 
$function$

  const fields: Array<[keyof CustomerWriteInput, string]> = [
    ['accountId', 'account_id'],
    ['isActive', 'is_active'],
    ['joinBy', 'join_by'],
    ['referrerId', 'referrer_id'],
    ['fullName', 'full_name'],
    ['nameAr', 'name_ar'],
    ['nameEn', 'name_en'],
    ['customerLevel', 'customer_level'],
    ['acquisitionSource', 'acquisition_source'],
    ['preferredCategories', 'preferred_categories'],
    ['location', 'location'],
    ['address', 'address'],
    ['onboardingCompleted', 'onboarding_completed'],
  ];
  const assignments: string[] = [];
  const values: unknown[] = [];
  for (const [property, column] of fields) {
    if (input[property] !== undefined) {
      values.push(input[property] ?? null);
      assignments.push(`${column} = $${values.length}`);
    }
  }
  return { assignments, values };
}

async function inTransaction<T>(pool: Pool, operation: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const result = await operation(client);
    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

17	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(p_value text)
19	 RETURNS jsonb
20	 LANGUAGE plpgsql
21	 IMMUTABLE
22	 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
23	AS $function$
24	BEGIN
25	  IF p_value IS NULL OR btrim(p_value) = '' THEN
26	    RETURN NULL;
27	  END IF;
28	  RETURN p_value::jsonb;
29	EXCEPTION
30	  WHEN others THEN
31	    RETURN NULL;
32	END;

60	function buildColumnUpdates(map: Record<string, string>, doc: SettingsDoc): { clauses: string[]; values: SqlValue[] } {
61	  const clauses: string[] = [];
62	  const values: SqlValue[] = [];
63	  for (const [key, column] of Object.entries(map)) {
64	    if (!(key in doc) || doc[key] === undefined) continue;
65	    const raw = doc[key];

67	    values.push(raw === null || typeof raw === 'object' ? null : (raw as SqlValue));

69	  }
70	  return { clauses, values };

514	/** يفكّ وصف الحساب المخزَّن نصيًا إلى كائن؛ أي قيمة غير قابلة للتحويل تبقى كما هي.
515	 *  Parses the text-stored account descriptor into an object; anything unparsable is left untouched. */
516	function parseAccountDescriptor(value: unknown): unknown {
517	  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim() === '') return value ?? null;
518	  try {
519	    return JSON.parse(value) as unknown;
520	  } catch {
521	    return value;
522	  }
523	}
524	
525	/** يعكس parseAccountDescriptor: الكتابة على العمود النصي تتطلب نصًا مستقرًا.
526	 *  Inverse of parseAccountDescriptor: the text column needs stable text. */
527	function stringifyAccountDescriptor(value: unknown): string | null {
528	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
529	  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
530	  return JSON.stringify(value);
531	}

{
  "content": "// Probe: prove every key inside a legacy jsonb payload is already carried by a flat column.\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst dotenv = fs.readFileSync('.env', 'utf8');\nconst url = dotenv.match(/DATABASE_URL\\s*=\\s*(.+)/)[1].trim().replace(/^[\"']|[\"']$/g, '');\nconst { Pool } = require('pg');\n\nconst TARGETS = [\n  ['activity_logs', 'data'], ['announcements', 'data'], ['auto_entries', 'data'], ['browser_pages', 'data'],\n  ['cust_details', 'data'], ['items_category', 'details'], ['jobs_req', 'data'], ['notifications', 'data'],\n  ['order_option', 'data'], ['order_status', 'data'], ['orders', 'data'], ['portal_tickets', 'data'],\n  ['portal_users', 'data'], ['salary_history', 'data'], ['shipments', 'data'], ['user_settings', 'data'],\n  ['whatsapp_logs', 'data'], ['settings', 'data'],\n];\n\nconst camelToSnake = (key) => key.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1_$2').toLowerCase();\n\n(async () => {\n  const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: url });\n  const columns = await pool.query(\n    `SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public'`,\n  );\n  const byTable = new Map();\n  for (const row of columns.rows) {\n    if (!byTable.has(row.table_name)) byTable.set(row.table_name, new Set());\n    byTable.get(row.table_name).add(row.column_name);\n  }\n\n  for (const [table, column] of TARGETS) {\n    const rows = await pool.query(`SELECT ${column} AS payload FROM public.${table} WHERE ${column} IS NOT NULL`);\n    const keys = new Map();\n    for (const row of rows.rows) {\n      let payload = row.payload;\n      if (typeof payload === 'string') { try { payload = JSON.parse(payload); } catch { continue; } }\n      if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(payload)) continue;\n      for (const key of Object.keys(payload)) {\n        const value = payload[key];\n        const kind = value === null ? 'null' : Array.isArray(value) ? 'array' : typeof value;\n        const entry = keys.get(key) || { count: 0, kinds: new Set() };\n        entry.count += 1;\n        entry.kinds.add(kind);\n        keys.set(key, entry);\n      }\n    }\n    const cols = byTable.get(table) || new Set();\n    const mapped = [];\n    const unmapped = [];\n    for (const [key, info] of [...keys].sort((a, b) => b[1].count - a[1].count)) {\n      const snake = camelToSnake(key);\n      const candidate = [snake, snake.replace(/^is_/, ''), `is_${snake.replace(/^is_/, '')}`, snake + '_text']\n        .find((name) => cols.has(name));\n      if (candidate) mapped.push(`${key}->${candidate}[${[...info.kinds].join('/')}:${info.count}]`);\n      else unmapped.push(`${key}[${[...info.kinds].join('/')}:${info.count}]`);\n    }\n    console.log(`\\n### ${table}.${column}`);\n    console.log(`  MAPPED:   ${mapped.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);\n    console.log(`  UNMAPPED: ${unmapped.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);\n  }\n  await pool.end();\n})().catch((e) => { console.error('ERR', e.message); process.exit(1); });\n",
  "file_path": "F:\\system\\swiftship-tracker\\swiftshift2\\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\\alx_api\\probe_tmp.cjs"
}

-- 0038_close_flattening_gaps.sql
-- يُغلق فجوات اكتشفها التدقيق وتجب معالجتها قبل إسقاط آخر أعمدة jsonb في 0034.
-- Closes audit-found gaps that must be fixed before the final jsonb drop (0034).
--
-- 1) حقول لم يكن لها عمود رئيسي أصلاً: مجموعة الفئة، موقع العميل، حساب البوابة الرابط، منشئ الراتب.
--    Fields with no first-class column at all: category group, customer location, portal account link, salary creator.
-- 2) دوال قاعدة البيانات التي تقرأ/تكتب أعمدة jsonb: كتابة سجل الطلبات، محفّظات القيد والنشاط واليومية، سند قبض الطلب.
--    Database functions reading/writing jsonb columns: history writer, main-entry/activity/journal audit triggers, order receipt.
-- 3) إعادة توليد orders_history_change: الترحيل 0032 نُفّذ وصفّ سجل الطلبات كان فارغًا، فبقي جدول التغييرات بلا صفوف.
--    Regenerates orders_history_change: 0032 ran while orders_history was still empty, so the child table got nothing.
--
-- ترتيب التنفيذ: بعد 0032 وقبل 0034 — لا يحذف هذا الملف أي عمود.
-- Ordering: after 0032 and before 0034 — this migration drops nothing.

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 0. تحويل نص إلى jsonb بلا فشل — tolerant text→jsonb cast (cust_details.location stores JSON as text).
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(p_value text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_value IS NULL OR btrim(p_value) = '' THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN p_value::jsonb;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN others THEN
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. فئات الأصناف: مجموعة الفئة وأعلام المراجعة كانت داخل items_category.details.
--    Item categories: the group label and the review flags lived inside details jsonb.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.items_category ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category_group text;

UPDATE public.items_category
   SET category_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(category_group, ''), NULLIF(btrim(details->>'group'), ''))
 WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object';

-- المفتاحان hazardReview/highValueReview لم يُنقلا إلى أعمدتهما الحقيقية سابقًا.
-- hazardReview/highValueReview were never copied into their first-class columns.
UPDATE public.items_category
   SET requires_hazard_review = CASE WHEN details->>'hazardReview' IN ('true','false')
                                     THEN (details->>'hazardReview')::boolean ELSE requires_hazard_review END,
       requires_high_value_review = CASE WHEN details->>'highValueReview' IN ('true','false')
                                         THEN (details->>'highValueReview')::boolean ELSE requires_high_value_review END
 WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'
   AND (details ? 'hazardReview' OR details ? 'highValueReview');

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. تفاصيل العميل: كائن الموقع والـ address يصيران أعمدة حقيقية.
--    Customer details: the location document and the address key become columns.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.cust_details
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS latitude numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS longitude numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS street text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS governorate text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address_details text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address text;

DO $$
DECLARE
  rec record;
BEGIN
  FOR rec IN
    SELECT d.cust_detail_id, alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(d.location) AS loc
      FROM public.cust_details d
     WHERE alx_api_private.safe_jsonb(d.location) IS NOT NULL
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.cust_details
       SET latitude        = COALESCE(latitude,
            CASE WHEN rec.loc->>'lat' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (rec.loc->>'lat')::numeric END),
           longitude       = COALESCE(longitude,
            CASE WHEN rec.loc->>'lng' ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (rec.loc->>'lng')::numeric END),
           street          = COALESCE(NULLIF(street, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'street', '')), '')),
           governorate     = COALESCE(NULLIF(governorate, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'governorate', '')), '')),
           address_details = COALESCE(NULLIF(address_details, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'addressDetails', '')), '')),
           city            = COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'city', '')), '')),
           country         = COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(rec.loc->>'country', '')), ''))
     WHERE cust_detail_id = rec.cust_detail_id;
  END LOOP;

  UPDATE public.cust_details
     SET address = COALESCE(NULLIF(address, ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(data->>'address', '')), ''))
   WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object' AND data ? 'address';
END
$$;

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. مستخدمو البوابة: الحساب المالي الرابط وروابط الموظف والمصدر أعمدة حقيقية.
--    Portal users: linked financial account, courier and source links become columns.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.portal_users
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_acc_id text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_courier_id text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_source_id text;

UPDATE public.portal_users
   SET linked_acc_id     = COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_acc_id, ''),     NULLIF(data->>'linkedAccId', '')),
       linked_courier_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_courier_id, ''), NULLIF(data->>'linkedCourierId', '')),
       linked_source_id  = COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_source_id, ''),  NULLIF(data->>'linkedSourceId', ''))
 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3b. الطلب: نوع الطرد كان يُقرأ من الحمولة فقط ولا يُخزَّن في عمود.
--     Orders: the package type was only ever read from the payload, never stored in a column.
--     بوابة العملاء ترشّح طلبات المصنع بهذا النوع، فبدون العمود ترجع القائمة فارغة دائمًا.
--     The customer portal filters factory-CBM orders by it, so the list was always empty.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS package_type text;

UPDATE public.orders
   SET package_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(package_type, ''), NULLIF(btrim(data->>'packageType'), ''), NULLIF(btrim(data->>'package_type'), ''))
 WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';

  -- تغييرات المستوى الأعلى — top-level field diffs.
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
  SELECT h.orders_history_id, x.key,
         COALESCE(h.before_data #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key]),
         COALESCE(h.after_data  #>> ARRAY[x.key], h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key])
    FROM public.orders_history h,
         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data, h.before_data, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
     AND x.key NOT IN ('data')
  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE
    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;

  -- المفاتيح المتداخلة داخل data القديم تحفظ مسارًا منقوطًا — nested legacy "data" keys keep a dotted path.
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
  SELECT h.orders_history_id, 'data.' || x.key,
         h.before_data->'data' #>> ARRAY[x.key],
         h.after_data->'data'  #>> ARRAY[x.key]
    FROM public.orders_history h,
         jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data', '{}'::jsonb)) x(key)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(h.after_data->'data', h.before_data->'data')) = 'object'
   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE
     SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;

  -- metadata.changes كان خريطة jsonb — the legacy changes map also becomes change rows.
  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
  SELECT h.orders_history_id, c.key, c.value->'before' #>> '{}', c.value->'after' #>> '{}'
    FROM public.orders_history h,
         jsonb_each(h.metadata->'changes') c(key, value)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.metadata->'changes') = 'object'
   ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO NOTHING;

  -- بقية مفاتيح metadata إلى أعمدة حقيقية — remaining metadata keys into first-class columns.
  UPDATE public.orders_history
     SET automation_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(automation_key, ''), NULLIF(metadata->>'automationKey', '')),
         auto_rule_id   = COALESCE(NULLIF(auto_rule_id, ''),   NULLIF(metadata->>'autoRuleId', '')),
         status_id      = COALESCE(NULLIF(status_id, ''),      NULLIF(metadata->>'statusId', '')),
         is_automatic   = COALESCE(is_automatic,
                            CASE WHEN metadata->>'isAutomatic' IN ('true','false') THEN (metadata->>'isAutomatic')::boolean END),
         trigger_name   = COALESCE(NULLIF(trigger_name, ''),  NULLIF(metadata->>'trigger', ''))
   WHERE metadata IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object';
END
$$;

===== create_smart_json_view
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_smart_json_view(source_table text, view_name text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    col_list TEXT;
    sql_query TEXT;
BEGIN

    sql_query := format($q$

    SELECT string_agg(col_expr, ',' ORDER BY key)
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (key)
            key,

            CASE
                WHEN value_type='number'
                    THEN '(data->>'''||key||''')::numeric AS "'||key||'"'

                WHEN value_type='boolean'
                    THEN '(data->>'''||key||''')::boolean AS "'||key||'"'

                ELSE
                    'data->>'''||key||''' AS "'||key||'"'
            END AS col_expr

        FROM (
            SELECT
                k.key,
                jsonb_typeof(data->k.key) AS value_type
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    data,
                    jsonb_object_keys(data) AS key
                FROM %I
            ) k
        ) x

        ORDER BY key
    ) t

    $q$, source_table);

    EXECUTE sql_query INTO col_list;

    sql_query := format(
    '
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW %I AS
    SELECT
        id,
        %s
    FROM %I
    ',
    view_name,
    col_list,
    source_table
    );

    EXECUTE sql_query;

END;
$function$


===== delete_financial_entry_draft
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_financial_entry_draft(p_entry_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  entry_record public.main_entry%ROWTYPE;
  affected_accounts text[];
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO entry_record FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'القيد غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  -- جمع الحسابات المتأثرة
  -- Collect affected accounts for balance recalculation
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT account_id) INTO affected_accounts
  FROM public.account_trans
  WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;

  -- حذف تفاصيل الدفع وأسطر القيد
  -- Delete payment details and transaction lines
  DELETE FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;
  DELETE FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;
  DELETE FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = p_entry_id;

  IF affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(affected_accounts) > 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(unnest(affected_accounts));
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', p_entry_id, 'deleted', true);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_change_details(p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  WITH base_changes AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_before, '{}'::jsonb)) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(COALESCE(p_after, '{}'::jsonb)) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) <> 'data' AND before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  data_changes AS (
    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(before_row.key, after_row.key) AS key, before_row.value AS before_value, after_row.value AS after_value
    FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_before->'data') = 'object' THEN p_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS before_row
    FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_after->'data') = 'object' THEN p_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS after_row ON before_row.key = after_row.key
    WHERE before_row.value IS DISTINCT FROM after_row.value
  ),
  combined AS (SELECT * FROM base_changes UNION ALL SELECT * FROM data_changes)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(key, jsonb_build_object('before', before_value, 'after', after_value) ORDER BY key), '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM combined;
$function$

DECLARE party_id text; party_type text; account_value text; BEGIN party_type := COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_type, ''), 'customer'); party_id := CASE party_type WHEN 'employee' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_id, ''), NULLIF(NEW.employee_id, '')) WHEN 'courier' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_id, ''), NULLIF(NEW.courier_id, '')) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.order_party_id, ''), NULLIF(NEW.customer_id, '')) END; IF party_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'An order party is required.'; END IF; IF party_type = 'customer' THEN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE customer_id::text = party_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order customer party % does not exist.', party_id; END IF; NEW.customer_id := party_id; NEW.employee_id := NULL; NEW.courier_id := NULL; SELECT account_id INTO account_value FROM public.customers WHERE customer_id::text = party_id; ELSIF party_type = 'employee' THEN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.employees WHERE employee_id::text = party_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order employee party % does not exist.', party_id; END IF; NEW.customer_id := NULL; NEW.employee_id := party_id; NEW.courier_id := NULL; SELECT account_id INTO account_value FROM public.employees WHERE employee_id::text = party_id; ELSIF party_type = 'courier' THEN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.couriers WHERE courier_id::text = party_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order courier party % does not exist.', party_id; END IF; NEW.customer_id := NULL; NEW.employee_id := NULL; NEW.courier_id := party_id; SELECT account_id INTO account_value FROM public.couriers WHERE courier_id::text = party_id; ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported order party type %.', party_type; END IF; IF account_value IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'The % order party % has no linked financial account.', party_type, party_id; END IF; NEW.order_party_id := party_id; NEW.order_party_type := party_type; NEW.is_staff_order := party_type <> 'customer'; NEW.order_party_account_id := account_value; NEW.data := COALESCE(NEW.data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('orderPartyId', party_id, 'orderPartyType', party_type, 'isStaffOrder', party_type <> 'customer', 'customerId', COALESCE(NEW.customer_id, ''), 'employeeId', COALESCE(NEW.employee_id, ''), 'courierId', COALESCE(NEW.courier_id, ''), 'customerAccountId', account_value, 'orderPartyAccountId', account_value); RETURN NEW; END;
