164	export function normalizePayload(table: string, payload: any): any {
165	  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return payload;
166	
167	  // Specific normalization for 'roles' permissions field
168	  if (table === 'roles' && payload.permissions) {
169	    if (typeof payload.permissions === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payload.permissions)) {
170	      payload.permissions = Object.values(payload.permissions);
171	    }
172	  }
173	
174	  // Generic object-to-array conversion for objects representing array maps (e.g. { "0": "...", "1": "..." })
175	  if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
176	    return payload.map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
177	  }
178	
179	  const keys = Object.keys(payload);
180	  for (const k of keys) {
181	    const val = payload[k];
182	    if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
183	      if (Array.isArray(val)) {
184	        payload[k] = val.map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
185	      } else {
186	        const subKeys = Object.keys(val);
187	        const isArrayMap = subKeys.length > 0 && subKeys.every(key => !isNaN(Number(key)));
188	        if (isArrayMap) {
189	          payload[k] = Object.values(val).map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
190	        } else {
191	          payload[k] = normalizePayload(table, val);
192	        }
193	      }
194	    }
195	  }
196	
197	  return payload;
198	}

200	export function cleanData(obj: any): any {
201	  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj;
202	  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
203	    return obj.map(item => cleanData(item));
204	  }
205	  if (typeof obj === 'object') {
206	    if (obj._methodName === 'serverTimestamp') {
207	      return Date.now();
208	    }
209	    // Specific custom classes used in PostgreSQL updates
210	    if (obj.constructor?.name === 'IncrementValue' || obj.constructor?.name === 'ArrayUnionValue') {
211	      return obj;
212	    }
213	    const clean: any = {};
214	    for (const k of Object.keys(obj)) {
215	      clean[k] = cleanData(obj[k]);
216	    }
217	    return clean;
218	  }
219	  return obj;
220	}

131	    const reads: Promise<ApiRow[]>[] = [];
132	
133	    if (context.shipmentId) {
134	      reads.push(fetchHistoryRows(`/api/v1/shipments/${encodeURIComponent(context.shipmentId)}/tracking`));
135	    }
136	
137	    const orderId = context.orderId
138	      ?? (context.orderNumber ? await resolveOrderIdByNumber(context.orderNumber) : null);
139	
140	    if (orderId) {
141	      reads.push(fetchHistoryRows(`/api/v1/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/history`));
142	    }
143	
144	    if (reads.length === 0) return [];
145	    const rows = (await Promise.all(reads)).flat();
146	    return deduplicate(rows.map(readEvent).filter((event) => event.id));

27	export function historyEventDate(event: OrderHistoryEvent): Date | null {
28	  const value = event.occurredAt ?? event.createdAt;
29	  if (!value) return null;

34	export function historyActorKey(event: OrderHistoryEvent): string {

38	function normalizedText(value: unknown): string {
39	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
40	  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.toLocaleLowerCase();
41	  try {
42	    return JSON.stringify(value).toLocaleLowerCase();
43	  } catch {
44	    return String(value).toLocaleLowerCase();
45	  }
46	}
47	
48	function matchesTimeRange(eventDate: Date, timeRange: HistoryTimeRange, now: Date): boolean {
49	  if (timeRange === 'all') return true;
50	  const timestamp = eventDate.getTime();
51	  if (timeRange === 'today') {
52	    const start = new Date(now);
53	    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
54	    return timestamp >= start.getTime() && timestamp <= now.getTime();
55	  }
56	
57	  const durationMs = timeRange === 'last_24_hours'
58	    ? 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
59	    : timeRange === 'last_7_days'
60	      ? 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
61	      : 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
62	  return timestamp >= now.getTime() - durationMs && timestamp <= now.getTime();
63	}
64	
65	function matchesDateAndTime(eventDate: Date, filters: OrderHistoryFilters): boolean {
66	  if (filters.dateFrom) {
67	    const from = new Date(`${filters.dateFrom}T00:00:00`);
68	    if (eventDate.getTime() < from.getTime()) return false;
69	  }
70	
71	  if (filters.dateTo) {
72	    const to = new Date(`${filters.dateTo}T23:59:59.999`);
73	    if (eventDate.getTime() > to.getTime()) return false;
74	  }
75	
76	  if (!filters.timeFrom && !filters.timeTo) return true;
77	  const minute = eventDate.getHours() * 60 + eventDate.getMinutes();
78	  const toMinute = (value: string) => {
79	    const [hours, minutes] = value.split(':').map(Number);
80	    return Number.isFinite(hours) && Number.isFinite(minutes) ? hours * 60 + minutes : null;
81	  };
82	  const from = filters.timeFrom ? toMinute(filters.timeFrom) : null;
83	  const to = filters.timeTo ? toMinute(filters.timeTo) : null;
84	
85	  if (from !== null && to !== null) {
86	    return from <= to ? minute >= from && minute <= to : minute >= from || minute <= to;
87	  }
88	  if (from !== null) return minute >= from;
89	  return to === null || minute <= to;
90	}

92	function matchesSearch(event: OrderHistoryEvent, query: string): boolean {
93	  const search = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
94	  if (!search) return true;
95	  const searchable = [
96	    event.id,
97	    event.eventType,
98	    event.eventCategory,
99	    event.operation,
100	    event.entityType,
101	    event.summary,
102	    event.actorName,
103	    event.actorRole,
104	    event.actorId,
105	    event.orderId,
106	    event.orderNumber,
107	    event.shipmentId,
108	    event.mainEntryId,
109	    event.accountTransId,
110	    event.activityLogId,
111	    event.beforeData,
112	    event.afterData,
113	    event.metadata,
114	  ].map(normalizedText).join(' ');
115	  return searchable.includes(search);
116	}
117	
118	export function filterOrderHistoryEvents(
119	  events: OrderHistoryEvent[],
120	  filters: OrderHistoryFilters,
121	  now = new Date(),
122	): OrderHistoryEvent[] {
123	  return events.filter((event) => {
124	    if (filters.eventType && event.eventType !== filters.eventType) return false;
125	    if (filters.actorKey && historyActorKey(event) !== filters.actorKey) return false;
126	    if (!matchesSearch(event, filters.query)) return false;
127	
128	    const eventDate = historyEventDate(event);
129	    const needsDate = filters.timeRange !== 'all' || Boolean(filters.dateFrom || filters.dateTo || filters.timeFrom || filters.timeTo);
130	    if (needsDate && !eventDate) return false;
131	    if (!eventDate) return true;
132	
133	    return matchesTimeRange(eventDate, filters.timeRange, now) && matchesDateAndTime(eventDate, filters);
134	  });
135	}

143	    filters.dateFrom,
144	    filters.dateTo,
145	    filters.timeFrom,
146	    filters.timeTo,
147	  ].filter(Boolean).length;

1	import type { OrderStatusItem } from '../hooks/useOrderStatuses';
2	import type { OrderHistoryEvent } from './orderHistoryService';
3	
4	export type StatusTransitionPlan = {
5	  allowed: boolean;
6	  reason?: 'same_status' | 'backward_transition' | 'status_previously_processed' | 'unknown_status';
7	  stagesToProcess: OrderStatusItem[];
8	  skippedStages: OrderStatusItem[];
9	};
10	
11	function statusIdFromEvent(event: OrderHistoryEvent): number | null {
12	  if (event.eventType !== 'order.status_changed' && event.eventType !== 'order.created') return null;
13	  const after = event.afterData ?? {};
14	  const raw = after.order_status_id ?? after.orderStatusId ?? after.orderStatus;
15	  const id = Number(raw);
16	  return Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
17	}
18	
19	export function getProcessedStatusIds(events: OrderHistoryEvent[]): Set<number> {
20	  return new Set(events.map(statusIdFromEvent).filter((id): id is number => id !== null));
21	}
22	
23	export function planOrderStatusTransition(
24	  statuses: OrderStatusItem[],
25	  currentStatusId: number,
26	  targetStatusId: number,
27	  processedStatusIds: Set<number>,
28	): StatusTransitionPlan {
29	  const ordered = [...statuses]
30	    .filter((status) => status.code !== 'cancelled')
31	    .sort((left, right) => (left.sortOrder ?? left.id) - (right.sortOrder ?? right.id));
32	  const target = statuses.find((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);
33	  const currentIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === currentStatusId);
34	  const targetIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);
35	
36	  if (!target || currentIndex < 0 || (target.code !== 'cancelled' && targetIndex < 0)) {
37	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'unknown_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
38	  }
39	
40	  if (target.code === 'cancelled') {
41	    return { allowed: true, stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
42	  }
43	  if (targetStatusId === currentStatusId) {
44	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'same_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
45	  }
46	  if (targetIndex < currentIndex) {
47	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'backward_transition', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
48	  }
49	  if (processedStatusIds.has(targetStatusId)) {
50	    return { allowed: false, reason: 'status_previously_processed', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
51	  }
52	
53	  const stagesToProcess = ordered.slice(currentIndex + 1, targetIndex + 1);
54	  return {
55	    allowed: true,
56	    stagesToProcess,
57	    skippedStages: stagesToProcess.slice(0, -1),
58	  };
59	}

184	  function readRecord(value: unknown): ApiRow {
185	    if (typeof value === 'string') {
186	      try {
187	        const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
188	        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed as ApiRow : {};
189	      } catch {
190	        return {};
191	      }
192	    }
193	    return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as ApiRow : {};
194	  }

196	  // Staff fallback: resolve published tracking profiles and internal orders through alx_api.
197	  const lookupInternalViaApi = async (queryStr: string): Promise<boolean> => {
198	    const publicId = queryStr.toUpperCase();
199	    try {
200	      const envelope = await client.get<{ success: true; data: ApiRow }>(profilePath(publicId));
201	      const row = envelope.data;
202	      const profile = readRecord(row.data);
203	      const status = readText(row.status) || readText(profile.status) || 'تم تسجيل الطلب';
204	      setTrackingData({
205	        id: readText(row.trackingId) || publicId,
206	        trackingNumber: readText(profile.trackingNumber) || publicId,
207	        orderNumber: readText(profile.orderNumber) || readText(row.orderNumber),
208	        status,
209	        customerName: readText(profile.customerName),
210	        customerPhone: readText(profile.customerPhone),
211	        customerAddress: readText(profile.customerAddress) || 'صنعاء، اليمن',
212	        weight: readNumber(profile.weight),
213	        cbm: readNumber(profile.cbm),
214	        shippingCompany: readText(profile.shippingCompany),
215	        amountPaid: readNumber(profile.amountPaid),
216	        amountRemaining: readNumber(profile.amountRemaining),
217	        totalCostYER: readNumber(profile.totalCostYER),
218	        currency: readText(profile.currency) || 'YER',
219	        products: readArray(profile.products),
220	        history: readArray(profile.history),
221	      });
222	      setResolvedSource('public');
223	      setGpsLocation(readText(row.locationYemen) || readText(profile.locationYemen) || 'مستودع الفرز والتبريد');
224	      setStatusSelector(status);
225	      return true;
226	    } catch (error) {
227	      if (!isNotFound(error)) console.error('[TrackingPage] tracking profile lookup failed:', error);
228	    }
229	
230	    try {
231	      const envelope = await client.get<{ success: true; data: ApiRow[] | { items?: ApiRow[] } }>('/api/v1/orders', { limit: 20, offset: 0, search: queryStr });
232	      const rows = Array.isArray(envelope.data) ? envelope.data : Array.isArray(envelope.data?.items) ? envelope.data.items : [];
233	      const match =
234	        rows.find((row) => readText(row.trackingNumber).toUpperCase() === publicId) ??
235	        rows.find((row) => readText(row.orderNumber).toUpperCase() === publicId);
236	      if (!match) return false;
237	      const detail = await client.get<{ success: true; data: ApiRow }>(`/api/v1/orders/${encodeURIComponent(readText(match.orderId))}`);
238	      const order = readRecord(detail.data.data);
239	      const status = readText(detail.data.orderStatus) || readText(order.orderStatus) || 'تم تسجيل الطلب';
240	      setTrackingData({
241	        id: readText(detail.data.orderId),
242	        trackingNumber: readText(detail.data.trackingNumber) || readText(detail.data.orderNumber) || publicId,
243	        orderNumber: readText(detail.data.orderNumber),
244	        status,
245	        customerName: readText(order.customerName),
246	        customerPhone: readText(order.customerPhone),
247	        customerAddress: readText(order.customerAddress) || readText(order.destination) || 'صنعاء، اليمن',
248	        weight: readNumber(order.totalWeight),
249	        cbm: readNumber(order.totalCBM),
250	        shippingCompany: readText(order.shippingCompany),
251	        amountPaid: readNumber(order.amountPaid),
252	        amountRemaining: readNumber(order.amountRemaining),
253	        totalCostYER: readNumber(order.totalCostYER),
254	        currency: readText(order.currency) || readText(detail.data.currency) || 'YER',
255	        products: readArray(order.items),
256	        history: readArray(order.history),
257	      });
258	      setResolvedSource('orders_db');
259	      setGpsLocation(readText(order.locationYemen) || 'مستودع الفرز والتبريد');
260	      setStatusSelector(status);
261	      return true;
262	    } catch (error) {
263	      console.error('[TrackingPage] order lookup failed:', error);
264	      return false;
265	    }

314	async function selectOrder(pool: Pool, orderId: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
315	  const order = await pool.query(
316	    `SELECT ${orderListColumns} ${orderListFrom} WHERE o.order_id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
317	    [orderId],
318	  );
319	  const row = order.rows[0] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
320	  if (!row) return null;
321	  const items = await pool.query(
322	    `SELECT ${orderItemColumns} FROM public.order_items WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, order_item_id ASC`,
323	    [orderId],
324	  );
325	  const shipments = await pool.query(
326	    `SELECT ${shipmentColumns} FROM public.shipments WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC, shipment_id ASC`,
327	    [orderId],
328	  );
329	  // المحفّظات المنفّذة صارت صفوفًا علائقية بدل قائمة داخل الحمولة النصية.
330	  // Fired triggers are relational rows now instead of a list inside a payload.
331	  const triggers = await pool.query<{ triggerName: string }>(
332	    'SELECT trigger_name AS "triggerName" FROM public.order_fired_trigger WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY seq ASC',
333	    [orderId],
334	  );
335	  return { ...row, firedTriggers: triggers.rows.map((trigger) => trigger.triggerName), items: items.rows, shipments: shipments.rows };
336	}
337	
338	// حقل واحد تغيّر بين لقطتين — a single field diff stored as its own row.
339	type HistoryChange = { fieldName: string; oldValue?: unknown; newValue?: unknown };
340	
341	function stringifyChangeValue(value: unknown): string | null {
342	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
343	  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
344	  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
345	  return String(value);
346	}
347	
348	// توحيد تسمية الحقول في سجل التغيير إلى camelCase مطابقةً لعُرف النظام.
349	// Change-field names are normalised to camelCase to match the system naming convention.
350	function toCamelCase(name: string): string {
351	  return name.replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, character: string) => character.toUpperCase());
352	}
353	
354	// مقارنة صفّين وتجاهل أعمدة التدقيق — compare two row snapshots, ignoring audit columns.
355	function diffHistoryRows(
356	  before: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
357	  after: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
358	  ignored: string[] = ['updatedAt', 'updatedBy', 'createdAt', 'createdBy', 'data'],
359	): HistoryChange[] {
360	  const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];
361	  return keys
362	    .filter((key) => !ignored.some((name) => toCamelCase(key) === name))
363	    .map((key) => ({ fieldName: toCamelCase(key), oldValue: before?.[key], newValue: after?.[key] }))
364	    .filter((change) => stringifyChangeValue(change.oldValue) !== stringifyChangeValue(change.newValue));
365	}

271	     WHERE COALESCE(b.key, a.key) <> 'data' AND b.value IS DISTINCT FROM a.value
272	    UNION ALL
273	    SELECT 'data.' || COALESCE(b.key, a.key), b.value #>> '{}', a.value #>> '{}'
274	      FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_before->'data') = 'object' THEN v_before->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) b
275	      FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_after->'data') = 'object' THEN v_after->'data' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a
276	        ON b.key = a.key
277	     WHERE b.value IS DISTINCT FROM a.value
278	  )
279	  INSERT INTO public.orders_history_change (orders_history_id, field_name, old_value, new_value)
280	  SELECT v_history_id, d.field_name, d.old_value, d.new_value FROM diffs d
281	  ON CONFLICT (orders_history_id, field_name) DO UPDATE
282	    SET old_value = EXCLUDED.old_value, new_value = EXCLUDED.new_value;
283	END;
284	$function$;
285	
286	COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.orders_history_write IS
287	  'Writes one order-history event plus its field-level change rows; no jsonb column is touched.';
288	
289	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
290	-- 7. محفّظة القيد المالي: كانت تدرج after_data/metadata مباشرة.
291	--    The main-entry audit trigger inserted the legacy jsonb columns directly.
292	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
293	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_history_from_main_entry()
294	 RETURNS trigger
295	 LANGUAGE plpgsql
296	 SECURITY DEFINER
297	 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
298	AS $function$
299	DECLARE
300	  v_order_id text;
301	  v_order_number text;
302	  v_actor record;
303	  v_line_count integer;
304	  v_event_type text;
305	  v_summary text;
306	  v_amount_original numeric;
307	  v_currency_original_no integer;
308	BEGIN
309	  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.posting_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.posting_status THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
310	  IF NEW.order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
311	  v_order_id := NEW.order_id;
312	  IF v_order_id IS NULL AND NEW.shipment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
313	    SELECT s.order_id INTO v_order_id FROM public.shipments s WHERE s.shipment_id = NEW.shipment_id;
314	  END IF;
315	  SELECT o.order_number INTO v_order_number FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_id = v_order_id;
316	  IF v_order_id IS NULL OR v_order_number IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
317	
318	  SELECT * INTO v_actor FROM public.orders_history_actor(COALESCE(NEW.posted_by_uid, NEW.voided_by_uid, NEW.updated_by_uid, NEW.created_by_uid));
319	
320	  SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(amount_original) FILTER (WHERE trans_type = 'Debit'), 0), COALESCE(MAX(currency_original_no), 1)
321	    INTO v_line_count, v_amount_original, v_currency_original_no
322	    FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = NEW.main_entry_id;
323	
324	  v_event_type := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'financial.entry_posted'
325	                       WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'financial.entry_voided'
326	                       ELSE 'financial.entry_status_changed' END;
327	  v_summary := CASE WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'posted' THEN 'تم ترحيل قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
328	                    WHEN NEW.posting_status = 'voided' THEN 'تم إبطال قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب'
329	                    ELSE 'تم تغيير حالة قيد مالي مرتبط بالطلب' END;
330	
331	  -- لقطة القيد تُحسب داخل الذاكرة وتُكتب كصفوف تغيير لا كأعمدة jsonb.
332	  -- The entry snapshot stays in memory and is persisted as change rows, never as jsonb columns.
333	  PERFORM public.orders_history_write(
334	    p_order_id => v_order_id,
335	    p_order_number => v_order_number,
336	    p_shipment_id => NEW.shipment_id,
337	    p_journal_entry_id => NEW.main_entry_id,
338	    p_event_type => v_event_type,
339	    p_event_category => 'financial',
340	    p_operation => lower(NEW.posting_status),
341	    p_entity_type => 'main_entry',
342	    p_source => 'financial_trigger',
343	    p_summary => v_summary,
344	    p_after_data => jsonb_build_object(
345	      'entryNumber', NEW.entry_number, 'entryCategory', NEW.entry_category, 'postingStatus', NEW.posting_status,
346	      'amountOriginal', v_amount_original, 'currencyOriginalNo', v_currency_original_no,
347	      'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method, 'description', NEW.description, 'effectiveAt', NEW.effective_at),
348	    p_metadata => jsonb_build_object(
349	      'accountTransCount', v_line_count, 'orderId', NEW.order_id, 'shipmentId', NEW.shipment_id, 'trigger', TG_NAME),
350	    p_actor_id => v_actor.actor_id,
351	    p_actor_name => v_actor.actor_name,
352	    p_actor_role => v_actor.actor_role
353	  );
354	
355	  RETURN NEW;

  "old_string": "function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {\n  return Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);\n}\n\nfunction changeEntries(event: OrderHistoryEvent): Array<[string, ChangeValue]> {\n  const changes = event.metadata?.changes;\n  if (isObject(changes)) {\n    return Object.entries(changes).map(([field, value]) => [field, isObject(value) ? value : { after: value }]);\n  }\n\n  const fields = Array.isArray(event.metadata?.changedFields) ? event.metadata.changedFields : [];\n  return fields.map((field) => {\n    const key = String(field);\n    return [key, { before: event.beforeData?.[key], after: event.afterData?.[key] }];\n  });\n}"
}

8	function mapRole(row: Record<string, unknown>): RoleViewModel {
9	  return {
10	    roleId: String(row.role_id ?? ''),
11	    title: typeof row.title === 'string' ? row.title : null,
12	    isDefault: Boolean(row.is_default),
13	    permissions: Array.isArray(row.permissions)
14	      ? [...new Set(row.permissions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string'))].sort()
15	      : [],
16	    createdAt: typeof row.created_at === 'string' ? asIsoUtc(row.created_at) : null,
17	    updatedAt: typeof row.updated_at === 'string' ? asIsoUtc(row.updated_at) : null,
18	    createdBy: typeof row.created_by === 'string' ? row.created_by : null,
19	    updatedBy: typeof row.updated_by === 'string' ? row.updated_by : null,
20	  };
21	}
22	
23	function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
24	  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
25	  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
26	  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
27	}
28	
29	export class CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway implements RolesGateway {
30	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<RoleViewModel>> {
31	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
32	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
33	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
34	      .from('roles')
35	      .select('role_id,title,is_default,permissions,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by', { count: 'exact' })
36	      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
37	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
38	    return page((data ?? []).map((row: unknown) => mapRow(row, mapRole)), { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
39	  }
40	
41	  async getById(roleId: string): Promise<RoleViewModel | null> {
42	    const { data, error } = await supabase
43	      .from('roles')
44	      .select('role_id,title,is_default,permissions,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by')
45	      .eq('role_id', roleId)
46	      .maybeSingle();
47	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
48	    return data ? mapRow(data, mapRole) : null;
49	  }
50	
51	  async save(role: RoleViewModel): Promise<RoleViewModel> {
52	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
53	    const { data, error } = await supabase
54	      .from('roles')
55	      .upsert({
56	        role_id: role.roleId,
57	        title: role.title,
58	        is_default: role.isDefault,
59	        permissions: [...new Set(role.permissions)].sort(),
60	        created_at: role.createdAt ?? now,
61	        updated_at: now,
62	        created_by: role.createdBy,
63	        updated_by: role.updatedBy,
64	      }, { onConflict: 'role_id' })
65	      .select('role_id,title,is_default,permissions,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by')
66	      .single();
67	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
68	    return mapRow(data, mapRole);
69	  }
70	}

2	import type { GatewayFailure } from '../contracts/common.gateway';
3	
4	export class DataGatewayError extends ApplicationError {
5	  constructor(failure: GatewayFailure) {
6	    super(failure, failure.cause);
7	    this.name = 'DataGatewayError';
8	  }
9	}
10	
11	function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
12	  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
13	    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
14	    : null;
15	}
16	
17	export function mapSupabaseError(error: unknown): DataGatewayError {
18	  const value = asRecord(error);
19	  const code = typeof value?.code === 'string' && value.code.length > 0
20	    ? value.code
21	    : 'DATA_GATEWAY_ERROR';
22	
23	  return new DataGatewayError({
24	    code,
25	    message: 'Data gateway request failed.',
26	    details: [],
27	    cause: error,
28	  });
29	}
30	
31	export function mapRow<T>(row: unknown, mapper: (value: Record<string, unknown>) => T): T {
32	  if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) {
33	    throw new DataGatewayError({
34	      code: 'INVALID_DATA_ROW',
35	      message: 'The data gateway received an invalid row.',
36	      details: [],
37	      cause: row,
38	    });
39	  }
40	  return mapper(row as Record<string, unknown>);
41	}

123	/**
124	 * استخراج الأعمدة المباشرة المجهزة لقاعدة البيانات بنظافة وأمان
125	 * Safely extract direct relational columns for Supabase REST queries
126	 */
127	export function extractDirectColumns(table: string, data: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {
128	  const mapping = DIRECT_COLUMNS_MAP[table];
129	  if (!mapping || !data || typeof data !== 'object') return {};
130	  const extracted: Record<string, any> = {};
131	  for (const [key, col] of Object.entries(mapping)) {
132	    let val: any = undefined;
133	    if (data[key] !== undefined) {
134	      val = data[key];
135	    } else if (data[col] !== undefined) {
136	      val = data[col];
137	    }
138	
139	    if (val !== undefined) {
140	      // تحويل المفاتيح الأجنبية الفارغة أو المسافات والتواريخ الفارغة إلى null لتفادي أخطاء القيود والأنواع بقاعدة البيانات
141	      // Convert empty string or whitespace foreign keys, dates, and timestamps to null so Postgres FK & type check succeeds
142	      if (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '') {
143	        if (
144	          col.endsWith('_id') ||
145	          col === 'cur_no' ||
146	          col.endsWith('_at') ||
147	          col.endsWith('At') ||
148	          col.endsWith('_date') ||
149	          col.endsWith('Date')
150	        ) {
151	          val = null;
152	        }
153	      }
154	      if (key === 'disabled' && (table === 'customers' || table === 'couriers')) {
155	        extracted[col] = !val;
156	      } else if (
157	        col.endsWith('_at') ||
158	        col.endsWith('At') ||
159	        col.endsWith('_date') ||
160	        col.endsWith('Date') ||
161	        col === 'lastRecalculatedAt' ||
162	        col === 'effective_at' ||
163	        col === 'posted_at' ||
164	        col === 'voided_at' ||
165	        col === 'processed_at' ||
166	        col === 'returned_at'
167	      ) {
168	        if (val === null || val === undefined || (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() === '')) {
169	          extracted[col] = null;
170	        } else if (typeof val === 'number') {
171	          extracted[col] = new Date(val).toISOString();
172	        } else if (typeof val === 'string') {
173	          const trimmed = val.trim();
174	          if (/^\d+$/.test(trimmed)) {
175	            extracted[col] = new Date(Number(trimmed)).toISOString();
176	          } else {
177	            const parsed = Date.parse(trimmed);
178	            extracted[col] = !isNaN(parsed) ? new Date(parsed).toISOString() : null;
179	          }
180	        } else {
181	          extracted[col] = val;
182	        }
183	      } else {
184	        extracted[col] = val;
185	      }
186	    }
187	  }
188	
189	  // Safety checks for foreign key ID columns
190	  if (table === 'orders') {
191	    const rawStatus = extracted['order_status_id'];
192	    if (rawStatus === undefined || rawStatus === null || String(rawStatus).trim() === '' || String(rawStatus).trim() === '0') {
193	      extracted['order_status_id'] = '1';
194	    } else {
195	      extracted['order_status_id'] = String(rawStatus);
196	    }
197	    if (typeof extracted['customer_id'] === 'string' && extracted['customer_id'].trim() === '') {
198	      extracted['customer_id'] = null;
199	    }
200	    if (typeof extracted['order_source_id'] === 'string' && extracted['order_source_id'].trim() === '') {
201	      extracted['order_source_id'] = null;
202	    }
203	    if (typeof extracted['delivery_courier_id'] === 'string' && extracted['delivery_courier_id'].trim() === '') {
204	      extracted['delivery_courier_id'] = null;
205	    }
206	    if (typeof extracted['shipping_courier_id'] === 'string' && extracted['shipping_courier_id'].trim() === '') {
207	      extracted['shipping_courier_id'] = null;
208	    }
209	  }
210	
211	  return extracted;
212	}

163	// Helpers
164	export function normalizePayload(table: string, payload: any): any {
165	  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return payload;
166	
167	  // Specific normalization for 'roles' permissions field
168	  if (table === 'roles' && payload.permissions) {
169	    if (typeof payload.permissions === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payload.permissions)) {
170	      payload.permissions = Object.values(payload.permissions);
171	    }
172	  }
173	
174	  // Generic object-to-array conversion for objects representing array maps (e.g. { "0": "...", "1": "..." })
175	  if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
176	    return payload.map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
177	  }
178	
179	  const keys = Object.keys(payload);
180	  for (const k of keys) {
181	    const val = payload[k];
182	    if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
183	      if (Array.isArray(val)) {
184	        payload[k] = val.map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
185	      } else {
186	        const subKeys = Object.keys(val);
187	        const isArrayMap = subKeys.length > 0 && subKeys.every(key => !isNaN(Number(key)));
188	        if (isArrayMap) {
189	          payload[k] = Object.values(val).map(item => normalizePayload(table, item));
190	        } else {
191	          payload[k] = normalizePayload(table, val);
192	        }
193	      }
194	    }
195	  }
196	
197	  return payload;
198	}
199	
200	export function cleanData(obj: any): any {
201	  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj;
202	  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
203	    return obj.map(item => cleanData(item));
204	  }
205	  if (typeof obj === 'object') {
206	    if (obj._methodName === 'serverTimestamp') {
207	      return Date.now();
208	    }
209	    // Specific custom classes used in PostgreSQL updates
210	    if (obj.constructor?.name === 'IncrementValue' || obj.constructor?.name === 'ArrayUnionValue') {
211	      return obj;
212	    }
213	    const clean: any = {};
214	    for (const k of Object.keys(obj)) {
215	      clean[k] = cleanData(obj[k]);
216	    }
217	    return clean;
218	  }
219	  return obj;
220	}

386	    }
387	  };
388	
389	  // Reorder Pages (Up / Down)
390	  const handleMoveOrder = async (page: BrowserPageItem, direction: 'up' | 'down', e: React.MouseEvent) => {
391	    e.stopPropagation();
392	    const currentIndex = filteredPages.findIndex(p => p.id === page.id);
393	    if (currentIndex === -1) return;
394	    const targetIndex = direction === 'up' ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
395	    if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= filteredPages.length) return;
396	
397	    const otherPage = filteredPages[targetIndex];
398	
399	    try {
400	      const currentSort = page.sortOrder || currentIndex;
401	      const otherSort = otherPage.sortOrder || targetIndex;
402	
403	      // Swap sortOrders
404	      if (!page.id.startsWith('auto_')) {
405	        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'browser_pages', page.id), { sortOrder: otherSort });
406	      }
407	      if (!otherPage.id.startsWith('auto_')) {
408	        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'browser_pages', otherPage.id), { sortOrder: currentSort });
409	      }
410	    } catch (err: any) {
411	      console.error('Error reordering pages:', err);
412	    }
413	  };
414	
415	  // Delete Page
416	  const handleDeletePage = async (page: BrowserPageItem, e: React.MouseEvent) => {

419	
420	    try {
421	      if (!page.id.startsWith('auto_')) {
422	        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'browser_pages', page.id));
423	      }
424	      toast.success(isAr ? 'تم حذف الصفحة' : 'Page deleted');
425	      if (activePage?.id === page.id) {
426	        setActivePage(null);
427	      }
428	    } catch (err: any) {

430	    }
431	  };

59	const money = (value: unknown) => Math.round((Number(value) || 0) * 100) / 100;
60	
61	export function calculateShipmentCategoryFees(category: Partial<ItemCategory> | undefined, cartonCount: unknown): ShipmentCategoryFees {
62	  const cartons = Math.max(0, money(cartonCount));
63	  const customsFee = money(cartons * money(category?.customsPerCarton));
64	  const taxFee = money(cartons * money(category?.taxPerCarton));
65	  const otherCategoryFee = money(cartons * money(category?.otherFeesPerCarton));
66	  return {
67	    cartonCount: cartons,
68	    customsFee,
69	    taxFee,
70	    otherCategoryFee,
71	    total: money(customsFee + taxFee + otherCategoryFee),
72	    currency: category?.feeCurrency || 'SAR',
73	  };
74	}

1	import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
2	import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
3	import { portalUserService } from '../../../services/portalUserService';
4	import { siteContentService, type AnnouncementRow, type JobApplicationRow, type PortalOrderRow, type SupportTicketRow } from '../../../services/siteContentService';
5	import { asyncState, runQuery, type AsyncState } from '../../../shared/contracts/ui.contracts';
6	
7	type WebsiteManagementQueryResult = {
8	  enrichedUsers: any[];
9	  portalOrders: PortalOrderRow[];
10	  tickets: SupportTicketRow[];
11	  announcements: AnnouncementRow[];
12	  jobApplications: JobApplicationRow[];
13	};
14	
15	/**
16	 * بيانات صفحة إدارة الموقع — كل مصدر يقرأ من alx_api فقط، وترتيب الأحدث أولًا صار خادميًا.
17	 * Website management data: every source reads through alx_api, and the newest-first ordering is done server-side.
18	 */
19	export function useWebsiteManagementData(isAr: boolean) {
20	  const [queryState, setQueryState] = useState<AsyncState<WebsiteManagementQueryResult>>(asyncState.loading());
21	  const loading = queryState.status === 'loading';
22	  const setLoading = (value: boolean) => setQueryState(value ? asyncState.loading() : asyncState.idle());
23	  const [portalUsers, setPortalUsers] = useState<any[]>([]);
24	  const [portalOrders, setPortalOrders] = useState<PortalOrderRow[]>([]);
25	  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<SupportTicketRow[]>([]);
26	  const [announcements, setAnnouncements] = useState<AnnouncementRow[]>([]);
27	  const [jobApplications, setJobApplications] = useState<JobApplicationRow[]>([]);
28	
29	  const loadAllData = useCallback(async () => {
30	    const result = await runQuery(async () => {
31	      const [enrichedUsers, orders, tick, ann, jobs] = await Promise.all([
32	        portalUserService.getPortalUsers(),
33	        siteContentService.listPortalOrders(),
34	        siteContentService.listTickets(),
35	        siteContentService.listAnnouncements(),
36	        siteContentService.listJobApplications(),
37	      ]);
38	      return { enrichedUsers, portalOrders: orders, tickets: tick, announcements: ann, jobApplications: jobs };
39	    }, setQueryState, () => false);
40	
41	    if (result.status === 'success') {
42	      setPortalUsers(result.data.enrichedUsers);
43	      setPortalOrders(result.data.portalOrders);
44	      setTickets(result.data.tickets);
45	      setAnnouncements(result.data.announcements);
46	      setJobApplications(result.data.jobApplications);
47	    } else if (result.status === 'error') {
48	      console.error('[WebsiteManagement] Error loading portal data:', result.error);
49	      toast.error(isAr ? 'حدث خطأ أثناء تحميل بيانات الموقع' : 'Error loading portal data');
50	    }
51	  }, [isAr]);
52	
53	  useEffect(() => {
54	    loadAllData();
55	  }, [loadAllData]);
56	
57	  return { loading, setLoading, portalUsers, setPortalUsers, portalOrders, tickets, announcements, jobApplications, loadAllData };
58	}
59	
60	export default useWebsiteManagementData;
61

-- 3. خيارات الطلب / order_option — تفاصيل نصية عادية بلا أي jsonb.
--    Order options keep a plain text details column; older clones stored it as jsonb.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_option' AND column_name = 'data'
  ) THEN
    UPDATE public.order_option
       SET name_ar  = COALESCE(NULLIF(name_ar, ''), data->>'nameAr'),
           name_en  = COALESCE(NULLIF(name_en, ''), data->>'nameEn'),
           code     = COALESCE(NULLIF(code, ''),    data->>'code'),
           type     = COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''),    data->>'type'),
           price    = COALESCE(price,    alx_api_private.payload_number(data, 'price')),
           duration = COALESCE(duration, alx_api_private.cast_integer(data->>'duration'))
     WHERE data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_option'
       AND column_name = 'details' AND data_type = 'jsonb'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_option
      ALTER COLUMN details TYPE text USING (NULLIF(btrim(details #>> '{}'), ''));
  END IF;
END
$$;

4	export function useItemCategories() {
5	  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<ItemCategory[]>(DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES);

9	    setCategories(DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES);

12	
13	  const activeCategories = useMemo(() => categories.filter((category) => category.isActive), [categories]);

16	    const id = `cat_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
17	    const newCategory: ItemCategory = { ...payload, id, createdAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now() };
18	    setCategories(prev => [...prev, newCategory]);
19	  };
20	
21	  const updateCategory = async (id: string, payload: Partial<ItemCategory>) => {
22	    setCategories(prev => prev.map(cat => cat.id === id ? { ...cat, ...payload, updatedAt: Date.now() } : cat));
23	  };
24	
25	  const deleteCategory = async (id: string) => {
26	    setCategories(prev => prev.filter(cat => cat.id !== id));
27	  };
28	
29	  const toggleCategoryStatus = async (category: ItemCategory) => {
30	    await updateCategory(category.id, { isActive: !category.isActive });
31	  };
32	
33	  return { categories, activeCategories, loading, addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, toggleCategoryStatus };
34	}

[]) as unknown[]) {\n    const row = value as Record<string, unknown> | null;\n    const roleId = typeof row?.role_id === 'string' ? row.role_id : '';\n    const code = typeof row?.permission_code === 'string' ? row.permission_code : '';\n    if (!roleId || !code) continue;\n    const codes = grouped.get(roleId);\n    if (codes) codes.push(code);\n    else grouped.set(roleId, [code]);\n  }\n  return grouped;\n}\n\nfunction page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {\n  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);\n  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);\n  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };\n}\n\nexport class CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway implements RolesGateway {\n  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<RoleViewModel>> {\n    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);\n    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);\n    const { data, error, count } = await supabase\n      .from('roles')\n      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS, { count: 'exact' })\n      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);\n    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n    const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[];\n    const grouped = await permissionsByRole(rows.map((row) => String(row.role_id ?? '')));\n    const items = rows.map((row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(String(row.role_id ?? '')) ?? []));\n    return page(items, { ...query, limit, offset }, count);\n  }\n\n  async getById(roleId: string): Promise<RoleViewModel | null> {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('roles')\n      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS)\n      .eq('role_id', roleId)\n      .maybeSingle();\n    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n    if (!data) return null;\n    const grouped = await permissionsByRole([roleId]);\n    return mapRow(data, (row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(roleId) ?? []));\n  }\n\n  async save(role: RoleViewModel): Promise<RoleViewModel> {\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('roles')\n      .upsert({\n        role_id: role.roleId,\n        title: role.title,\n        code: role.code ?? null,\n        description: role.description ?? null,\n        is_default: role.isDefault,\n        created_at: role.createdAt ?? now,\n        updated_at: now,\n        created_by: role.createdBy,\n        updated_by: role.updatedBy,\n      }, { onConflict: 'role_id' })\n      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS)\n      .single();\n    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);\n\n    // استبدال صفوف الصلاحيات بالكامل بدل كتابة مصفوفة داخل الجدول الأب.\n    // The child rows are replaced wholesale (delete by role_id then insert) instead of writing roles.permissions.\n    const codes = [...new Set(role.permissions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0))].sort();\n    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase\n      .from('role_permission')\n      .delete()\n      .eq('role_id', role.roleId);\n    if (deleteError) throw mapSupabaseError(deleteError);\n    if (codes.length > 0) {\n      const { error: insertError } = await supabase\n        .from('role_permission')\n        .insert(codes.map((permission_code) => ({ role_id: role.roleId, permission_code })));\n      if (insertError) throw mapSupabaseError(insertError);\n    }\n\n    return mapRow(data, (row) => mapRole(row, codes));\n  }\n}\n",
  "file_path": "F:/system/swiftship-tracker/swiftshift2/SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM/src/data/current-supabase/gateways/roles.gateway.ts"
}

65	export function calculateShipmentCategoryFees(category: Partial<ItemCategory> | undefined, cartonCount: unknown): ShipmentCategoryFees {
66	  const cartons = Math.max(0, money(cartonCount));
67	  const customsFee = money(cartons * money(category?.customsPerCarton));
68	  const taxFee = money(cartons * money(category?.taxPerCarton));
69	  const otherCategoryFee = money(cartons * money(category?.otherFeesPerCarton));
70	  return {
71	    cartonCount: cartons,
72	    customsFee,
73	    taxFee,
74	    otherCategoryFee,
75	    total: money(customsFee + taxFee + otherCategoryFee),
76	    currency: category?.feeCurrency || 'SAR',
77	  };
78	}

1	import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
2	import { DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES, ItemCategory } from '../services/itemCategoryService';
3	
4	export function useItemCategories() {
5	  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<ItemCategory[]>(DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES);
6	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
7	
8	  useEffect(() => {
9	    setCategories(DEFAULT_ITEM_CATEGORIES);
10	    setLoading(false);
11	  }, []);
12	
13	  const activeCategories = useMemo(() => categories.filter((category) => category.isActive), [categories]);
14	
15	  const addCategory = async (payload: Omit<ItemCategory, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => {
16	    const id = `cat_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
17	    const newCategory: ItemCategory = { ...payload, id, createdAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now() };
18	    setCategories(prev => [...prev, newCategory]);
19	  };
20	
21	  const updateCategory = async (id: string, payload: Partial<ItemCategory>) => {
22	    setCategories(prev => prev.map(cat => cat.id === id ? { ...cat, ...payload, updatedAt: Date.now() } : cat));
23	  };
24	
25	  const deleteCategory = async (id: string) => {
26	    setCategories(prev => prev.filter(cat => cat.id !== id));
27	  };
28	
29	  const toggleCategoryStatus = async (category: ItemCategory) => {
30	    await updateCategory(category.id, { isActive: !category.isActive });
31	  };
32	
33	  return { categories, activeCategories, loading, addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, toggleCategoryStatus };
34	}

42	    const code = typeof row?.permission_code === 'string' ? row.permission_code : '';
43	    if (!roleId || !code) continue;
44	    const codes = grouped.get(roleId);
45	    if (codes) codes.push(code);
46	    else grouped.set(roleId, [code]);
47	  }
48	  return grouped;
49	}

51	function page<T>(items: T[], query: GatewayQuery, count: number | null): GatewayPage<T> {
52	  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
53	  const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
54	  return { items, limit, offset, hasMore: (count ?? offset + items.length) > offset + items.length };
55	}

57	export class CurrentSupabaseRolesGateway implements RolesGateway {
58	  async list(query: GatewayQuery = {}): Promise<GatewayPage<RoleViewModel>> {
59	    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(query.limit ?? 50, 1), 200);
60	    const offset = Math.max(query.offset ?? 0, 0);
61	    const { data, error, count } = await supabase
62	      .from('roles')
63	      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS, { count: 'exact' })
64	      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
65	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
66	    const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[];
67	    const grouped = await permissionsByRole(rows.map((row) => String(row.role_id ?? '')));
68	    const items = rows.map((row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(String(row.role_id ?? '')) ?? []));
69	    return page(items, { ...query, limit, offset }, count);
70	  }
71	
72	  async getById(roleId: string): Promise<RoleViewModel | null> {
73	    const { data, error } = await supabase
74	      .from('roles')
75	      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS)
76	      .eq('role_id', roleId)
77	      .maybeSingle();
78	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
79	    if (!data) return null;
80	    const grouped = await permissionsByRole([roleId]);
81	    return mapRow(data, (row) => mapRole(row, grouped.get(roleId) ?? []));
82	  }
83	
84	  async save(role: RoleViewModel): Promise<RoleViewModel> {
85	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
86	    const { data, error } = await supabase
87	      .from('roles')
88	      .upsert({
89	        role_id: role.roleId,
90	        title: role.title,
91	        code: role.code ?? null,
92	        description: role.description ?? null,
93	        is_default: role.isDefault,
94	        created_at: role.createdAt ?? now,
95	        updated_at: now,
96	        created_by: role.createdBy,
97	        updated_by: role.updatedBy,
98	      }, { onConflict: 'role_id' })
99	      .select(ROLE_COLUMNS)
100	      .single();
101	    if (error) throw mapSupabaseError(error);
102	
103	    // استبدال صفوف الصلاحيات بالكامل بدل كتابة مصفوفة داخل الجدول الأب.
104	    // The child rows are replaced wholesale (delete by role_id then insert) instead of writing roles.permissions.
105	    const codes = [...new Set(role.permissions.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0))].sort();
106	    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase
107	      .from('role_permission')
108	      .delete()
109	      .eq('role_id', role.roleId);
110	    if (deleteError) throw mapSupabaseError(deleteError);
111	    if (codes.length > 0) {
112	      const { error: insertError } = await supabase
113	        .from('role_permission')
114	        .insert(codes.map((permission_code) => ({ role_id: role.roleId, permission_code })));
115	      if (insertError) throw mapSupabaseError(insertError);
116	    }
117	
118	    return mapRow(data, (row) => mapRole(row, codes));
119	  }
120	}

async function upsertCustomerDetails(
  pool: Pool,
  input: { detailId: string; userUid: string; customerId: string; details: PortalCustomerDetailsInput; updatedAt: Date },
): Promise<PortalCustomerDetailsDto | null> {
  const keys = (Object.keys(DETAILS_COLUMNS) as DetailKey[]).filter((key) => input.details[key] !== undefined);
  if (keys.length === 0) {
    const existing = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(detailsSelectSql, [input.detailId]);
    return existing.rows[0] ? mapDetails(existing.rows[0]) : null;
  }

  const columns = ['cust_detail_id', 'user_uid', 'customer_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at', ...keys.map((key) => DETAILS_COLUMNS[key])];
  const values: unknown[] = [input.detailId, input.userUid, input.customerId, input.updatedAt, input.updatedAt];
  for (const key of keys) {
    const value = input.details[key];
    values.push(key === 'preferredCategories' && Array.isArray(value)
      ? (value as readonly string[]).map((item) => String(item).trim()).filter((item) => item !== '')
      : value);
  }

  const placeholders = values.map((_, index) => `$${index + 1}`).join(', ');
  const updates = keys.map((key) => `${DETAILS_COLUMNS[key]} = EXCLUDED.${DETAILS_COLUMNS[key]}`).join(', ');
  // updated_at لا يُشتق من نص مستخدم؛ يُمرر كمعامل رقمي في الموضع الصحيح.
  // updated_at is a bound parameter, never interpolated text.
  const updatedAtPlaceholder = `$${columns.indexOf('updated_at') + 1}`;

  await pool.query(
    `INSERT INTO public.cust_details (${columns.join(', ')}) VALUES (${placeholders})
       ON CONFLICT (cust_detail_id) DO UPDATE SET ${updates}, updated_at = ${updatedAtPlaceholder}`,
    values,
  );

  const result = await pool.query<Record<string, unknown>>(detailsSelectSql, [input.detailId]);
  return result.rows[0] ? mapDetails(result.rows[0]) : null;
}

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. فئات الأصناف: مجموعة الفئة وأعلام المراجعة كانت داخل items_category.details.
--    Item categories: the group label and the review flags lived inside details jsonb.
--    العمود group_name أُنشئ في 0029 لكن بقيت أعلام المراجعة بلا قيم، فالتعبئة تُعاد بأمان.
--    group_name came from 0029; the review flags never got their values, so the fill is repeated safely.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
UPDATE public.items_category
   SET group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(group_name, ''), NULLIF(btrim(details->>'group'), ''))
 WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object';

-- المفتاحان hazardReview/highValueReview لم يُنقلا إلى أعمدتهما الحقيقية سابقًا.
-- hazardReview/highValueReview were never copied into their first-class columns.
UPDATE public.items_category
   SET requires_hazard_review = CASE WHEN details->>'hazardReview' IN ('true','false')
                                     THEN (details->>'hazardReview')::boolean ELSE requires_hazard_review END,
       requires_high_value_review = CASE WHEN details->>'highValueReview' IN ('true','false')
                                         THEN (details->>'highValueReview')::boolean ELSE requires_high_value_review END
 WHERE details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'
   AND (details ? 'hazardReview' OR details ? 'highValueReview');

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. تفاصيل العميل: كائن الموقع والـ address يصيران أعمدة حقيقية.
--    Customer details: the location document and the address key become columns.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE public.cust_details
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS latitude numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS longitude numeric,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS street text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS governorate text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address_details text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS address text;
